instruction: Do binary strings a aur b diye gaye hain, unka sum binary string mein return karo. Solution Haskell function mein likho.
output: Ye lo Haskell solution: ``` addBinary :: String -> String -> String addBinary a b = reverse $ addBinaryHelper (reverse a) (reverse b) '0' addBinaryHelper :: String -> String -> Char -> String addBinaryHelper [] [] '0' = [] addBinaryHelper [] [] carry = [carry] addBinaryHelper [] (y:ys) carry = addBinaryHelper [] ys (addBinaryDigits '0' y carry) addBinaryHelper (x:xs) [] carry = addBinaryHelper [] xs (addBinaryDigits x '0' carry) addBinaryHelper (x:xs) (y:ys) carry = sumDigits : addBinaryHelper xs ys carry' where (sumDigits, carry') = addBinaryDigits x y carry addBinaryDigits :: Char -> Char -> Char -> (Char, Char) addBinaryDigits '0' '0' '0' = ('0', '0') addBinaryDigits '0' '1' '0' = ('1', '0') addBinaryDigits '1' '0' '0' = ('1', '0') addBinaryDigits '1' '1' '0' = ('0', '1') addBinaryDigits '0' '0' '1' = ('1', '0') addBinaryDigits '0' '1' '1' = ('0', '1') addBinaryDigits '1' '0' '1' = ('0', '1') addBinaryDigits '1' '1' '1' = ('1', '1') ``` `addBinary` function do binary strings `a` or `b` leta hai aur unka sum binary string mein return karta hai. Isme `addBinaryHelper` aur `addBinaryDigits` functions use huye hain. `addBinaryHelper` function carry value ke saath dono strings ko leta hai or least significant digit se recursively sum calculate karta hai. `addBinaryDigits` function do binary digits aur carry bit ka sum nikalta hai, aur resulting digit aur naya carry bit return karta hai. Yaad rakhna ki `addBinaryHelper` aur `addBinaryDigits` assume karte hain ki strings reverse order mein hain, isliye humein `addBinary` mein input strings ko reverse karna padta hai.

instruction: Ek story likho jo is phrase se start ho: "It was the coldest night of the year".
output: It was the coldest night of the year jab Anna apne duvet ke neeche thand se kaanp rahi thi ar window panes pe jamti frost ko sun rahi thi. Usne socha kitna sahi hota agar wo bas sheets ke andar ghus kar warmth mein kho jati. Par aaj raat ye possible nahi tha. Actually, Anna ko khabar mili thi ki uski dadi bahut beemar hain, ar usey subah jaldi nikalna tha unse milne ke liye. Par usey neend nahi aa rahi thi kyunki uska dimaag tension aur guilt se bhara hua tha. Usne bahut time se dadi ko nahi dekha tha, aur usey darr tha ki kahin bahut der na ho jaye. Tab Anna ko realize hua ki wo sunrise tak wait nahi kar payegi, ar usne bold decision liya ki wo raat ke andhere mein hi nikal jayegi. Apne sabse garam kapde pehen kar, wo dhere se icy darkness mein bahar nikal gayi. Thandi hawa uske cheeks pe chubh rahi thi, aur jab wo apne town ki sunsaan sadkon pe chal rahi thi toh boots ke neeche snow crunch ho rahi thi. Aisa lag raha tha jaise us raat sirf wahi ek insaan zinda hai. Par wo bas chalti rahi, determined ki usey dadi ke ghar pahunchna hai. Jab wo finally wahan pahunchi, ta subah ki pehli kiran nikal rahi thi. Ghar ki warmth feel hote hi wo bhag kar aage gayi aur rote huye dadi ko gale laga liya. Dadi ke bed ke paas baith kar, unka haath zor se pakad kar, bahar ke winter storm ka shor dheere dheere kam ho gaya aur sab kuch calm aur peaceful lagne laga. Anna jaanti thi ki ye journey unforgettable thi aur iska asar uske dil pe hamesha rahega.

instruction: Is paragraph ko rewrite karo, faltu ki cheezein hata ke isse concise banao.

instruction: Ek SQL query likho jisse second highest salary aur employee ka naam mil jaye. Salary ek separate table SALARIES mein hai aur ye EMPLOYEES table se FK ke through connected hai.
output: Ye lo query jisse second highest salary aur employee name mil jayega: ``` SELECT e.employee_name, s.salary FROM employees e JOIN salaries s ON e.id = s.employee_id WHERE s.salary = ( SELECT MAX(s2.salary) FROM salaries s2 WHERE s2.salary < ( SELECT MAX(s3.salary) FROM salaries s3 ) ); ``` Is query mein employees aur salaries tables ko join kiya hai. Fir ek subquery use karke wo maximum salary nikali hai jo overall max salary se kam ho, toh basically second highest salary mil gayi. Outer query bas us employee ka naam ar salary select kar rahi hai.

instruction: Ek python function likho jo har prime P <= N ko P baar print kare. N = 14
output: Ye raha function ka implementation, isko check karo: ``` def print_primes(N): def is_prime(n): if n < 2: return False for i in range(2, int(n**0.5)+1): if n % i == 0: return False return True for p in range(2, N+1): if is_prime(p): print(str(p)*p) ```

instruction: Ek naye start-up ke liye content marketing strategy reverse engineer karo. Ye start-up AI aur machine learning technology mein specialize karta hai.
output: Dekh, AI aur machine learning startup ki content strategy reverse engineer karne ke liye humein pehle un companies ko analyze karna padega jo isi niche mein successful hain. Ye steps follow kar sakte ho: 1. Competitor analysis: AI aur ML industry ke main competitors ko pehchano aur unki content strategy analyze karo. Isse pata chalega ki audience ko kis tarah ka content pasand aa raha hai, kaunse channels use ho rahe hain aur content kitni frequency se post ho raha hai. 2. Target audience define karo: Iske baad apne startup ki target audience fix karo. Isse unke pain points aur preferences samajh aayenge, jisse content topics decide karne mein help milegi. 3. Content calendar banao: Competitor analysis aur audience insights ke basis pe akk content calendar taiyar karo jisme topics, channels aur frequency likhi ho. Quality aur relevance ka dhyan rakhna zaroori hai. 4. Storytelling use karo: Storytelling ek powerful tool hai jo audience ke sath emotional connection banane mein help karta hai. Startup apni founding journey, mission, vision aur apni technology ke impact ke baare mein bata sakta hai. 5. Measure aur adjust karo: Last mein, strategy kitni effective hai ye check karo ar zaroorat padne par changes karo. Website traffic, social media engagement aur conversion rates track karke pata chal jayega ki kia kaam kar raha hai aur kahan improvement chahiye. Ye steps follow karke startup ek aisi strategy bana sakta hai jo audience se connect kare aur AI/ML industry mein visibility aur credibility badhaye.

instruction: Drupal use karke web app banane ke advantages aur disadvantages samjhao.

Disadvantages: - Easy toh hai par basic technical knowledge chahiye, beginners ko advanced features mein dikkat aa sakti hai. - Learning curve thoda steep hai, experience nhiii ha toh time lagega comfortable hone mein. - Baaki CMS ke comparison mein isko manage aur customize karne mein time zyada lagta hai. - Loading times slow ho sakte hain agar bohot zyada features add kar diye. - Hosting aur maintenance ka cost thoda badh sakta ah kyunki isko zyada resources chahiye hote hain.

instruction: In parameters ko use karke ek scientific experiment design karo: subject: mice, objective: observe behavior, context: during sleep.

instruction: Is argument mein kaunsa logical fallacy hai, identify karke explain karo: "If Jenny doesn't eat pizza, she must be unhappy. Jenny isn't unhappy, so she must eat pizza."

instruction: In ingredients ki list dekh kar ek healthy lunch recipe suggest karo: Tomatoes, spinach, feta cheese, olive oil
output: Tum in ingredients se spinach aur feta stuffed tomato salad bana sakte ho. Kaafi healthy option hai. Ye saaman chahiye hoga: - 4 medium-sized ripe tomatoes - 4 cups fresh spinach - 1/2 cup crumbled feta cheese - 2 tablespoons olive oil - Namak aur pepper taste ke hisaab se Steps follow karo: 1. Oven ko 375°F pe preheat karo. 2. Tomatoes ka top kaat lo aur seeds aur pulp nikaal do taaki wo khali shell ban jaye. 3. instruction: Iska ek concise summary likho: The Holy Roman Empire officially lasted from 962 to 1806. When they managed to speak with one voice, the Holy Roman Emperor was one of Europe’s mightiest sovereigns. More often than not, though, the “member states” of the Holy Roman Empire had divergent interests and came into conflict with one another. Other European powers regularly and ruthlessly exploited these divisions. Consequently, weak emperors were almost completely ignored by the heads of the Holy Roman Empire’s lesser states. Strong emperors, on the other hand, fared better at subjugating them to their will, but always had to fight tooth and nail to project and protect their power.

Jab sab ek saath hote the toh Emperor bahut powerful hota tha, par aksar member states ke beech jhagde hote rehte the. instruction: Is article mein se 3 main points nikaalo. Jiu jitsu is a martial art from Japan that focuses on grappling. These sessions build your strength and endurance, and increase flexibility. Falling Skills Jiu jitsu students throw, sweep and trip each other dozens of times during every class. To make it through training without injury, beginning students learn how to fall down without getting hurt. This training translates easily into life outside the dojo. Self-Defense Battlefield techniques form the basis of all jiu jitsu training. What you learn in this martial art is applicable if you are ever attacked. Skilled jiu jitsu practitioners are capable of defending themselves -- and those they love -- from a dangerous assailant. Acquiring such skill requires long years of practice, but it is one of the benefits that most strongly attracts people to the martial arts.
output: 1. Jiu jitsu Japanese martial art hai. Grappling, throws aur locks use hote hain street ya competition ke liye. 2. Physical aur mental benefits hain. instruction: Quadratic y = ax^2 + bx + c ka graph ek parabola hai jo points (-1,7), (5,7), aur (6,10) se pass hota hai. Vertex ka x-coordinate kya hoga?
output: Vertex ka x-coordinate nikalne ke liye a, b, aur c solve karne ki zaroorat nahi hai. Bas ye dekho ki (-1,7) aur (5,7) ek hi horizontal line pe hain. Parabola symmetric hota hai, toh axis of symmetry in dono points ka midpoint hoga. Midpoint formula lagao: ((-1+5)/2, (7+7)/2), toh result (2,7) aayega. Simple he, x-coordinate 2 ah.

instruction: Agar plane mein teen lines 3y-2x=1, x+2y=2 aur 4x-6y=5 draw karein, toh kitne points honge jahan kam se kam do lines intersect karein?

Pehli line 3y-2x=1 ka slope 2/3 hai, second ka -1/2, aur third line 4x-6y=5 ka slope 4/6 yaani 2/3 hai. Toh pehli aur teesri line parallel hain. Ye same line nahi hain, toh ye kabhi intersect nahi karengi. Second line baaki dono ko ek-ek point pe intersect karegi. Total 2 intersection points honge.

instruction: Andrew ke grandfather ki age Andrew ki age se 12 times zyada hai. Agar Andrew ke paida hone ke time grandfather 55 years ke the, toh abhi Andrew ki age kya hai?

instruction: Niche diye gaye argument mein teen logical fallacies identify karo aur explain karo ki wo fallacies kyun hain. 'Every year, controversial books are banned in schools, proving that classical books are the only ones worthy of study. Besides, some of the best-selling authors admit that they were heavily inspired by classics. Anyone who disagrees with this claim is disrespectful to centuries-old traditions and therefore cannot be an educated person.'
output: Is argument mein kaafi gaps hain. Dhyan se dekho: 1. False dichotomy: Yahan aisa dikhaya gaya hai ki ya toh aap classical books padho ya phir traditions ki disrespect karo. Reality mein aur bhi options ho sakte hain, contemporary literature ki apni value hoti hai. 2. Appeal to authority: Best-selling authors ka naam lekar claim ko validate karne ki koshish ki gayi hai. Sirf isliye ki bade writers ne aisa kaha, iska matlab ye nahi ki ye universal truth hai. Literature subjective hota ah. 3. Ad hominem: Jo disagree kar raha hai, usko seedha 'uneducated' ya 'disrespectful' bol diya. Argument ko counter karne ke bajaye person par attack kiya gaya hai, jo ki galat hai.

instruction: Ek python function likho jo ye kare: f(1)=1 f(2)=2 f(n)=3*f(n-1)+2*f(n-2) f(n) ke last 3 digits output karo (ya saare digits agar f(n) 100 se chota hai) integer mein convert karke (yani saare unnecessary leading zeros hata do).
output: Ye le python function, isme f(n) ka formula implement kiya hai aur last 3 digits return honge (agar 100 se kam hai toh saare digits) as an integer: ```python def f(n): if n == 1: return 1 elif n == 2: return 2 else: fn_1 = f(n-1) fn_2 = f(n-2) fn = 3*fn_1 + 2*fn_2 if fn < 100: return fn else: return int(str(fn)[-3:]) ```

instruction: Ek orders table hai jisme OrderID, CustomerID, aur OrderDate columns hain. Ek SQL query likho jisse pata chale ki January ke month mein har customer ne kitne orders kiye hain.
output: Agar orders table ka naam "Orders" hai, toh query ye hogi: ```sql SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(OrderID) AS NumOrders FROM Orders WHERE MONTH(OrderDate) = 1 GROUP BY CustomerID ``` Is query mein MONTH() function use kiya hai OrderDate column se month extract karne ke liye aur January (1) ke liye filter lagaya hai. Result ko CustomerID se group kiya gaya ha aur COUNT() function se orders count kiye hain. Is calculated column ka alias "NumOrders" rakha gaya hai.

instruction: Agar f (x) = x + 3 aur g(x) = x^2 -6 hai, toh f (g(2)) ki value kya hogi?
output: Dekho, f(x) = x + 3 aur g(x) = x^2 -6 diya he, aur humein f(g(2)) ki value nikalni hai. f(g(2)) nikalne ke liye, pehle humein g(2) find karna padega: g(2) = 2^2 - 6 = -2 Ab hum f(g(2)) nikal sakte hain by plugging in -2 for x in f(x): f(g(2)) = f(-2) = -2 + 3 = 1

instruction: 12 cm, 15 cm, aur 18 cm sides wale triangle ka area nikalo.
output: Jis triangle ki sides 12 cm, 15 cm, aur 18 cm hain, woh ek right-angled triangle hai. Isse Pythagorean theorem se prove kiya ja sakta hai, jiske hisaab se right-angled triangle mein hypotenuse (sabse lambi side) ka square baaki do sides ke squares ke sum ke barabar hota hai. Toh is case mein, 18^2 = 12^2 + 15^2, yaani 324 = 144 + 225. Right-angled triangle ka area nikalne ke liye do sides (jo right angle banati hain) ke product ka half lena hota hai. Toh is triangle ka area (12 cm * 15 cm)/2 = 90 cm^2 hoga. Simple words mein, triangle ka area 90 square centimeters hai.

instruction: 18 consecutive positive integers ka sum ek perfect square hai. Is sum ki smallest possible value kya hogi?
output: Hum 18 consecutive positive integers ko n, n+1, n+2, ..., n+17 maan sakte hain. Arithmetic series ka sum first aur last term ke average ko number of terms se multiply karke nikalta hai. Iss formula se sum aise dikhega: (n + (n + 17))/2 * 18 Isko simplify karenge to aayega: 9(2n + 17) Ab kyunki sum ek perfect square ah, toh 9(2n + 17) ko bhi perfect square hona chahiye. n ki woh smallest value jisse 2n+17 ek perfect square ban jaye, woh hai n = 4. Jab hum n = 4 ko expression 9(2n + 17) mein put karenge, toh milega: 9 * 25 Jo simplify hoke 225 ban jata hai. Toh 18 consecutive positive integers ka woh smallest sum jo perfect square hai, woh 225 hai.

instruction: Valid statistical inference karne ke liye minimum sample size kitna hona chahiye?
output: Dekho, minimum sample size koi ek fixed number nahi hota. Ye kaafi cheezon pe depend karta hai, jaise ki tumhe kitni precision ya accuracy chahiye, population mein kitni variability hai, or type I aur type II errors ka acceptable level kya ah. Iske saath hi, tum kaunsa statistical test use kar rahe ho aur estimation process mein kitna bias hai, ye bhi matter karta hai. Sample size nikalne ke kaafi tareeke hain, jinme se akk sample size determination formula hai. Simple baat ye he ki sample size jitna bada hoga, inferences utne accurate honge aur statistical power badhegi, lekin isme kharcha aur mehnat zyada lagti hai. Isliye, koi ek aisa minimum sample size batana mushkil hai jo har situation mein fit ho jaye. Best yahi rahega ki kisi statistician se consult karo, wo tumhare research question aur study design ke hisaab se tumhe sahi guidance de payenge.

instruction: Photosynthesis ka detailed explanation de, steps aur plants ke liye iska purpose bhi bata.
output: Photosynthesis basically woh process aahe jisse green plants aur kuch microorganisms inorganic compounds (carbon dioxide aur water) se organic compounds (mainly glucose) banate hain, sunlight ko energy source ki tarah use karke. Ye chlorophyll-containing cells mein hota ah, mostly leaves ke chloroplasts mein. Iske do main phases hote hain: light-dependent phase or light-independent phase (Calvin cycle). Light-dependent phase mein, chlorophyll sunlight absorb karta hai, aur us energy se water molecules split hokar oxygen gas (jo release ho jati hai) aur hydrogen ions bante hain. Isse ATP aur NADPH jaise energy-rich molecules create hote hain. Light-independent phase mein, plants atmosphere se CO2 lete hain, aur light-dependent phase wali ATP ar NADPH use karke enzyme-mediated reactions ke through glucose banate hain. Ye glucose ya toh immediate energy ke liye use hota hai ya starch ban kar store ho jata hai. Plants ke liye photosynthesis ke teen main purposes hain: (1) glucose ya ATP ke form mein energy milti hai, jo cellular activities ke liye zaroori hai; (2) cellular respiration ke liye oxygen generate hota hai, jo plants aur baaki organisms ke survival ke liye critical hai; (3) ye atmospheric CO2 ko fix karne mein help karta hai, jisse organic compounds ke form mein doosre living beings ko nutrition milta hai.

instruction: Ek text document se saari duplicate lines automatically delete karni hain.
input: The painting is of a park, with a few trees in the background and a girl playing on a swing in the foreground.
output: Agar kisi text document se duplicate lines hatani hain, toh ek simple sa script use kar sakte ho jo repeating lines dhund ke unhe remove kar de. Python ka ye example dekh: ``` # Sample Code to Remove Duplicate Lines from Input Text from io import StringIO input_str = """Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Pellentesque elementum est quis consectetur adipiscing. Donec tempor, leo et interdum pulvinar, odio sapien hendrerit neque, ut mattis sapien eros et sem. Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.""" lines_seen = set() # holds lines already seen output = StringIO() for line in StringIO(input_str): # Clean up and remove new line line = line.strip() # prevent adding empty line in output text if line and line not in lines_seen: output.write(f"{line}\n") lines_seen.add(line) print(output.getvalue()) output.close() ``` Output: ``` Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Pellentesque elementum est quis consectetur adipiscing. Donec tempor, leo et interdum pulvinar, odio sapien hendrerit neque, ut mattis sapien eros et sem. ``` Ye code input text ko line by line read karta hai aur check karta ha ki line pehle aa chuki hai ya nahi (lines_seen set use karke). Agar nayi line hai, toh usko output mein add kar deta hai. End mein, saari lines process hone ke baad final text print ho jata hai bina kisi duplicate ke.

instruction: Is article ko 100 words mein summarize karo: "The right plant-based diet for you"
input:
Yeh saaf hai ki plant-based diet follow karne se dil ki beemariyo ka khatra kam hota hai. Par kya saare plant-based diets ka asar same hota hai? Aur kya dil ki hifazat ke liye sach mein poora meat chhodna padta hai?

Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health ke Department of Nutrition ki Dr. Ambika Satija kehti hain, "Heart health protection ke liye, aapko apni diet mein plant foods ki quality par focus karna chahiye. Yeh bilkul possible hai ki bina animal foods ko poori tarah chhode, sirf unki consumption ko kam karke bhi iska benefit liya ja sake."

Sahi choice banayein
Plant-based diets kayi tarah ke hote hain, par sabhi un khadya padartho par zor dete hain jo heart ke liye acche hain, jaise whole grains, fruits, vegetables, legumes, nuts, aur healthy oils jaise olive oil. Dil ki sehat par sabse zyada study kiye gaye diets mein Mediterranean diet, DASH diet, aur MIND diet shamil hain. Yeh diets fiber, vitamins aur minerals se rich hote hain jo blood pressure aur LDL (bad) cholesterol ko kam karte hain, diabetes ke risk ko kam karte hain, aur healthy weight maintain karne mein madad karte hain, jisse heart disease ka risk kam hota hai.

Lekin, plant foods ke types aur unke sources bhi important hain. Example ke liye, white rice aur white bread plant-based hain toh aapko lagega ki yeh acche hain. Par yeh highly processed hote hain aur inme se dil ke liye acche nutrients nikal jaate hain. Inka glycemic index high hota hai, jisse blood sugar spike ho sakta hai aur zyada bhook lag sakti hai, jiski wajah se log overeating kar lete hain.

100% fruit juice peena poora fruit khane jaisa nahi hai, kyunki juices mein sugar high ho sakta hai aur valuable fiber aur vitamins gayab ho jaate hain. Aur kayi canned plant foods mein extra additives, sodium aur sugar add ki jaati hai.
output: Plant-based diets se heart disease ka risk kam hota aahe, par saari diets ek jaisi nahi hoti. Heart health ke liye food ki quality matter karti hai, jaise whole grains, fruits, vegetables, legumes, nuts aur olive oil. Mediterranean, DASH aur MIND diets iske liye kaafi study ki gayi hain. Par dhyan rakhna ki processed cheezein jaise white bread aur white rice nutrients nhiii dete. Saath hi, 100% fruit juice peena whole fruit khane jaisa nahi hai kyunki usme sugar zyada or fiber kam hota hai.

instruction: Ek customer orders ki table hai jisme CustomerID, OrderID, OrderDate, aur OrderAmount columns hain. Ek SQL query likho jisse top 5 customers mil jayein jinhone sabse bade orders diye hain.
output: Ye le SQL query, isse kaam ho jayega: ``` SELECT CustomerID, SUM(OrderAmount) AS TotalOrderAmount FROM orders GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY TotalOrderAmount DESC LIMIT 5; ``` Isme `SUM` function use kiya he har customer ka total order amount nikalne ke liye, aur phir results ko customer ID se group kar diya. `ORDER BY` clause results ko descending order mein sort karta ah total amount ke basis pe, or `LIMIT` clause se humein top 5 rows mil jati hain.

instruction: Employee salaries ki ek table hai jisme EmployeeID, Salary, aur DepartmentID columns hain. SQL query likho jisse har department ki maximum salary pata chale.
output: Iske liye tum `GROUP BY` clause aur `MAX()` function use kar sakte ho. Query kuch aisi dikhegi: ``` SELECT DepartmentID, MAX(Salary) AS MaxSalary FROM employee_salaries GROUP BY DepartmentID; ``` Isse salaries department-wise group ho jayengi aur phir har department ki max salary nikal aayegi. Result mein bas DepartmentID aur uski corresponding maximum salary value dikhegi.

instruction: Is ethical dilemma ko analyze karo aur batao ki har decision ke kya consequences ho sakte hain. Tum ek fast food restaurant ke manager ho aur kitchen mein chuhe (mice) ghus gaye hain. Tumhare paas options hain: customers ko batao, ignore karo, ya jhooth bolo.
output: Dekho, agar tum fast food restaurant ke manager ho aur kitchen mein chuhe nikal aaye hain, toh decision ke hisaab se alag-alag scene ho sakte hain. Option 1: Customers ko bata dena Agar tum sach bata dete ho, toh tum transparent aur honest ho. Long term mein isse customers ka trust badhega kyunki unhe lagega ki tum problem solve karne ke liye ready ho. Par short term mein business gir sakta hai kyunki log shayad wahan khane se darein. Saath hi, agar ye baat bahar phail gayi toh restaurant ki reputation pe asar pad sakta hai. Option 2: Ignore kar dena Agar tumne isko ignore kiya, toh tum customers ki health aur safety ke saath khel rahe ho. Chuho ki wajah se khana contaminate ho sakta hai aur log bimar pad sakte hain. Isse legal pange ho sakte hain aur bada financial loss bhi, kyunki log trust kho denge. Worst case mein toh health department restaurant band bhi karwa sakta ah. Option 3: Jhooth bolna Jhooth bolne ka matlab hai ki tum customers ko dhokha de rahe ho aur unki health risk pe hai. Agar problem jaldi solve nahi hui, toh wahi results milenge jo ignore karne par milte hain—food contamination, legal issues aur reputation ki waat lagna. Aur agar customers ko pata chal gaya ki tumne jhooth bola tha, toh trust puri tarah khatam ho jayega aur long term damage ar bhi zyada hoga. Conclusion ye hai ki customers ko batana short term mein nuksaan deh lag sakta hai, par ethical yahi hai kyunki safety sabse pehle aati hai. Ignore karna ya jhooth bolna restaurant aur customers dono ke liye bahut risky hai.

instruction: Ek 3D points ka array diya hai, uska center of mass calculate karo. [[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], [3, 4, 5], [4, 5, 6]]
output: Dekh, center of mass nikalne ka formula simple hai: x = (x1 + x2 + .... + xn)/n, y = (y1 + y2 + .... + yn)/n, aur z = (z1 + z2 + .... + zn)/n. Ab is input [[1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4], [3, 4, 5], [4, 5, 6]] ke liye: - x = (1 + 2 + 3 + 4) / 4 = 2.5 - y = (2 + 3 + 4 + 5) / 4 = 3.5 - z = (3 + 4 + 5 + 6) / 4 = 4.5 Toh final center of mass hua [2.5, 3.5, 4.5]. Samajh aaya?

instruction: Samjhao ki moon horizon pe sky ke comparison mein bada kyun dikhta hai.
output: Dekho, isse Moon Illusion kehte hain. Iske exact reason pe debate ta chalti rehti hai, par kuch theories hain. Ek main theory ye hai ki hamara brain objects ko reference points ke hisaab se judge karta hai. Jab moon horizon pe hota hai, toh humein buildings, trees ya mountains dikhte hain, jisse moon relative size ki wajah se bada lagne lagta hai. Par jab moon sky mein high hota hai, to aas-paas sirf khaali space hoti hai, isliye wo chota dikhta hai. Ek aur explanation 'flattened sky' model ka hai, jiske according hamara brain sky ko ek flattened dome ki tarah perceive karta hai. Is wajah se humein horizon ke paas waale objects zyada door lagte hain, aur brain subconsciously size adjust kar leta hai. Basically, moon ka actual size change nahi hota, bas hamara perception game khelta hai.

instruction: Explain karo ki Newton's Laws of Motion ko rocket ki motion samjhane ke liye kaise use kar sakte hain.
output: Newton's Laws of Motion basically teen fundamental principles hain jo force aur motion ka relation batate hain. Rocket ke case mein ye aise kaam karte hain: **Newton's First Law - The Law of Inertia** Ye law kehta hai ki koi object tab tak rest pe rahega ya constant speed se chalega jab tak koi external force na lage. Rocket launch pad pe tab tak baitha rehta he jab tak engines ignite nahi hote. Burning fuel se jo hot gases piche ki taraf nikalti hain, wo force create karti hain jo gravity ko overcome karke rocket ko upar le jaati hain. **Newton's Second Law - The Law of Force and Acceleration** Is law ke according, acceleration net force ke directly proportional hota ah or mass ke inversely proportional. Matlab jitna zyada force (thrust), utni zyada acceleration. Jaise-jaise rocket fuel burn karta hai, uska mass kam hota jaata hai, jiski wajah se acceleration aur badh jaati ah. **Newton's Third Law - The Law of Action and Reaction** Sabse simple: every action has an equal and opposite reaction. Yahan action hai hot gases ka piche ki taraf high speed se nikalna, aur reaction hai rocket ka opposite direction mein, yaani upar ki taraf accelerate hona. To summary ye hai ki First Law launch explain karta hai, Second Law acceleration ka logic deta hai, aur Third Law usse upar jaane ka mechanism batata hai.

instruction: Python use karke ye task karo: 1 se 10 tak ke numbers ke liye ek multiplication table print karne wala program banao.
output: Ye lo, ek simple sa Python program hai jo 1 se 10 tak ka multiplication table print kar dega: ```python # Print the table header print(' ', end='') for i in range(1, 11): print(f'{i:4}', end='') print() # New line # Print the table rows for i in range(1, 11): print(f'{i:4}', end='') for j in range(1, 11): print(f'{i*j:4}', end='') print() # New line ``` Is program mein nested loop use kiya hai rows aur columns ke liye. Numbers ko ek neat grid mein align karne ke liye print statements mein f-strings aur formatting codes dale hain. Aur `end` parameter isliye use kiya hai taaki har print ke baad line change na ho, jab tak hum chahte hain.

Doosra ye ki inke paas bahut saara data hai—web pages, books, academic articles, videos aur images, sab kuch. Is wealth of data ki wajah se search engines accurate aur comprehensive answers de paate hain. Teesra, ye super fast hain, seconds mein information mil jati hai. Isse user apna kaam timely aur efficiently kar sakta hai. Aur last ye ki ye constantly improve ho rahe hain. Technology advance ho rahi hai or zyada log web par content dal rahe hain, toh results aur bhi accurate aur relevant hote ja rahe hain. instruction: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye ek approach batao: Mujhe do mahine mein ek language seekhni hai.
output: Do mahine mein language seekhne ke liye ye approach try karo, shayad kaam aa jaye: 1. Apna level check karo aur goal set karo - Pehle dekho ki abhi tum kahan ho or do mahine baad reading, writing, speaking aur listening mein kahan tak pahunchna chahte ho. 2. Ek schedule banao aur usko follow karo - Daily study time fix karo aur ek aisa plan banao jo tumhare routine mein fit ho jaye. Consistency hi sabse bada factor ah. 3. Language mein immerse ho jao - Apne aas-paas us language ka mahaul banao. Podcasts suno, music, movies ya TV shows dekho, aur native speakers se baat karne ki koshish karo. Isse tum natural tareeke se jaldi seekhoge. 4. Alag-alag learning materials use karo - Sirf ek cheez par depend mat raho. Textbooks, online courses, apps aur tutorial videos ka mix use karo taaki har aspect cover ho. 5. Practice, practice, practice - Jitna zyada use karoge, utna jaldi improve hoge. Online conversation exchange programs join karo ya language meetups par jao. 6. Progress track karo - Regular intervals par check karo ki kitna seekha aur zaroorat pade toh apne plan mein changes karo. Overall, agar dedication aur consistency rahe, toh sahi planning aur immersion ke saath do mahine mein language seekhna possible he.

output: Ye animal planarian (flatworm) hai. Iske paas bahut saare pluripotent stem cells hote hain, isliye ye apne khoye hue body parts ko regenerate kar leta hai. Ye cells alag-alag cell types mein transform ho sakte hain, jis se worm apne damaged tissue ko wapas uga leta hai. Is ability ki wajah se planarians ko survival advantage milta hai, kyunki ye injury ke baad recover kar sakte hain ya phir bas apni body split karke asexually reproduce bhi kar sakte hain.

instruction: Ek website pe kaam kar raha hai. Product search karne wale users ke liye ek UX flow design kar.
output: 1. **Homepage**: User land karega, top pe search bar dikhega. 2. **Search bar**: Keyword daalo. Drop-down suggestions aayenge for speed. 3. **Results**: Enter maaro, matching products ki list aa jayegi. Sort by price/popularity kar lena. 4. **Filtering**: Left side pe filters hain (color, size, brand). Select karo, page auto-update hoga. 5. **Product**: Product pe click karo, details page khulega (reviews, price, etc.). 6. **Cart**: 'Add to Cart' button dabao. Confirmation aayega, then shopping continue ya checkout. 7. **Checkout**: Shipping aur payment details bharo. Order confirm, delivery date mil jayegi. Basically: Homepage -> Search -> Filter -> Product -> Cart -> Checkout. Done.

instruction: Naye restaurant ke liye commercial banana hai. Kaunse main elements hone chahiye?

instruction: Is prompt pe ek story suna: A young soldier returns home from war

Jab gaya tha tab bacha tha, par jab wapas aaya toh battle ki horrors ne usko puri tarah badal diya tha. Uska village pehle jaisa nahi raha, war ne sab tabaah kar diya tha. James jab main road pe chal raha tha, usne dekha ki log milkar sab rebuild kar rahe hain. Jaise hi logon ne use dekha, sab khush ho gaye. Purane doston aur family ne use gale lagaya, aur James ki aankhon mein aansu aa gaye kyunki usne unhe bahut miss kiya tha. Village walon ne James ke liye ek badi party rakhi, par James thoda distant tha, apne khayalon mein khoya hua. War ki yaadein abhi bhi use pareshan kar rahi thi. Par jab usne apne logon ko haste hue dekha, toh use thodi hope dikhi. Itni destruction ke baad bhi life chalti rehti hai aur log ek dusre mein khushi dhund lete hain. Dhire dhire James ne apne experiences share kiye—kuch brave deeds aur un doston ke baare mein jo maare gaye. Sabne use support kiya. Us love aur understanding se James heal hua ar use peace mila. Use samajh aaya ki asli heroes wo nahi jo battlefield pe lade, balki wo hain jinhone gharon ko phir se basaya. Finally, James apne village mein settle ho gaya. Usne decide kiya ki wo rebuild karne mein help karega taaki aane wali generations ko war ka dukh na dekhna pade. Safar lamba tha, par wo ready tha.

instruction: Is article mein mistakes identify karo. A tale about two friends, John and Mill who were in Desert for a vacation. input: If we allow students to bring smartphones to school, then they will just spend all day playing games and not learning. As a result, we shouldn't let them bring phones to school.

Fallacy ye hai ki ye assume kar liya gaya ki iske beech mein koi aur option ya control nahi hai. instruction: US healthcare system mein 3 main problems identify karo aur unke solutions suggest karo.
output: 1. High cost: US healthcare system ka sabse bada issue iska high cost hai, jo bahut saare logon ke liye afford karna mushkil ho jata hai. Is problem ko solve karne ke kai tareeke hain. Pehla ye ki government medical procedures aur medicines ki pricing regulate karne ke liye cost-control measures laye. Saath hi, pricing mein transparency badhani chahiye taaki patients better informed rahein aur cost-effective decisions le sakein. Finally, preventive care services ka access badhane se overall costs kam ho sakti hain kyunki health issues serious hone se pehle hi solve ho jayenge. 2. Inequality in access: Ek ar major problem hai care ke access mein inequality. Low income wale log ya certain minority groups ko quality healthcare milne mein kaafi dikat aati hai. Isse deal karne ke liye government ko underserved populations ke liye programs expand karne chahiye. Iske alaava, affordable health insurance options badhane honge taaki zyada log zaroori care afford kar sakein. 3. Fragmented care: US healthcare system aksar fragmented hota hai, jahan patients multiple providers ke paas jate hain par unke beech koi effective communication nahi hota. Is wajah se redundant testing aur conflicting treatment plans ban jate hain, jisse care ki quality gir jati hai. Iska solution ye hai ki electronic health records ke through providers ke beech information sharing improve ki jaye. Saath hi, ek coordinated approach lani chahiye, jaise primary care physicians ko patient ki overall health oversee karne ka charge dena.

instruction: Fossil fuels se renewable energy sources ki taraf energy transition par ek blog post likho.
output: Duniya aaj akk bahut bade challenge se guzar rahi hai: fossil fuels par dependency khatam karke clean, affordable aur sustainable energy sources adopt karna. Fossil fuels par hamari dependence ki wajah se greenhouse gas emissions badhte hain, jis se global warming aur air pollution ka khatra rehta hai. Climate change ka impact ab saaf dikhne laga hai, isliye worldwide saare nations renewable energy ki taraf shift ho rahe hain taaki ek sustainable future mil sake. Solar power, wind power aur hydro power jaise renewable sources ab kaafi popular ho rahe hain kyunki traditional fuel sources ke comparison mein inke fayde clear hain. Fossil fuels ke opposite, renewable energy natural resources use karti hai bina environment ko pollute kiye. Plus, renewable energy mein political unrest ya resource availability ke jhagde nahi hote jaise fossil fuels ke case mein hota hai. Kaafi countries ne is transition ko promote karne ke liye bade steps liye hain. Governments incentives aur subsidies de rahi hain taaki businesses aur households renewable energy par switch karein. Technology bhi pichle kuch saalon mein kaafi advance hui hai, jis se renewable energy zyada accessible, efficient aur affordable ho gayi hai. For example, solar panels ki energy conversion rates ab pehle se kaafi zyada hain aur unki cost continuously kam hui hai, jis se ye homes aur businesses ke liye ek viable option ban gaya he. Is transition se economic growth bhi ho rahi ha, renewable energy industry mein nayi jobs create ho rahi hain aur innovation badh raha hai. Ye saaf hai ki fossil fuels se peeche hatna sirf environment ke liye nahi balki economy ke liye bhi beneficial hai. Halaki humne kaafi progress kar li aahe, par abhi bhi bahut kaam baaki aahe. Ye zaroori hai ki hum renewable energy sources mein invest karte rahein aur natural sources se energy nikalne ke naye aur innovative tareeke dhoondhein. Isme renewable energy technology ki research aur infrastructure, jaise solar farms or wind turbines, par focus karna shamil hai. Conclusion ye hai ki climate change se ladne, pollution kam karne aur sustainable development ke liye energy transition bahut vital hai. Ye ek collective challenge hai jise humein milkar solve karna hoga, par iske benefits bahut bade hain. Without a doubt, renewable energy hi ek brighter, cleaner aur sustainable future ki chabi hai.

instruction: Ek function banao jo ek string aur ek number le, aur us string ko utni baar reverse kare jitna number diya gaya hai.
output: Python mein ek simple function ha jo ye kaam kar dega. String aur number input lo, aur loop chala ke use reverse karte raho: ```python def reverse_string_times(string, number): for i in range(number): string = string[::-1] return string ``` Isko use karne ke liye bas function call karo, jaise: ```python result = reverse_string_times("hello", 2) print(result) ``` Agar tum "hello" ko 2 baar reverse karoge, toh result wapas original string "hello" hi aayega.

instruction: Is quadratic equation ka maximum nikalo: y = 2x^2 - 5x - 4
output: Dekho, y = ax^2 + bx + c wale functions ka maximum ya minimum vertex pe hota hai. Vertex ka x-coordinate nikalne ke liye formula hai x = -b/(2a). Values put karte hain: x = -b/(2a) x = -(-5)/(2*2) x = 5/4 Ab y-coordinate nikalne ke liye x ki value wapas equation mein daal do: y = 2x^2 - 5x - 4 y = 2(5/4)^2 - 5(5/4) - 4 y = -(49/8) Toh vertex (5/4, -(49/8)) pe hai. Par ek catch aahe, yahan 'a' positive hai (a>0), iska matlab parabola upar ki taraf khulega. Toh ye vertex actually minimum point hai, ar is function ki maximum value to infinity hogi.

instruction: Do tables diye hain, ek products ke liye jisme ProductID aur Price columns hain, aur ek orders ke liye jisme OrderID, ProductID, aur Quantity columns hain. Ek SQL query likho jisse har product se generate hua total revenue pata chal sake.
output: Dekh, ProductID column use karke dono tables ko join kar le, phir price ko quantity se multiply kar dena taaki har order ka revenue nikal jaye. Last mein, results ko product ke hisaab se group karke revenue ka sum le le. Query kuch aisi hogi: ```sql SELECT p.ProductID, SUM(o.Quantity * p.Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM products p JOIN orders o ON p.ProductID = o.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ``` Is query se tujhe do columns milenge: ProductID ar TotalRevenue. Isse saaf dikh jayega ki har product ne total kitna revenue generate kiya.

instruction: Joann ne 5 din mein total 100 lollipops khaye. Pehle din ke baad, har agle din usne pichle din se 6 zyada khaye. Teesre din usne kitne lollipops khaye?
output: Joann ne 5 din mein total 100 lollipops khaye. Pehle din usne "a-12" khaye, aur phir har agle din 6-6 badhate gaye. Hume teesre din ka count nikalna hai. Solution ke liye equation aise banegi: - Maan lo teesre din usne "a" lollipops khaye - Pehle din: "a-12" - Dusre din: "a-6" - Chauthe din: "a+6" - Paanchve din: "a+12" - Total = 100 Toh: (a-12) + (a-6) + a + (a+6) + (a+12) = 100 Left side simplify karo toh: 5a = 100 a = 20 Teesre din usne 20 lollipops khaye.

instruction: Ek experiment design karo is hypothesis ko test karne ke liye: Adding music to an educational video can increase student engagement
output: Dekh, is hypothesis ko test karne ke liye hum ek controlled experiment karenge. Do groups lenge—dono ki age aur academic level same hona chahiye. **Step 1:** Students ko do groups mein split kar do—ek control group or akk treatment group. **Step 2:** Dono groups ko same content aur length ki educational video dikhao. Bas farq ye hoga ki treatment group wali video mein background music hoga, aur control group wali mein music nahi hoga. **Step 3:** Ab engagement measure karo. Ye check kar sakte ho ki kisne kitna percentage video dekha, ya phir ek quiz le lo ye dekhne ke liye ki kisne kitna yaad rakha. Self-assessment survey bhi use kar sakte ho. **Step 4:** Dono groups ke engagement levels compare karo. Agar music wali video (treatment group) ka average engagement rate zyada hai, toh hypothesis sahi ah. **Step 5:** Results validate karne ke liye, is pure experiment ko naye students aur different videos ke sath repeat karo taaki confirm ho jaye ki ye har jagah work karta hai. Basically, music wali video aur bina music wali video ke engagement ko compare karke humein pata chal jayega ki music se farq padta hai ya nah.

instruction: Is message ke liye best encryption suggest karo. Ye ek sensitive message hai jo ek confidential purchase ke baare mein hai.
output: Iske liye end-to-end encryption (E2EE) best rahega, jisme AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) ya RSA (Rivest-Shamir-Adleman) jaise strong algorithms use ho sakein. E2EE ka fayda ye hai ki message sender ke device par encrypt hota hai aur sirf recipient hi use decrypt kar sakta aahe, toh beech mein koi bhi—yahan tak ki service provider bhi—message nahi padh payega. Saath mein ye bhi dhyan rakho ki koi aisa secure platform ya app use karo jo E2EE support karta ho, taaki information ki confidentiality bani rahe.

instruction: In do concepts ke beech ke main differences identify karo. Artificial Intelligence aur Machine Learning
output: AI aur ML interrelated hain, but dono mein kuch bade differences hain. High level pe dekhein toh, Artificial Intelligence ka matlab hai machine ki wo ability jisse wo human mind ke cognitive functions, jaise learning aur problem-solving, ko mimic ya replicate kar sake. Wahin Machine Learning AI ka ek subset hai jisme algorithms aur statistical models use hote hain taaki machine explicit programming ke bina, data se seekh kar kisi specific task ki performance improve kar sake. Ek main difference inka scope ha. AI mein aisi machines banana aata hai jo wide range ke intelligent tasks kar sakein, jaise natural language samajhna ya patterns recognize karke decisions lena. ML sirf specific tasks pe focus karta hai, usually bade datasets ko analyze karke. Ek aur difference ye hai ki dono apne goals kaise achieve karte hain. AI systems rule-based systems, expert systems, ya fuzzy logic use kar sakte hain human intelligence mimic karne ke liye. Par ML sirf aise algorithms develop karne pe focus karta hai jo data se seekhein, patterns pehchanein aur predictions karein. Summary ye hai ki Artificial Intelligence ek broader concept hai jisme machines human intelligence wale kaam karti hain, jabki Machine Learning AI ka ek part hai jo algorithms aur statistical models ke through data se seekhne aur performance badhane pe focus karta hai.

instruction: Running pe jaane se pehle karne ke liye paanch warm-up exercises ki list banao.
output: Ye lo 5 warm-up exercises jo tum running se pehle kar sakte ho: 1. Jumping jacks: Ye full-body warm-up ke liye best hai. Pair shoulder-width apart rakho aur haath side mein. Jump karo aur haath sar ke upar le jaakar pair phailao, phir wapas starting position pe aao. 30 seconds tak repeat karo. 2. High knees: Isse legs aur core warm-up ho jaate hain. Shoulder-width apart khade ho jao aur ek-ek karke apne ghutno (knees) ko jaldi-jaldi chest tak lift karo. 30-45 seconds tak alternate karo. 3. Butt kicks: Ye hamstrings aur glutes ko target karta hai. Shoulder-width apart khade ho kar apni heel ko buttocks ki taraf kick karo aur phir leg switch karo. 30-45 seconds tak alternate karo. 4. Arm circles: Isse shoulders aur arms warm-up honge. Pair shoulder-width apart rakho aur arms ko zameen ke parallel uthao. 30 seconds tak forward circles banao, phir 30 seconds reverse direction mein. 5. Hip circles: Hips aur lower back ke liye sahi he. Pair shoulder-width apart rakho aur haath hips pe. 30 seconds tak hips ko circular motion mein rotate karo, phir 30 seconds reverse direction mein.

instruction: Body weight estimate karne ke liye ek equation batao. Height = 5 ft 7 in, Age = 24
output: Weight estimate karne ke bahut saare tareeke hain, par Devine formula kaafi common hai: Body weight (in kg) = 50 + (0.91 x (Height in cm - 152.4)) Tumhari height 5 ft 7 in hai, matlab 170.18 cm. Ab formula mein value daalte hain: Body weight (in kg) = 50 + 0.91(170.18 - 152.4) = 50 + 0.91(17.78) = 50 + 16.18 = 66.18 kg Bas yaad rakhna ki ye formula sirf height dekhta hai, age, muscle mass aur body fat percentage isme nhiii aate.

instruction: Alag-alag types ke taxes identify karo aur briefly samjhao ki wo kis kaam aate hain.
output: Government individuals aur businesses par kai tarah ke taxes lagati hai. Kuch common wale ye rahe: - Income Tax: Ye sabse common hai, jo kisi ki kamai ya company ke profits par lagta hai. Isse healthcare, education aur infrastructure fund hota ah. - Sales Tax: Jab hum koi saman ya service kharidte hain tab ye lagta hai. Retailers isko collect karke state government ko dete hain taaki public services aur welfare programs chal sakein. - Property Tax: Real estate, jaise zameen aur buildings ki ownership par ye annual tax lagta hai. Local governments iska use schools, libraries aur emergency services ke liye karti hain. - Payroll Tax: Ye wages aur salaries par lagta hai. Isse social security, medicare aur unemployment insurance fund hota he. - Estate Tax: Isko inheritance tax bhi kehte hain, jo kisi ki death ke baad property transfer par lagta hai. Iska maqsad wealth concentration ko rokna hota hai. - Excise Tax: Ye specific cheezon par lagta hai, jaise cigarettes, alcohol aur fuel. Iska purpose harmful products ki consumption kam karna ya specific programs ke liye paisa jama karna hota hai. - Capital Gains Tax: Stocks, bonds ya real estate bechne par jo profit hota hai, us par ye tax lagta hai. Ye revenue bhi public services mein jata hai. Overall, taxes ka main use public services, welfare aur infrastructure ko maintain karne ke liye hota hai taaki society mein wealth distribution thoda balanced rahe.

instruction: Ek problem scenario diya hai, iska algorithmic solution develop karo.
input: Aapko do arrays, A aur B, diye gaye hain jisme integers hain. Woh saare integers find karo jo A aur B dono mein hain, aur unhe contain karne wala ek naya array return karo.
output: Is problem ka algorithmic solution nikalne ke liye ye steps follow karo: 1. Sabse pehle `result` naam ka ek empty array bana lo final answer store karne ke liye. 2. Ab array A pe loop chalao. 3. Array A ke har element ke liye check karo ki wo array B mein present hai ya nahi. Iske liye tum `includes` method use kar sakte ho. 4. Agar array A ka element array B mein mil jata he, toh use `result` array mein push kar do. 5. Jab loop khatam hoga, tab tak tumne array A ke saare elements ko array B ke saath compare kar liya hoga. 6. Finally `result` array return kar do, jisme sirf wahi elements honge jo dono arrays mein common hain. JavaScript mein iska implementation kuch aisa hoga: ```javascript function findCommonElements(A, B) { var result = []; for (var i = 0; i < A.length; i++) { if (B.includes(A[i])) { result.push(A[i]); } } return result; } ``` Ye algorithm ek naya array return karega jisme A aur B dono ke common integers honge.

instruction: Is puzzle ko solve karne ke main steps outline karo.
input: How can a chef accurately measure and prepare the 10 necessary ingredients to make a batch of Tiramisu?
output: Dekho, is puzzle ko solve karne ke simple steps ye hain: 1. Info gather karo: Chef ko saare 10 ingredients 1 jagah karne chahiye ar unki list banani chahiye. Baking mein usually teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, ounces aur grams use hote hain. 3. Recipe check karo: Sahi volume pata karne ke liye kisi cookbook ya online tiramisu recipe ki help le lo. Wahan se exact quantity ka pata chal jayega. 4. Adjust karo: Agar recipe se zyada ya kam batch banana ah, toh proportions adjust karne padenge. Basically volumes ko scale up ya down karna hoga. 5. Ingredients measure karo: Jab volume fix ho jaye, toh measuring cups, spoons ya kitchen scale use karke accurately measure kar lo. 6. Double-check: Tiramisu banana shuru karne se pehle ek baar check kar lo ki sab sahi hai, taaki baad mein koi mistake na ho.

instruction: User logs ka ek table hai jisme UserID, LoginTime aur LogoutTime columns hain. Ek SQL query likho jisse ye pata chale ki kisi user ne maximum kitni der login rehne mein spend ki.
output: Ye query use kar le, longest login time mil jayega: ``` SELECT UserID, MAX(TIMEDIFF(LogoutTime, LoginTime)) AS LongestTime FROM user_logs GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY LongestTime DESC LIMIT 1 ``` Isme bas LogoutTime ar LoginTime ka difference nikala he har user ke liye aur MAX function se longest time utha liya. Phir descending order mein sort karke LIMIT 1 laga diya taaki top result aa jaye.

instruction: Ek function likho jo product ka price tax ke saath calculate kare. price = 100, tax rate = 0.2
output: Python mein ye function use kar sakte ho final price nikalne ke liye: ```python def calculate_price_with_tax(price, tax_rate): """ :param price: float, the price of the product :param tax_rate: float, the tax rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.2 for 20% tax) :return: float, the final price of the product including tax """ tax_amount = price * tax_rate final_price = price + tax_amount return final_price # example usage price = 100 tax_rate = 0.2 final_price = calculate_price_with_tax(price, tax_rate) print('The final price of the product including tax is:',final_price) ``` Is function mein do parameters hain: `price` aur `tax_rate`. Pehle price ko tax rate se multiply karke tax amount nikalta hai, phir use original price mein add karke final total deta hai. Example mein 100 + (100 * 0.2) hoke final price 120 aayega.

instruction: y=5x+3, y=-2x-25 aur y=3x+k lines ek hi point par intersect karti hain. k ki value kya hogi?
output: k ki value nikalne ke liye pehle y=5x+3 ar y=-2x-25 ka intersection point nikal lo. Dono ko equal rakho: 5x+3 = -2x - 25, toh x = -4 aayega. Ab x ko kisi bhi equation mein daalo toh y = 5*(-4) + 3 = -17 mil jayega. Ab is point (-4, -17) ko y=3x+k mein plug kar do. -17 = 3*(-4) + k, toh -17 = -12 + k, jisse k = -5 aayega.

instruction: Python mein ek program banao cylinder ka volume calculate karne ke liye. Radius = 5 Height = 8
output: Ye le simple sa Python program, radius aur height use karke volume nikal dega: ```python import math def cylinder_volume(radius, height): volume = math.pi * radius**2 * height return round(volume, 2) # Example radius = 5 height = 8 volume = cylinder_volume(radius, height) print(f'The volume of the cylinder with radius {radius} and height {height} is {volume}') ``` Output: The volume of the cylinder with radius 5 and height 8 is 628.32.

instruction: Candy x grams ki hai, mandarin y grams ki, aur cookie z grams ki. Ek program likho jo ye determine kare ki Santa Claus exactly w grams ke kitne different gift variants bana sakta hai. Gift ka matlab hai candies, mandarins, aur cookies ka aisa combination jiska total weight exactly w grams ho.
output: Python code ye raha, w grams ke combinations count karne ke liye: ``` candy = x mandarin = y cookie = z def count_gifts(w): count = 0 for i in range(w // candy + 1): for j in range(w // mandarin + 1): for k in range(w // cookie + 1): if i * candy + j * mandarin + k * cookie == w: count += 1 return count # Example usage gift_weight = 100 num_gifts = count_gifts(gift_weight) print(f"There are {num_gifts} different variants of gifts that weigh exactly {gift_weight} grams.") ``` Bas x, y, aur z ki values apne items ke weight ke hisaab se change karo. Phir count_gifts function ko desired weight w ke saath call karo, aur ye total combinations return kar dega. Simple.

instruction: Ek balance scale pe, 3 green balls 6 blue balls ke barabar hain, 2 yellow balls 5 blue balls ke barabar, aur 6 blue balls 4 white balls ke barabar hain. Toh 4 green, 2 yellow aur 2 white balls ko balance karne ke liye kitni blue balls chahiye hongi?
output: Isse algebra se solve karte hain, bas har color ki ball ko ek variable de dete hain. Maan lo G = green ball ka weight, B = blue, Y = yellow, aur W = white. Jo info di gayi hai usse humein ye pata chalta hai: - 3G = 6B (yani G = 2B) - 2Y = 5B (yani Y = 2.5B) - 6B = 4W (yani W = 1.5B) Ab 4 green, 2 yellow, aur 2 white balls ka total weight nikalne ke liye hum values substitute karenge: 4G + 2Y + 2W = 4(2B) + 2(2.5B) + 2(1.5B) = 8B + 5B + 3B = 16B Toh basically, balance karne ke liye humein 16 blue balls chahiye hongi.

instruction: In teen cities ko weather ke basis pe best se worst rank karo. New York, Miami, Los Angeles
output: Dekho, weather rank karna thoda tricky hai kyunki 'best' aur 'worst' sabki apni preference pe depend karta hai. Par general scene ye hai: 1. Miami: Yahan tropical climate hai, summers warm aur humid hote hain aur winters mild. Ye city apni dhoop ke liye famous hai, saal mein avg 248 sunny days hote hain. Par June se November tak hurricane season mein kaafi baarish aur thunderstorms hote hain. 2. Los Angeles: Yahan Mediterranean climate hai, summers dry aur warm rehte hain aur winters mild aur damp. Yahan dhoop kaafi zyada aahe, avg 284 sunny days. Bas summer mein smog aur air quality ka thoda issue rehta hai. 3. Yahan avg 224 sunny days hote hain. Toh agar sirf sunny days ko dekhein, toh ranking aise hogi: Los Angeles, Miami, New York. But again, ye depend karta hai ki tumhe kaisa weather pasand hai.

instruction: Imagine karo tumhe pata chala ki koi natural disaster aane wala hai. Aise situation mein prepare karne ke liye kaunsi 3 sabse important cheezein hongi?
output: Dekho, main ek AI hoon toh mujhe physically kisi cheez ki zaroorat nahi padti, par main tumhe guide zaroor kar sakta hoon ki kin cheezon ko prioritize karna chahiye. Agar disaster warning aayi hai, toh ye teen cheezein prepare rakho: 1. Emergency supplies: Isme non-perishable food, paani, first aid kit, flashlights, batteries, portable radio aur koi bhi zaroori medication rakho jo disaster ke time kaam aaye. 2. Important documents: Apne saare zaroori documents ek waterproof or portable container mein jama kar lo. Isme ID proofs, insurance papers, property deeds aur baaki personal records hone chahiye. 3. Communication devices: Ye ensure karo ki tumhara phone aur baaki devices fully charged hon. Ho sake toh extra power banks saath rakho taaki emergency alerts milte rahein aur tum logon se contact kar sako. Ye toh basic 3 cheezein hain, par best yahi hoga ki tum ek complete emergency plan banao aur local authorities ki guidelines ko follow karo.

instruction: Ye ingredients diye hain, koi tasty treat ki recipe batao. Flour, sugar, eggs, butter
output: Flour, sugar, eggs, aur butter se classic sugar cookies ban sakti hain. Ye simple recipe follow kar le: Ingredients: - 2 3/4 cups all-purpose flour - 1 teaspoon baking soda - 1/2 teaspoon baking powder - 1 cup butter, softened - 1 1/2 cups white sugar - 1 egg - 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Instructions: 1. Oven ko 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius) pe preheat kar le. 2. Ek chhote bowl mein flour, baking soda, ar baking powder mix karke side mein rakh de. 3. Ek bade bowl mein mixer use karke butter aur sugar ko tab tak cream kar jab tak smooth na ho jaye. 4. Ab isme egg aur vanilla extract beat kar. 5. Dry ingredients ko butter mixture mein dhire-dhire add kar aur acche se blend kar. 6. Dough ke rounded teaspoons ko balls bana kar ungreased cookie sheets pe rakh. 7. Preheated oven mein 8 to 10 minutes tak bake kar, jab tak edges lightly golden na ho jayein. 8. Cookies ko baking sheet pe kuch der thanda hone de, phir wire rack pe shift kar le. Enjoy kar apni classic sugar cookies! Plain bhi kha sakta hai ya phir frosting aur sprinkles se decorate kar le.

instruction: sqrt(2x)=4x equation ke liye x ki largest value kya hogi? Answer simplest fractional form mein dena.
output: Dono sides ko square karo: (sqrt(2x))^2 = (4x)^2 2x = 16x^2 16x^2 - 2x = 0 8x^2 - x = 0 x(8x - 1) = 0 Toh x ki value 0 ya 1/8 ho sakti hai. Largest chahiye, toh answer 1/8 hai. Simple.

instruction: Is problem ke potential solutions identify karo.

instruction: Is policy ke implications analyze karo.
output: Dekh, imported goods par strict tax regulations ka matlab hai ki importers par financial burden badhega, aur woh ye extra cost consumers par pass kar denge. Isse customers ke liye prices badh jayenge, toh shayad woh imported goods kam khareedein. Phir domestic alternatives saste lagenge aur unki demand badh jayegi. Isse local goods zyada price-competitive ho jayenge, jis se local economy grow karegi aur trade deficit kam hoga. Par 1 risk ye hai ki foreign competition na hone se domestic industries lazy ho sakti hain, jis se quality giregi aur innovation kam hoga. International trade relations par bhi asar padega; doosre countries retaliatory restrictions laga sakte hain. Isse overall international trade kam ho sakta aahe aur relations kharab ho sakte hain. Last mein, impact is baat par depend karega ki tax kitna badha hai, kaunse goods hain, aur government ke doosre countries ke saath trade agreements kaise hain.

instruction: Ek context diya hai, usse ek poori story likh do. Context: Ek chhoti bachchi ko apne backyard mein ek mysterious note milta hai.
output: Ek baar ki baat hai, Lily naam ki ek ladki thi. Wo apne parents, bade bhai aur apne dog Max ke saath town ke kone mein ek chhote se ghar mein rehti thi. Ek sunny afternoon, Lily garden mein phool tod rahi thi jab usne kuch ajeeb dekha. Ek bright yellow flower ke neeche ek chhota sa paper ka tukda tha. Curious hokar usne note uthaya aur padha: "Old willow tree waale raaste pe jao, wahan tumhe wo milega jo tumhara intezaar kar raha hai." Lily excitement se bhar gayi aur usne dekha ki ek purana raasta jungle ki taraf ja raha hai. Bina soche wo Max ke saath nikal padi. Raste mein wo soch rahi thi ki ye note kisne chhoda hoga aur end mein kia milega. Thodi der baad wo ek bade se purane willow tree ke paas pahunchi jiski branches zameen ko chhu rahi thi. Wahan roots ke beech ek chhota sa wooden box tha. Lily ne dhere se lid uthaya aur hairan reh gayi. Andar polished stones ka ek sundar necklace tha aur ek note tha: "Is land ki sabse brave ladki ke liye, ye necklace tumhe khushi de ar yaad dilaye ki adventure hamesha paas hota hai." Lily ki aankhon mein khushi ke aansu aa gaye. Use yakeen nahi ho raha tha ki koi itni mehnat karke uske liye gift chhodega. Jab wo ghar wapas mudhi, use feel hua ki ye toh bas shuruat hai aur aage aur bhi bahut saare adventures aane waale hain.

instruction: Is input ke basis pe ek story banao: Franklin ek young veterinarian tha jisne abhi college graduate kiya tha. Wo naye job ke liye excited tha par jald hi use realize hua ki kaam utna easy nahi tha jitna usne socha tha.
output: Franklin ekdum excited aur eager tha jab wo apne pehle din veterinarian banne ke liye us chhote se clinic mein ghusa. College ke time se hi uska ye dream tha aur usne yahan tak pahunchne ke liye bahut ghisa tha. Animals se use bahut pyaar tha aur wo hamesha unki help karna chahta tha. Franklin ko laga tha ki apni skills or knowledge se wo animals aur unke owners ki life mein change la payega. Par pehle hi din uska excitement thoda kam hone laga jab use samajh aaya ki job actually kitni challenging ha. Clinic mein itni bheed thi, animals ki line lagi rehti thi—kisi ko chhoti chot thi toh kisi ki halat critical thi. Franklin ko lagne laga ki workload khatam hi nahi ho raha aur use bahut lambe hours kaam karna pad raha tha. Shuru mein wo kaafi overwhelmed feel karne laga, aur kai baar use laga ki wo ye pressure handle nahi kar payega. Use experience ki kami thi toh diagnose karne mein time lagta tha aur aksar apne colleagues se help leni padti thi. Use ye bhi realize hua ki vet banna sirf animals ko treat karna nahi hai, balki owners se baat karna, unhe complex medical terms samjhana aur unke emotions handle karna bhi hai. Par Franklin ne haar nahi maani. Wo hard work karta raha ar slowly uski skills aur knowledge improve hone lagi. Kuch months baad wo confident ho gaya aur use asli khushi tab milti jab animals uski care se theek ho jate. Franklin ko ab samajh aane laga ki vet hona sirf ek job nahi, ek calling hai—un animals ki help karna jo mushkil mein hain, chahe situation kitni bhi tough ho. Usne har din ko enjoy karna seekha, chhoti victories ko celebrate kiya aur ek young veterinarian ke roop mein apne future ka wait karne laga.

instruction: Step by step socho: Tomatoes, onions, garlic, olive oil aur Parmesan cheese use karke vegetarian pasta dish kaise prepare karoge?
output: 1. Saara saman ikattha kar lo: tomatoes, onions, garlic, olive oil, Parmesan cheese, pasta (spaghetti ya penne), aur seasoning ke liye salt aur pepper. 2. Sabziyan ready karo: onions dice kar lo, garlic mince karo, aur tomatoes chop karke alag rakh lo. 3. Ek bade pan ko medium heat pe rakho, olive oil dalo aur phir diced onions add karo. Onions ko tab tak pakaao jab tak wo translucent na ho jayein. 4. Ab mince kiya hua garlic dalo aur ek minute tak pakaao, constantly stir karte raho taaki garlic jale nahi. 5. Chopped tomatoes pan mein dalo, thodi der pakaao or beech-beech mein stir karo, taaki tomatoes soft ho jayein ar apna juice chhod dein. 6. Sauce taste karo aur zaroorat ke hisaab se salt aur pepper dalo. 7. Saath hi, ek bade pot mein salted water boil karo aur pasta ko package instructions ke according al dente hone tak pakaao. 8. Pasta drain karo aur use tomato sauce wale pan mein dalo, acche se toss karo taaki pasta evenly coat ho jaye. 9. Turant serve karo, upar se grated Parmesan cheese daal kar.

instruction: Isko python mein solve kar: Edward ek Alchemist hai. Paise kamane ke liye wo market mein gold aur silver bechta hai. Par gold rare hai, toh kabhi kabhi Edward alchemy use karke lead ko gold jaisa dikhata hai. Par usey careful rehna hoga! Agar wo zyada fake gold bechne ki koshish karega, toh log pakad lenge. Fake gold ki quantity total (fake + real) gold ke half se strictly kam honi chahiye. Metals ki value ye hai: Pb - 1 coin Ag - 10 coins Au - 100 coins Input: Ek string 'metals' jisme metals ke naam ke baad quantity ho, space se separated. Silver Ag, Lead Pb, aur Gold Au isi order mein honge. e.g. Ag 27 Pb 10 Au 5 Output: Edward maximum kitni value kama sakta hai, wo output karo.
output: Ye le code, try karle: ```python metals = input("Enter the quantities of metals (in the format 'Ag n Pb m Au p'): ").split() # Convert the quantities to integers ag_qty = int(metals[1]) pb_qty = int(metals[3]) au_qty = int(metals[5]) # Calculate the maximum quantity of fake gold that can be sold max_fake_gold = (au_qty + pb_qty) // 2 - au_qty # Make sure the maximum quantity is non-negative max_fake_gold = max(0, max_fake_gold) # Calculate the total value of the metals Edward can sell total_value = ag_qty * 10 + pb_qty + (au_qty + max_fake_gold) * 100 print("Maximum value: {} coins".format(total_value)) ```

instruction: Given the two passages, compare and contrast their concepts. Passage 1: Agile methodology emphasizes rapid iteration and quickly responding to change. Passage 2: Waterfall methodology is an action-oriented approach to project management which follows a linear progression from beginning to end.
output: Agile aur Waterfall dono project management ke tareeke hain, par dono ka concept aur execution ekdum alag hai. Agile ka main focus rapid iterations pe hota hai, jahan feedback aur changes ko quickly integrate kiya jata hai. Iska goal hota hai ki changes ko swiftly handle kiya ja sake. Doosri taraf, Waterfall ek sequential aur linear approach ha. Isme project ek structure mein ek phase se doosre phase pe jata hai, aur har phase pichle wale ke complete hone pe depend karta hai. Basically, Agile adaptive hai aur Waterfall ek fixed sequence follow karta hai starting se end tak.

instruction: Given a scenario, come up with a solution. Scenario: You are a high school student struggling to balance school and extracurricular activities.

Proper neend le: Study ke chakkar mein sleep sacrifice mat kar. Focus aur memory ke liye neend bahut zaroori hai. Ye sab follow karega toh school work bhi manage ho jayega aur relax karne ka time bhi milega.

instruction: Is description ke basis pe story batao.

instruction: Is sentence se start karke do animals wali ek kahani banao: "Once upon a time, a rabbit and a fox met in a forest."

Fox bola, "Hello chhote rabbit, is bade aur khatarnak jungle mein akele kya kar rahe ho?" Rabbit ne jawab diya, "Main darta nahi hoon. Fox mann hi mann hasa aur bola, "Theek hai chote, ho sakta hai tum clever ho, par tum kabhi ek fox jitne chalaak nahi ban sakte." Rabbit bas muskuraaya aur apne kaam mein lag gaya. Par fox ko laga ki wo apni chalaki dikhaye, toh wo rabbit ka peecha karne laga taaki use surprise attack karke pakad sake. Rabbit ko feel hua ki koi uska peecha kar raha hai, toh usne apni speed badha di aur pedon-jhadiyon ke beech zig-zag bhagne laga. Fox ne bahut try kiya, par rabbit usse kahin zyada fast tha. Finally, fox thak gaya aur use saans lene ke liye rukna pada. Tab rabbit ne mud kar kaha, "Dekha Mr. Fox, hamesha chalaaki kaam nahi aati. Kabhi kabhi fast aur clever hona zyada important hota hai." Fox ko apni galti realize hui aur wo sharminda ho gaya. Usne rabbit ko underestimate kiya tha aur apne ghamand mein haar gaya. Us din ke baad se dono dost ban gaye aur winter ke liye milkar khana jama karne lage, dono ne apni-apni strengths use ki. Toh is story ki moral ye hai ki har kisi ki apni unique strength hoti hai, isliye kisi ko kam nahi samajhna chahiye aur apne pride ko beech mein nahi aane dena chahiye.

instruction: Java aur Python ko compare karo in criteria ke basis pe: user base, applications, aur syntax.
output: Java aur Python dono hi kaafi popular programming languages hain, par dono ka purpose alag hai aur features bhi unique hain, taaki developers apne project ke goals ke hisaab se sahi tool choose kar sakein. User Base: Java ka enterprise application domain mein bahut bada user base hai, almost saari Fortune 500 companies is language ko use karti hain. Iske opposite, Python ka user base scientific aur academic communities mein zyada hai, khaas kar AI, Machine Learning (ML), data analysis aur visualizations ke liye. Applications: Java mostly bade scale ke enterprise applications, web apps, mobile apps, games aur internet-of-things (IoT) systems banane ke liye use hoti hai. Android development ke liye bhi ye primary he. Wahi Python ke sabse common applications data science, machine learning, AI, web development (specially back-end ke liye Django ya Flask frameworks use karke) aur scripting hain. Syntax: Java ek statically-typed language hai jiska syntax C aur C++ se kaafi influenced hai. Ye thodi verbose hai, isme explicit variable declaration chahiye hota hai aur aksar Python ke mukable zyada lines likhni padti hain. Dusri taraf, Python dynamically-typed hai jiska syntax concise aur easy-to-read hai, isliye ise aksar “executable pseudo-code” bhi kaha jata hai. Overall, Java aur Python dono hi developers ke liye powerful tools hain aur tech field mein career banane ke liye ye foundational skills hain.

instruction: x^2+y^2=-2x-10y-16 equation wale circle ka center point (x,y) hai. x+y ki value kya hogi?
output: x+y nikalne ke liye pehle circle ka center find karna padega. Iske liye hum completing the square use karenge taaki standard form mil jaye. Constant term ko chhod kar baaki sab left side shift karte hain: x^2+2x+y^2+10y=-16. Ab x ke liye (2/2)^2=1 aur y ke liye (10/2)^2=25 dono side add karo. Equation ban jayegi: (x+1)^2+(y+5)^2=10. Toh center point hua (-1,-5). Iska matlab x+y = -1+(-5) = -6.

instruction: Do binary strings a aur b diye gaye hain, unka sum ek binary string ke roop mein return karo. Solution ko Haskell function mein likho.
output: Is problem ka Haskell solution ye raha: ``` addBinary :: String -> String -> String addBinary a b = reverse $ addBinaryHelper (reverse a) (reverse b) '0' addBinaryHelper :: String -> String -> Char -> String addBinaryHelper [] [] '0' = [] addBinaryHelper [] [] carry = [carry] addBinaryHelper [] (y:ys) carry = addBinaryHelper [] ys (addBinaryDigits '0' y carry) addBinaryHelper (x:xs) [] carry = addBinaryHelper [] xs (addBinaryDigits x '0' carry) addBinaryHelper (x:xs) (y:ys) carry = sumDigits : addBinaryHelper xs ys carry' where (sumDigits, carry') = addBinaryDigits x y carry addBinaryDigits :: Char -> Char -> Char -> (Char, Char) addBinaryDigits '0' '0' '0' = ('0', '0') addBinaryDigits '0' '1' '0' = ('1', '0') addBinaryDigits '1' '0' '0' = ('1', '0') addBinaryDigits '1' '1' '0' = ('0', '1') addBinaryDigits '0' '0' '1' = ('1', '0') addBinaryDigits '0' '1' '1' = ('0', '1') addBinaryDigits '1' '0' '1' = ('0', '1') addBinaryDigits '1' '1' '1' = ('1', '1') ``` `addBinary` function do binary strings `a` aur `b` leta hai aur unka sum return karta hai. Isme `addBinaryHelper` aur `addBinaryDigits` functions ka use hua hai. `addBinaryHelper` function dono strings aur ek carry value leta hai, aur least significant digit se start karke recursively sum compute karta hai. `addBinaryDigits` function do binary digits ar ek carry bit ka sum nikalta hai aur result digit aur naya carry return karta he. Yaad rakhna ki `addBinaryHelper` aur `addBinaryDigits` assume karte hain ki strings reverse order mein hain, isliye humne `addBinary` mein input strings ko reverse kiya hai.

instruction: Python mein solve karo: Do hexadecimal strings `a` aur `b` diye gaye hain, unhe add karke result Roman numerals mein output karna hai.
output: Ye raha Python code is problem ke liye: ``` def hex_to_decimal(hex_string): return int(hex_string, 16) def decimal_to_roman(decimal_num): roman_numerals = ["M","CM","D","CD","C","XC","L","XL","X","IX","V","IV","I"] decimal_values = [1000,900,500,400,100,90,50,40,10,9,5,4,1] roman_string = "" for i in range(len(decimal_values)): while decimal_num >= decimal_values[i]: roman_string += roman_numerals[i] decimal_num -= decimal_values[i] return roman_string a = "3F" b = "2B" sum_ab = hex_to_decimal(a) + hex_to_decimal(b) result_roman = decimal_to_roman(sum_ab) print(result_roman) ``` Isme do helper functions use kiye hain `hex_to_decimal` aur `decimal_to_roman`. Pehla wala hexadecimal string ko decimal integer mein convert karta hai, aur doosra decimal integer ko Roman numeral string mein badal deta hai. Phir code `a` aur `b` strings leta hai, unhe decimal mein convert karke add karta hai, aur end mein `decimal_to_roman` function se final result nikal leta hai. Output mein final Roman numeral string milegi.

Shuru mein toh parents aur teachers ko uski ye zid funny lagti thi, par dheere-dheere unhe realize hua ki ye 1 problem banti ja rahi hai. Unhone har possible tareeka try kiya use samjhane ka, par kuch kaam nahi aaya. Timmy ko lagta tha ki ye saare rules faltu hain aur inhe todne mein koi burai nahi hai. Phir ek din, Timmy ki is zidd ki wajah se uski jaan jaate-jaate bachi. Woh doston ke saath park mein tha tab usne ek sign dekha jispe likha tha 'Do Not Enter'. Bina soche samjhe usne warning ignore ki aur fence kood gaya. Use nahi pata tha ki woh sign use construction zone ke khatre se bachane ke liye tha. Khush-kismati se ek worker ne use dekh liya aur turant safe jagah khinch liya. Is incident ke baad, Timmy ke parents ne use baitha kar samjhaya ki rules follow karna kyun zaroori hai. Unhone bataya ki rules humein aur doosron ko safe rakhne ke liye hote hain, aur bhale hi humein vo pasand na aayein, unhe follow karna chahiye. Thoda time laga, par eventually Timmy ko unki baat samajh aa gayi. Uske baad se, Timmy rules zyada dhyan se follow karne laga. Uska curiosity aur adventurous nature waisa hi raha, par ab woh use responsibility ke saath balance karna seekh gaya tha. Aage chalkar wo ek brave, intelligent aur kind young man bana, jiski sab respect karte thhe.

instruction: Proposed method ki efficacy evaluate karne ke liye ek experiment design karo. Proposed Method: Neural persistence
output: Neural persistence method kitna effective hai, yeh check karne ke liye hum yeh experiment design kar sakte hain: Step 1: Objective aur metrics define karo Sabse pehle yeh clear karna hoga ki experiment ka goal kya hai—matlab neural persistence ki effectiveness assess karna. Phir humein metrics set karne honge success measure karne ke liye, jaise accuracy, precision, recall or F1 score. Step 2: Dataset select karo aur usko training aur testing sets mein split karo Ab ek sahi dataset choose karna hoga jo problem domain se relevant ho aur jisme kaafi samples hon. Phir is dataset ko training or testing sets mein split karenge, standard 80/20 ratio use karke. Step 3: Proposed method implement karo Neural persistence method ko kisi sahi programming language aur software framework use karke implement kiya jayega. Implementation details method ki specifics pe depend karengi. Step 4: Model train karo Training dataset use karke model ko train karenge. Isme input data model mein feed hoga aur parameters adjust kiye jayenge taaki error rate minimum ho jaye. Step 5: Model test karo Training ke baad, testing dataset se performance check karenge. Input data feed karke predictions ko ground truth labels se compare karenge. Step 1 wale metrics se effectiveness measure hogi. Step 6: Results analyze karo aur conclusions nikalo Testing ke baad results analyze karke final conclusion nikalenge. Isme hum baseline method se results compare kar sakte hain yeh dekhne ke liye ki performance mein significant improvement hai ya nahi. Statistical tests bhi kar sakte hain results verify karne ke liye. Summary mein, neural persistence ki efficacy check karne ke liye humein dataset select karna hoga, split karna hoga, method implement karke model train aur test karna hoga, aur end mein results analyze karke conclusion nikalna hoga.

instruction: Diye gaye event ki probability calculate karo. Ek standard deck of 52 cards mein se heart nikalne ki probability kya hogi?
output: Dekho, ek standard deck of 52 cards mein 4 suits hote hain: Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, aur Spades. Har suit mein 13 cards hote hain (2 se 10 tak, aur face cards: Jack, Queen, King, aur Ace). Probability ka basic formula hai: favorable outcomes divided by total outcomes. Is case mein calculation aise hogi: Favorable outcomes: Deck mein total 13 hearts hain. Total outcomes: Total 52 cards hain. Toh probability hui 13/52, yaani 0.25 (25%). Simple hai.

instruction: Ek bacteria colony mein number har din double ho raha hai. Colony 3 bacteria se start hoti hai, day 1 ke end tak 6 ho jate hain, day 2 pe 12, aur aise hi chalta rehta hai. Woh kaunsa pehla din hoga jab colony 100 bacteria cross karegi?
output: Hume pata hai ki bacteria har din double ho rahe hain. Toh day n ke end tak number nikalne ka formula hoga 3*2^n. Hume woh first day dhundna hai jab colony 100 se zyada ho jaye. Iske liye yeh inequality set karo: 3*2^n > 100. Ab solve karte hain: 2^n > 100/3 Dono side log lene pe: n*log(2) > log(100/3) n > log(100/3) / log(2) Calculator se check karo toh n approx 5.77 aata hai. Par hum pure days ki baat kar rahe hain, to hum round up karke next integer lenge. Isliye smallest n jo is inequality ko satisfy karega, woh he n = 6.

instruction: Is input se ek set banao aur uska size nikalo. [1, 2, 3, 2, 4, 2]
output: Is list mein kuch repeating elements hain. Set basically ek unordered collection data type hota hai jo iterable aur mutable hota hai, aur isme koi duplicate elements nahi hote. Hum is input list se set aise bana sakte hain: ``` my_set = set([1, 2, 3, 2, 4, 2]) ``` Isse list ke duplicates hat jayenge aur sirf unique elements bachenge. Resulting set `{1, 2, 3, 4}` hoga. Is set mein total 4 elements hain, yaani iska size 4 hai. Size nikalne ke liye hum `len()` function use karenge: ``` size = len(my_set) ``` Toh, is input list se bane set ka size 4 hai.

instruction: Lauren ne equation |x-5| = 2 solve ki. Jane ne ek equation x^2+ bx + c = 0 solve ki jiske solutions Lauren ki equation ke same the. (b, c) ki ordered pair kya hogi?
output: Pehle Lauren ki equation |x-5| = 2 solve karte hain: - Agar x-5 positive hai, toh |x-5|=x-5=2, jisse x=7 aayega. - Agar x-5 negative hai, toh |x-5|=5-x=2, jisse x=3 aayega. Toh solutions hue x=3 aur x=7. Ab Jane ki quadratic equation ke roots bhi 7 aur 3 hone chahiye. Toh hum isse factored form mein aise likh sakte hain: (x-3)(x-7)=0 Isko expand karne par Jane ki equation hogi: x^2-10x+21=0 So, ordered pair (b,c) hai (-10,21).

instruction: Is problem ko JavaScript function use karke solve karo: n integers read karo aur saare odd integers ke sum ka square print karo.
output: Is problem ka JavaScript solution ye raha: ```javascript function squareSumOfOddIntegers(n, arr) { let sum = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (arr[i] % 2 !== 0) { sum += arr[i]; } } return sum * sum; } // Example usage: const arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]; console.log(squareSumOfOddIntegers(arr.length, arr)); // Output: 81 ``` Is function mein do parameters hain: `n` integers ki count hai aur `arr` actual array hai. Ye array par loop chalata hai ar check karta hai ki number odd hai ya nahi, agar odd hai toh usko `sum` variable mein add kar deta hai. Last mein, ye odd integers ke total sum ka square return kar deta hai.

instruction: Is topic par 300-400 words ka essay likho: Internet ka communication par impact
output: Internet ne communication ka pura scene hi badal diya hai, information exchange ar interact karne ka tareeka ekdum change ho gaya hai. Ab duniya mein kahin bhi ho, instant aur saste mein baat karna possible hai. Sabse bada impact communication ka democratization hai. Social media, blogging aur online platforms ki wajah se ab koi bhi apne ideas global audience tak pahuncha sakta hai. Pehle sirf TV aur newspapers wale control karte the, par ab bas internet connection chahiye aur aapki awaaz sab tak pahunch jayegi. Efficiency bhi bahut badh gayi hai. Email aur instant messaging se real-time collaboration hota hai. Wo khat ya fax ka wait karne wala zamana gaya, ab bas kuch clicks mein kisi se bhi connect kar sakte hain. Internet ki wajah se hum aise logo se jud paate hain jinke interests same hain, chahe wo kahin bhi ho. Online forums aur social media groups se like-minded communities milti hain aur lasting friendships banti hain. Lekin, iske kuch negative side effects bhi hain. Anonymity ki wajah se cyberbullying, trolling aur hate speech badh gayi hai. Log bhool jate hain ki screen ke peeche ek real person hai, isliye wo aisi baatein bol dete hain jo face-to-face kabhi nahi bolte. Aur ek baat, internet ne connect toh kiya par disconnect bhi kar diya. Log online toh bahut time spend karte hain par real world mein isolated aur lonely feel karte hain. Internet kitna bhi advance ho jaye, face-to-face interaction wali human connection usse replace nahi kar sakta. Overall, internet ka communication par impact bahut deep aahe. Isne cheezein easy aur efficient banayi hain, par ise responsibly use karna zaroori hai. Internet ne hamare baat karne ka dhang badal diya hai aur aage bhi ye interact karne ke tareeko ko shape karta rahega.
