Market samajhna: Shuruat mein target market ko samajhne aur unke pain points identify karne mein time lagao, phir aisa product banao jo unhe solve kare. 2. Strong value proposition: Early adopters ko attract karne ke liye clear benefits dikhao taaki log tumhare product ki baat karein or buzz create ho. 3. Digital marketing ka use: Social media aur online ads se kam cost mein bade audience tak pahuncho. SEO aur content marketing se leads generate karo. 4. Referral program: Word-of-mouth sabse powerful tool aahe. Aisa system banao jahan existing customers ko naye users lane pe reward mile. 5. Strategic partnerships: Aise businesses ke sath collab karo jinka target market same ho, taaki reach jaldi badhe. 6. Team scale-up: Jaise demand badhe, sahi log hire karo aur ek aisa culture banao jahan innovation aur collaboration ho. 7. Continuous improvement: Feedback lekar product ko improve karte raho taaki customers jude rahein aur naye log attract hon. Agar ye sab cheezein sahi se combine ho jayein ta 1 million customers tak pahuncha ja sakta hai. Par guarantee kuch nahi hai, sab market conditions aur execution pe depend karta hai.

instruction: Is ethical dilemma ko dekho aur dono sides ke liye teen-teen arguments banao.
input: The applications of Artificial Intelligence have been advancing exponentially over the last decade, resulting in promising solutions in the fields of healthcare and finance.
output: Pro-I: 1. Efficient Diagnosis: AI software se doctors bimariyan jaldi aur accurately diagnose kar payenge. AI bohot saara medical data aur images quickly analyze karke sahi symptoms pehchan sakta hai. Isse lives save hongi, khaas karke emergency cases ya rare diseases mein jo diagnose karna mushkil hota hai. 2. Medical Staff ka load kam hoga: Diagnosis ke boring aur time-consuming tasks AI sambhal lega, toh medical staff patients ki better care pe focus kar payenge aur baaki critical issues handle kar sakenge. 3. Healthcare Access badhega: AI software un areas mein bohot help karega jahan doctors ya hospitals ki kami ha. Remote areas mein rehne wale log bina door travel kiye accurate diagnosis pa sakenge. Con-I: 1. Misdiagnosis: AI accurate ho sakta aahe par perfect nahi, toh galat diagnosis ka risk hamesha rahega. Galat treatment se patients ko nuksan ho sakta hai. Plus, ye accountability ka panga hai ki galti software ki thi ya doctor ki. 2. Job Losses: Disease diagnosis mein AI ke aane se medical sector mein jobs kam ho sakti hain. Radiologists aur pathologists jaise professionals ki zarurat kam ho jayegi, jis se unemployment badh sakti he. 3. Data Privacy: AI ko seekhne ke liye patients ka bohot saara medical data chahiye hota ha. Risk ye hai ki data hack ho sakta aahe ya misuse ho sakta hai. Saath hi, ye ethical issue bhi hai ki companies is data ko kaise collect aur share kar rahi hain.

instruction: n ki positive value nikalo taaki equation 9x^2+nx+1=0 ka exactly ek solution ho in x.
output: Dekh, agar 9x^2 + nx + 1 = 0 ka exactly ek solution chahiye, toh quadratic expression perfect square hona chahiye. 9 se divide karke square complete karte hain: x^2 + (n/9)x + 1/9 = 0 Ab is expression ko perfect square hone ke liye (x + 1/3)^2 ya (x - 1/3)^2 hona padega, kyunki leading coefficient aur constant term fixed hain. Positive n ke liye hum pehla case lenge: n = 2/3 * 9 = 6

instruction: Is shape ka moment of inertia nikalo. Shape: Rectangle width = 5 m and length = 7 m

instruction: Ek code likho jo ye detect kare ki page access karne ke liye kaunsa browser use ho raha hai.
output: Ye dekho, JavaScript use karke browser detect karne ka ek simple tareeka: ```javascript function detectBrowser(){ var userAgent = navigator.userAgent; var browserName = ""; if (userAgent.indexOf("Firefox") > -1){ browserName = "Firefox"; } else if (userAgent.indexOf("SamsungBrowser") > -1){ // Samsung Browser browserName = "Samsung Internet"; } else if (userAgent.indexOf("Opera") > -1 || userAgent.indexOf("OPR") > -1){ // Opera 8.0+ browserName = "Opera"; } else if (userAgent.indexOf("Edg") > -1){ // Edge (Chromium) browserName = "Microsoft Edge"; } else if (userAgent.indexOf("Chrome") > -1){ browserName = "Chrome"; } else if (userAgent.indexOf("Safari") > -1){ browserName = "Safari"; } else if (userAgent.indexOf("Trident") > -1){ // (Internet Explorer) browserName = "Internet Explorer"; }else { browserName = "Unknown Browser"; } return browserName; } console.log('You are using ' + detectBrowser() + ' browser.'); ``` Is code mein `navigator.userAgent` use kiya hai browser identify karne ke liye. Ye common browsers jaise Firefox, Chrome, Safari etc. ke patterns check karta hai or unka naam return kar deta hai. Agar kuch match nahi hua, toh "Unknown Browser" dikhayega.

instruction: Maan lo ek 'invoices' table hai jisme 'invoice_id', 'customer_id', 'invoice_date', aur 'amount' columns hain. Aisi SQL query likho jo top 5 customers nikaale jinka average invoice amount sabse zyada ho, bas unko hata dena jinhone 10 se kam purchases kiye hain.
output: Ye lo query, kaam ho jayega: ``` SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS average_invoice_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_id) AS num_invoices FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id HAVING num_invoices >= 10 ORDER BY average_invoice_amount DESC LIMIT 5; ``` Is query mein pehle customer ID se group kiya, average aur count nikala, fir `HAVING` clause use karke unhe filter kar diya jinhone 10 se kam purchases kiye hain. Last mein descending order karke top 5 results limit kar diye. Simple.

instruction: Mere paas ek database hai aur mujhe use Java se access karna hai. Example code bhej do kaise hoga. Table names: ORDER_TABLE, CUSTOMER_TABLE, COST_TABLE.
output: Haan dekh, ye le sample code. Isse tu database connect karke multiple tables se data nikaal sakta hai: ``` import java.sql.*; public class DatabaseExample { public static void main(String[] args) { try(Connection conn = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/mydatabase", "username", "password")) { String query = "SELECT * FROM CUSTOMER_TABLE " + "JOIN ORDER_TABLE ON CUSTOMER_TABLE.customer_id = ORDER_TABLE.customer_id " + "JOIN COST_TABLE ON ORDER_TABLE.order_id = COST_TABLE.order_id"; PreparedStatement preparedStatement = conn.prepareStatement(query); ResultSet resultSet = preparedStatement.executeQuery(); while (resultSet.next()) { int orderId = resultSet.getInt("order_id"); String customerName = resultSet.getString("customer_name"); double cost = resultSet.getDouble("cost"); System.out.println("Order ID: " + orderId + ", Customer Name: " + customerName + ", Cost: " + cost); } } catch(SQLException ex) { ex.printStackTrace(); } } } ``` Isme MySQL use kiya hai localhost pe, aur JOIN laga ke teeno tables (CUSTOMER_TABLE, ORDER_TABLE, aur COST_TABLE) ka data uthaya hai. Data ResultSet object mein store hoke console pe print ho jayega. Bas 'mydatabase', 'username', aur 'password' apne waale daal lena.

instruction: Diye gaye inputs use karke COVID-19 ke healthcare safety par ek half-page blog post likho. - current healthcare protocols - potential future protocols
output: COVID-19 pandemic ke time pe healthcare protocols ka strict hona bahut zaroori hai taaki safety bani rahe. Situation badalti rehti hai, isliye in protocols ko baar-baar update kiya gaya hai. Current protocols ka main goal virus spread rokna aur patients ko sahi care dena hai. Sabse important cheez hai PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) ka use. Healthcare workers ke liye ye must aahe kyunki wo patients ke close contact mein hote hain. Gloves, face shields aur respirators ek barrier create karte hain, jisse virus transmit hone ka risk kam ho jata hai. PPE ke saath-saath sanitation pe bhi bahut zor aahe. Regular hand washing, sanitizers aur surfaces ko disinfect karna compulsory hai taaki contaminated surfaces se virus na phaile. Future mein, hum transmission risk aur kam karne pe focus kar sakte hain. Telemedicine ka use badhaya ja sakta hai jahan patients remote consult kar sakein. Isse hospital aane ki zaroorat kam hogi aur risk bhi ghatega. Saath hi, rapid testing se patients ko jaldi identify karke safety badhayi ja sakti aahe. Conclusion ye hai ki COVID ke time pe safe healthcare delivery ke liye protocols essential hain. Abhi PPE aur sanitation pe focus hai, par future mein telemedicine aur rapid testing game-changer ho sakte hain. Jaise-jaise situation change hogi, humein inhe update karte rehna chahiye.

instruction: Ek program banao jo is math question ko solve kare. What is the sum of 2 + 6?
output: Dekh, ye raha ek simple tareeka is question ko solve karne ka: ```python def solve_math_problem(question: str) -> str: # Parse the question to find the numbers and required operation numbers = [int(word) for word in question.split() if word.isdigit()] operation = "" if "sum" in question or '+' in question: operation = "addition" elif "difference" in question or '-' in question: operation = "subtraction" elif "product" in question or '*' in question: operation = "multiplication" elif "division" in question or '/' in question: operation = "division" # Perform the required operation result = 0 if operation == "addition": result = sum(numbers) elif operation == "subtraction": result = numbers[0] - numbers[1] elif operation == "multiplication": result = numbers[0] * numbers[1] elif operation == "division": result = numbers[0] / numbers[1] # return the answer return f"The answer is {result}." input_question = "What is the sum of 2 + 6?" answer = solve_math_problem(input_question) print(answer) # "The answer is 8." ``` Ye program input leta hai, operation (is case mein addition) ar numbers find karta hai. Phir 2 aur 6 ko add karke answer return kar deta hai.

instruction: Mujhe Python mein Google Maps API use karni hai. Mujhe do points (lat1, long1) aur (lat2, long2) ke beech ka distance nikalna hai.
output: Bhai, distance calculate karne ke liye pehle Google Cloud Platform Console mein project bana, Google Maps JavaScript API enable kar aur API key le le. Uske baad Python ki `googlemaps` library aur `distance_matrix()` method use kar le. Ye raha example code: ``` import googlemaps # Enter your API key here api_key = 'YOUR_API_KEY' # Define the client client = googlemaps.Client(api_key) # Define the origins and destinations origins = (lat1, long1) destinations = (lat2, long2) # Call the distance_matrix method to get the distance result = client.distance_matrix(origins, destinations) # Extract the distance value distance = result['rows'][0]['elements'][0]['distance']['value'] # Convert the distance to miles distance_miles = distance * 0.000621371 # Print the result print("The distance between the two points is: ", distance_miles, "miles") ``` Bas 'YOUR_API_KEY' ki jagah apni actual API key daal dena jo Console se mili hai.

instruction: Machine learning ke baare mein is text ko summarize karo. It focuses on the development of computer programs that can access data and use it to learn for themselves. The process of machine learning is divided into two parts, supervised and unsupervised learning. In supervised learning, the computer is provided with an output for each input and used to optimize its algorithms to produce a generalized output. In unsupervised learning, the computer is given an input and then it searches for patterns or trends in the data.
output: Machine learning AI ki ek branch he jisse computers bina explicit programming ke khud seekh sakte hain. Isme aise algorithms banaye jate hain jo data access aur analyze karke apni performance improve karein. ML do types ke hote hain: supervised aur unsupervised. Supervised mein computer ko input-output pairs se train kiya jata hai taaki woh general outputs nikaal sake. Unsupervised mein computer input data ke andar patterns aur trends search karta hai.

instruction: Is logical puzzle ko solve karne ke liye instructions generate karo. Logical Puzzle: Trains A & B 120 km door hain aur ek dusre ki taraf travel kar rahi hain. Train A ki speed 54 km/h hai aur Train B ki 42 km/h.
output: Is puzzle ko solve karne ke liye ye steps follow karo: 1. Sabse pehle total distance dekho, jo ki 120km diya gaya hai. 2. Dono trains ki speed note karo: Train A ki 54 km/h aur Train B ki 42 km/h. 3. Kyunki dono trains ek dusre ki taraf aa rahi hain, ta unki relative speed nikalne ke liye speeds ko add kar do. Relative speed = 54 km/h + 42 km/h = 96 km/h. 4. Ab distance = speed x time wala formula use karo time nikalne ke liye. Time (t) = distance / relative speed = 120 km / 96 km/h = 1.25 hours. Toh basically, dono trains 1.25 hours baad milengi.

instruction: Arithmetic sequence ke pehle chaar terms ka sum 10 hai. Agar fifth term 5 hai, toh sixth term kya hoga?
output: Common difference ko 'x' maan lo. Sum of first four terms in terms of x and fifth term: - fourth = 5 - x - third = 5 - 2x - second = 5 - 3x - first = 5 - 4x Equation: (5 - 4x) + (5 - 3x) + (5 - 2x) + (5 - x) = 10 Simplifying: -10x = -10 x = 1 Sixth term = fifth term (5) + diff (1) = 6.

instruction: John Wick 4 ke is review ko summarize karo.
input:
Half of this review will be me gushing about the action. Wow. Just wow. I was in complete awe. There were multiple times I was both tearing up and laughing at how unbelievably amazing the fight scenes are. Now this is nothing new for the John Wick series. But for me, this is far and away the best action of the entire series.

I'm an action junkie and am repeatedly disappointed with action movies and their terrible fight scenes, filled with shaky cam, quick cuts and close-up shots (looking at you Snake Eyes and Mortal Kombat). Then I watch a John Wick movie and feel so spoiled, while also being baffled at why other action movies can't learn from this. The fights are so fast-paced yet completely clear and easy to follow.

There is every kind of action imaginable. So many weapons, styles, chases, vehicles, animals, everything. So much creativity with the kills. Amazing combinations of weaponry and fighting styles.

The music is awesome as usual, maybe even a step up. It enhances every action scene. The cinematography is pristine. So many beautiful shots, so many mesmerizing locations for the action.

There are a couple of scenes that are shot in such a creative way that I've never seen before. One is an overhead shot one-take that I couldn't believe. It takes the movie to a new level. So many scenes feel like they're a video game brought to life. Numerous times it feels like the VR game Pistol Whip.

Donnie Yen is awesome. End of paragraph.

About an hour into this nearly 3-hour movie, I felt like I experienced enough action amazingness for an entire movie. I was in a state of ecstasy. Not only was this looking like the best of the series, I started wondering if this would be a landmark action flick. Maybe it's my own fault for setting expectations so high mid-movie, but the second half is more flawed, though still awesome.

The subplot with the tracker doesn't seem at all consequential. And his dog attacks were already done, and better, with Halle Berry in Parabellum. A few of the issues I had with Parabellum pop up again, like overdoing it sometimes with the damage he takes. For example, instead of getting hit by one car, he gets hit by three cars. And that's a mild example. Also, it's fairly anticlimactic.

Even with those flaws, I had a BLAST with this movie and will definitely see it at least once more in theaters. Seeing it on a premium screen is a must. Loudest speakers, biggest screen. TRUST ME.
output: Reviewer action scenes se kaafi impressed tha, uske hisaab se ye series ke best scenes hain. Fast-paced fights aur weaponry ka mix use kaafi pasand aaya. Music or cinematography bhi top-notch thi, jisne action ko aur better bana diya. Bas tracker wala subplot thoda bekar laga aur second half mein protagonist ko overkill damage dikhaya gaya. Phir bhi, overall movie use bahut pasand aayi aur usne isse theater mein dekhne ki recommendation di hai.

instruction: 'The 3 Types of RNA and Their Functions' article ko summarize karo.
input:
One common homework and test question asks students to name the three types of RNA and list their functions. There are several types of ribonucleic acid, or RNA, but most RNA falls into one of three categories.
mRNA or Messenger RNA

mRNA transcribes the genetic code from DNA into a form that can be read and used to make proteins. mRNA carries genetic information from the nucleus to the cytoplasm of a cell.
rRNA or Ribosomal RNA

rRNA is located in the cytoplasm of a cell, where ribosomes are found. rRNA directs the translation of mRNA into proteins.
tRNA or Transfer RNA

Like rRNA, tRNA is located in the cellular cytoplasm and is involved in protein synthesis. Transfer RNA brings or transfers amino acids to the ribosome that corresponds to each three-nucleotide codon of rRNA. The amino acids then can be joined together and processed to make polypeptides and proteins.
output: Dekho, basically teen types ke RNA hote hain: mRNA, rRNA, aur tRNA. mRNA DNA se genetic code uthakar protein synthesis ke liye lata hai, rRNA usko proteins mein translate karta ah, aur tRNA amino acids ko ribosome tak transfer karta he. Simple hai.

instruction: Ek algorithm banao jo given upper limit tak saare prime numbers find kare.
output: Upper limit tak prime numbers nikalne ke liye Sieve of Eratosthenes best hai. Agar limit 20 hai, toh logic aise kaam karega: 1. 2 se lekar max number (upper limit) tak ek list banao, `numbers = [2, 3, 4, ..., 20]`. 2. Prime numbers store karne ke liye ek empty list lo, `primes = []`. 3. `p = 2` se start karo, jo pehla prime hai. 4. `numbers` list se `p` ke saare multiples hata do. Modulus operator (`n % p == 0`) use karke check karo aur remove kar do. 5. Ab `p` ko next available number pe move karo aur step 4 repeat karo. 6. Ye tab tak karo jab tak `p` max number ke square root se bada na ho jaye. Baaki bache saare numbers prime honge, unhe `primes` list mein daal do. 7. `primes` list return kar do. Python mein code aisa dikhega: ```python def find_primes(upper_limit): numbers = list(range(2, upper_limit + 1)) primes = [] p = 2 while p <= upper_limit**0.5: primes.append(p) numbers = [n for n in numbers if n % p != 0] p = numbers[0] primes.extend(numbers) return primes upper_limit = 20 result = find_primes(upper_limit) print(result) ```

instruction: Do strings s aur t diye hain, check karna hai ki t, s ka anagram hai ya nahi. Anagram matlab letters ko rearrange karke naya word banana, jisme original letters exactly ek baar use hue hon.

Solution ka Python code yeh raha: ``` def is_anagram(s, t): if len(s) != len(t): return False s_dict = {} t_dict = {} for char in s: if char not in s_dict: s_dict[char] = 0 s_dict[char] += 1 for char in t: if char not in t_dict: t_dict[char] = 0 t_dict[char] += 1 return s_dict == t_dict ``` Bas is function mein do strings pass karo aur ye bata dega ki second string first wali ka anagram hai ya nahi.

instruction: Tumhe ek sorted unique integer array `nums` diya gaya hai. Ek range [a,b] ka matlab hai a se b tak ke saare integers (inclusive). Smallest sorted list of ranges return karo jo array ke saare numbers ko exactly cover kare. Matlab, `nums` ka har element exactly ek range mein hona chahiye, aur aisa koi integer x nahi hona chahiye jo range mein toh ho par `nums` mein na ho. List mein har range [a,b] ko aise output karna hai: "a->b" agar a != b "a" agar a == b
output: Iska simple solution ye hai ki array pe iterate karo aur current range ka track rakho. Agar agla number current range ke baad wala consecutive number hai, toh endpoint update kar do. Nahi toh, current range ko result list mein daalo aur naye number se nayi range start karo. Last mein, aakhri range add karna mat bhulna. Python mein implementation ye raha: ```python def summaryRanges(nums): if not nums: return [] res = [] start = end = nums[0] for num in nums[1:]: if num == end + 1: end = num else: res.append(str(start) + "->" + str(end) if start != end else str(start)) start = end = num res.append(str(start) + "->" + str(end) if start != end else str(start)) return res ``` For example, `summaryRanges([0,1,2,4,5,7])` return karega `['0->2', '4->5', '7']`.

instruction: Ek integer `n` diya gaya hai, true return karo agar wo power of two hai. Warna false return karo. Ek integer `n` power of two tab hota hai agar koi aisa integer `x` exist kare ki `n == 2^x`.
output: Dekh, Python mein iska solution aise hoga: ```python def isPowerOfTwo(n: int) -> bool: if n <= 0: return False while n % 2 == 0: n //= 2 return n == 1 ``` Ye function `n` leta hai aur boolean return karta hai—`True` agar `n` power of two hai, aur `False` agar naahi hai. Pehle check karte hain ki `n` zero ya negative toh nahi, kyunki wo power of two nahi ho sakte. Phir jab tak `n` even hai, usey 2 se divide karte raho. Agar end mein 1 bacha, ta matlab `n` power of two tha (`2^0 = 1`). Warna iska matlab `n` mein 2 ke alawa koi aur factor tha, toh wo power of two nahi ho sakta. For example: ```python >>> isPowerOfTwo(1) True >>> isPowerOfTwo(16) True >>> isPowerOfTwo(218) False ```

instruction: Ek singly linked list ka head diya gaya hai, true return karo agar wo palindrome hai, warna false.
output: Singly linked list ko palindrome check karne ke liye ye algorithm use kar lo: 1. List traverse karo aur saari values ek stack mein push kar do. 2. Phir se traverse karo aur har node ki value ko stack ke top element se compare karo. 3. Agar koi bhi value match nahi hui, to list palindrome nahi hai, false return kar do. 4. Agar sab match ho gaye, toh true return kar do. Python code ye raha: ```python class Solution: def isPalindrome(self, head: ListNode) -> bool: # Step 1: Push all nodes onto the stack stack = [] cur = head while cur is not None: stack.append(cur.val) cur = cur.next # Step 2: Traverse linked list and compare values with stack cur = head while cur is not None: if cur.val != stack.pop(): return False cur = cur.next # Step 3: All values matched, return True return True ``` Is code mein `head` linked list ka start node hai aur `ListNode` node class hai.

instruction: Agar x + sqrt(x^2 - 1) + 1/(x - sqrt(x^2 - 1)) = 20, toh find karo x^2 + sqrt(x^4 - 1) + 1/(x^2 + sqrt(x^4 - 1)).
output: Sabse pehle second term ke denominator ko rationalize karte hain: 1/(x - sqrt(x^2 - 1)) = (x + sqrt(x^2 - 1))/(x^2 - (x^2 - 1)) = (x + sqrt(x^2 - 1))/(2x - sqrt(x^2 - 1)) Toh original equation ban jayegi: x + sqrt(x^2 - 1) + (x + sqrt(x^2 - 1))/(2x - sqrt(x^2 - 1)) = 20, jo simplify hoke ye ban jayegi: 2x + 2 sqrt(x^2 - 1) = 20, yani ki: x + sqrt(x^2 - 1) = 10. Ab dono sides ko square karne par humein milega: x^2 - 1 = 100 - 20x + x^2, jisse aayega: x = 101/20. Ab us expression ko solve karte hain jo humein find karna hai: 1/(x^2 + sqrt(x^4 - 1)) = (x^2 - sqrt(x^4 - 1))/(x^4 - (x^4 - 1)) = (x^2 - sqrt(x^4 - 1))/(2x^4 - 2) = x^2 - sqrt(x^4 - 1) So: x^2 + sqrt(x^4 - 1) + 1/(x^2 + sqrt(x^4 - 1)) = 2x^2 = 10201/200.

instruction: Point A se, Leigh 40 yards south, 60 yards west, 10 yards north, aur 20 yards east chalkar point B par pahunchti hai. AB ki length, yards mein, kya hogi?
output: AB ki length nikalne ke liye, humein Leigh ki north-south aur east-west movements ko separately add karna padega. instruction: Ek array 'nums' diya hai jisme n distinct numbers hain range [0, n] mein. Woh ek number return karo jo is range mein array se missing hai.
output: Isko solve karne ka akk simple approach Gauss formula use karna hai, jisme 1 se n tak ke numbers ka sum n*(n+1)/2 hota hai. Hum is formula se range [0, n] ka total sum nikal sakte hain. Phir array ke har number ko is sum se subtract kar do. Jo result bachega, wahi missing number hoga. Ye raha code: ``` def missingNumber(nums): n = len(nums) total_sum = n*(n+1)//2 # // integer division hai for num in nums: total_sum -= num return total_sum ``` Dhyan rakhna ki second line mein integer division (//) use kiya hai taaki result integer hi rahe.

instruction: Tum ek product manager ho aur ek nayi product develop kar rahe ho. Badkismati se, latest version quality check mein fail ho gaya. Kyunki har version pichle version pe based hota hai, toh ek bad version ke baad wale saare versions bhi bad honge. Maano tumhare paas n versions [1, 2, ..., n] hain aur tumhe woh pehla bad version dhundna hai jiski wajah se baaki saare bad ho gaye. Tumhe ek API bool isBadVersion(version) diya gaya hai jo batata hai ki version bad hai ya nahi. Ek function implement karo jo first bad version dhunde. API calls minimize karne ki koshish karna.
output: First bad version nikalne ke liye tum binary search use kar sakte ho. Middle version se start karo aur check karo ki woh bad hai ya nahi. Agar bad hai, toh uske baad wale saare versions bhi bad honge, isliye left half check karo. Agar nahi ah, toh pehle wale saare good hain, toh right half check karo. Bas yahi process repeat karo jab tak first bad version na mil jaye. Function ka implementation ye raha: ``` def firstBadVersion(n): """ :type n: int :rtype: int """ left = 1 right = n while left < right: mid = (left + right) // 2 if isBadVersion(mid): right = mid else: left = mid + 1 return left ``` Is function mein `left` aur `right` pointers use ho rahe hain range track karne ke liye. Hum [1, n] ki poori range se start karte hain. Har iteration mein middle version calculate karke check karte hain ki vo bad hai ya nahi. Agar bad hai, toh range update karke [left, mid] kar dete hain kyunki `mid` ke baad wale sab bad hain. Agar nah hai, toh range [mid+1, right] ho jati hai kyunki `mid+1` se pehle wale sab good hain. Ye tab tak chalta ha jab tak `left == right` na ho jaye, aur wahi tumhara first bad version hota hai.

instruction: Ek integer array nums diya gaya hai, saare 0's ko end mein move karo aur non-zero elements ka relative order maintain rakho. Yaad rahe ki ye in-place hona chahiye, array ki copy nahi banani hai.
output: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye tum two-pointer technique use kar sakte ho. Do pointers initialize karo, i aur j, jahan i 0 se start hoga aur j array mein pehle 0 ke occurrence se. i pointer ke saath array traverse karo. Agar element zero nhi hai, toh use index j wale element ke saath swap kardo aur j ko increment karo. Iteration ke baad, saare non-zero elements starting mein apne original order mein aa jayenge, aur saare zeros end mein chale jayenge. Algorithm implement karne ka code ye raha: ``` void moveZeroes(vector<int>& nums) { int n = nums.size(); int j = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (nums[i] != 0) { swap(nums[i], nums[j]); j++; } } } ```

instruction: Suppose aapke paas ek table hai "invoices" jisme columns "invoice_id", "customer_id", "invoice_date", aur "amount" hain. Ek SQL query likho top 5 customers find karne ke liye jinka average invoice amount highest ho, aur un customers ko exclude karo jinhone 10 se kam purchases kiye hain.
output: Ye le query, top 5 customers nikalne ke liye: ``` SELECT customer_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM invoices GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(invoice_id) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_amount DESC LIMIT 5; ``` Is query mein pehle invoices ko customer-wise group kiya gaya hai, phir har customer ka average amount calculate kiya hai. HAVING clause use karke sirf unhe rakha ha jinhone 10 ya usse zyada purchases kiye hain. Finally, average amount ke basis pe descending order mein sort karke LIMIT 5 se top results nikaal liye.

instruction: m ek three-digit positive integer hai jo teen distinct prime factors x, y aur 10x+y ka product hai, jahan x aur y dono 10 se kam hain. m ki largest possible value kya hogi?
output: Largest value nikaalne ke liye ye steps follow karo: - Sabse pehle, agar 10x+y prime hai, toh y 2 ya 5 nahi ho sakta. - Kyunki x aur y prime digits hain, toh y ya toh 3 hoga ya 7, or x baaki teen prime digits mein se koi akk hoga. - Ab in six cases ko check karo (jahan x aur y (2,3), (3,2), (2,7), (7,2), (3,7), ya (7,3) ho sakte hain). - 10x+y form waale prime numbers 23, 53, 73, aur 37 hain. - Ab in chaaro ke liye xy(10x+y) compute karo: 138, 795, 1533, aur 777. - Toh m ki largest possible value 795 hai, kyunki ye 1000 se chhota hai aur baaki sabse bada hai.

instruction: Caesar cipher use karke message encrypt karne ka ek coding program banao. Message: "Hello World"
output: Ye raha Caesar cipher use karke message encrypt karne ka ek example program: ```python # Caesar Cipher def encrypt_caesar_cipher(message, key): # define the alphabet alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' # convert the message to uppercase message = message.upper() # create the encrypted message encrypted_message = '' # iterate through the message for char in message: # check if the character is in the alphabet if char in alphabet: # find the index of the character in the alphabet char_index = alphabet.index(char) # shift the index by the key new_index = (char_index + key) % len(alphabet) # add the encrypted character to the encrypted message encrypted_message += alphabet[new_index] else: # if the character is not in the alphabet, add it to the encrypted message without encryption encrypted_message += char # return the encrypted message return encrypted_message # Example message = "Hello World" key = 3 encrypted_message = encrypt_caesar_cipher(message, key) print(encrypted_message) ``` ```output KHOOR ZRUOG ``` Is example mein 'message' variable mein wo text hai jise encrypt karna aahe, aur 'key' variable shift ki value hai. 'encrypt_caesar_cipher' function in dono parameters ko leta hai aur encrypted message return karta hai. Alphabet ko 'alphabet' variable mein store kiya gaya hai aur message ko uppercase mein convert kiya gaya hai taaki case ka chakkar na rahe. Fir hum message ke har character pe iterate karte hain aur check karte hain ki wo alphabet mein hai ya nahi. Agar hai, toh uska index nikaal kar key se shift kar dete hain. Modulo operator use kiya gaya hai taaki alphabet wrap around ho sake. Agar character alphabet mein nahi hai, toh use bina encrypt kiye add kar dete hain. Last mein, encrypted message return ho jata ah aur print ho jata hai.

instruction: Historical stock price data ke basis pe future stock price predict karne ke liye ek neural network model banao. Example data: [20,19.5,23,22.5,25,24.5]
output: Historical data se stock price predict karne ke liye ye steps follow karne honge: 1. Data gather aur preprocess karo: Time-series analysis techniques best rahengi. Example ke liye data normalization kar lo jahan data ka mean zero or variance unit ho. 2. Model define karo: Time-series ke liye RNN ya LSTM models best hote hain. Ek simple LSTM model aise define kar sakte hain: ```python from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential from tensorflow.keras.layers import LSTM, Dense # Set the sequence length seq_length = 6 # Build the model model = Sequential() model.add(LSTM(50, input_shape=(seq_length, 1))) model.add(Dense(1)) # Compile the model model.compile(loss='mean_squared_error', optimizer='adam') ``` 3. Model train karo: Data ko training aur test sets mein split karo or training set se model ko train karo. Data prepare karne aur train karne ka example ye raha: ```python import numpy as np # Import the data data = [20, 19.5, 23, 22.5, 25, 24.5] # Scale the data data = np.array(data).reshape(-1, 1) data = (data - data.min()) / (data.max() - data.min()) # Prepare data for the model X = [] y = [] for i in range(seq_length, len(data)): X.append(data[i - seq_length:i, 0]) y.append(data[i, 0]) X = np.array(X) y = np.array(y) X = np.reshape(X, (X.shape[0], X.shape[1], 1)) # Train the model model.fit(X, y, epochs=100, batch_size=10) ``` 4. Predictions karo: Training ke baad, tum model ko future prices predict karne ke liye use kar sakte ho.

instruction: Ek experiment design karo jo kisi phenomenon ka cause confirm karne mein help kare. Observation: Full moon ke time birds zyada erratic tarike se udte hue dikhte hain.

instruction: Integers ki ek array ko binary tree mein convert karne ka code likho. Input array: [1, 2, 3, 4]
output: Ye le Python code jo array ko binary tree mein convert kar deta hai: ```python from queue import Queue class TreeNode: def __init__(self, key): self.left = None self.right = None self.val = key def insert_node_level_order(numbers): q = Queue() n = len(numbers) if not numbers: return None root = TreeNode(numbers[0]) q.put(root) i = 1 while not q.empty(): node = q.get() # insert left child if i < n: node.left = TreeNode(numbers[i]) q.put(node.left) i += 1 # insert right child if i < n: node.right = TreeNode(numbers[i]) q.put(node.right) i += 1 return root def inorder(node): if node: inorder(node.left) print(node.val) inorder(node.right) arr = [1, 2, 3, 4] root = insert_node_level_order(arr) inorder(root) ``` Is code mein elements ko level-by-level insert karke array ko binary tree banaya gaya hai. Input array [1, 2, 3, 4] ha aur `insert_node_level_order` function binary tree ka root node return karta hai.

instruction: Un real numbers ke 10-tuples (x_1, x_2, …, x_10) ki count find karo jo is equation ko satisfy karein: (1 - x_1)^2 + (x_1 - x_2)^2 + (x_2 - x_3)^2 + … + (x_9 - x_10)^2 + x_10^2 = 1/11.
output: Hume wo 10-tuples (x_1, x_2, …, x_10) find karne hain jo is equation ko satisfy karein: (1 - x_1)^2 + (x_1 - x_2)^2 + (x_2 - x_3)^2 + … + (x_9 - x_10)^2 + x_10^2 = 1/11. Cauchy-Schwarz inequality use karke: [(1^2 + 1^2 + 1^2 + … + 1^2 + 1^2)][(1 - x_1)^2 + (x_1 - x_2)^2 + (x_2 - x_3)^2 + … + (x_9 - x_10)^2 + x_10^2] ≥ [(1 - x_1) + (x_1 - x_2) + (x_2 - x_3) + … + (x_9 - x_10) + x_10]^2 = 1. Kyunki yahan equality hai, ta Cauchy-Schwarz ki equality condition use karenge: (1 - x_1)/1 = (x_1 - x_2)/1 = (x_2 - x_3)/1 = … = (x_9 - x_10)/1 = x_10/1. Maano d = 1 - x_1 = x_1 - x_2 = x_2 - x_3 = … = x_9 - x_10 = x_10. Isse humein milta hai: (1 - x_1) + (x_1 - x_2) + … + (x_9 - x_10) + x_10 = 11d. Toh, 11d = 1, jiska matlab hai d = 1/11. Iska solution hoga: (x_1, x_2, x_3, …, x_10) = ( 10/11, 9/11, 8/11, …, 1/11). Matlab sirf ek hi solution hai.

instruction: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye ek C++ function likho: Ek pattern aur ek string s di gayi hai, check karo ki s usi pattern ko follow karta hai ya nahi. Yahan follow ka matlab hai full match, jahan pattern ke ek letter aur s ke ek non-empty word ke beech bijection ho.
output: Ye le ek possible implementation C++ mein: ``` bool matchPattern(string pattern, string s) { int n = pattern.size(); stringstream ss(s); unordered_map<char, string> mp; // mapping between pattern and s for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { char p = pattern[i]; if (!mp.count(p)) { // p not mapped yet string word; if (!(ss >> word) || word.empty()) return false; // s has less words than pattern or an empty word mp[p] = word; // map p to word } else { string word = mp[p]; string nextWord; if (!(ss >> nextWord) || nextWord != word) return false; // mismatched word for p } } return ss.eof(); // s has more words than pattern? } ```

instruction: Ek specific library ka usage demonstrate karne ke liye code snippet likho. Library Name: Scikit-learn
output: Ye dekh, Scikit-learn library use karke simple linear regression model kaise banate hain uska example code: ``` python from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression # Sample data x_train = [[0], [1], [2], [3]] y_train = [0, 1, 2, 3] # Create and fit the model model = LinearRegression() model.fit(x_train, y_train) # Make predictions x_test = [[4], [5], [6]] y_pred = model.predict(x_test) # Output predictions print(f'Predictions: {y_pred}') ``` Is code mein humne `linear_model` module se `LinearRegression` class import ki hai. instruction: Kuch binary classification data diya gaya hai, identify karo ki is task ke liye kaunsa machine learning model suitable rahega.
output: Binary classification ke liye kaafi saare popular ML models hain. Kaunsa best hai, wo tumhare data ke size, dimensionality aur class balance pe depend karega. Ye rahe kuch common options: 1. Logistic Regression: Ye ek simple linear model hai jo probabilities deta hai. Agar data linearly separable hai, to ye best hai. 2. Decision Trees: Ye non-parametric model hai jo data ko smaller subsets mein break karke decision leta he (gini index ya information gain ke base pe). 3. Random Forest: Ye ensemble method hai jo multiple decision trees ka result aggregate karta hai. Isme overfitting ka risk kam hota ah aur performance better milti hai. 4. Support Vector Machines (SVM): SVM ek hyperplane dhoondhta hai jo do classes ko maximum margin ke saath separate kare. 5. Naive Bayes: Ye probabilistic classifier hai jo Bayes’ theorem use karta hai. Ye bahut fast hai, especially agar features independent hon. 6. Neural Networks: Complex aur high-dimensional datasets ke liye ye best hain kyunki ye non-linear patterns seekh sakte hain. Suggestion ye hai ki pehle Logistic Regression ya Decision Tree jaise simple models se start karo aur performance check karo, phir complex models pe jao. Saath mein data preprocessing aur feature engineering bhi zaroori hai.

instruction: Tu apne dost ke saath ye Nim Game khel raha hai: - Table pe stones ka ek heap hai. - Tu aur tera dost alternate turns lenge, aur tu pehle start karega. - Har turn pe, jiski baari hogi wo heap se 1 se 3 stones utha sakta hai. - Jo aakhri stone uthayega, wo winner hoga. Given n, stones ka number, toh bata agar tu win kar sakta hai (assuming dono optimal khel rahe hain), nahi toh false return kar. Nim Game solve karne ke liye Python code likh.
output: Nim-sum waala concept use karke ye raha code: ```python def can_win_nim(n): return n % 4 != 0 ``` Logic ye hai: Agar n, 4 ka multiple he, toh tu kitne bhi stones utha le, tera opponent hamesha utne stones uthayega ki remaining stones phir se 4 ka multiple ban jayein, aur tu haar jayega. Baaki saare cases mein, tu hamesha aise stones utha sakta hai ki balance 4 ka multiple rahe aur tu jeet jaye. Isliye, agar n % 4 != 0 ha toh True return karenge, naahi toh False.

instruction: Do sentences mein is article ko summarize kar. Deep learning is part of a broader family of machine learning methods based on artificial neural networks with representation learning. Learning can be supervised, semi-supervised or unsupervised.[2] Deep-learning architectures such as deep neural networks, deep belief networks, deep reinforcement learning, recurrent neural networks, convolutional neural networks and transformers have been applied to fields including computer vision, speech recognition, natural language processing, machine translation, bioinformatics, drug design, medical image analysis, climate science, material inspection and board game programs, where they have produced results comparable to and in some cases surpassing human expert performance.[3][4][5] Artificial neural networks (ANNs) were inspired by information processing and distributed communication nodes in biological systems. ANNs have various differences from biological brains. Specifically, artificial neural networks tend to be static and symbolic, while the biological brain of most living organisms is dynamic (plastic) and analog.[6][7] The adjective "deep" in deep learning refers to the use of multiple layers in the network. Early work showed that a linear perceptron cannot be a universal classifier, but that a network with a nonpolynomial activation function with one hidden layer of unbounded width can. Deep learning is a modern variation that is concerned with an unbounded number of layers of bounded size, which permits practical application and optimized implementation, while retaining theoretical universality under mild conditions. In deep learning the layers are also permitted to be heterogeneous and to deviate widely from biologically informed connectionist models, for the sake of efficiency, trainability and understandability.
output: Deep learning ML ka subset hai jo multi-layer neural networks use karta hai, and it's used in CV, NLP, and drug design. Biological networks se inspired toh hai, par static nature aur nonpolynomial activation functions ki wajah se alag hai.

instruction: Smartphone ki brightness adjust karne ka algorithm design karo, lighting conditions ke hisaab se.
output: Dekh, ye ek simple algorithm hai brightness adjust karne ke liye: 1. Pehle phone ke built-in light sensor se ambient light level check kar. Ye sensor lux mein value deta hai, jo environment ki brightness batata hai. 2. Ek mapping function bana jo lux value input le aur display brightness output kare. Isme linear scaling use kar sakte hain, ya phir user settings, battery level aur time of day jaise factors bhi add kar sakte hain. 3. Mapping function use karke current light level ke basis pe desired brightness decide kar. 4. Brightness ko ekdum se change mat kar, smoothly adjust kar taaki user ko jhatka na lage. 5. Light sensor ko continuously monitor kar aur steps repeat kar taaki lighting change hone pe brightness dynamically adjust ho jaye. Pseudocode ye raha: ``` def adjust_brightness(): ambient_light = read_light_sensor() brightness = map_brightness(ambient_light) set_display_brightness(brightness) def map_brightness(ambient_light): if ambient_light < DARK_THRESHOLD: return MIN_BRIGHTNESS elif ambient_light > BRIGHT_THRESHOLD: return MAX_BRIGHTNESS else: # Linear mapping function return (ambient_light - DARK_THRESHOLD) * (MAX_BRIGHTNESS - MIN_BRIGHTNESS) / (BRIGHT_THRESHOLD - DARK_THRESHOLD) + MIN_BRIGHTNESS ```

instruction: Dilution rate nikalo jab 500 mL 0.3 M solution ko 800 mL 0.1 M solution mein add kiya jaye.
output: Iske liye dilution formula use karenge, jahan M1V1 = M2V2 hota hai. Jahan: - M1 initial molarity he - V1 initial volume hai - M2 final molarity hai - V2 final volume hai Assume karte hain ki final volume dono solutions ka sum aahe, yani V2 = 500 mL + 800 mL = 1300 mL. Values put karke M2 solve karte hain: M2 = (M1V1)/(V2) Total moles dono solutions mein: Solution 1 ke moles = (0.3 M) (0.5 L) = 0.15 mol Solution 2 ke moles = (0.1 M)(0.8 L) = 0.08 mol Total solute moles = 0.15 mol + 0.08 mol = 0.23 mol Ab formula mein dalo, M2 = (mol of solute)/(V2) M2 = 0.23 mol/1.3L = approx 0.177 M Toh final dilution rate approx 0.177 M hoga.

instruction: Is money management problem ke do solutions batao: Ek family ki monthly income $10,000 hai, par wo mahine ka $12,000 kharch kar dete hain.
output: Is money management problem ke do potential solutions ho sakte hain: Solution 1: Expenses kam karna Family ko apne monthly kharche dhyan se dekhne chahiye taaki pata chale kahan cut-back kar sakte hain. Kuch recommended steps ye ho sakte hain: - Budget banana: Isse unhe pata chalega ki paisa kahan ja raha hai aur spending prioritize ho jayegi. - Non-essential kharche hatana: Yahan family faltu cheezon par kharch kam kar sakti hai. Jaise bahar khana band karna, subscriptions cancel karna, ya entertainment expenses kam karna. - Essential expenses ghatana: Yahan zaruri cheezon ki cost kam karni hogi, jaise housing (chota ghar rent pe lena), transportation (public transport use karna), food (brand names avoid karna), utilities (energy bachana) wagera. In strategies ko implement karke, family har mahine $2,000 ya usse zyada bacha sakti hai taaki income or spending ka gap khatam ho jaye. Solution 2: Income badhana Expenses kam karne ke saath, ek aur solution hai income increase karna. Iske kuch possible tareeke ye hain: - Current job mein raise maangna ya overtime kaam karna. - Side job lena: Family members freelancing ya part-time kaam kar sakte hain, jaise Uber/Lyft chalana ya Airbnb pe spare room rent pe dena. - Purani cheezein bechna: Jo saman use nahi hota usko eBay, Facebook Marketplace, ya Craigslist jaise platforms pe bech sakte hain. In methods se monthly income $2,000 ya usse zyada badh sakti hai, jisse income spending ke barabar aa jayegi.

instruction: Ek single sentence input se ek short story banao. The lazy elephant was strolling in the jungle.
output: Garmiyon ki ek dopahar thi, aur Raja naam ka ek lazy haathi jungle ki haryali mein maze se ghum raha tha. Uske paas karne ko kuch khaas nahi tha, bas apne aas-paas ki shanti enjoy kar raha tha. Use bas ghumna aur explore karna pasand tha, aur wo aksar ghane pedon ki chhaon mein neend puri karta tha jab suraj ki roshni patton se chhan kar aa rahi hoti thi. Ghumte-ghumte Raja ne notice kiya ki jungle mein ajeeb si khamoshi hai. Usually use bandaron ka shor aur chidiyon ki chahchahat sunayi deti thi, par aaj sab shant tha. Wo ruka aur apne bade-bade kaan khade karke sunne ki koshish ki, par kuch nahi sunayi diya. Raja aage badha, aur jald hi use pata chala ki jungle itna shant kyun tha. Ek khali jagah par akk chota sa hiran ka bachha (fawn) pada tha, jo itna kamzor tha ki khada bhi naahi ho pa raha tha. Baaki janwar uske aas-paas jama the, par kisi ko samajh nahi aa raha tha ki us nanhi jaan ki help kaise karein. Bina kisi deri ke, Raja ko samajh aa gaya ki kya karna hai. Usne apni strong trunk se fawn ko uthaya ar use paas ki ek nadi tak le gaya. Usne trunk mein pani bhara aur dhire-dhire fawn par dala, jisse wo dhire-dhire hosh mein aane laga. Baaki janwar hairan the ki jis haathi ko sab lazy samajhte the aur lagta tha ki use kisi cheez ki parvah nahi hai, usne itni compassion dikhayi. Us din ke baad, Raja ko sirf "jungle mein ghumne wala lazy haathi" nahi kaha gaya; wo ek hero ban gaya jisne ek jaan bachayi aur sabko sikhaya ki kabhi-kabhi choti-choti cheezein hi sabse bada asar dalti hain.

instruction: Maan lo tumhare paas "orders" naam ki table hai jisme "order_id", "customer_id", "order_date", aur "amount" columns hain. Ek SQL query likho jisse customer ke first aur second order ke beech ka average number of days pata chale.
output: First aur second order ke beech ka average gap nikalne ke liye ye SQL query use karo: ```sql SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF(second_order.order_date, first_order.order_date)) FROM ( SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id ) AS first_order JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS second_order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date > ( SELECT MIN(order_date) FROM orders WHERE customer_id = orders.customer_id ) GROUP BY customer_id ) AS second_order ON first_order.customer_id = second_order.customer_id ``` Steps: - "first_order" subquery se har customer ki pehli order date nikali gayi ah. - "second_order" subquery mein pehli order date ko filter karke minimum date li gayi hai, jisse second order date mil jaye. - Dono subqueries ko customer_id par join kiya gaya hai taaki first aur second order ke beech ka time difference nikal sakein. - Last mein, AVG() function use karke average number of days calculate kar liya.

instruction: Ek cylindrical water tank 1/5 full hai. Agar usme teen liters aur dale, toh tank 1/4 full ho jayega. Full tank ki capacity kitni liters hai?
output: Tank initially 1/5 full hai. Maan lo start mein water 'w' liters tha aur total capacity 'c' hai. Toh w/c = 1/5, matlab w = c/5. 3 liters add karne pe (w+3)/c = 1/4 hota hai. Cross-multiply karne pe milega c = 4w + 12. First equation se w ki value put karo: c = 4(c/5) + 12. Solve karne pe c = 60 aata hai. Toh tank ki full capacity 60 liters hai.

instruction: Integers ke array mein se largest element return karne ka algorithm banao. [4, 2, 7, 9, 1]
output: Array mein largest element nikalne ke liye simple algorithm use kar sakte hain jo saare elements ko compare kare. Example dekho: 1. Ek variable `max_value` lo aur usme array ka pehla element daal do. 2. Array pe loop chalao, second element (index 1) se start karke. 3. Agar current element `max_value` se bada hai, toh `max_value` ko update kar do. 4. Loop tab tak chalao jab tak saare elements compare na ho jayein. 5. Finally `max_value` return kar do. Pseudocode ye raha: ```python def find_largest_element(arr): max_value = arr[0] for i in range(1, len(arr)): if arr[i] > max_value: max_value = arr[i] return max_value ``` Ab is input pe apply karte hain: [4, 2, 7, 9, 1] - `max_value` initialize kiya 4 se. - 2 ko compare kiya, 4 bada hai toh `max_value` 4 hi raha. - 7 ko compare kiya, 7 bada hai toh `max_value` 7 ho gaya. - 9 ko compare kiya, 9 bada hai toh `max_value` 9 ho gaya. - 1 ko compare kiya, 9 bada hai toh `max_value` 9 hi raha. Result: 9.

instruction: Ek fraction ki decimal representation 0.3 pe end hoti hai. Agar is decimal ko common fraction mein badal kar lowest terms mein likhein, toh denominator kya hoga?
output: Dekho, humein decimal fraction diya hai jo 0.3 pe end hota hai. Isko lowest terms wale common fraction mein badalne ke liye pehle equation banate hain: Maan lo S = 0.3. Ab dono side 10 se multiply karo toh 10S = 3.3 aayega. In dono equations ko subtract kar do S eliminate karne ke liye: 10S - S = 3.3 - 0.3, toh 9S = 3 ho gaya. S ki value nikaalein toh S = 1/3 aata hai. Toh original fraction lowest terms mein 1/3 hai, aur denominator 3 hai.

instruction: Aniara' ke is review ka sentiment analysis karo. On one level this movie is a success. It's an engaging, non-commercial Sci-fi film that is well acted, directed and produced. It held my attention and made me want to find out the fate of the ship and crew. I knew nothing of the poem. I knew nothing other than what the trailer contained. It is incredibly difficult to adapt a poem which is tied more than any other literary form to the word, into a mostly visual medium. Since the screenwriter seemed to jettison the words of the poem what we are left with is an outline. That's where some problems begin. The poem was written in 1956, when space travel hadn't even started. So, it's pretty lame when a space ship the size of the Aniara doesn't have redundant power and a number of backup plans for when/if things go wrong. But hey, we're already in outer space, disbelief is suspended, so, shut the hell up. There's a bunch character driven scenes but none of character ever develop. The really all stay the same no matter what they've been through. Also Instead of a fully developed story we get inundated with a series of let downs which really come off as more of a drag than tragic. I mean would it really be that bad to be traveling through space? The filmmakers certainly seem sure it is. There's some poignant moments throughout, to be sure. The problem is it's all for a movie that just peters out. What may have had great resonance on the page doesn't make it through the translation to screen. I think if they had stronger conclusion to what happens to the main character at the end the movie would've worked better. That way the ultimate ending would've become a post script. That didn't happen, so we're left with a movie that just stops on some sort of note about 'the vastness of space'. All this makes 'Aniara' unsatisfying even though it's well done on many levels.
output: Overall, sentiment mixed hai. Reviewer ne movie ko non-commercial Sci-fi genre, acting or engagement ke liye appreciate kiya hai. But sath hi movie ki limitations bhi batayi hain, jaise poem ka adaptation, character development aur ek unsatisfying conclusion. End mein reviewer ne "Aniara" ko unsatisfying bola hai, bhale hi movie technical levels pe well-made ho.

instruction: Ek algorithm design karo jo target sum ke liye dice combinations find kare. Target Sum = 9
output: Target sum find karne ke liye ek recursive function use kar sakte hain. Ye dekho algorithm kaise kaam karega: 1. Ek function define karo, `dice_combinations(target_sum, dice, current_sum, current_combination, all_combinations)`, jahan `target_sum` desired sum hai, `dice` ek array hai possible values ka (jaise `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]`), `current_sum` ab tak ka total hai, `current_combination` current dice rolls ka array hai, aur `all_combinations` saare valid combinations ka array hai. 2. Agar `current_sum` equal hai `target_sum` ke, toh `current_combination` ko `all_combinations` mein add kar do. 3. Agar `current_sum` target se zyada ho gaya, toh wahi se return kar jao kyunki aage check karne ka koi fayda nahi. 4. Nahi ta, `dice` array ki har value ke liye `dice_combinations` function ko recursively call karo, `current_sum` update karke aur value ko `current_combination` mein append karke. 5. Finally, `all_combinations` array return kar do. Python mein iska implementation aise hoga: ```python def dice_combinations(target_sum, dice, current_sum=0, current_combination=[], all_combinations=[]): if current_sum == target_sum: all_combinations.append(current_combination) return if current_sum > target_sum: return for die in dice: dice_combinations( target_sum, dice, current_sum + die, current_combination + [die], all_combinations ) return all_combinations all_combinations = dice_combinations(9, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]) for combination in all_combinations: print(combination) ``` Iska output aisa aayega: ``` [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1] ... (and other combinations) ```

instruction: In facts ko use karke global warming par ek essay likho. Global warming is the gradual increase in the average temperature of the Earth's atmosphere and its oceans, a change that is believed to be permanently changing the Earth’s climate.
output: Scientists saalon se warn kar rahe hain ki global warming kitni dangerous hai, par aaj bhi bohot log iske impacts ko seriously nahi lete. Simple words mein kahein toh global warming matlab Earth ke atmosphere aur oceans ke average temperature ka dheere-dheere badhna, jis se climate permanently change ho raha hai. Iska main reason hai humans ka atmosphere mein greenhouse gases release karna. Natural gases toh hoti hain, par fossil fuels jalane, deforestation aur galat farming practices ki wajah se inka concentration badh gaya hai. Is wajah se heat trap ho rahi hai aur global temperature badh raha hai. Iske consequences bohot bade hain. Temperature badhne se heatwaves, hurricanes, cyclones aur floods jaise extreme weather events zyada ho rahe hain. Ice caps aur glaciers pighalne se sea levels badh rahe hain, jis se coastal cities ko khatra hai aur millions of people displace ho sakte hain. Kuch jagah droughts ho rahe hain toh kuch jagah bhayanak baarish. Sirf environment hi naahi, food security aur water resources par bhi iska asar pad raha hai, aur infectious diseases bhi badh rahi hain. Agar temperature rise 2°C se neeche naahi rakha gaya, jaisa 2016 Paris Agreement mein decide hua tha, toh results catastrophic ho sakte hain. Conclusion yeh hai ki global warming ek serious problem hai or sab nations ko milkar urgent action lena hoga. Yeh ek raat mein solve nahi hoga, par agar efforts jaari rahe toh hum future generations ke liye sustainable world chhod sakte hain.

instruction: Us line ki equation nikalo jo given point se pass hoti hai aur given vector ke parallel hai. Point: (2, 1), Vector: (−2, 1)
output: Maan lo line ki equation y = mx + b form mein hai, jahan m slope hai aur b y-intercept hai. Pehle slope nikalte hain. Vector (−2,1) ke parallel line ka slope y-component ar x-component ka ratio hota hai. Toh slope m = 1/(-2) = -1/2. Ab point-slope form use karte hain: y - y1 = m(x - x1), jahan (x1, y1) hamara point (2,1) ah. Values put karte hain: y - 1 = -1/2(x - 2). Ab isko slope-intercept form mein lane ke liye -1/2 ko distribute karte hain aur y ke liye solve karte hain: y - 1 = -1/2 x + 1 y = -1/2 x + 2 Toh final equation hui y = -1/2 x + 2.

instruction: Is business challenge ko explain karo Restaurant industry faces numerous challenges related to rising labor costs, increasing competition and slow population growth.
output: Restaurant industry mein profitability maintain karna aur market mein tikna kaafi mushkil hota ja raha hai kyunki wahan kai problems hain. Pehli badi problem hai labor costs ka badhna. Iska matlab hai ki chefs, servers aur kitchen staff ko hire karne ar rakhne ka kharcha badh gaya hai, jisse owners ki finances pe pressure pad raha hai. Is wajah se prices competitive rakhna aur profit nikalna tough ho gaya hai. Doosri challenge hai badhta hua competition. Ab restaurants ko customers attract karne ke liye kuch naya aur innovative karna padega. Last cheez ha slow population growth. Chote customer base ki wajah se, restaurants ko apne purane clients ko retain karne aur naye logon ko jodne ke liye aur zyada mehnat karni pad rahi hai. Overall, ye sab challenges growth ko slow kar dete hain.

instruction: Content Management System (CMS) aur Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system mein kya difference hai?
output: CMS aur ERP dono alag-alag tarah ke software hain jo business mein different purposes ke liye use hote hain. CMS ka use digital content create, manage aur publish karne ke liye hota hai, jaise website pages, blog posts, images aur videos. Isse companies bina kisi heavy technical knowledge ke apni website manage kar sakti hain. Isme content creation, storage, workflow management aur archiving jaise features hote hain. Doosri taraf, ERP system business ke overall operations manage karne ke liye hota hai, jaise finance, accounting, inventory, sales, customer service, supply chain aur HR. ERP company ke main business processes ko streamline or automate karta aahe aur sab kuch ek centralized system mein integrate kar deta hai. Isme financial management, project management aur HR management jaise functionalities hoti hain. Simple words mein, CMS digital content aur publishing pe focused hai, jabki ERP business processes ko manage karne pe focused hai.

instruction: Ek integer array `nums` diya hai, isme multiple queries handle karni hain: `left` aur `right` indices ke beech ka sum nikalo (inclusive) jahan `left <= right` ho. `NumArray` class implement karo: `NumArray(int[] nums)` object ko integer array `nums` ke saath initialize karta hai. `int sumRange(int left, int right)` indices `left` aur `right` ke beech ke elements ka sum return karta hai (i.e. `nums[left] + nums[left + 1] + ... + nums[right]`).
output: Dekho, `NumArray` class ke liye ek `prefix` sum array bana lo jahan `prefix[i]` 0 se `i` tak ka sum ho. Phir `sumRange(left, right)` simply `prefix[right] - prefix[left-1]` ho jayega (agar `left > 0` hai). Agar `left == 0` hai toh direct `prefix[right]` return kar do. Constructor mein hi prefix array fill kar lena. `sumRange` ki time complexity `O(1)` hogi. Implementation ye rahi: ``` class NumArray { private int[] prefix; public NumArray(int[] nums) { prefix = new int[nums.length]; for (int i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) { if (i == 0) { prefix[i] = nums[i]; } else { prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] + nums[i]; } } } public int sumRange(int left, int right) { if (left == 0) { return prefix[right]; } else { return prefix[right] - prefix[left-1]; } } } ``` Bas `NumArray` ka instance banao input array `nums` ke saath ar `sumRange` method call karke sum nikal lo.

instruction: Socho agar ek aisi duniya ho jahan har country mein free healthcare ho, toh is reality ke positive aur negative implications kya honge?
output: Bhai, agar har jagah free healthcare hota toh kaafi cheezein change ho jati. Positive implications: 1. Universal access: Sabko medical care milta, chahe unki financial condition kaisi bhi ho. 2. Public health improve hoti: Log bimariyon ka treatment time pe karwa lete aur preventative care badh jata. 3. Medical costs kam hote: Logo ko apni jeb se paise nahi dene padte, to financial tension bohot kam ho jati. 4. Economic productivity badhti: Jab citizens healthy rahenge toh workforce zyada productive hogi, jisse economy ko fayda hota. Negative implications: 1. Government pe heavy cost: Poori nation ko free healthcare dena bohot mehenga padta, jiske liye taxes badhane padte ya doosre sectors ka budget kam karna padta. 2. Hospitals mein bheed: Free care ki wajah se medical facilities overcrowded ho sakti thi, jisse waiting time badhta aur quality gir jati. 3. Doctors ki kami: Demand zyada hone ki wajah se medical professionals ki shortage ho sakti thi, jisse burnout aur workload badh jata. 4. Kuch treatments limited hote: Cost control karne ke liye govt shayad kuch mehnge treatments restrict kar deti, jisse unka access kam ho jata.

instruction: Diye gaye input se ek rule-based system banao cat breeds identify karne ke liye. Images of cats (or dog breeds) from different breeds such as Persian, Siamese, Maine Coon, etc.
output: Cat breeds identify karne ke liye steps simple hain: 1. Data Collection: Labeled images collect karo (Persian, Siamese, Maine Coon, etc.). 2. Feature Extraction: Coat length, color, texture aur face features (eye shape, ear placement, nose shape) analyze karo. 3. Rule Creation: Features ke basis pe rules banao. Example: Long fur + flat face + round eyes = Persian. 4. Classification: Nayi images pe ye rules apply karo. Pehle features extract karo, phir rules se match karke breed decide karo. Ye system basic images pe kaam karega, par breed variations ki wajah se accuracy limited ho sakti hai. Better results ke liye ML algorithms use karo. Rules update karte raho.

instruction: Vectors ke beech ka angle calculate karo. Vector A: 4i + 2j Vector B: -3i + 5j
output: Dot product formula use karo: A.B = ||A|| ||B|| cos(θ). Jaha θ angle hai, ||A|| aur ||B|| magnitudes hain, aur A.B dot product hai. Pehle A.B nikal lo: A.B = (4)(-3) + (2)(5) = -12 + 10 = -2. Ab dono vectors ke magnitudes nikalte hain: ||A|| = sqrt(4^2 + 2^2) = sqrt(16 + 4) = sqrt(20) = 2sqrt(5) ||B|| = sqrt((-3)^2 + 5^2) = sqrt(9 + 25) = sqrt(34) Formula me values daalte hain: cos(θ) = (A.B) / (||A|| ||B||) = -2 / (2sqrt(5)sqrt(34)) = -1/sqrt(85) θ = arccos(-1/sqrt(85)) = 82.82° Bas, angle approx 82.82 degrees hai.

instruction: Ek function likho jo diye gaye limit tak saare prime numbers ka sum nikal sake.
output: Python me ye raha function: ```python from math import sqrt def sum_of_primes(limit): if limit < 2: return 0 primes = [2] for n in range(3, limit+1, 2) : is_prime = True for i in primes: if i > sqrt(n): break if n % i == 0: is_prime = False break if is_prime: primes.append(n) return sum(primes) ``` Dekh, pehle function check karta hai ki limit 2 se kam toh nahi hai, kyunki 2 se neeche koi prime nahi hota. Agar aisa hai, toh seedha 0 return kar dega. Nahi toh, ek primes list banayega jisme starting me 2 hoga. Phir 3 se lekar limit tak saare odd numbers `n` ke liye check karega ki wo prime hai ya nahi. Iske liye wo check karta hai ki kia `sqrt(n)` tak ka koi prime number `n` ko divide kar raha hai. Agar `n` prime nikalta hai, toh usko list me add kar dega. Last me function saare primes ka sum return kar deta hai.

instruction: Ek list se duplicate elements remove karne ka code likho. [1, 2, 3, 2, 4, 5]
output: Ye lo Python code jo list se duplicates hata deta hai: ```python def remove_duplicates(input_list): # create an empty list to store the unique elements unique_list = [] # iterate over the elements in the input list for item in input_list: # if the item is not already in the unique list if item not in unique_list: # add it to the unique list unique_list.append(item) # return the unique list return unique_list # test the function with the given input input_list = [1, 2, 3, 2, 4, 5] result = remove_duplicates(input_list) # print the result print("Result:", result) ``` **Output**: ``` Result: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] ``` Ye code `remove_duplicates` naam ka akk function define karta hai jo input list leta hai. Ye ek `unique_list` banata hai jisme unique elements store hote hain. Phir for loop use karke `input_list` ke har element ko check kiya jata hai. Agar element `unique_list` mein nahi hai, to use append kar diya jata hai. Last mein, function wahi unique list return kar deta hai bina kisi duplication ke.

instruction: Maano tumhare paas "employees" naam ki ek table hai jisme "employee_id", "name", "start_date", "salary", aur "manager_id" columns hain. Har manager ke liye top 3 highest paid employees nikaalne ki SQL query likho.
output: Ye rahi SQL query jo har manager ke top 3 highest paid employees return karegi: ``` SELECT m.name AS manager_name, e.name AS employee_name, e.salary FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.manager_id = m.employee_id WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees WHERE manager_id = m.employee_id AND salary >= e.salary) <= 2 ORDER BY manager_name, salary DESC; ``` Is query me "employees" table ko manager_id ke basis pe self-join kiya gaya hai, aur fir subquery use karke salary ke according employees ko rank kiya gaya hai taaki top 3 mil sakein. instruction: Base six number 53_6 base b number 113_b ke equal hai. b ki positive value kya hogi?
output: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye, pehle 53_6 ko base ten mein convert karte hain: 53_6 = 5*6^1 + 3*6^0 = 33_10. Ab 113_b ko base ten mein express karte hain: 113_b = 1*b^2 + 1*b^1 + 3*b^0 = (b^2 + b + 3)_10. Kyunki 53_6 aur 113_b same number ko represent karte hain, toh: 33_10 = (b^2 + b + 3)_10. Bas ab b ki value nikaalni hai. Dono expressions ko equal kar do: b^2 + b + 3 = 33. Simplify karne pe equation aayegi: b^2 + b - 30 = 0. Ab left side ko factorize karo: (b - 5)(b + 6) = 0. Toh b ki possible values b = 5 aur b = -6 hain, par humein positive value chahiye, isliye b = 5 answer hai.

instruction: Maan lo tumhare paas "sales" naam ki ek table hai jisme "product_id", "sale_date", aur "sale_amount" columns hain. Ek SQL query likho un products ko dhoondhne ke liye jinki sales kam se kam 3 months tak lagatar badhi ho.
output: Ye query try kar, isse kaam ho jayega: ``` SELECT DISTINCT s1.product_id FROM sales s1 JOIN sales s2 ON s1.product_id = s2.product_id AND s2.sale_date = DATE_ADD(s1.sale_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) JOIN sales s3 ON s1.product_id = s3.product_id AND s3.sale_date = DATE_ADD(s2.sale_date, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) WHERE s2.sale_amount > s1.sale_amount AND s3.sale_amount > s2.sale_amount; ``` Is query mein "sales" table ko teen baar self-join kiya he, s1, s2, aur s3 aliases use karke taaki consecutive months mil sakein. Join condition ensure karti hai ki s2, s1 ke baad wala month ho aur s3, s2 ke baad wala. WHERE clause sirf wahi rows filter karta hai jahan sales 3 months tak continuously badhi ho. DISTINCT use kiya hai taaki product repeat na ho.

instruction: Is system of equations ko solve karne ke steps batao. x + 4y = 7 5x + 2y = 7
output: Dekh, aise solve hoga ye: Step 1: Dono equations likh le: x + 4y = 7 5x + 2y = 7 Step 2: Pehli equation ko 5 se multiply kar taaki x eliminate ho jaye: 5(x + 4y) = 5(7) 5x + 20y = 35 Step 3: Nayi first equation mein se second wali subtract kar: (5x + 20y) - (5x + 2y) = 35 - 7 5x + 20y - 5x - 2y = 28 18y = 28 Step 4: 18 se divide karke y ki value nikaal: 18y/18 = 28/18 y = 28/18 y = 14/9 Step 5: Ab y ki value kisi bhi original equation mein daal ke x nikaal: x + 4(14/9) = 7 x + 56/9 = 7 x = 7 - 56/9 x = (63/9) - (56/9) x = 7/9 Step 6: Final answer ordered pair mein likh: (x, y) = (7/9, 14/9) Toh final solution (7/9, 14/9) hai.

instruction: To Kill a Mockingbird ke protagonist aur antagonist ki moral values compare karke batao.
output: Harper Lee ki book 'To Kill a Mockingbird' mein do characters hain jo ek dum opposite moral values dikhate hain—Atticus Finch (protagonist) aur Bob Ewell (antagonist). Atticus ek lawyer aur father hai jo apni integrity, empathy aur fairness ke liye jana jata hai. Uska ek strong moral compass hai aur wo hamesha sahi kaam karne mein believe karta hai, bhale hi log usey pasand na karein. Ye tab saaf dikhta hai jab wo Tom Robinson ko defend karne ka decision leta hai, ek black man jispe white woman ke saath rape ka jhootha ilzaam tha. Dusri taraf, Bob Ewell bilkul opposite hai. Wo ek gareeb, uneducated aur racist aadmi aahe jo apne bacchon ko abuse karta hai aur usme koi morals ya decency nah hai. Wo bahut spiteful aur vengeful hai, bas apne matlab ke liye kisi ko bhi nuksan pahuncha sakta hai. Tom Robinson pe jhootha case karna bas apni reputation bachane ki ek koshish thi, jisse pata chalta hai ki usey sach aur justice se koi lena-dena nahi hai. Basically, Atticus aur Bob Ewell ke moral value systems ek dum alag hain. Atticus equality or justice mein believe karta hai, jabki Ewell gusse, resentment aur self-preservation se chalta hai. Ye contrast novel mein justice aur prejudice ke themes ko highlight karne ke liye bahut zaroori ha.

instruction: Ek algorithm banao jisse kisi investment ka end balance calculate kiya ja sake ek specific time period ke liye.
output: Ek investment ka end balance calculate karne ka algorithm ye raha: Initialize: Principal = p Interest Rate = r Time in years = t Compounding frequency = n End Balance = B Step 1: Start Step 2: p, r, t ar n ki values input lo. Step 3: Interest rate ko percentage se decimal mein convert karo 100 se divide karke. i.e. r = r / 100. Step 4: Total compounding times calculate karo time in years ar compounding frequency ko multiply karke. i.e. A = t * n. Step 5: Interest factor calculate karo, F = (1 + (r / n)). Step 6: End Balance calculate karo, B = p * pow (F, A) Step 7: End Balance ki value display karo. Step 8: Stop.

instruction: Python mein ek web crawler banao jo website se data scrape kare. Website URL: https://www.example.com/
output: ``` import requests from bs4 import BeautifulSoup url = 'https://www.example.com/' headers = { 'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/58.0.3029.110 Safari/537.36' } response = requests.get(url, headers=headers) soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser') # get all links on the page links = [] for link in soup.find_all('a'): links.append(link.get('href')) # get all text on the page text = soup.get_text() # print the results print(links) print(text) ``` Ye script requests package use karti hai HTTP GET request ke liye, ar custom User-Agent header dala hai taaki ye regular browser jaisa lage. Phir BeautifulSoup se HTML response parse karke links aur text nikal liye.

instruction: Ek chota sa article likhna hai kisi aisi nayi technology pe jo tumhe lagta hai ki duniya badal degi.
output: Artificial Intelligence (AI) ek aisi field hai jo bahut tezi se grow kar rahi aahe or hamari daily life ke bahut saare aspects ko revolutionize kar sakti hai. AI technology pehle se hi healthcare, transportation aur manufacturing jaise industries ko change kar rahi hai, aur iske growth aur innovation ki koi limit nahi hai. Ek AI tech jo duniya pe bada impact daalne wali hai, wo hai conversational AI. Ye AI ka wo form hai jisse computers human language ko natural ar intuitive tarike se samajh aur respond kar sakte hain. Isi tech se virtual assistants, chatbots aur voice-activated devices chalte hain, aur ye pehle se hi hamare technology ke saath interact karne ka tarika badal raha hai. Conversational AI kaafi versatile hai aur logo ki life kai tareekon se improve kar sakta hai. For example, isse zyada efficient self-service customer support platforms banaye ja sakte hain, jisse log apne sawalon ke jawab jaldi paa sakein. Iska use personal assistants banane mein bhi ho sakta hai jo appointments track karke, reminders bhej kar aur on-the-fly info de kar life organize karne mein help karein. Par iski potential sirf in basic functions tak nahi ha. Machine learning aur natural language processing mein advances ki wajah se, conversational AI systems ab aur sophisticated ho rahe hain, jisse wo context samajh sakte hain, intent recognize kar sakte hain aur humans ke saath interact karke seekh sakte hain. Iska matlab ye hai ki wo zyada complex tasks kar payenge, jaise personalized medical advice dena, nayi languages ya skills seekhne mein help karna, ya phir un logo ko emotional support aur companionship dena jinhe iski zaroorat hai. In short, conversational AI ek powerful technology hai jo hamari life ke bahut saare hisson ko revolutionize kar sakti hai. Jaise-jaise ye grow hogi, hum technology ke saath aur bhi natural tarike se interact kar payenge, aur communication, collaboration aur innovation ke naye raste khulenge. Isme koi doubt nahi hai ki aane wale saalon mein conversational AI ek game-changer hoga.

instruction: Ek classification model train karo emails ko "spam" ya "not-spam" classify karne ke liye, given dataset use karke. csv dataset jisme 200 emails hain.
output: Spam email classifier banane ke liye kuch steps follow karne honge. Sabse pehle data prepare karna hai. Pandas library use karke csv file ko dataframe mein read karenge. Dataset ko do parts mein split karna hoga: features (email text) aur target variable (spam ya not-spam label). Target variable ko numerical values mein badalna padega, jahan 1 "spam" ke liye aur 0 "not-spam" ke liye ho sakta hai. Next, features ko preprocess karna hai. Email texts unstructured data hote hain, toh unhe numerical feature vectors mein convert karna hoga. Iske liye Bag of Words technique use kar sakte hain. Sklearn library se CountVectorizer ya TfidfVectorizer use karke text data ko token counts ya tf-idf scores ke matrix mein badal sakte hain. Preprocessing ke baad, sklearn ke `train_test_split` se dataset ko training aur testing sets mein split karenge. Isse hum ek subset pe model train kar payenge aur doosre pe performance evaluate. Ab model train karne ki baari hai. Spam classification ke liye Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees ya Random Forests jaise algorithms use ho sakte hain. Alag-alag models try karke dekho aur jo best perform kare use choose kar lo. Training ke baad, test dataset pe accuracy, precision, recall aur f1-score jaise metrics se performance check karo. Agar result sahi hai, toh naye emails ko "spam" ya "not-spam" classify karne ke liye is model ko use kar sakte hain. Basically, process simple hai: data preparation, feature preprocessing, model training aur evaluation. 200 emails wali csv file ke saath ye steps follow karke classification model ready ho jayega.

instruction: Function f(x) ki values niche di gayi hain: x 3 4 5 6 7 f(x) 10 17 26 37 50 f^-1(f^-1(50)× f^-1(10)+f^-1(26)) evaluate karo.
output: Dekho, values ye hain: x 3 4 5 6 7 f(x) 10 17 26 37 50 Hamein f^-1(f^-1(50)× f^-1(10)+f^-1(26)) nikalna hai. Hum jante hain ki f(7) = 50, toh f^-1(50) = 7. Waise hi, f(3) = 10 aur f(5) = 26, toh f^-1(10) = 3 aur f^-1(26) = 5. Ab in values ko expression mein daal do: f^-1(f^-1(50)× f^-1(10)+f^-1(26)) = f^-1(7×3+5) = f^-1(26) = 5 Toh final answer 5 hai.

instruction: Ek python script likho jo GUI window display kare. Usme 'Save', 'Next', aur 'Exit' buttons hone chahiye aur unke upar ek text area.
output: Tkinter use karke ye lo sample code. Basic hai but kaam karega: ```python import tkinter as tk # Create the window window = tk.Tk() # Add a text area text_area = tk.Text(window) text_area.pack() # Create the buttons button_save = tk.Button(window, text="Save") button_next = tk.Button(window, text="Next") button_exit = tk.Button(window, text="Exit") # Add the buttons to the window button_save.pack(side=tk.LEFT) button_next.pack(side=tk.LEFT) button_exit.pack(side=tk.LEFT) # Run the window window.mainloop() ``` Isse ek GUI window ban jayegi jisme text area hoga aur buttons horizontally arrange honge.

instruction: Ye art piece apne time aur culture ke context mein kyun important hai, explain karo. The Night Watch by Rembrandt
output: Rembrandt ne 1642 mein 'The Night Watch' banayi thi, jo Dutch Golden Age art ka ek masterpiece hai aur duniya ki sabse famous paintings mein se ek aahe. 17th century mein Dutch Republic commercial prosperity aur artistic growth ke phase se guzar raha tha. Is painting mein civic guardsmen ka group hai, aur ye apne time ke hisaab se kai reasons se important hai. Pehle toh, isne group portraits banane ka style badal diya. Pehle aise portraits bahut formal aur static hote the, jahan log bas ek line mein khade hote the. Rembrandt ne is tradition ko toda aur figures ko dynamic aur theatrical tareeke se arrange kiya. Aisa lagta hai guardsmen action ke beech mein hain—kuch mud rahe hain, toh kuch aage badh rahe hain. Ye dramatic composition us time ke liye kaafi groundbreaking tha. Doosra, isme Rembrandt ki light aur shadow ki mastery dikhti ha. Usne 'chiaroscuro' technique use ki jisse bright aur dark areas ke beech ek tagda contrast create hua. Isse painting mein depth aayi aur focus seedha main figures par gaya. Finally, 'The Night Watch' Dutch Republic ke culture aur history ka ek record hai. Us time civic guardsmen city mein order maintain karne ke liye bahut zaroori the aur log unpe proud feel karte the. Painting mein wahi pride aur patriotism dikhta hai. Saath hi, us time ke fashions, costumes aur muskets ka bhi pata chalta hai. Overall, apni unique composition, technical mastery aur Dutch Golden Age ki history ko reflect karne ki wajah se ye ek bahut important work of art hai.

instruction: Is poem ko uske literary form, rhyme, rhythm aur figurative language ke hisaab se analyze karo. "To Sleep" by John Keats
output: "To Sleep" John Keats ki ek sonnet hai. Isme 14 lines hain—ek octave (8 lines) aur ek sestet (6 lines), jo ek typical Petrarchan sonnet ka structure hota hai. Rhyme scheme ABBAABBA CDCDCD hai, jo traditional format ko follow karti hai. Poem iambic pentameter mein likhi gayi hai, matlab har line mein 10 syllables hain aur stress every second syllable par hai, jisse ek rhythmic flow banta he. Message convey karne ke liye isme kaafi figurative language use hui hai. Starting lines mein Keats ne sleep ko personify kiya hai, use 'embalmer of the still midnight' bola hai. Ye metaphor batata hai ki sleep raat ki shanti ko preserve karti hai. Poet ne ek simile bhi use kiya ha, jahan sleep ko 'closing up of careful eyes' se compare kiya gaya ha taaki rest ke waqt surrender wali feeling dikhai ja sake. Poem mein imagery ka use karke sleep ki restful state ki vivid picture banayi gayi hai. 'sealing up the ship-boy's eyes' aur 'fainting slumber' jaise phrases deep sleep ko darshate hain. Last mein, lines 9-12 ki shuruat mein 'O' ko repeat karke anaphora use kiya gaya hai taaki speaker ki rest ke liye plea par emphasis aaye. Overall, "To Sleep" ek beautifully crafted poem hai jo literary techniques ka use karke apna message deti hai. Iski figurative language, imagery aur rhythmic structure milkar ise ek powerful poem banate hain.

instruction: Diagram mein, har circle do equal areas mein divided hai aur O larger circle ka center hai. Larger circle ka area 64π hai. Shaded regions ka total area kya hoga? [asy] size(100); import graph; fill(Arc((0,0),2,180,360)–cycle,mediumgray);fill(Arc((0,1),1,0,180)–cycle,mediumgray); draw(Circle((0,0),2)); draw(Circle((0,1),1)); dot((0,0)); label("O",(0,0),N); draw((-2,0)–(2,0)); draw((-1,1)–(1,1)); [/asy]
output: Dekho, larger circle ka area 64π hai aur dono circles equal areas mein divided hain, toh larger shaded area 64π ka 1/2 hoga, yaani 32π. Maano larger circle ka radius r hai. Since area 64π hai aur r > 0, toh: π r^2 = 64π r^2 = 64 r = sqrt(64) = 8. Ab smaller circle larger circle ke center se pass hota hai aur outer circle ko touch karta hai, toh symmetry ki wajah se iska diameter larger circle ke radius ke barabar hoga. (Simple words mein, agar hum larger circle ke center ko touch point se connect karein, toh wo line larger circle ka radius aur smaller circle ka diameter ban jayegi). Toh smaller circle ka diameter 8 hai, matlab iska radius 4 hai. Isliye, smaller circle ka area π(4^2) = 16π hoga, toh smaller shaded area 1/2 × 16π yaani 8π hoga. Total shaded area = 32π + 8π = 40π.

instruction: Ek integer n diya gaya hai, true return karo agar wo power of three hai. Nahi toh false return karo. Ek integer n power of three tab hota hai agar koi integer x aisa ho ki n == 3^x.
output: Is problem ko tum logarithm use karke solve kar sakte ho. Ye raha Python code: ```python import math def isPowerOfThree(n: int) -> bool: if n <= 0: return False x = round(math.log(n, 3)) return 3**x == n ``` `math.log(n, 3)` function `n` ka base 3 logarithm return karta hai, jisse humein equation `n == 3^x` mein exponent `x` mil jata hai. Hum `round` function use karke `x` ko nearest integer pe round off karte hain. Finally, hum check karte hain ki kyaaa `3**x` equal ah `n` ke, aur result return kar dete hain.
