instruction: Code parse karo aur samjhao ki ye algorithm kaise kaam karta hai. def binsearch(arr, x): start = 0 end = len(arr) - 1 while start <= end: mid = (start + end)//2 if arr[mid] == x: return mid elif arr[mid] > x: end = mid - 1 else: start = mid + 1 return none
output: Ye binary search ka implementation hai, jo sorted array 'arr' mein target value 'x' ki position dhoondta hai. Input mein array aur target value li jati ha. Sabse pehle, 'start' aur 'end' variables initialize hote hain taaki array ke segment ke indices track ho sakein. Shuru mein poora array consider hota hai, toh 'start' 0 aahe ar 'end' last index (len(arr)-1) hai. Ek 'while' loop chalta hai jab tak 'start' less than or equal to 'end' ho. Is loop ka kaam search range ko tab tak narrow down karna hai jab tak target element na mil jaye ya ye confirm na ho jaye ki element array mein nhi hai. Loop ke andar, 'start' ar 'end' ka average nikal kar 'mid' index calculate hota aahe. Phir check hota hai ki kya 'mid' index wala element target value 'x' ke equal hai. Agar hai, toh 'mid' return ho jata hai. Agar 'mid' index wala element target value se bada hai, toh target left half mein hoga. Isliye 'end' ko 'mid-1' kar diya jata hai, jisse search range left half ho jati hai. Agar element target se chhota hai, toh target right half mein hoga. Tab 'start' ko 'mid+1' kar diya jata hai, aur search range right half ho jati hai. Jab loop khatam hota ha aur target nahi milta, toh function 'none' return karta hai, jiska matlab hai ki target value array mein nahi hai.

instruction: Samjhao ki is type ka system kaise kaam karta hai. A distributed ledger system uses a peer-to-peer network in which all participants maintain a copy of the same ledger.
output: Distributed ledger system basically ek database hota hai jo computers ke ek network pe spread hota hai. Is system mein, network ke saare participants ke paas ledger ki ek copy hoti he, jo network mein hue saare transactions ka record rakhti aahe. Iska main idea ye hai ki multiple parties ek saath information access aur update kar sakein, or saath hi data secure aur accurate rahe. Ledger saare participants ke beech synchronized rehta hai, toh agar kisi ek ki copy baakiyon se alag hui, toh network use reject kar dega. Isse fraudulent transactions ya mistakes ka chance khatam ho jata hai. Iska ek bada feature ye hai ki ye decentralized hai, matlab koi ek central authority nhi hoti jo ledger maintain kare. Iske bajaye, transactions network participants dwara validate hote hain, usually ek consensus mechanism ke through, jahan majority ko agree karna padta hai ki transaction valid hai tabhi wo record hota ha. Blockchain iska sabse famous example hai, jo Bitcoin jaise cryptocurrencies mein use hota hai. Ismein transactions blocks mein group hote hain, aur har block pichle block se cryptographically linked hota hai, jisse ek 'blockchain' banti hai. Is wajah se ledger ko alter karna bahut mushkil hai, kyunki ek block badalne ke liye saare subsequent blocks badalne padenge, jo network turant detect kar lega. Overall, distributed ledger system data record aur share karne ka ek secure, transparent aur efficient tareeka hai.

National Gardening Association ke ek article mein likha hai ki soil organic material aur minerals se bani hoti hai jo growth support karti hai, jabki paani mein ye properties nahi hoti isliye extra nutrients dene padte hain. Overall, scientific studies suggest karti hain ki kai cases mein plants soil mein better grow karte hain kyunki soil woh support aur nutrients deta hai jo sirf paani se nahi milte.

instruction: Ek rectangle ka perimeter 48 hai. Iska maximum possible area kya hoga?

instruction: Ek persuasive essay likho jisme kisi particular point of view ko support kiya gaya ho. Topic: Online Education ke fayde
output: Tech ki wajah se hamari daily life kaafi badal gayi hai, aur education bhi isse alag nahi hai. Online education, yaani internet ke zariye seekhna, ab bohot grow kar chuka hai kyunki digital communication infrastructure improve hua hai. Is essay mein main online education ke benefits par focus karunga aur bataunga ki aaj ke students ke liye ye kyun zaroori hai. Sabse bada advantage iski flexibility hai. Online courses mein students apne pace pe seekh sakte hain, bina kisi fixed classroom timing ke. Iska matlab hai ki student us material pe zyada time laga sakta hai jo use mushkil lagta hai, aur jo aata hai use jaldi skip kar sakta hai. Saath hi, bas internet connection chahiye aur tum kahin se bhi class attend kar sakte ho. Ye un students ke liye bohot helpful hai jinhe job ya family commitments manage karne padte hain. Doosra fayda ye hai ki courses ki range bohot wide milti hai. Local colleges mein limited courses hote hain, aur zaroori nahi ki wahan wo subject mile jo student padhna chahta hai. Par online education se tum duniya bhar ke institutions ke kisi bhi course mein enroll kar sakte ho. Isse un logo ke liye opportunities khul jati hain jo niche subjects mein interest rakhte hain. Ek or point ye hai ki online education cost-effective hai. Traditional on-campus courses ke muqable online programs ki tuition fees aksar kam hoti hai. Iske alawa, transport aur hostel ka kharcha bhi bach jata hai. Lastly, online education se self-motivation, discipline aur responsibility aati hai—jo life skills bohot valuable hain. Online course mein student apni learning journey ke liye khud responsible hota hai. Use apna schedule commit karna padta hai aur workload independently manage karna hota hai. Ye experience student ko goal achieve karne ke liye determination deta hai. Conclusion mein, online education flexibility, variety, low cost aur discipline jaise bohot saare benefits deta hai. Hume is potential ko recognize karna chahiye aur ise traditional learning ke ek viable alternative ki tarah accept karna chahiye. Aisa karne se students ko apni learning maximize karne ke better resources milenge.

instruction: Ek convex polygon ka ek interior angle 160 degrees hai. Baaki saare interior angles 112 degrees hain. Polygon ki kitni sides hain?
output: Algebra se solve karte hain. Maan lo sides ki number 'x' hai. Hume pata hai ki x sides wale polygon ke saare angles ka sum 180(x-2) hota hai. Question ke hisab se, ek angle 160 hai, toh baaki (x-1) angles 112 degrees ke honge. Toh sum ki 1 aur equation banegi: 160 + 112(x-1). Dono equations ko equal kar do: 180(x-2) = 160 + 112(x-1). Simplify karne pe: 68x = 408. x nikalne pe: x = 6. Matlab 6 sides hain, toh ye ek hexagon hai.

instruction: Is series ka sum calculate karo: 1 + 4 + 7 + 10 + ... + 91
output: Dekh, ye ek arithmetic sequence aahe jahan first term (a1) 1 ha aur common difference (d) 3 hai. nth term ka formula hota hai an = a1 + (n - 1)d. Pehle terms ki quantity (n) nikalte hain: 91 = 1 + (n - 1)3 (91 - 1) = 3(n - 1) 90 = 3n - 3 n = (90 + 3) / 3 n = 31. Ab sum ka formula use karenge: Sn = (n/2) * (a1 + an). Values put karte hain: S31 = (31/2) * (1 + 91) = 1431. Toh final sum 1431 ha.

instruction: Variables wale expressions ko simplify karne ke liye ek function likho. Example: input: (x + 2)(2x + 3) output: 2x^2 + 7x + 6
output: Is tarah ke binomial multiplication expressions ko simplify karne ke liye FOIL method (First, Outer, Inner, Last) use karo aur phir like terms ko combine kar lo. Python mein ye function aise likh sakte ho: ``` def simplify_expression(expr): # Remove any whitespace and convert to a list of terms terms = expr.replace(' ', '').split('*') # Initialize variables to store the FOIL products first = '' outer = '' inner = '' last = '' # Iterate through the terms to extract the factors of each binomial for term in terms: if term[1] == '+': a, b = term.split('+') else: a, b = term.split('-') b = '-' + b if not first: first = a last = b else: outer = a + '*' + last inner = first + '*' + b # Multiply the FOIL products and combine like terms result = eval(outer) + eval(inner) + eval(first) * eval(last) return simplify(result) def simplify(expr): # Use SymPy library to combine like terms and simplify from sympy import Symbol, expand x = Symbol('x') return str(expand(expr.replace('^', '**').replace('x', 'x'))) ``` Ab tum is function ko `(x + 2)(2x + 3)` ke saath call kar sakte ho aur ye tumhe `2*x**2 + 7*x + 6` return karega. Bas ye dhyan rakhna ki input expression ek valid binomial multiplication hona chahiye bina kisi syntax error ke.

instruction: C++ mein QT use karke ek GUI interface banao jisme "UP" aur "DOWN" buttons hon aur beech mein ek textarea ho.
output: Ye raha ek simple code snippet jisse tum Qt in C++ use karke 'UP' or 'DOWN' buttons aur beech mein text area wala interface bana sakte ho: ``` #include <QApplication> #include <QWidget> #include <QPushButton> #include <QTextEdit> #include <QVBoxLayout> int main(int argc, char *argv[]) { QApplication app(argc, argv); QWidget window; window.setWindowTitle("Up Down Buttons"); // Create buttons QPushButton *upButton = new QPushButton("UP"); QPushButton *downButton = new QPushButton("DOWN"); // Create text area QTextEdit *textArea = new QTextEdit(); // Add buttons and text area to a vertical layout QVBoxLayout *layout = new QVBoxLayout(); layout->addWidget(upButton); layout->addWidget(textArea); layout->addWidget(downButton); // Set widget layout window.setLayout(layout); window.show(); return app.exec(); } ``` Is code mein 'UP' aur 'DOWN' buttons ke liye `QPushButton` use kiya hai aur text area ke liye `QTextEdit`. In sab widgets ko `QVBoxLayout` use karke vertical layout mein dala hai, or `setLayout()` se window pe set kar diya hai. Finally, `show()` aur `app.exec()` se interface display ho jata hai aur event loop start ho jata aahe.

instruction: Ek integer n diya hai, n+1 length ka array ans return karo jisme ans[i] binary representation mein 1s ka count ho. Python mein shortest solution likho.
output: Python mein iska shortest solution ye raha: ``` def countBits(n): return [bin(i).count('1') for i in range(n+1)] ``` Isme list comprehension use kiya hai array generate karne ke liye. 0 se n tak har integer i ke liye `bin()` function se binary string nikali hai, aur phir `.count('1')` se 1s ko count kiya hai. Ye count seedha array mein add hota jata hai ar end mein pura array return ho jata hai.

instruction: Ek C++ function likho jo SQL database query kare is problem solve karne ke liye: Suppose you have a table named "employees" with columns "employee_id", "name", "start_date", "salary", and "department_id". Write a SQL query to find the department with the highest average salary per employee.
output: Ye raha C++ function jo problem solve kar dega: ```cpp #include <iostream> #include <mysql.h> using namespace std; void findHighestAvgSalaryPerEmployee(MYSQL* conn) { MYSQL_RES* res; MYSQL_ROW row; string query = "SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) as avg_salary_per_employee FROM employees GROUP BY department_id ORDER BY avg_salary_per_employee DESC LIMIT 1"; if (mysql_query(conn, query.c_str())) { cerr << "Error querying database: " << mysql_error(conn) << endl; mysql_close(conn); exit(1); } res = mysql_use_result(conn); if (res) { row = mysql_fetch_row(res); cout << "Department with highest average salary per employee: " << row[0] << endl; } else { cerr << "Error getting result set: " << mysql_error(conn) << endl; mysql_close(conn); exit(1); } mysql_free_result(res); } int main() { MYSQL* conn = mysql_init(NULL); if (conn == NULL) { cerr << "Error initializing MySQL: " << mysql_error(conn) << endl; exit(1); } if (mysql_real_connect(conn, "localhost", "username", "password", "database", 3306, NULL, 0) == NULL) { cerr << "Error connecting to database: " << mysql_error(conn) << endl; mysql_close(conn); exit(1); } findHighestAvgSalaryPerEmployee(conn); mysql_close(conn); return 0; } ``` Ye function MySQL C++ Connector use karke database se connect karta hai aur 'employees' table query karta hai. Pehle ek SQL query string banata hai jo har department ka average salary calculate karke descending order mein sort karti hai aur top row return karti hai. Phir query execute karke highest average salary waale department ki ID output kar deta hai.

instruction: Ek integer `n` diya hai, true return karo agar woh power of four hai, nahi toh false. An integer `n` is a power of four, if there exists an integer `x` such that `n == 4^x`.
output: Agar check karna hai ki `n` power of four hai ya nah, toh simple hai—`n` ka log base 4 lo aur dekho result integer hai ya nahi. Agar integer hai, toh power of four he. Python code ye raha: ```python import math def is_power_of_four(n): if n <= 0: return False x = math.log(n, 4) return x == int(x) ``` Function pehle check karta hai ki `n` zero ya negative toh nhi hai, kyunki tab toh power of four ho hi nhi sakta. Phir `math.log` use karke base 4 calculate karta hai. Agar result integer match hua ta `True`, warna `False`. Example ke liye, `is_power_of_four(16)` True dega kyunki 16 = 4^2 hota ah.

instruction: Is matrix ka determinant find karo. [1 8 3] [2 7 9] [5 1 6]
output: Dekho, 3x3 matrix ka determinant aise nikalte hain: |A| = a * (ei - fh) - b * (di - fg) + c * (dh - eg) Yahan elements hain: a = 1, b = 8, c = 3 d = 2, e = 7, f = 9 g = 5, h = 1, i = 6 Formula mein values daalo: |A| = 1 * (7*6 - 9*1) - 8 * (2*6 - 9*5) + 3 * (2*1 - 7*5) |A| = 1 * 33 - 8 * -33 + 3 * -33 |A| = 33 + 264 - 99 |A| = 198 Toh final answer 198 ah.

instruction: Ek complex mathematical equation di hai, specific variable ke liye solve karo. Solve for x: y = 4x^2 + 3x - 10
output: Is equation y = 4x^2 + 3x - 10 ko solve karne ke liye quadratic formula use kar sakte hain. Pehle equation ko standard form `ax^2 + bx + c = 0` mein lana hoga. y ko subtract karo toh milega `4x^2 + 3x - 10 - y = 0`. Ab coefficients ho gaye a = 4, b = 3, aur c = -10 - y. Quadratic formula hota ha `x = (-b ± √(b^2-4ac)) / (2a)`. Values put karo: `x = (-3 ± √(3^2 - 4 * 4 * (-10-y))) / (2 * 4)` `= (-3 ± √(9 + 160 + 16y)) / 8` `= (-3 ± √(169 + 16y)) / 8` Toh x ki values hain `x = (-3 + √(169 + 16y)) / 8` aur `x = (-3 - √(169 + 16y)) / 8`.

instruction: C++ mein suffix tree implement kar de. Input strings mein sirf lowercase English alphabet ('a' to 'z') hone chahiye.
output: Ye le, C++ mein suffix tree ka implementation: ``` #include <iostream> #include <vector> #include <unordered_map> using namespace std; class SuffixTree { private: struct Node { int start; int end; Node* suffixLink; unordered_map<char, Node*> children; Node(int start, int end) { this->start = start; this->end = end; suffixLink = nullptr; } int getLength() { return min(end, (int)text.size()) - start; } string getText() { return text.substr(start, getLength()); } void addChild(Node* node) { char c = text[node->start]; children[c] = node; } }; Node* root; Node* activeNode; int activeEdge; int activeLength; int remaining; string text; public: SuffixTree(string text) { this->text = text; root = new Node(-1, -1); activeNode = root; activeEdge = -1; activeLength = 0; remaining = 0; build(); } void print() { printHelper(root, 0); } private: Node* split(Node* node) { if (activeLength == 0) { return node; } char startChar = text[node->start + activeEdge]; Node* child = node->children[startChar]; int splitEnd = node->start + activeEdge + activeLength - 1; if (child->getLength() == activeLength) { return child; } Node* splitNode = new Node(child->start, child->start + activeLength); node->addChild(splitNode); child->start += activeLength; splitNode->addChild(child); return splitNode; } void extend(int index) { remaining++; Node* lastNode = nullptr; while (remaining > 0) { if (activeLength == 0) { activeEdge = index; } char nextChar = text[index]; if (activeNode->children[nextChar] == nullptr) { Node* newNode = new Node(index, text.size()); activeNode->addChild(newNode); if (lastNode != nullptr) { lastNode->suffixLink = activeNode; } lastNode = activeNode; } else { Node* nextNode = activeNode->children[nextChar]; if (walkDown(nextNode)) { continue; } char nextChar2 = text[nextNode->start + activeLength]; if (nextChar == nextChar2) { activeLength++; if (lastNode != nullptr) { lastNode->suffixLink = activeNode; } break; } Node* splitNode = split(nextNode); Node* newNode = new Node(index, text.size()); activeNode->addChild(splitNode); newNode->addChild(splitNode); activeNode->addChild(newNode); if (lastNode != nullptr) { lastNode->suffixLink = newNode; } lastNode = newNode; } remaining--; if (activeNode == root && activeLength > 0) { activeLength--; activeEdge = index - remaining + 1; } else { activeNode = activeNode->suffixLink != nullptr ? activeNode->suffixLink : root; } } } bool walkDown(Node* node) { int length = node->getLength(); if (activeLength >= length) { activeEdge += length; activeLength -= length; activeNode = node; return true; } return false; } void build() { for (int i = 0; i < text.size(); i++) { extend(i); } } void printHelper(Node* node, int level) { cout << string(level * 2, ' ') << node->getText() << endl; for (auto child : node->children) { printHelper(child.second, level + 1); } } }; int main() { string text = "abcabxabcd"; SuffixTree st(text); st.print(); return 0; } ```

instruction: Diye gaye input ko use karke ek traveler ki story likho. The traveler was tired and hungry, but he kept going.

Usne kuch lakdiyan ikatthi ki aur ek chhoti si aag jalayi, jiski garmahat aur roshni ne use sukoon diya. Wo aag ke paas baith gaya aur apni aankhein band karke khayalon mein kho gaya. instruction: Mujhe aksar aisa construction dikhta hai: > I look forward to hearing from you soon. Ye thoda ajeeb lagta hai. Mere hisaab se "to hear" zyada sahi lagta. Pata nahi verbals ka kuch chakkar hai ya kya... Khair, mujhe ye jaanna hai ki correct form kaunsa hai aur kyun?
output: Is case mein "to hearing from you" hi correct hai. Scene ye he ki "look forward to" ek phrasal verb hai jiske baad usually gerund ya noun aata hai. Gerunds wo verb forms hote hain jo noun ki tarah kaam karte hain ar "-ing" pe end hote hain. Toh yahan "hearing" ek gerund hai jo preposition "to" ke object ki tarah use ho raha hai. Infinitive form "to hear" use karna galat hoga kyunki wo adverbial infinitive ki tarah kaam karega, aur "look forward to" ke saath adverbial infinitives nahi lagte. For example, "I want to hear from you soon" sahi hai kyunki "want" ke saath infinitive aata hai. Toh summary ye hai ki "look forward to" ke saath gerund ya noun lagao, isliye "to hearing" hi correct construction hai.

instruction: Ek aisa software package design karo jo is problem ko solve kare: Businesses ko internal communication aur collaboration ke liye ek system chahiye.

Iska interface kaafi intuitive aur user-friendly hai, jisse daily tasks easy ho jate hain aur productivity badhti hai. Features: 1. Chat: Is feature se businesses teams, departments ya poori organization ke liye chat rooms bana sakte hain. Team members real-time mein baat kar sakte hain, files share kar sakte hain aur tasks pe easily collaborate kar sakte hain. 2. Forums: Forums feature se businesses different topics ke liye discussion boards bana sakte hain, jaise upcoming events, project management, aur business strategy. Isse saari communication ek jagah rehti hai aur open communication ka environment banta hai. 3. File Sharing: Internal Connect secure file sharing options deta hai taaki teams documents pe collaborate kar sakein. Version control ki wajah se changes track karna easy hai aur projects mein koi confusion nahi hota. 4. Task Management: Internal Connect ke task management feature se teams tasks create aur assign kar sakte hain, deadlines set kar sakte hain ar progress track kar sakte hain. Isse accountability badhti hai aur sab apni responsibilities pe updated rehte hain. 5. Calendar: Calendar feature se businesses events, meetings aur deadlines schedule or organize kar sakte hain. Is calendar ko team members ke saath share kiya ja sakta hai ya private rakha ja sakta hai, taaki sab ek hi page pe rahein. 6. Notification System: Software mein ek notification system hai jo team members ko new messages, task updates aur upcoming events ke baare mein alert karta hai. Isse sab loop mein rehte hain aur important updates miss nahi hote. 7. User Management: Internal Connect advanced user management options deta hai, jisse businesses user accounts create or manage kar sakte hain. Isse access control karna easy hota hai, taaki sensitive information secure rahe. 8. Customization: Software fully customizable hai, toh businesses isse apni zaroorat ke hisaab se tailor kar sakte hain. Custom branding se lekar personalized dashboards tak, Internal Connect flexibility deta hai ki software ko apna banaya ja sake. instruction: Tum blockchain ka concept kisi aise insaan ko kaise samjhaoge jisne iske baare mein pehle kabhi nahi suna?
output: Blockchain ek tarah ka database hai jo data ko safe, secure or aise store karta hai ki ek baar entry ho jaye toh use change karna bahut mushkil hota hai. Isko ek ledger ki tarah samjho jahan saari transactions record hoti hain. Ye kisi ek computer pe store hone ke bajaye internet pe multiple computers mein evenly distributed hota hai. Data ka har block ek page jaisa hota hai, jisme multiple transactions hoti hain. Jab ek block full ho jata hai, toh wo pichle blocks ki chain mein jud jata hai, jisse 'blockchain' banta hai. Har block pichle aur agle block se ek unique code ke through connected hota hai jise cryptographic hash kehte hain. Ye code ek fingerprint ki tarah hota hai—unique hota he aur ensure karta hai ki koi bhi block mein chori-chupe badlav na kar sake. Iske setup ki wajah se kisi ek insaan ke liye blockchain data ko control karna bahut hard hai. Isliye ye financial transactions ya property records jaisi important information ke liye best choice hai. Is technology se hum bina kisi bank ya government agency jaise middleman ke paise ya property deeds transfer kar sakte hain.

instruction: Doosre types ke natural language processing models ke muqable GPT models ki limitations explain karo.
output: GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) models deep learning techniques use karke text generate karte hain. Inki strengths toh bahut hain, jaise coherent aur contextually relevant text likhna, par doosre NLP models ke muqable kuch limitations bhi hain: 1. Data Bias: GPT models puri tarah apne training data pe depend karte hain. Agar training data biased hai, toh model apne outputs mein wahi bias reflect karega. Ye sensitive applications mein problematic ho sakta hai, jaise race, gender ya religion se related text generate karte waqt. 2. Lack of Understanding: Ye models fluent text generate karne mein toh expert hain, par inhe actually text ka matlab nahi pata hota. Iska matlab ye hai ki ye aisa text likh sakte hain jo grammatically correct lage par factually galat ho, ya jisme common sense ki kami ho. 3. Difficult to Control Outputs: Inke outputs pe control rakhna mushkil he. Model sirf next word ki probability pe text generate karta hai, isliye bina "prompt engineering" ke output ko specific direction mein steer karna hard hota hai. 4. Large Resource Requirements: GPT models, khaaskar bade wale, train aur run karne ke liye bahut zyada computational power aur memory maangte hain. Is wajah se small organizations ya individual developers ke liye inhe use karna mushkil hota hai. 5. Difficulty in Fine-tuning: Inhe medical ya legal jaise specific domains ke liye fine-tune karna challenging hota hai. Kyunki ye general text pe trained hote hain, toh specialized text ke liye inhein adapt karne mein kaafi effort ar domain-specific knowledge lagti hai. Overall, GPT models ki apni limitations hain. Inhe use karte waqt ye baatein dhyan mein rakhna zaroori hai taaki inhe responsibly aur sahi context mein use kiya ja sake.

instruction: Maan lo tumhare paas "transactions" naam ki ek table hai jisme "transaction_id", "customer_id", "transaction_date", aur "amount" columns hain. Ek SQL query likho jisse wo customers mil jayein jinki spending pichle mahine ke muqable is mahine sabse zyada percentage increase hui hai.
output: Ye SQL query check karo, isse kaam ho jayega: ``` SELECT current_month.customer_id, 100 * (current_month.total_spending - previous_month.total_spending) / previous_month.total_spending AS percentage_increase FROM ( SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_spending FROM transactions WHERE YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) AND MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY customer_id ) AS current_month INNER JOIN ( SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_spending FROM transactions WHERE YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) GROUP BY customer_id ) AS previous_month ON current_month.customer_id = previous_month.customer_id ORDER BY percentage_increase DESC LIMIT 1; ``` Is query mein subqueries use ki gayi hain taaki current month aur previous month ki total spending per customer calculate ki ja sake. Phir hum in dono subqueries ko customer_id pe join karte hain aur percentage increase nikaalte hain. Last mein, results ko descending order mein sort karke sirf top result uthaya gaya hai (yaani wo customer jiska spending increase sabse zyada hai).

instruction: Van Gogh aur Claude Monet ke 'The Starry Night' paintings ke beech ka difference batao.
input:
Version A: The Starry Night by Van Gogh
Version B: The Starry Night by Claude Monet
output: Van Gogh aur Claude Monet dono ne 'The Starry Night' banayi hai, naam same hai par dono paintings ekdum alag hain. Dekho differences kya hain: 1. Style: Van Gogh ki painting post-impressionist style ka perfect example ah, jisme thick brushstrokes aur heavy texture hai. Wahin Monet ki painting impressionistic style mein hai, jisme loose brushwork hai aur light capture karne pe focus ah. 2. Colors aur Atmosphere: Van Gogh wale version mein moody blue aur black sky hai, aur stars aur moon ke liye bright yellows or whites use kiye gaye hain. Isse akk turbulent energy feel hoti aahe. Monet ka version zyada serene hai, pastel blue dominant color hai, aur clouds aur shaant paani ki wajah se ek ethereal vibe aati hai. 3. Composition: Dono ka composition kaafi different hai. Van Gogh ka version zyada dynamic hai, swirling clouds aur stars poore canvas pe chhaaye hue hain, ar left side pe ek cypress tree sky ki taraf ja raha hai. Dusri taraf, Monet ka composition balanced hai—upar half sky hai aur niche half mein sky ka reflection paani mein dikh raha hai. 4. Mood: Mood bhi alag hai. Van Gogh ki painting emotionally charged lagti ah, swirling clouds mein ek tension aur movement hai. Monet ki painting peaceful or contemplative hai, soft colors aur shaant paani se ek stillness feel hoti hai. Overall, dono apne artists ke style ke best examples hain, par style, composition, colors aur mood ke maamle mein kaafi different hain.

instruction: Outcome predict karne ke liye ek statistical model construct karo. Dataset mein gender, age, occupation, aur income hai.
output: Maan lete hain ki data gather aur preprocess ho chuka hai aur humare paas target variable ah. Is task ko aise approach kar sakte hain: 1. Dataset Exploration: Pehle data ko samajho. Outliers ya missing values check karo aur unhe handle karo. Summary stats nikalo or visualization se variables ka relation dekho. 2. Model Selection: Outcome variable ke hisaab se model choose karo. Agar continuous hai toh linear regression, aur agar categorical hai toh logistic regression ya decision tree use karo. 3. Feature Encoding: Categorical variables ko numerical mein badlo (like one-hot encoding), kyunki models categorical data handle nahi kar paate. 4. Model Training: Data ko training aur validation set mein split karo. Training set pe model fit karo aur validation set pe performance check karo (regression ke liye MSE ya classification ke liye accuracy). 5. Fine-tuning: Hyperparameters optimize karo. Iske liye cross-validation ya grid search use kar sakte ho. 6. Model Evaluation: Last mein ek separate test set pe final model evaluate karo taaki generalization check ho sake. Bas ye steps follow karke hum gender, age, occupation, aur income se outcome predict karne wala model bana lenge.

instruction: Ek regular expression banao jo is pattern ko match kare: Koi bhi word jo 'c' se start ho aur 'h' pe end ho
output: Jo regex 'c' se start aur 'h' pe end hone waale words ko match karega vo ye hai: ``` \b[cC]\w*[hH]\b ``` Explanation: - `\b` word boundary ke liye hai - `[cC]` matches 'c' or 'C' (case insensitive) - `\w*` kitne bhi word characters (letters, digits, underscores) match karega - `[hH]` matches 'h' or 'H' (case insensitive) - `\b` word boundary end karta hai

instruction: In do lines ke beech banne waale angle ka size nikalo. Line 1: y=3x+2 Line 2: y=7x+4
output: Do lines ke beech ka angle nikalne ke liye, pehle humein dono lines ka slope pata hona chahiye. Line ka slope-intercept form y = mx + b hota aahe, jahan m slope hai aur b y-intercept. Toh Line 1 ke liye slope 3 hai, aur Line 2 ke liye slope 7 hai. Do lines jinke slopes m1 aur m2 hon, unke beech ka angle is formula se nikalta hai: θ = | atan(m1) - atan(m2) |, jahan atan inverse tangent function hai. Line 1 aur Line 2 ke slopes formula mein daalne par: θ = | atan(3) - atan(7) | Calculator use karke, humein milta hai atan(3) ≈ 71.56° aur atan(7) ≈ 81.87° Toh, θ = | 71.56 - 81.87 | ≈ 10.31° Iska matlab, given lines ke beech ka angle approximately 10.31 degrees hai.

instruction: Ek given dataset use karke, outcome predict karne ke liye machine learning model banao. sklearn use karo. Data set: population ka temperature aur height Outcome: BMI
output: Scikit-learn use karke BMI predict karne wala ML model banane ke liye ye steps follow kar: 1. Dataset load kar 2. Dataset ko training aur testing sets mein split kar 3. Data preprocess kar (jaise normalize karna ya feature engineering) 4. Regression ke liye ek suitable model choose kar 5. Training dataset pe model ko train kar 6. Testing dataset pe model ki performance evaluate kar 7. New data pe predictions ke liye model use kar Ye raha ek example code jo linear regression use karke temperature aur height ke basis pe BMI predict karta hai: ``` import pandas as pd from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error # Load the dataset data = pd.read_csv('data.csv', header=0) # Split the dataset into training and testing sets X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(data[['temperature', 'height']], data['BMI'], test_size=0.2) # Preprocess the data (e.g. normalize data or do any feature engineering) # Choose a suitable model for regression model = LinearRegression() # Train the model on the training dataset model.fit(X_train, y_train) # Evaluate the model's performance on the testing dataset y_pred = model.predict(X_test) mse = mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred) print("Mean squared error: ", mse) # Use the model to make predictions on new data new_data = pd.DataFrame({'temperature': [26.5, 27.0], 'height': [175, 180]}) model.predict(new_data) ``` Bas 'data.csv' ko apni file name se replace kar lena, aur features aur model ko zaroorat ke hisaab se adjust kar lena.

instruction: Universe ki origin ki do theories—Big Bang aur Steady State—ko compare aur contrast karo.
output: Dekho, Big Bang aur Steady State dono theories universe kaise start hua aur evolve hua, wahi samjhane ki koshish karti hain. Dono hi modern cosmology pe based hain aur kaafi scientists inhe maante hain. Par inme kuch bade differences hain. Big Bang theory kehti hai ki universe ek bahut hi compressed aur hot state (singularity) se shuru hua tha. Lagbhag 13.8 billion years pehle ek massive explosion hua, jisse saara matter aur energy create hui. Tab se universe expand aur cool ho raha hai, jisse stars or galaxies bane. Doosri taraf, Steady State theory kehti hai ki universe ka na koi start ha na end, yeh hamesha se aisa hi tha jaisa aaj dikhta hai. Iske hisaab se universe eternal hai aur expand hote waqt naya matter banta rehta hai taaki density constant rahe. Sabse bada difference 'shuruat' ka hai—Big Bang kehta hai ek definite start tha, Steady State kehta hai hamesha se tha. Ek aur baat, Big Bang predict karta hai ki pehle universe zyada dense aur hot tha, jabki Steady State kehta hai ki hamesha almost same raha. Inki predictions CMB (Cosmic Microwave Background) radiation pe bhi alag hain. CMB wahi thermal radiation hai jo Big Bang ke baad bachi thi. Big Bang theory predict karti hai ki CMB uniform hona chahiye, par Steady State mein aisa nahi he. Observations se Big Bang theory hi sahi lagti hai kyunki CMB evidence wahi deta hai. Toh basically, dono theories apni jagah hain, par Big Bang zyada accepted hai kyunki uske predictions observational evidence se match karte hain.

instruction: x ki value nikalo jahan ⌊ x ⌋ + x = 13/3. x ko common fraction mein likhna.
output: Pehle toh yeh dekh lo ki x positive hona chahiye, nahi ta ⌊ x ⌋ + x nonpositive ho jayega. Ab, x ka decimal part 1/3 hona chahiye, toh hum x ko n+1/3 likh sakte hain (jahan n greatest integer hai). Toh equation ban gayi n + n + 1/3 = 13/3. Isko solve karenge toh n=2 aayega. So, x ki value 2 + 1/3 hogi, jo fraction mein 7/3 hai.

instruction: Ek mathematical equation banao 100g substance ke movement ke liye 273 K se 293 K temperature tak.
output: Formula simple hai: q = m × c × ΔT Yahan: - q (joules ya J) heat absorbed ya released hai, - m (grams ya g) substance ka mass hai, - c (J g^-1 K^-1) specific heat capacity hai, - ΔT (kelvin ya K) temperature change hai (yani 293 K - 273 K = 20 K). Toh 100g substance ke liye equation hogi: q = 100 g × c × 20 K Ya phir q = 2000 × c J (Note: Specific heat capacity 'c' material ke hisaab se change hoti hai, toh exact value nikalne ke liye 'c' pata hona chahiye ya calorimeter se measure karna padega).

instruction: In economic theories mein se do select karo aur short mein samjhao Supply-Side economics, Keynesian economics
output: Dekh, main ye do explain kar deta hoon: Supply-side economics ek aisi theory hai jo kehti hai ki economic growth badhane ke liye taxes kam karne chahiye aur regulations ghatane chahiye taaki production badhe. Iska basic belief ye hai ki producers hi growth ke main drivers hote hain, toh agar unke liye barriers kam honge toh economy stimulate hogi. Business aur individuals pe tax kam karne se unke paas investment aur consumption ke liye zyada paisa bachega. Doosra hai Keynesian economics. Ye theory kehti he ki economy ko stabilize karne ke liye, khaas karke recession ke time, government intervention zaroori hai. John Maynard Keynes ne ise Great Depression ke time develop kiya tha. Iska main point ye hai ki demand economy ko drive karti hai, supply nahi. Keynesians ka manna ah ki jab recession mein demand girti aahe, toh government ko spending badhani chahiye taaki demand wapas aaye aur full employment restore ho sake.

instruction: March se October tak emails pe vacation alert set karna hai. Kaise karein?
output: Dekh, March to October tak out-of-office reply set karne ke liye ye steps follow kar: Gmail ke liye: 1. Browser pe Gmail open kar aur account login kar. 2. Top right corner mein gear icon pe click kar aur “Settings” select kar. 3. “Vacation responder” section tak scroll kar. 4. “Vacation responder on” select kar. 5. First day March ka pehla din aur last day October ka aakhri din set kar. 6. Subject aur message fields mein woh reply likh jo tu chahta hai ki log dekhein jab tu vacation pe ho. 7. Page ke bottom mein “Save Changes” pe click kar. Outlook ke liye: 1. Outlook open kar ar login kar. 2. "File" tab pe ja, phir "Info" pe click kar. 3. "Automatic Replies (Out of Office)" select kar. 4. "Automatic Replies" box mein "Send automatic replies" choose kar. 5. Out-of-office period ka start aur end time set kar (is case mein March to October). 6. Apna out-of-office reply message type kar. 7. Changes save karne ke liye "OK" pe click kar. Note kar lena ki steps email service aur version ke hisaab se thode alag ho sakte hain. Agar koi aur service use kar raha hai, toh unke support pages ya help center check kar lena.

instruction: Set S = {1, 2, 3, … , 49, 50} mein pehle 50 positive integers hain. Agar 2 aur 3 ke saare multiples hata diye jayein, toh set S mein kitne integers bachenge?
output: Set S mein pehle 50 positive integers hain: 1, 2, 3, ..., 49, 50. Pehle S se 2 ke saare multiples hatao, toh sirf odd integers bachenge. 50 mein se 25 multiples of 2 hain, toh bache 50-25=25 integers. Ab humein S se odd multiples of 3 hatane hain. 1 aur 49 ke beech odd multiples hain: 3, 9, 15, 21, 27, 33, 39, aur 45. Iska matlab 8 integers aur hatane padenge. Toh final count hoga 25-8=17. Ye vo integers hain jo 1 se 50 ke beech 2 ya 3 ke multiples nahi hain.

instruction: Ivan ne ek car rent ki $25 per day aur $0.20 per mile pe. Agar usne 4 din ke liye rent kiya aur 400 miles drive kiya, toh total kitne dollars pay karne honge?
output: Ivan car rent kar raha hai $25 per day aur $0.20 per mile pe. Agar 4 days rent aur 400 miles driving hai, toh total cost kitni hogi? 4 days ka rental cost hua $25 × 4 = $100, aur 400 miles drive karne ka cost hua ($0.20 × 400) = $80. Toh total payment hogi $100 (4 days rental) + $80 (400 miles driving) = $180.

instruction: Explain karo ki ek student ko laptop computer pe scale par GPT language model kyun nahi chalana chahiye.
output: Laptop pe scale par GPT language model run karna kaafi challenging ho sakta hai, aur uske reasons ye hain: 1. Resource constraints: GPT-3 jaise bade language models ko optimally chalne ke liye powerful computational resources chahiye hote hain, jaise high RAM ya GPU memory. Laptops mein aksar utna sophisticated hardware nahi hota, jiski wajah se performance lags, crashes, ya system freeze hone ki problem aa sakti hai. 2. Processing power: Dataset ya vocabulary jitni badi hogi, computational demand utni hi badhegi. Laptop CPUs mein woh multi-core ya multi-thread architecture nahi hota jo language model processing ke itne saare calculations handle kar sake. 3. Cost implications: Laptop pe GPT-3 jaise heavy programs chalane se CPU aur GPU pe load bahut badh jata hai. Isse energy consumption badhti hai aur long run mein hardware wear and tear ho sakta hai, jisse machine ki lifespan kam ho jayegi aur maintenance cost badh jayegi. Summary ye hai ki laptop pe GPT models chalana possible toh hai, par scale par karne se fayde se zyada nuksan ho sakta hai. Better hoga ki student distributed computing ya cloud services ka use kare.

instruction: Socho tum ek tour guide ho. Rome city ka ek interesting overview do.
output: Welcome to Rome! Isse 'eternal city' kehte hain kyunki yahan history, beauty aur culture ka zabardast mix hai. Ye city lagbhag 3,000 saal purani hai aur isne duniya ko shape karne mein bada role play kiya hai. Yahan ancient ruins bhi hain aur modern marvels bhi. Sabse pehle Colosseum dekhna toh must hai, wo massive amphitheater jahan gladiator fights hoti thi. Phir Pantheon hai, jo ancient Roman gods ka ek bahut sundar temple hai. Agar religious history mein interest ah, to Vatican City zaroor jana. Ye duniya ka smallest country hai aur Roman Catholic Church ka HQ hai. Wahan Sistine Chapel (Michelangelo ke frescoes ke liye famous) aur St. Peter's Basilica dekh sakte ho, jo duniya ka largest church hai. Art aur culture ki toh kami hi nahi hai yahan—museums, galleries ar monuments bhar-bhar ke hain. Roman Forum se lekar Baroque fountains tak, sab amazing hai. Best tareeka ye hai ki bas galliyon mein ghumo aur city ki vibe feel karo. Aur khane pe aayein toh Rome foodies ke liye jannat hai. Pizza, pasta, gelato aur espresso—sab authentic Italian style mein milega. Chahe fancy restaurant ho ya street-side stand, taste top-notch hota hai. Basically, Rome history, art aur food ka ek unforgettable package hai. Ek din aao ya akk hafta, yahan bore hone ka sawal hi nahi uthta!

instruction: Ek mathematical equation construct karo. Output <answer>=<answer> format mein hona chahiye. x ki value nikalo jab y=8 ho.
Ek chart banao jo alag alag planets ke ratios dikhaye.
input: The radius of Jupiter is 69,911 km, and the radius of Earth is 6,371 km.
output: | Planets | Ratio (Jupiter : Planet) | Calculations | |----------|--------------------------|----------------------| | Earth | 1 : 0.09 | 69111 km : 6371 km | | Jupiter | 1 : 1 | 69111 km : 69111 km | Explanation: - Sirf Jupiter aur Earth ka radius diya hai, toh bas inka ratio niklega. - Ratio nikalne ke liye Jupiter ke radius ko Earth ke radius se divide kiya: 69,911 km / 6,371 km ≈ 10.96 - Toh simplified ratio 1 : 0.09 hai, jahan Jupiter 1 hai aur Earth 0.09. Iska matlab Jupiter Earth se roughly 11 times bada hai. - Jupiter ka ratio 1:1 hai kyunki hum use khud se compare kar rahe hain.

instruction: Ek function banao jo do arguments le aur unme se jo bada ho woh return kare.

instruction: Do integers n aur k diye hain, 1 se 9 tak ke numbers use karke k numbers ke saare unique combinations nikalo jinka sum n ho. Iska C++ program likho.
output: Ye lo C++ program: ``` #include <iostream> #include <vector> using namespace std; void findCombinations(int n, int k, vector<int>& current, vector<vector<int>>& result) { if (k == 0) { if (n == 0) { result.push_back(current); } return; } for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) { if (n - i >= 0) { current.push_back(i); findCombinations(n - i, k - 1, current, result); current.pop_back(); } } } int main() { int n, k; cout << "Enter the value of n: "; cin >> n; cout << "Enter the value of k: "; cin >> k; vector<vector<int>> result; vector<int> current; findCombinations(n, k, current, result); for (auto combination : result) { for (int i = 0; i < combination.size(); i++) { cout << combination[i]; if (i != combination.size() - 1) { cout << " + "; } } cout << endl; } return 0; } ``` Is program mein humne `findCombinations` naam ka akk recursive function use kiya hai jo n, k, current combination aur final result ko handle karta hai. Hum 1 se 9 tak iterate karte hain or number tabhi add karte hain agar woh remaining value `n - i` se chota ya equal ho. Jab k elements add ho jate hain, toh check karte hain ki sum n hai ya nah. Agar hai ta result mein add kar dete hain, nahi toh backtrack karke doosre combinations try karte hain. `main` function mein bas user se n aur k ki value leni hai aur function call karke results print kar dena hai.

instruction: Biological evolution ke key aspects describe karo jo Earth par organisms ki diversity ko explain karte hain.
output: Biological evolution woh process hai jisse different species time ke saath apne ancestors se evolve aur diversify hote hain. Iska ek main part hai natural selection, jisme woh individuals survive karte hain jinke traits reproductive success aur survival ke liye better hote hain. Dheere-dheere yeh traits population mein badh jaate hain aur nayi species ban sakti hain. Ek aur important cheez hai genetic variation. DNA mein mutations ki wajah se gene pool mein variation aata hai. Yeh variation aur natural selection milkar population ko evolve karte hain, jisse naye adaptations aate hain aur Earth par itni diversity dikhti hai. Iske alawa, geographic isolation aur genetic drift bhi populations ko divide karke nayi species bana sakte hain. Geographic isolation tab hota hai jab koi physical barrier population ko alag kar deta hai. Phir genetic drift aur naye environment ke pressures ki wajah se nayi species emerge hoti hain. Basically, natural selection, genetic variation, geographic isolation aur genetic drift ki wajah se hi Earth par itni variety hai. Inhi processes ne millions of species banayi hain jo apne environment ke hisaab se adapt ho chuki hain.

instruction: Three points A(2, 4), B(-1, 6) aur C(-3, 0) diye hain, triangle ABC ka area nikalo.
output: Jab vertices pata hon toh hum triangle area ka formula use kar sakte hain. Formula hai: Area = (1/2) |x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2)| Yahan (x1, y1), (x2, y2) aur (x3, y3) points A, B aur C ke coordinates hain. Values put karte hain: Area = (1/2) |(2)(6 - 0) + (-1)(0 - 4) + (-3)(4 - 6)| = (1/2) |12 + 4 - 6| = (1/2) * 10 = 5 Toh triangle ABC ka area 5 square units hai.

instruction: Ek circle ki equation formulate karo jiska radius 5 ho aur center (1, -2) par ho.
output: Circle ki standard form equation hoti hai (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2, jahan (h, k) center hai aur r radius ha. Center (1, -2) aur radius 5 lekar values plug kar do: (x - 1)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 5^2 Simplify karne par milega: (x - 1)^2 + (y + 2)^2 = 25.

Team ke ideas or concerns ko dhyan se suno aur phir respond karo. 3. Constructive feedback do: Improvement ke liye feedback zaroori hai, par tareeka sahi hona chahiye. Strengths ko acknowledge karo aur phir batao kahan improve karna hai. 4. Approachable bano: Aisa mahaul rakho ki team ke members bina dare aapse koi bhi sawal pooch sakein. 5. Open communication encourage karo: Team mein honesty aur openness honi chahiye taaki sab apne thoughts freely share kar sakein. 6. Sahi body language use karo: Non-verbal communication bhi matter karti hai. Eye contact maintain karo taaki message effectively convey ho. 7. Style badlo: Sabka learning style alag hota hai. Kuch ke liye one-on-one meetings sahi hoti hain toh kuch ke liye group discussions. 8. Positive aur respectful raho: Hamesha tameez se baat karo aur negative ya confrontational language avoid karo. 9. Follow up karo: Baat karne ke baad check karo ki sabko samajh aaya ya nahi, ar agar zaroorat ho toh clarify karo. 10. Lead by example: Sabse important, khud waisa hi behave karo jaisa aap team se expect karte ho. Ek positive communication culture set karo.

instruction: Neeche diye gaye data ko use karke country ki population density nikal lo. Country: India Population: 1.314 billion Land area: 3.287 million square kilometers
output: India ki population density nikalne ke liye bas population ko land area se divide karna hoga. Population density = Population / Land area Given hai ki India ki population 1.314 billion hai aur land area 3.287 million square kilometers, toh calculation aise hogi: Population density = 1.314 billion / 3.287 million = 400 people per square kilometer. Toh basically, India ki population density approx 400 people per square kilometer hai.

instruction: 500 dollars ke deposit par 3% interest se 10 saal ka compound interest calculate karo.
output: Dekho, 500 dollars ke deposit par 3% rate se 10 saal ka compound interest nikalne ke liye ye formula use karo: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt) Yahan: A = investment ki future value P = initial principal balance (is case mein 500 dollars) r = interest rate (is case mein 3% yaani 0.03) t = number of years (is case mein 10 years) n = saal mein kitni baar interest compound hota hai (is calculation ke liye assume karte hain ki annually hai, toh n = 1) Values put karte hain: A = 500(1 + 0.03/1)^(1*10) A = 500(1.03)^10 A = 671.95 Toh 500 dollars par 3% per annum interest se 10 saal baad total amount $671.95 hoga. Interest earned hua $671.95 - $500 = $171.95.

Jab saara kaam ho jata hai, toh wo suit utaar kar workshop jata hai jahan naye frames assemble karta hai ya honey ki bottling karta hai. Din ke end tak wo thak toh jata hai par satisfied hota hai ki usne apni bees ka khayal rakha. Phir wo agle din ka wait karta hai aur us meethi honey ka maza leta hai.

instruction: Structured query language aur non-structured query language ke beech ka difference samjhao.

Isse bade datasets aur multiple tables ko handle karna efficient ho jata hai. Doosri taraf, non-structured query language (NoSQL) ka koi fixed syntax nahi hota, ye zyada flexible hai. Ye documents, multimedia ya social media posts jaise unstructured data ke liye design kiya gaya hai, jisse querying zyada intuitive ho jati ah. Summary ye hai ki SQL rigid hai aur relational databases ke liye hai, jabki non-structured languages flexible hain aur NoSQL databases ke liye best hain.

instruction: Ek bag mein 10 balls hain, kuch red hain aur baaki yellow. Jab do balls randomly ek saath nikali jati hain, toh probability ki dono red ho 1/15 hai. Bag mein kitni red balls hain?
output: Humein diya gaya aahe ki bag mein total 10 balls hain, kuch red hain aur kuch yellow. Do balls randomly nikalne par dono ke red hone ki probability 1/15 hai. Humein red balls ka number nikalna hai. Maano ki red balls ka number 'r' hai. Toh pehli ball red hone ki probability r/10 hogi. Ab, agar pehli ball red nikal gayi, toh dusri ball ke red hone ki probability (r-1)/9 hogi. Do balls ko 1 saath nikalna basically bina replacement ke ek ke baad 1 nikalne jaisa hi ha. Toh dono red hone ki probability r/10 * (r-1)/9 hogi, jise hum 1/15 ke equal rakhenge. Equation solve karne par r=3 aata hai. Toh bag mein 3 red balls hain.

instruction: Diye gaye topic par ek 250 words ka essay likho: Education mein technology ka role.
output: Technology ne education ke field ko poori tarah badal diya ah, chahe wo padhane ka tareeka ho ya students ka learning material ke saath interact karna. Smart devices ar internet ki wajah se, schools ab e-learning platforms use karke students ka learning experience improve kar sakte hain. Sabse bada advantage ye hai ki technology se learning ko individual needs ke hisaab se personalize kiya ja sakta hai. Multimedia, e-books aur learning software information present karne ke alag-alag tareeke dete hain, jis se cheezein zyada samajh aati hain aur yaad rehti hain. Student ke clicks aur responses track karke, ye platforms unki strengths aur weaknesses ke according strategy change kar sakte hain. Iske saath hi, technology ne resources ka ek khazana khol diya hai jo pehle sirf kuch logon tak limited tha. Online classes iska best example hain, jisse universities bina kisi physical infrastructure ke door-door tak ke students tak pahunch sakte hain. Remote learning se engagement badhta hai, travel ka kharcha kam hota hai aur education sabke liye affordable ho jati hai. Result ye hai ki education ab zyada interactive ho gayi ah. Interactive whiteboards, videos, simulations aur games complex concepts ko aasaan bana dete hain. Saath hi, online collaboration tools aur social media se students kisi bhi location se group projects par kaam kar sakte hain. Conclusion ye hai ki technology ka education par overall positive impact raha hai. Jo institutions ise sahi se integrate karenge, wo apne students ko behtar learning experience aur knowledge ka bada access de payenge.

instruction: Is equation ke saare solutions (real and complex) nikalo: x^4+64=0. Saare answers commas se separate karke likhna.
output: Dekho, x^4 + 64 = 0 solve karne ke liye hum isko difference of squares ki tarah factor kar sakte hain: x^4 + 64 = (x^2)^2 - (8i)^2 = (x^2 - 8i)(x^2 + 8i) Ab humein 8i aur -8i ke square roots chahiye. i ke square roots ±(sqrt(2)/2 + sqrt(2)/2i) hote hain. Toh 8i ke square roots honge ±sqrt(8)(sqrt(2)/2 + sqrt(2)/2i) = ±(2 + 2i), ar -8i ke square roots honge ±sqrt(-8)(sqrt(2)/2 + sqrt(2)/2i) = ±(2i - 2). Toh final solutions hain: x = 2 + 2i, -2 - 2i, -2 + 2i, 2 - 2i.

instruction: Ek box mein tiles hain, numbered 1, 2, 3,..., 49, 50. Sirf wo tiles blue hain jinpe number 2 (mod 5) ho. Ek tile randomly pick ki, probability kya hai ki wo blue ho?
output: 1 se 50 tak tiles hain. Blue tiles wo hain jo 2 (mod 5) hain. Pehle n ki max value nikalte hain jahan 2+5(n-1) <= 50 ho. Inequality solve karenge toh n <= 53/5 aayega. Toh n ki greatest integer value 10 hogi. Total 50 tiles hain, toh blue tile ki probability 10/50 hogi, yaani 1/5.

instruction: Ek string s aur words ki list di hai, s mein woh saare starting indices find karo jahan words ka concatenation exactly once bina kisi gap ke ho.
output: Is problem ko sliding window approach se solve kar sakte hain. Sabse pehle, hum ek dictionary use karke words ki frequency count kar lenge. Phir, s ke saare possible starting indices par iterate karenge aur ek window maintain karenge jiski length `len(words)*len(words[0])` hogi, jo ki saare words concatenate hone ke baad ki total length hai. Har position par, hum check karenge ki kya woh substring words ki list se exactly match kar rahi hai. Iske liye akk aur dictionary banayenge current window ki frequency track karne ke liye. Agar current window desired concatenation se match kar jati hai, toh starting index ko result mein add kar denge. Ye raha Python code: ``` def findSubstring(s: str, words: List[str]) -> List[int]: if not s or not words: return [] word_freq = {} for word in words: word_freq[word] = word_freq.get(word, 0) + 1 word_len = len(words[0]) total_len = word_len * len(words) res = [] for i in range(len(s) - total_len + 1): window_freq = {} j = i while j < i + total_len: curr_word = s[j:j+word_len] if curr_word not in word_freq: break window_freq[curr_word] = window_freq.get(curr_word, 0) + 1 if window_freq[curr_word] > word_freq[curr_word]: break j += word_len if j == i + total_len: res.append(i) return res ```

instruction: Ek code likho jo reminder email bheje. Target Date: August 15, 2022 Subject: Greeting Message
output: Dekho, Python ki smtplib aur SSL use karke tum reminder email bhej sakte ho. Ye raha code: ```python import smtplib, ssl from datetime import datetime, timedelta from email.message import EmailMessage import time sender_email = "<Sender's Email>" receiver_email = "<Receiver's Email>" date_entry = 'August 15, 2022' password = input("Type your password and press enter: ") text = 'This is a reminder message' def send_reminder(target_date, subject): # calculate time to sleep before sending the reminder target_datetime = datetime.strptime(target_date, '%B %d, %Y') now = datetime.now() wait_seconds = (target_datetime - now).total_seconds() # sleep for the time gap between now time.sleep(int(wait_seconds)) # Create the email message message = EmailMessage() message.set_content(text) message['Subject'] = subject message['From'] = sender_email message['To'] = receiver_email # Send the email context = ssl.create_default_context() with smtplib.SMTP_SSL("smtp.gmail.com", 465, context=context) as server: server.login(sender_email, password) server.send_message(message) print('Email sent successfully') send_reminder(date_entry, "Greeting Message") ``` Is code se hum `target_date` aur `subject` daal kar reminder schedule kar sakte hain. Program calculate karega ki current time aur target date mein kitna gap hai aur utne time tak wait karke email bhej dega. Dhyan rakhna ki `sender_email` aur `receiver_email` sahi hone chahiye. Run karte waqt sender ka password enter karna hoga. Aur haan, email account mein 'less secure apps' ka access allow karna mat bhoolna, warna error aayega.

instruction: Ek integer array nums di hai, ek answer array return karo jahan answer[i] ye bataye ki nums[i] ke right side mein kitne smaller elements hain.
output: Modified merge sort use karo. 1. Helper function banao jo array ko do halves mein divide kare ar recursively call ho. 2. Base case: agar ek element bacha hai, toh use return kar do. 3. Merge karte waqt track rakho ki right half ke kitne elements left half ke current element se chhote hain. Ek count variable rakho jo increment hoga jab right half ka element pehle merge hoga. 4. Is count ko answer array mein update karo. 5. Final answer array return kar do. Sample code ye raha: ``` def countSmaller(nums): def mergeSort(nums, left, right): if left >= right: # base case return [nums[left]] mid = (left + right) // 2 left_half = mergeSort(nums, left, mid) right_half = mergeSort(nums, mid + 1, right) i, j, count = 0, 0, 0 merged = [] while i < len(left_half) and j < len(right_half): if left_half[i] <= right_half[j]: merged.append(left_half[i]) answer[left + i + count] += j # update answer array i += 1 else: merged.append(right_half[j]) j += 1 count += 1 merged += left_half[i:] merged += right_half[j:] return merged answer = [0] * len(nums) mergeSort(nums, 0, len(nums) - 1) return answer ``` Note: Time complexity O(nlogn) hai kyunki divide-and-conquer merge sort use ho raha hai. Simple.

instruction: Do strings s aur t di hain, s mein minimum window find karo jisme t ke saare characters hon, O(n) complexity mein. C++ program likho.
output: Sliding window lagao. C++ code ye raha: ``` #include <iostream> #include <string> #include <unordered_map> using namespace std; string minWindow(string s, string t) { unordered_map<char, int> tFreq, windowFreq; int required = t.size(); int left = 0, right = 0; int minLeft = 0, minLength = s.size() + 1; for (char ch : t) tFreq[ch]++; while (right < s.size()) { // Expand the window to the right windowFreq[s[right]]++; if (tFreq.count(s[right]) && windowFreq[s[right]] <= tFreq[s[right]]) { required--; } // Shrink the window from the left while (required == 0 && left <= right) { if (right - left + 1 < minLength) { minLength = right - left + 1; minLeft = left; } windowFreq[s[left]]--; if (tFreq.count(s[left]) && windowFreq[s[left]] < tFreq[s[left]]) { required++; } left++; } right++; } if (minLength > s.size()) { return ""; } else { return s.substr(minLeft, minLength); } } int main() { string s = "ADOBECODEBANC"; string t = "ABC"; cout << minWindow(s, t) << endl; return 0; } ``` `minWindow` function s aur t leta hai aur minimum window return karta hai. Do frequency maps use kiye hain: `tFreq` target characters ke liye aur `windowFreq` current window ke liye. `left` or `right` pointers se window slide hoti hai. `required` variable track karta hai ki t ke kitne characters abhi bhi chahiye. Pehle window right side expand hoti hai aur frequency update hoti hai. Agar character t mein hai or count match karta hai, toh `required` decrement hota hai. Phir window left side se shrink hoti hai jab tak `required` zero rahe. `minLength` aur `minLeft` se sabse choti window track hoti hai. Agar koi window nahi milti toh empty string, warna result substring return hogi. Example mein `minWindow("ADOBECODEBANC", "ABC")` se `"BANC"` milega. Done.

instruction: P(x) = 0 ek least possible degree ki polynomial equation hai with rational coefficients, jiska ek root 7^(1/3) + 49^(1/3) hai. P(x) = 0 ke saare roots ka product compute karo.
output: Dekho, 7^(1/3) + 49^(1/3) ko hum difference-of-cubes factorization se pehchan sakte hain: 7 - 1 = (7^(1/3) - 1)(1 + 7^(1/3) + 49^(1/3}). Agar hum 7^(1/3) + 49^(1/3) ke liye solve karein, toh milega: 7^(1/3) + 49^(1/3) = (7-1)/(7^(1/3)-1) - 1 = 6/(7^(1/3)-1) - 1. Is expression se hum aisi polynomial bana sakte hain jiska root 7^(1/3) + 49^(1/3) ho. Pehle, note karo ki 7^(1/3) x^3 - 7 = 0 ka root hai. Phir, 7^(1/3)-1 (x+1)^3 - 7 = 0 ka root hoga, kyunki (7^(1/3)-1+1)^3 - 7 = (7^(1/3))^3 - 7 = 0. Iska matlab he ki 6/(7^(1/3)-1) is equation ka root hai: (6/x+1)^3 - 7 = 0. Dono side ko x^3 se multiply karke polynomial equation banate hain: (6+x)^3 - 7x^3 = 0. Finally, x ko (x+1) se replace karke, humein dikhta hai ki 6/(7^(1/3)-1) - 1 is equation ka root hai: (7+x)^3 - 7(x+1)^3 = 0. Ye equation x^3 - 21x - 56 = 0 ke equivalent he. Toh Vieta's formulas ke hisab se, roots ka product 56 hoga.

instruction: Hamari school ki girls volleyball team mein 14 players hain, jisme 3 triplets hain: Missy, Lauren, aur Liz. 6 starters choose karne ke kitne ways hain agar condition ye hai ki teeno triplets ek saath starting lineup mein nahi ho sakte?
output: Dekh, total 14 players hain aur humein 6 starters choose karne hain, par condition ye hai ki teeno triplets ek saath nahi hone chahiye. Iska solution nikalne ke liye, pehle total ways nikaalte hain 6 starters choose karne ke: C(14,6) = 3003. Ab humein wo cases minus karne honge jahan condition break ho rahi hai, matlab jahan teeno triplets saath mein hain. In cases mein, hum teeno triplets ko ek unit maan lete hain, toh bache hue 3 spots ke liye humein remaining 11 players mein se choose karna hoga: C(11,3) = 165 ways. Toh final answer hoga: 3003 - 165 = 2838 possible starting lineups.

instruction: Ek program likho jo word list se randomly sample kare. Word jitna lamba hoga, uske sample hone ke chances utne zyada hone chahiye.
output: Ye lo Python program, isse kaam ho jayega: ```python import random word_list = ['apple', 'banana', 'orange', 'watermelon', 'pineapple'] samples = [] for word in word_list: for i in range(len(word)): samples.append(word) sampled_word = random.choice(samples) print(sampled_word) ``` Is program mein humne `word_list` banayi hai. Phir ek empty `samples` list li. Humne har word ke liye loop chalaya aur jitne usme letters hain, utni baar wo full word `samples` list mein add kar diya. Iska matlab lamba word zyada baar add hoga, toh uske select hone ke chances badh jayenge. Last mein `random.choice()` use karke ek random element pick kiya aur print kar diya.

instruction: Ek input string s aur pattern p diya gaya hai, regular expression matching implement karo '.' aur '*' ke support ke saath. Java program likho aur built-in regex functions use mat karna.
output: Dekh, '.' aur '*' wala regex matching karne ke liye Dynamic Programming (DP) best rehti he. Java mein approach kuch aisi hogi: ``` public boolean isMatch(String s, String p) { boolean[][] dp = new boolean[s.length()+1][p.length()+1]; dp[0][0] = true; for (int j=1; j<=p.length(); j++) { if (p.charAt(j-1)=='*') { dp[0][j] = dp[0][j-2]; } } for (int i=1; i<=s.length(); i++) { for (int j=1; j<=p.length(); j++) { if (p.charAt(j-1)=='.' || p.charAt(j-1)==s.charAt(i-1)) { dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]; } else if (p.charAt(j-1)=='*') { dp[i][j] = dp[i][j-2]; if (p.charAt(j-2)=='.' || p.charAt(j-2)==s.charAt(i-1)) { dp[i][j] |= dp[i-1][j]; } } } } return dp[s.length()][p.length()]; } ``` Yahan humne akk DP table banayi hai. `dp[0][0]` true hai kyunki empty string ar empty pattern match hote hain. Phir '*' handle karne ke liye hum piche wale states check karte hain. Finally, `dp[s.length()][p.length()]` humein result de deta hai. Try karke dekh.

instruction: DSLR, Point and Shoot aur Smartphone Camera ke features aur specifications mein kya differences hain, explain karo.
output: DSLR (Digital Single Lens Reflex) cameras sabse advanced hote hain, isme image quality, exposure settings par full control milta hai or aap lenses bhi change kar sakte ho. Ye size mein bade hote hain aur inke complex features seekhne mein thoda time lagta hai. Par agar best quality photography chahiye, toh DSLR ideal choice hai kyunki isme high resolution, wide aperture aur fast action shots ke liye speedy continuous shooting milti hai. Doosri taraf, Point-and-Shoot cameras chhote hote hain, portable hain aur DSLRs se chalane mein aasaan hain. Inme exposure settings par utna control nahi hota, par automatic modes hote hain jo zyada tar situations mein achhi photos le lete hain. Inke lenses fixed hote hain aur ye DSLRs se kaafi saste hote hain. Smartphone Cameras ki baat karein toh ye sabse convenient hain kyunki phone hamesha hamare paas hota ah. Ye kaafi jaldi improve ho rahe hain, ab bahut saare models mein high-resolution sensors, fast lenses aur advanced software processing aati hai. Inke lenses bhi fixed hote hain, par inka size aur ease of use spontaneous photography ke liye perfect hai. Basically, DSLRs mein best control aur quality milti hai, Point-and-Shoot ek affordable aur portable option hai, aur Smartphone cameras convenience aur badhti hui quality provide karte hain everyday photography ke liye.

instruction: Ek student ki summer holiday par creative story likho. Output mein story honi chahiye. Alexa Los Angeles ki ek 14-year-old student hai.
output: Alexa, jo Los Angeles ki ek 14 saal ki student hai, uska school semester khatam hua tha aur wo apni summer holiday ke liye bahut excited thi. Jaise hi school ki final bell baji, wo classroom se aise bahar nikli jaise koi goli chali ho, apne adventure ko start karne ke liye. Agle din, jaise hi suraj ki pehli kiran uske kamre mein aayi, usne poore josh ke saath apna bag pack kiya. Wo Hawaii mein apni aunt ke ghar ja rahi thi, jahan wo do mahine tropical dhoop aur island ki masti mein bitane wali thi. Wahan pahunch kar, Alexa apna din ocean mein swimming karne aur white sand par seashells collect karne mein bitati thi. Wo sandcastles banati aur shaved ice khati jabki dhoop ka maza leti. Kabhi kabhi wo volcanoes ke tours par jati aur fishes ke beech snorkel karti, coral reefs ke vibrant colors ko dekhte hue. Wahan se Alexa ki summer holiday aur bhi behtar hoti gayi. Uske aunt usey local music festivals mein le gayi jahan wo sunset ke time steel drum ki rhythm par dance karti thi, jab aasmaan orange aur pink rang se bhar jata tha. Baaki dino mein, wo porch par baith kar lehron ko kinare se takrate hue dekhti, freshly squeezed passion fruit juice peeti aur grilled fish tacos khati. Par Alexa ki summer ka main highlight tha surfing seekhna. Poore determination ke saath, wo apne surfboard par khadi hoti aur 1 ke baad ek lehron par pro ki tarah ride karti. Un lehron par ride karte waqt, usey ek alag hi pride aur accomplishment feel ho rahi thi. Aur dekhte hi dekhte, do mahine beet gaye aur Alexa ke ghar lautne ka time aa gaya. Jab usne apni aunt aur turquoise waters ko goodbye kaha, usey realize hua ki is summer ne usey sirf ek spectacular tan nahi, balki aisi yaadein di hain jo zindagi bhar saath rahengi. Wo is adventure ke liye grateful thi aur abhi se apni agli summer holiday ka intezar kar rahi thi.

instruction: Ek popular mobile game lo aur uski duniya par ek story likho. Clash of Clans
output: Clash of Clans ki mystical duniya mein, Gavin naam ka ek wise aur powerful chief tha. Kaafi saalon tak Gavin aur uske log shanti se rahe, apne resources badhaye aur defenses ko strong kiya. Par phir ek din, unhe khabar mili ki 1 invading army aa rahi hai. Rumors sahi the, barbarians ka ek jhund unka village force se capture karne aa raha tha. Gavin ne apne Council of Elders ke saath meeting ki aur strategy banayi. Unhone scouts bheje taaki enemy ki movement track ho sake aur intelligence mile. Unhone apne sabse brave warriors aur archers ko ikattha kiya aur training shuru kar di. Yahan tak ki powerful wizards ki help li, jinhone bahut potent spells banaye. Battle ka din aaya, aur enemy horde gusse mein village par toot pada. Gavin ki army ready thi aur unhone poore determination ke saath unka saamna kiya. Talwaro ki awaaz poore area mein goonj rahi thi kyunki villagers apne ghar ko bachane ke liye bravely lad rahe the. Arrows hawa mein ud rahe the aur enemy lines ko hit kar rahe the. Wizards ne aise devastating spells chhode ki barbarians dher hone lage. Ghanto tak dono armies ke beech bhayanak ladayi chali. Gavin ne apni mighty hammer ke saath apne troops ko lead kiya. Slowly, uski strategy aur preparation kaam aayi. Barbarians haar manne lage aur peeche hatne lage. Villagers khushi se chilla uthe kyunki wo jeet gaye the. Unhone apne ghar aur logo ko bacha liya tha. Battle ke baad, Gavin or uske logo ne jaldi se village ko repair karna shuru kiya. Unhone ghayalo ka ilaaj kiya aur jo mare gaye unke liye pray kiya. Is experience se wo aur bhi strong ho gaye the. Unhone ek bade dushman ka saamna kiya aur jeet haasil ki. Unhone prove kar diya ki jab tak wo ek saath khade hain, koi bhi unhe hara nahi sakta.

Music ki duniya mein Nirvana, Garth Brooks, ar Beastie Boys jaise influential artists ke debut albums aaye. Overall, 1989 political, technological aur cultural developments ka ek bada saal tha.

Sir Cedric apni sword ki bahut care karta tha aur usko hamesha saaf aur sharp rakhta tha. Usne kai baar prove kiya ki woh sword kitni powerful ah. instruction: (2, 0), (6, 4) aur (3, 8) vertices wale triangle ka area nikaalo.
output: Dekh, agar vertices (x1, y1), (x2, y2), aur (x3, y3) hain, toh ye formula use kar: Area = abs(((x1*(y2-y3) + x2*(y3-y1)+ x3*(y1-y2))/2)) Is case mein vertices (2, 0), (6, 4), aur (3, 8) hain. Formula mein values put karenge toh: Area = abs(((2*(4-8) + 6*(8-0) + 3*(0-4))/2)) Simplify karne pe aayega: Area = abs((-8 + 48 - 12) / 2) Jo ki equal hai: Area = abs(28 / 2) Toh final area 14 square units hai.

instruction: Integers ki ek list di hai, longest increasing subsequence find karo. List: [3, 2, 6, 4, 5, 1]
output: Is list [3, 2, 6, 4, 5, 1] ka longest increasing subsequence [2, 4, 5] hai. Alternate way: Isse solve karne ka ek tareeka dynamic programming hai. Pehle `n` variable lo jo list ki length ho. Phir usi length ka ek `dp` array banao aur sabko 1 se initialize karo, kyunki har element apne aap mein length 1 ka subsequence hota hai. Phir list pe loop chalao aur elements ko left to right compare karo. Agar current element pichle element se bada ha aur `dp` value choti hai, toh `dp` value mein 1 add karke update kar do. Last mein max `dp` value return kar do. Python mein code kuch aisa dikhega: ```python def longest_increasing_subsequence(lst): n = len(lst) dp = [1] * n for i in range(1, n): for j in range(i): if lst[i] > lst[j] and dp[i] < dp[j] + 1: dp[i] = dp[j] + 1 return max(dp) result = longest_increasing_subsequence([3, 2, 6, 4, 5, 1]) print(result) ``` Iska output 3 aayega, jo [2, 4, 5] ki length hai.

instruction: Theodore Sturgeon ki collected works ki ten volumes hain. Paperback $15 ki hai aur hardcover $25 ki. Theresa ne total ten volumes kharidi aur total $220 spend kiye. Usne kitni hardcover volumes li?
output: Maan lo `h` hardcover volumes hain jo Theresa ne li, aur `p` paperbacks hain. Total ten volumes hain, toh: h + p = 10 Total cost $220 hai, iska matlab: 25h + 15p = 220 Is equation ko 5 se divide karke simplify karte hain: 5h + 3p = 44 Ab `h` nikaalne ke liye `p` ko eliminate karna hoga. Pehli equation ko 3 se multiply karke second equation se subtract karte hain: (25h + 15p) - 3(3h + 3p) = 220 - 90 Simplify karne pe aata hai: 16h = 130 Toh: h = 8.125 Arre yaar, problem ho gayi! `h` ki value whole number nahi hai, matlab ye solution valid nhi hai. Iska matlab ye ki Theresa ke liye possible hi nahi hai ki wo books lekar exact $220 spend kare.

instruction: Is code ko Java mein likho. import requests # Make a GET request to the MediaWiki API to retrieve a random Wikipedia page response = requests.get('https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=random&rnnamespace=0&rnlimit=1&format=json') # Parse the response JSON to get the title of the random page random_title = response.json()['query']['random'][0]['title'] # Print the title of the random page print(random_title)
output: Ye code Python mein likha hai jo Java se kaafi alag hai. Ye raha Java code snippet jo HttpUrlConnection use karke same kaam karta hai: ``` import java.net.HttpURLConnection; import java.net.URL; import java.io.BufferedReader; import java.io.InputStreamReader; import org.json.*; public class RandomWikiPage { public static void main(String[] args) { try { // make a GET request to retrieve a random Wikipedia page URL url = new URL("https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&list=random&rnnamespace=0&rnlimit=1&format=json"); HttpURLConnection con = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection(); con.setRequestMethod("GET"); // read the API response into a string BufferedReader in = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(con.getInputStream())); String response = ""; String line; while ((line = in.readLine()) != null) { response += line; } in.close(); // parse the response JSON to extract the title of the random page JSONObject json = new JSONObject(response); String randomTitle = json.getJSONObject("query").getJSONArray("random").getJSONObject(0).getString("title"); // print the title of the random page System.out.println(randomTitle); } catch (Exception e) { e.printStackTrace(); } } } ``` Note kar lena ki is code ke liye `org.json` package ki library chahiye hogi.

instruction: Shark protection ke favour mein 3 arguments likho. Opinion: Sharks ko zyada protection milni chahiye

Isliye protection zaroori hai. 2. Endangered Species: Overfishing aur habitat destruction ki wajah se bohot saari shark species khatre mein hain. Inhe bachana crucial ha kyunki inka loss marine ecosystems pe bura asar daal sakta hai. Survival ke liye zyada protections chahiye. 3. Economic Benefits: Sirf ecology hi nahi, economically bhi sharks valuable hain. Shark-related tourism, jaise diving aur snorkeling, se har saal millions of dollars ka revenue aata hai. Wahi doosri taraf, fins ki demand unsustainable hai. Agar protection badhayenge toh ek sustainable aur beneficial relationship ban payegi.

instruction: Is topic pe research karke ek article likho. Topic: Battery Technology
output: Battery Technology: Current Situation ka akk overview Battery technology purane lead-acid batteries ke dino se kaafi aage nikal chuki hai. Aaj kal portable gadgets se lekar renewable energy grid tak, har jagah batteries use ho rahi hain. EVs ar renewable energy ke shift ki wajah se better battery tech ar bhi zaroori ho gaya hai. Is article mein hum current situation aur future developments ki baat karenge. Recent years mein lithium-ion batteries sabse popular choice bani hain portable devices aur EVs ke liye. Iska main reason hai inki high energy density, jis se choti battery mein zyada energy store ho jati hai. Power density bhi high hai, toh high-power applications ke liye ye best hain. Par inke apne issues hain, jaise overheating, jis se thermal runaway ka risk rehta hai. Researchers ab different approaches try kar rahe hain. Ek hai solid-state batteries, jahan liquid ki jagah solid electrolyte use hota hai. Is se energy density badhegi aur thermal runaway ka risk kam hoga. Lifespan bhi zyada hogi aur degradation kam hoga. Halanki ye technology abhi shuruati phase mein hai aur widespread use se pehle kaafi kaam baaki hai. Ek ar area hai naye materials ka. Lithium-sulfur aur lithium-air batteries pe kaam chal raha hai, jinme lithium-ion se bhi zyada energy density mil sakti hai. Saath hi, batteries ko recycle karne ke tareeke dhoonde ja rahe hain taaki environment pe impact kam ho. Conclusion ye hai ki battery tech ne kaafi progress ki hai, par abhi aur rasta baaki ah. Clean aur efficient energy storage ki demand badh rahi hai, isliye ye priority bani hui hai. Hope ha ki naye advancements se hum ek sustainable energy future ki taraf badh payenge.

instruction: In do products ke characteristics compare aur contrast karo. Products: iPhone 8 and iPhone 10

Front mein dono 7MP hain, par X mein TrueDepth system hai for Face ID and Animoji. Hardware: Dono A11 Bionic chip use karte hain. X mein RAM zyada hai (3GB vs 2GB) aur battery bhi thodi badi hai. Wireless charging dono mein hai. Price: Launch ke time X kaafi mehenga tha. Sept 2021 tak, iPhone 8 sasta mil raha hai as refurbished, kyunki Apple ne discontinue kar diya hai. X bhi discontinued hai par used market mein abhi bhi mehenga hai. Conclusion: Processor aur wireless charging same hai, baaki design, display, camera aur price mein bada fark hai.

instruction: Ek long-term project ko break down karne ke liye events ki timeline banao. Ek effective marketing plan banana
output: Effective marketing plan banana ek long-term project aahe jisme kaafi stages hote hain. Is project ko break down karne ke liye ye timeline help karegi: **Week 1:** Research aur Analysis - Target audience, competition aur current trends samajhne ke liye market research karo. - Research ke results analyze karo aur opportunities identify karo. **Week 2-3:** Goal Setting aur Strategy Development - Research aur analysis ke base pe marketing goals aur objectives define karo. - Goals achieve karne ke liye ek marketing strategy develop karo. **Week 4-5:** Budgeting aur Resource Planning - Marketing plan ke liye budget determine karo. - Strategy execute karne ke liye zaroori resources plan karo, jaise personnel, equipment aur materials. **Week 6-7:** Implementation Planning - Ek implementation plan banao, jisme actions ar responsibilities ki timeline ho. - Marketing team ko tasks aur responsibilities assign karo. **Week 8-9:** Execution - Implementation plan ke hisab se marketing plan execute karna shuru karo. - Progress monitor karo aur jahan zaroorat ho adjustments karo. **Week 10-12:** Evaluation aur Optimization - Marketing plan ke results evaluate karo aur check karo ki ye kitna effective tha. - Zaroori changes karo aur better results ke liye plan ko optimize karo. **Week 13+:** Ongoing Maintenance - Marketing plan ko continuously monitor aur evaluate karte raho. - Iski effectiveness banaye rakhne ke liye updates aur changes karte raho.

output: Dekh, is equation (7x + 7)/(3x + 4) = 5 ko solve karne ka simple tareeka ye hai: 1. Sabse pehle fraction hatane ke liye dono sides ko (3x + 4) se multiply kar do. Isse milega: (7x + 7) = 5(3x + 4). 2. Ab right side ko simplify karo 5 distribute karke: (7x + 7) = 15x + 20. 3. x wale terms ko ek side lane ke liye dono sides se 7x subtract karo: 7 = 15x + 20 - 7x. 4. Right side ko phir se simplify karo like terms combine karke: 7 = 8x + 20. 5. Variable ko isolate karne ke liye dono sides se 20 subtract karo: -13 = 8x. 6. Finally, x ki value nikalne ke liye dono sides ko 8 se divide karo: x = -13/8. Toh final solution x = -13/8 aayega.

instruction: Do objects ke beech gravitational force calculate karo jinke masses 10 kg aur 20 kg hain aur distance 5m hai.
output: Bhaiya, do objects ke beech gravitational force is formula se calculate hota hai: F = G * ((m1 * m2) / d^2) Jahan F gravitational force hai, G gravitational constant hai, m1 aur m2 objects ke masses hain, aur d unke beech ka distance hai. Gravitational constant G ki value approx 6.674 x 10^-11 N(m/kg)^2 hoti hai. Ab values put karte hain: F = (6.674 x 10^-11 N(m/kg)^2) * ((10 kg * 20 kg) / (5 m)^2) F = 5.339 x 10^-10 N Toh dono objects ke beech gravitational force approximately 5.339 x 10^-10 Newtons hoga.

instruction: Selection sort method use karke numbers ke array ko sort karne ka pseudocode algorithm banao. Array: [3, 1, 4, 7, 8, 2]
output: Selection sort ka pseudocode ye raha, check kar le: Procedure selection_sort(Array: list of sortable items) BEGIN Declare index_min, temporary: integer For i from 0 to Array length - 2 index_min = i For j from i+1 to Array length - 1 If Array[j] < Array[index_min], Then index_min = j End If End For temporary = Array[i] Array[i] = Array[index_min] Array[index_min] = temporary End For END Example: Array: [3, 1, 4, 7, 8, 2] First pass ke baad: [1, 3, 4, 7, 8, 2] Second pass ke baad: [1, 2, 4, 7, 8, 3] Third pass ke baad: [1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 4] Fourth pass ke baad: [1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 7] Fifth pass ke baad: [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8] Final sorted array: [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8]

instruction: Ek algorithm banao jo integers ki list le aur unke squares return kare. Input: [2, 3, 5, 8]

instruction: Java mein ek function banao jo integer array le aur check kare ki usme duplicates hain ya nahi.
output: Yeh le, ek simple sa implementation: ``` public boolean containsDuplicates(int[] nums) { Set<Integer> set = new HashSet<>(); for(int n : nums) { if(set.contains(n)) return true; set.add(n); } return false; } ``` Isme maine HashSet use kiya hai duplicates track karne ke liye. Loop chala kar har number ko check karte hain; agar number pehle se set mein hai, toh matlab duplicate mil gaya aur `true` return kar do. Nahi toh set mein add karke aage badho. Agar loop khatam hone tak kuch nahi mila, toh `false` return kar dena. Time complexity `O(n)` hai kyunki hum array ko sirf 1 baar traverse kar rahe hain.
