instruction: Cloud computing pe kam se kam 7 sentences ka ek paragraph likho (around 200 words).
output: Cloud computing ek aisi innovative technology hai jisne data store karne ar access karne ka tarika poora badal diya hai. Basically, isme internet ke through software, storage, aur processing power jaisi services milti hain. Iska fayda ye ah ki tum kisi bhi device se apna data access kar sakte ho, bas internet hona chahiye—physical storage ka jhanjhat khatam. Ab companies ko apne data ke liye mehnge infrastructure pe kharcha nahi karna padta. Wo bas kisi cloud service provider ka subscription le lete hain, jo remotely unka data manage aur secure karta hai. Iska sabse bada advantage flexibility aur scalability hai. Business needs ke hisaab se resources ko jaldi scale up ya down kiya ja sakta hai. Isse paise bhi bachte hain kyunki company utna hi pay karti hai jitna wo use karti hai. Plus, collaboration aur productivity bhi badh jati hai kyunki employees kahin se bhi kaam kar sakte hain. Lekin, security aur privacy ko lekar thode concerns zaroor hain. Isi wajah se naye security standards laye gaye hain taaki providers customer ka data safe rakh sakein. Overall, cloud computing se efficiency toh badhti hai, par ek reputed provider choose karna bahut zaroori hai.

instruction: Television advertising ke maamle mein candidates aur interest groups ko kin cheezon ka dhyan rakhna chahiye?
output: Jab political campaigns ya kisi agenda ke liye TV ads chalane ho, toh candidates aur groups ko ye points dekhne chahiye: 1. Target audience: Audience kaun hai, wo kya dekhna pasand karte hain aur kaunse channels use karte hain, ye define karna zaroori hai. Tabhi messaging sahi logon tak pahuchegi. 2. Cost: TV ads kaafi expensive ho sakte hain, khaas kar prime time ya bade sports events ke waqt. Budget planning dhang se karni hogi. 3. Content: Content pe bahut dhyan dena hoga kyunki isse candidate ki image banti hai. Negative reactions se bachne ke liye saare claims accurate aur verifiable hone chahiye. 4. Timing: Sahi time pe ad chalana crucial hai. Debates ar elections ki critical dates ka pata hona chahiye for maximum impact. 5. Regulations: TV political ads ke liye kuch rules hote hain, jaise disclosure requirements aur spending limits. Apne jurisdiction ke rules pata hone chahiye taaki koi legal issue na ho. 6. Reach: TV ki reach broad he, par digital ads aur social media jaise options bhi hain, unhe ignore nahi karna chahiye. Basically, TV ads ek great tool hain, par iske liye strategic planning ar regulations ka dhyan rakhna bahut zaroori hai.

instruction: 2006 aur 2008 election cycles mein television advertising ke use ko compare aur contrast karo.
output: Political campaigns mein TV ads hamesha se important rahe hain. Par 2006 aur 2008 ke cycles mein kaafi difference tha, kyunki media consumption aur data analytics badal gaya tha. 2006 mein TV ads hi dominant the. Candidates ne ABC, NBC, aur CBS jaise traditional networks pe heavy invest kiya. Strategy simple thi—mass media ke through broad voters ko target karna or simple messages dena. Lekin 2008 tak scene change ho gaya. TV ads toh the, par shift 'targeted' aur 'data-driven' advertising ki taraf ho gaya. Digital tech use karke candidates ne specific voter demographics ko target kiya. Sophisticated analytics tools se messaging ko customize kiya gaya, jisse ads sahi audience tak sahi time pe pahuche. Saath hi, 2008 mein cable TV ads bhi badh gaye. Cable news aur niche programming ki wajah se candidates ne smaller, targeted viewerships ko target karna shuru kiya. 2006 ke broad ads ke opposite, 2008 ke cable ads zyada character-driven the, jisme candidate ki personal values aur story pe focus tha. Short mein bolun toh, 2008 mein data-driven strategy ar cable ads ka use zyada tha. Overall, TV ads zyada sophisticated aur strategic ho gaye the.

instruction: Is statement ko analyze karo aur batao isme kya galat hai. Statement: "All politicians are lies."
output: Is statement mein ek grammatical error hai aur ek logical fallacy. Grammatically, subject (politicians) plural hai, toh verb (are) bhi plural hai, lekin predicate (lies) singular hai. Toh ye sentence grammatically galat hai. Logically, ye 'hasty generalization' ki fallacy hai—bina kisi proof ke saare politicians ke baare mein absolute claim kar diya. Sabko dishonest bolna unfair aur galat hai, kyunki har insaan alag hota hai.

instruction: Teen point coordinates (x, y, z) diye hain, do points ke beech ka distance calculate karo. Point A: x=2, y=3, z=1 Point B: x=4, y=1, z=6
output: 3D space mein do points `(x1,y1,z1)` aur `(x2,y2,z2)` ke beech ka distance nikalne ke liye ye formula use hota hai: `√((x2−x1)^2 + (y2−y1)^2 + (z2−z1)^2)` Is case mein Point A `(2,3,1)` hai aur Point B `(4,1,6)` hai. Values formula mein daalte hain: `distance = √((4-2)^2 + (1-3)^2 + (6-1)^2)` `distance = √(2^2 + (-2)^2 + (5)^2)` `distance = √(4+4+25)` `distance = √33` Toh final distance `√33` units hai.

instruction: Samjhao ki koi government apne citizens ke liye certain countries mein travel ban kyu lagati hai.
output: Dekho, government travel ban kayi reasons se laga sakti ah. Sabse bada reason hota hai citizens ki safety aur security. Agar kisi country mein war chal rahi ho, political instability ho ya crime rate bahut high ho, toh government travel restrict kar deti hai taaki log khatre mein na padein. Iske liye travel advisories issue ki jati hain. Doosra reason public health ho sakta aahe. Pandemic ya kisi contagious disease ke outbreak ke time travel ban lagaya jata hai taaki bimari apne desh mein na faile. Iske alawa diplomatic ya political reasons bhi hote hain. instruction: Ek function banao jo month name aur date use karke bataye ki us month mein kitne days hain.
output: Haan, ye Python function use kar lo month name aur year ke base pe days nikalne ke liye: ```python from calendar import monthrange def days_in_month(month: str, year: int) -> int: """ Ye function month name aur year leta hai aur us month ke total days return karta hai. """ months = { "january": 1, "february": 2, "march": 3, "april": 4, "may": 5, "june": 6, "july": 7, "august": 8, "september": 9, "october": 10, "november": 11, "december": 12 } if month.lower() not in months: raise ValueError(f"Invalid month name: {month}.") month_num = months[month.lower()] days = monthrange(year, month_num)[1] return days #example print(days_in_month("February", 2020)) ``` Ismein `calendar` module ka `monthrange` method use hua hai. Function month name aur year leta hai, dictionary se month ka number nikalta hai, aur phir `monthrange` ko pass karta hai. Ye method ek tuple return karta hai jisme second value total days hoti hai. Sabse acchi baat ye hai ki ye leap years ko bhi handle kar leta hai, toh February ke days hamesha sahi aayenge.

instruction: Online bahut saare databases available hain, toh sahi database select karte waqt kin factors ka dhyan rakhna chahiye?
output: Online itne saare options hain, toh sahi database chunne ke liye ye cheezein zaroor dekh lena: 1. **Purpose:** Sabse pehle clear hona chahiye ki database chahiye kis liye. Alag-alag needs ke liye alag-alag databases bane hain. 2. **Data type or structure:** Data store aur retrieve karne ka tarika har DB mein alag hota hai. Agar structured data hai toh relational DB best hai, par agar unstructured data hai ya schema flexible chahiye toh MongoDB ya CouchDB jaise document-based DBs better rahenge. 3. **Scalability:** Ye check karo ki platform kitna scale ho sakta hai. Kuch DBs heavy data easily handle kar lete hain, kuch nahi. Ye bhi dekho ki scale-out (nodes badhana) aur scale-up (resources badhana) kitna easy hai. 4. **Reliability aur support:** Database system ka core hota hai, to downtime ya data loss bahut bhari pad sakta aahe. Aisa DB choose karo jiska track record reliability mein accha ho aur support system strong ho. 5. **Cost:** Budget bhi matter karta hai. Kuch open source or free hain, kuch ke licensing costs bahut high hote hain. Features aur budget ka balance banao. 6. **Ease of use:** Ye bhi dekho ki team ke liye use karna kitna easy hai. Kuch interfaces intuitive hote hain, kuch ka learning curve bahut steep hota hai. Team ki technical skills ke hisaab se select karo.

instruction: Ek string se names extract karne ke liye regex banao 'Jayden, Malcolm, and Jimmy went to school'
output: Dekh, names nikalne ke liye `([A-Z][a-z]+)` wala pattern use kar sakte hain. Iska logic simple hai: - `[A-Z]` se pehla uppercase letter match hoga (ye assume karke ki har name capital se start hota hai). - `[a-z]+` se baaki lowercase letters pick honge. - Parentheses `()` capture group banate hain taaki hum actual names extract kar sakein. Python mein `re.findall` use karke ye easily ho jayega. Ye dekh example: ```python import re text = 'Jayden, Malcolm, and Jimmy went to school' # define regex pattern pattern = r'([A-Z][a-z]+)' # find all occurrences of pattern in given string names = re.findall(pattern, text) print(names) # ['Jayden', 'Malcolm', 'Jimmy'] ```

instruction: Ek object ki average acceleration nikalo jo 6 seconds mein 45m/s se 69m/s ki speed par jaata hai.
output: Average acceleration ka formula simple hai: acceleration = (final velocity - initial velocity) / time. Values put karte hain: acceleration = (69 m/s - 45 m/s) / 6 s acceleration = 24 m/s / 6 s acceleration = 4 m/s² Toh final average acceleration 4 meters per second squared hoga.

instruction: Plastic pollution kam karne ke liye ek three-step plan banao Issue: How to reduce plastic pollution
output: Dekho, plastic pollution khatam karne ka 3-step plan ye raha: Step 1: Single-use plastics ko hatao: Straws, bags aur bottles jaisi cheezein jo ek baar use karke phek dete hain, unhe band karo. instruction: Meeting attend karte waqt proper etiquette ke liye kuch rules banao

Thank you bolo: Meeting khatam hone par host aur attendees ko thanks bolo.

instruction: Ek short story di gayi hai, iska ek different aur lamba version generate karo. Alex had been studying for weeks for his big math test. He was nervous, but he felt confident that he'd ace it. As the test began, he became increasingly anxious. He started to doubt himself and got more and more confused as he went on. He was sure he'd fail, but he kept on trying.
output: Alex apne math test mein top karne ke liye ekdum determined tha. Kai hafton se usne saari distractions side mein rakh kar textbooks aur practice tests chaat liye the. Jaise-jaise date pass aa rahi thi, nervousness toh thi par confidence bhi tha. Usne khud ko samjhaya ki mehnat toh puri ki aahe, toh material ki samajh toh hogi hi. Test wala din aaya aur Alex ne seat par baithte hi ek gehri saans li. Classmates ke chehre dekh kar lag raha tha sab tension mein hain. Jaise hi teacher ne papers distribute kiye, Alex ki adrenaline rush badh gayi. Usse pata tha ki agla ek ghanta uska grade decide karega. Par pehla question padhte hi doubt hone laga. Kya usne galat material padha tha? Kya test umeed se zyada hard tha? Confidence girne laga aur panic hone laga. Lekin Alex ne haar nahi maani. Phir se saans li aur problems solve karne laga. Par jitna aage badha, confusion aur badhta gaya. Questions unexpected tareeke se tough the aur wo apne answers pe doubt karne laga. Har minute ke saath usse lag raha tha ki wo fail ho jayega. Despair toh tha, par usne koshish jaari rakhi. Jab teacher ne time-up bola, tab usne kaampte hathon se paper submit kiya. Bhale hi usse laga ki wo fail ho gaya hai, par Alex ko sukoon tha ki usne apna best diya. Hafton ki mehnat aur test mein puri jaan laga dene ke baad, results ka wait karte waqt wahi ek comfort tha.

instruction: Is writing piece ko critique karo: 'As history tells us, the Ancient Greeks invented everything. Plus, text thoda repetitive hai, bas Greeks ki tareef hi karta ja raha hai. Agar isko thoda objective banaya jaye aur baaki civilizations ke context mein dekha jaye, toh accuracy better ho jayegi.

instruction: Ek historian ki tarah World War I ke teen bade causes batao aur unki significance explain karo.
output: 1. Militarism: European powers, khaas karke Germany ar Great Britain, ne ek dusre se zyada military strength banane ki hod laga li thi. Is arms race ki wajah se mahaul aisa ho gaya ki koi bhi choti ladayi bade war mein badal sakti thi. 2. Alliances: Europe ki badi powers do groups mein banti thi—Triple Entente (France, Russia, UK) aur Triple Alliance (Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy). Iska matlab tha ki agar do countries ke beech jhagda hua, toh baaki sab bhi kheeche chale aayenge, ar yahi hua. 3. Nationalism: Apne desh ke liye zyada pride ki wajah se competition badh gaya, jiske results kaafi bure nikle. Austria-Hungary jaise multi-ethnic empires mein nationalist movements ne tension badha di, aur end mein Archduke Franz Ferdinand ke assassination ne aag mein ghee ka kaam kiya.

instruction: Analyze karo ki do products ke beech kya differences hain aur conclusion do ki kaunsa better hai. Product 1: Automatically synchronizes data across all the users. Product 2: Allows users to share files, with automatically synced versions.
output: Di gayi info ke hisaab se, Product 1 aur Product 2 dono mein automatic synchronization ki capability hai. Par dono mein kuch main differences hain. Product 1 focus karta hai ki data saare users ke beech automatically sync ho jaye, matlab agar ek user ne kuch change kiya toh wo real-time mein sabke devices par update ho jayega. Ye tab kaafi useful hai jab multiple log ek hi project ya document par kaam kar rahe hon aur unhe latest info chahiye ho. Doosri taraf, Product 2 users ko files share karne ka option deta hai, jisme versions automatically sync hote hain. Iska matlab users decide kar sakte hain ki kaunsi files share karni hain aur specific files hi doosron ke saath share kar sakte hain. Is feature se, shared file mein koi bhi update hoga toh sirf un users ko dikhega jinhe access diya gaya hai. Conclusion ye hai ki dono mein auto-sync hai, par Product 1 saare data ko sync karta hai, jabki Product 2 mein control aur selectivity zyada hai. Better kaunsa hai ye user ki requirement par depend karta hai. Agar control chahiye ki kya share karna hai, toh Product 2 sahi rahega. Par agar sab kuch real-time mein sabke liye sync hona chahiye, toh Product 1 better choice ha.

instruction: Kisi specific company ki news ke liye Google Alert kaise set up karenge taaki notification milta rahe?
output: Kisi specific company ki news ke liye Google Alert set karna kaafi simple hai, ye steps follow karo: 1. Google Alerts website par jao: Browser mein http://www.google.com/alerts open karo. 2. Google account se sign-in karo: Agar login nahi kiya hai, toh top-right corner se login kar lo. 3. Search terms dalo: "Create an alert about" waale field mein us company ka naam likho jiske updates chahiye. 4. Alert settings configure karo: Search bar ke neeche "Show options" button hoga, usse ye settings milengi: - "How often": "As-it-happens", "At most once a day" ya "At most once a week" choose karo. - "Sources": Specific sources select kar sakte ho, jaise ki "News". - "Language": Wo language choose karo jisme content chahiye. - "Region": Select karo ki results kis region ya country se aane chahiye. - "How many": Decide karo ki sirf best results chahiye ya saare. - "Deliver to": Choose karo ki alerts kahan receive karne hain. 5. "CREATE ALERT" button par click karo: Isse settings save ho jayengi aur alert create ho jayega. Ab se, tumhare chosen settings ke hisaab se jab bhi us company ki news aayegi, Google tumhe notify kar dega.

instruction: Is poem ko analyze karke author ka central message samjhao. "The Road Not Taken" by Robert Frost Two roads diverged in a yellow wood, And sorry I could not travel both And be one traveler, long I stood And looked down one as far as I could
output: "The Road Not Taken" Robert Frost ki ek kaafi famous poem hai jo individuality, decision-making aur life ke choices ki complexities ko explore karti aahe. Poem ki shuruat mein speaker do raaston ke beech khada hai jo ek yellow wood mein alag ho rahe hain, jo ek decision lene ke moment ko dikhata hai. Ye yellow wood badlav ke season, jaise autumn, ko represent kar sakta hai jab patte peele hokar girte hain. Is mod par khade hokar speaker ko dukh hai ki wo dono raaston par nahi chal sakta aur saari possibilities ko experience nahi kar sakta. "And be one traveler, long I stood" wali line se pata chalta hai ki speaker apne decision ko lekar kitna serious hai, aur wo kaafi time lekar dono raaston ke fayde-nuksan soch raha hai. Is part ka main message ye hai ki life choices se bhari hui hai aur har choice humein alag raaste par le ja sakti hai. Decisions lena life ka ek inevitable part hai, aur humein rasta chunne se pehle apne options ko dhyan se dekhna chahiye. Jab wo "looked down one as far as he could" karta hai, toh wo actually future dekhne ki koshish kar raha hai ki kaunsa rasta best hoga. Par future toh koi nahi dekh sakta, isliye decision lene ke liye bravery aur risk lene ki himmat chahiye hoti hai. Basically, Robert Frost ki "The Road Not Taken" ka essence ye hai ki life choices se banti hai aur yahi choices akk insaan ki identity define karti hain. Road ke fork ki significance is baat mein hai ki insaan ki apni life par control (agency) hoti hai.

instruction: Niche diye gaye statement ko truth value (true ya false) assign karo: Money cannot buy happiness.

Is baat par kaafi debate aur research hui hai ki happiness mein paise ka kya role he. Kuch studies kehti hain ki ek certain point tak income badhne se well-being badhti hai, wahi kuch aur studies suggest karti hain ki paisa nahi, balki usko kharch karne ka tareeka happiness ko influence karta he. Ultimately, happiness 1 complex state hai jo personal circumstances, outlook, relationships ar health jaise kaafi factors par depend karti hai, sirf financial situation par nahi.

instruction: Is claim ke liye supporting evidence add karo. Streaming video services ki popularity pichle kuch saalon mein bahut zyada badh gayi hai.
output: Is claim ko support karne ke liye bahut saara data, statistics aur surveys available hain. For example: - Pew Research Center ke survey ke mutabiq, American adults jo Netflix, Hulu, ya Amazon Prime Video jaise streaming services use karte hain, unka percentage 2015 mein 61% se badhkar 2021 mein 72% ho gaya. - eMarketer ki ek report suggest karti hai ki 2019 mein pehli baar US population ka aadhe se zyada hissa streaming services ka subscriber tha. Ye number ab aur bhi badh gaya hoga. - UK ki media regulatory authority Ofcom ki study ke hisaab se, UK ke adults ne 2019 ke muqable 2020 mein streaming services dekhne mein average 40 minutes zyada spend kiye. - Business data platform Statista batata hai ki worldwide paid streaming subscriptions 2015 mein 170 million se badhkar 2021 mein 845 million ho gaye, jo content ki demand mein huge growth dikhata hai. - Motion Picture Association ka data reveal karta hai ki global streaming subscriptions 2020 mein pehli baar 1 billion cross kar gaye, jo pichle saal se 26% ki increase hai. Ye saare data points prove karte hain ki streaming video services ki popularity sach mein explode hui aahe.

instruction: Diye gaye extract ke basis pe author ka main argument samjhao aur identify karo ki kaunsi persuasive techniques use ki gayi hain. Climate change is an urgent crisis that requires immediate collective action. If society does not take action now, the devastating effects of global warming will become irreversible. The scientific evidence supporting climate change is overwhelming, with the vast majority of reputable scientists agreeing on this issue. This is not a belief, it is a fact supported by data. Disregarding the evidence is irresponsible and dangerous. As responsible citizens, it is our duty to take action, reduce our carbon footprint, and support policies that prioritize environmental protection.
output: Author ka main argument ye hai ki climate change ek urgent issue hai jise solve karne ke liye turant collective action lene ki zaroorat hai. Wo emphasize kar rahe hain ki ye scientific evidence se backed ek fact hai, aur zyada tar scientists is baat se agree karte hain. Persuasive techniques ki baat karein toh author ne emotional language use ki hai (jaise 'devastating', 'irreversible', 'irresponsible' aur 'dangerous'), reputable scientists ka reference dekar authority ko appeal kiya hai, aur reader ko ek responsible citizen banne ke liye call-to-action diya hai taaki wo environment protection ke liye practical steps uthayein.

instruction: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye ek program banao: Tum ek competitive game khel rahe ho aur apne doston ko dikhana chahte ho ki tum improve hue ho. Tumhe wo number of games return karna hai jo tumhe apne objective ranking points tak pahunchne ke liye khelne padenge. Input: Line 1 : initial ranking points ke liye ek integer b Line 2 : har game mein jitne ya haare gaye points ke liye ek integer p Line 3 : jin games ko tum haaroge unka count, ek integer l Line 4 : ranking points jo tumhe reach karne hain, ek integer o
output: Ye raha Python program is problem ke liye: ```python b = int(input()) p = int(input()) l = int(input()) o = int(input()) games_needed = 0 while b < o: games_needed += 1 if games_needed > l: b += p else: b -= p print(games_needed) ``` Explanation: Pehle hum inputs ko unke respective variables mein read kar rahe hain. Phir `games_needed` ko 0 se initialize kiya hai, jo hamara final answer hoga. Hum ek loop use kar rahe hain jo `games_needed` ko tab tak increment karega jab tak `b` ki value `o` se badi ya uske barabar na ho jaye. Loop ke har iteration mein, hum check karte hain ki kya hum `l` games se zyada khel chuke hain. Agar haan, toh hum ranking mein `p` points add karte hain. Nahi toh, ranking se `p` points subtract karte hain. Jaise hi `b` ki value `o` ke barabar ya zyada ho jati hai, loop exit ho jata hai aur hum `games_needed` print kar dete hain. Ye program assume karta hai ki `p` ek positive number hai. Agar `p` negative ho sakta hai, toh logic thoda change karna padega.

instruction: Software product ki quality assess karne ke liye sabse important evaluation criteria kya hote hain?
output: Software quality check karne ke liye kaafi saare criteria hote hain. Ye rahe main points: 1. Functionality: Software wahi kaam kare jiske liye use banaya gaya hai, aur accurate aur reliable ho. 2. Usability: Interface intuitive hona chahiye aur instructions clear hon taaki user easily use kar sake. 3. Performance: Response time fast ho aur downtime minimum rahe. 4. Scalability: Demand badhne par bhi performance drop nahi honi chahiye. 5. Security: User data protect karne ke liye sahi security measures hone chahiye. 6. Reliability: Failure rate low ho aur errors se software jaldi recover kar sake. 7. Maintainability: Code organized ho aur documentation clear ho taaki updates easy rahein. 8. Compatibility: Alag-alag hardware aur software configurations pe bina kisi conflict ke chale. 9. Portability: Different platforms aur OS pe bina major changes ke run ho sake. 10. Customer Support: Ek responsive support team ho jo users ki issues solve karne mein help kar sake.

instruction: Iss task ke liye kaunsa classification model suitable rahega? Ek hafte baad stock price predict karna.
output: Dekho, stock price predict karna classification task nahi hai, ye actually ek regression task hai. Classification mein hum categorical labels predict karte hain, jabki regression mein continuous numerical values predict ki jaati hain. Stock price prediction ke liye Time Series forecasting models best rahenge, jaise ARIMA, SARIMA, ya LSTM, kyunki ye data ke temporal nature ko handle karte hain. Random Forest, Support Vector Regression (SVR), or Linear Regression bhi use kiye ja sakte hain. Ek aur baat, stock price predict karna kaafi challenging hota hai aur ye models hamesha accurate nahi hote. Inki performance data quality, feature selection aur parameter tuning pe depend karti hai.

instruction: Goal: Ek complex palindrome wo string hoti hai jo alphanumeric characters consider karne pe aur case ignore karne pe palindrome ho. Pata lagana hai ki di gayi string complex palindrome hai ya nahi. Input: ASCII characters wali ek string `text`.
output: Python mein ye raha solution: ```python import re def is_complex_palindrome(text): # Non-alphanumeric characters hatao aur lowercase karo text = re.sub('[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', text).lower() # Check karo ki reversed string original ke equal hai ya nahi return text == text[::-1] ``` Isme `re` module use karke saare non-alphanumeric characters remove kar diye hain aur string ko lowercase mein convert kiya hai. Phir bas ye check kiya ah ki reverse karne ke baad string waisi hi hai ya nahi, jisse pata chal jayega ki wo palindrome hai ya nahi.

instruction: Bolt ko dhila karne ke liye jitna force chahiye, wo wrench ke handle ki length ke inversely proportional hota hai. Agar 9 inches wale handle se 375 pounds force lagta hai, toh 15 inches wale handle se kitna force lagega usi bolt ke liye?
output: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye hum inverse proportionality ka formula use karenge. Is formula ke hisaab se, dono variables (wrench length aur required force) ka product constant rehta hai. Toh agar hum ek variable change karte hain aur product ko constant rakhte hain, toh hum doosre variable ki nayi value nikal sakte hain. Is case mein, wrench length 9 inches se badhkar 15 inches ho rahi hai. Force nikalne ke liye hum ye dekh sakte hain ki dono lengths ka ratio 5/3 hai (15/9 = 5/3). Kyunki ye inversely proportional hain, toh forces ka ratio iska reciprocal hoga, yaani 3/5. Ab 15-inch wrench ke liye force nikalne ke liye, hum 9-inch wrench wale force (375 pounds) ko 3/5 se multiply karenge: 375 x 3/5 = 225 pounds Toh, 15 inches handle wale wrench se usi bolt ko dhila karne ke liye 225 pounds force ki zaroorat hogi.

instruction: Ek creative story likho jo is phrase se start ho: "The sun was setting in the west".
output: The sun was setting in the west, aur sky ekdum fiery orange or pink ho gaya tha. Birds apne goodnight songs gaa rahe the aur crickets ki evening symphony shuru ho chuki thi. Jaise hi light kam hui, Lily naam ki ek chhoti ladki apne porch ki steps pe baithkar sunset ki beauty dekh rahi thi. Lekin jaise hi andhera badhne laga, woh peaceful scene anxiety mein badal gaya. Lily ko raat hone se pehle forest mein jaakar apne parivaar ke liye lakdiyan (firewood) ikhatta karni thi. Usne apni basket uthayi, akk gehri saans li, aur jungle ki taraf nikal gayi. Jab wo lakdiyan chun rahi thi, use ajeeb noises sunayi di aur pedon ke beech shadows move karte dikhe. Wo darr gayi aur apne ghar ki taraf bhagne lagi. Tabhi achanak uska pair phisla aur wo gir gayi, jis se uski basket se saari lakdiyan bikhar gayi. Uski aankhon mein aansu aa gaye kyunki use pata tha ki agar usne sab fir se collect nahi kiya, toh uski family raat ko thand mein rahegi. Tabhi use jhadiyon mein kuch halchal sunayi di, aur ek chhoti si fairy dikhi jo soft light se chamak rahi thi. Fairy ne kaha, "Ro mat chhoti bacchi, main teri madad karti hoon lakdiyan jama karne mein." Fairy ki help se Lily ne jaldi se lakdiyan ikhatta ki aur ghar wapas pahunch gayi. Jab usne fairy ko thank you bolne ke liye peeche muda, toh wo ja chuki thi, bas hawa mein thoda glittering fairy dust bacha tha. Lily smile karne lagi, use samajh aa gaya ki magic har jagah he, chahe raat kitni bhi andheri kyun na ho. Sun west mein set ho gaya tha, par usne ek naye adventure aur akk naye dost ka rasta khol diya tha.

instruction: RAM aur ROM memory ke beech ke main differences batao. RAM (Random Access Memory) ROM (Read-only Memory)
output: RAM (Random Access Memory) aur ROM (Read-only Memory) mein ye main differences hain: 1. Purpose: RAM computer ki primary memory hoti hai, jahan currently use hone wala data temporarily store hota hai. Wahin ROM mein firmware ya permanent data hota hai jo basic functioning ke liye chahiye, jaise BIOS. 2. Volatility: RAM volatile hoti hai, matlab power off hote hi data chala jata hai. Par ROM non-volatile hai, toh computer off hone ke baad bhi data safe rehta hai. 3. Write Capability: RAM read-write memory hai, yaani isme data read bhi kar sakte hain aur write bhi. ROM sirf read-only hoti hai, isme data write nahi kar sakte. 4. Speed: RAM ki speed bahut high hoti hai, jabki ROM thodi slow hoti hai. 5. Capacity: Generally RAM ki storage capacity ROM se zyada hoti he. 6. Usage: RAM un cheezon ke liye use hoti hai jo baar-baar change hoti hain, aur ROM unke liye jise change karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti.

instruction: Ek algorithm banao jo numbers ke array mein maximum value find kar sake. [3, 5, 7, 2]
output: Simple hai, array mein se max value nikalne ke liye ye steps follow karo: 1. Array ke pehle element ko max value maan lo. 2. Baaki elements pe loop chalao aur current max se compare karo. 3. Agar koi element current max se bada milta hai, toh use naya max value set kar do. 4. Saare elements check hone tak loop chalao. 5. Last mein max value return kar do. Pseudocode: ``` function findMaxValue(array) { let maxValue = array[0]; for (let i = 1; i < array.length; i++) { if (array[i] > maxValue) { maxValue = array[i]; } } return maxValue; } ``` Example implementation in Python: ```python def find_max_value(arr): max_value = arr[0] for i in range(1, len(arr)): if arr[i] > max_value: max_value = arr[i] return max_value # Test the function with the provided input arr = [3, 5, 7, 2] print(find_max_value(arr)) # Output: 7 ```

instruction: Goal: Customers ki line hai, har doosra customer tea order karta hai (2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, ...). Aap unhe list karte ho aur har prime number wale tea customer ko T-Shirt dete ho. Total customers (n) diye hain, toh batao kitni T-Shirts distribute hui? Example: 4 customers hain: Customer 1: kuch aur order karta hai Customer 2: tea order karta hai (1st tea customer) Customer 3: kuch aur order karta hai Customer 4: tea order karta hai aur T-Shirt milti hai (2nd tea customer --> prime number 2) Answer: 1 Input: Line 1 : Ek integer n (total customers).
output: Logic simple hai: 1. T-Shirt counter 0 se start karo. 2. 1 se n tak loop chalao. 3. Agar customer number even hai, toh tea counter badhao. 4. Check karo ki tea counter prime hai ya nhi. 5. Agar prime hai, toh T-Shirt counter increment karo. 6. T-Shirt counter return kar do. Code ye raha: ``` def is_prime(n): if n < 2: return False for i in range(2, int(n**(0.5))+1): if n % i == 0: return False return True n = int(input()) t_shirts = 0 counter = 0 for i in range(1, n+1): if i % 2 == 0: counter += 1 if is_prime(counter): t_shirts += 1 print(t_shirts) ``` Pehle line pe n ki value dalo ar code output de dega.

Unhone lake ki ek powerful sorceress ki kahaniyan suni thi jo zindagi de sakti thi. Unhe samajh aa gaya ki ye bacha uska gift hai aur unhone use apna liya. Saal beete aur wo ladka ek bahadur young man ban gaya. Use hamesha paani se ek special connection feel hota tha. Kabhi-kabhi shaant raaton mein, jab chand chamak raha hota tha, wo lake ke beech mein jaakar baithta aur use us sorceress ki awaaz sunayi deti, jo use magic aur adventure ki kahaniyan sunati thi.

instruction: Is data set ko use karke ek data story banao: Ek industry mein kaam karne waale logon ka average meeting time per day.
output: Maine ek dataset analyze kiya hai jo batata hai ki akk hi industry ke log roz average kitna time meetings mein spend karte hain. Ye data meeting culture samajhne ke liye kaafi sahi hai, khaas kar un companies ke liye jo apni meeting strategy improve karna chahti hain. Data se pata chalta hai ki industry ke hisaab se meeting ka time kaafi change hota hai. For example, technology industry waale sabse zyada time meetings mein bitate hain—average lagbhag do ghante roz. Uske baad finance waale aate hain jo average 1.5 hours spend karte hain. Wahin retail industry mein meeting time sabse kam hai, aadhe ghante se bhi kam. Analysis se ye bhi dikhta ah ki jahan collaboration zyada chahiye hota hai, wahan meetings bhi zyada hoti hain. Tech aur finance mein collaboration high hai, isliye meetings zyada hain. Retail mein collaboration kam hai, isliye meetings short hoti hain. Hum ye bhi assume kar sakte hain ki meeting ka style bhi industry ke hisaab se badalta hai. Retail mein short aur focused meetings se productivity badhti hogi, jabki tech mein lambi meetings brainstorming aur innovation mein help karti hongi. Conclusion ye hai ki meeting ka time industry ke nature, collaboration level aur style pe depend karta hai. Companies is data ko use karke apne meetings ke duration aur frequency ko optimize kar sakti hain.

instruction: Ek triangle ka hypotenuse nikalo jiska base 12 cm aur height 6 cm hai.
output: Agar triangle ka base 12 cm ah, height 6 cm hai, aur wo akk right triangle hai, toh hypotenuse nikalne ke liye Pythagorean theorem use kar lo. Iska formula hota hai c² = a² + b², jahan c hypotenuse hai aur a aur b baaki do sides hain. Is triangle ke liye, hum base aur height ko sides maan lete hain. Toh a = 12cm aur b = 6cm rakh kar solve karte hain: c² = 12² + 6² c² = 144 + 36 c² = 180 c = √180 √180 ko simplify karke hum 6 * √5 likh sakte hain. Toh is right triangle ke hypotenuse ki length 6 * √5 cm hai, jo lagbhag 13.42 cm hoti hai.

instruction: Goal: Your vehicle is moving at speed v0 and has an acceleration of a. Find the speed v1 after x meters. The formula to calculate the speed is: v1 ^ 2 - v0 ^ 2 = 2 * a * x The formula works only with the following units, you might have to do some conversion: m/s for v1 and v0 m/s^2 for a m for x BE CAREFUL OF THE UNIT! Input: Line 1: v0, consisting of the original speed (integer) and the unit, separated by a space. The unit can be m/s or km/h Line 2: An integer a, the acceleration, in meter per second squared Line 3: An integer x, the distance, in meter Output: You must output a string with the speed v1 rounded to the nearest integer and the unit separated by a space, using the same unit as v0.
output: Ye raha Python solution: ```python import math # Convert km/h to m/s def kmh_to_ms(speed): return speed / 3.6 # Convert m/s to km/h def ms_to_kmh(speed): return speed * 3.6 # Parse the input v0_input, v0_unit = input().split() v0 = int(v0_input) a = int(input()) x = int(input()) # Convert v0 to m/s if needed if v0_unit == "km/h": v0 = kmh_to_ms(v0) # Calculate v1 v1_squared = v0 ** 2 + 2 * a * x v1 = math.sqrt(v1_squared) # Convert v1 to km/h if needed if v0_unit == "km/h": v1 = ms_to_kmh(v1) # Round v1 to the nearest integer v1_rounded = round(v1) # Output the result print(str(v1_rounded) + " " + v0_unit) ``` Dekho, pehle humne km/h aur m/s ke beech conversion ke liye do functions banaye. Phir input read karke parse kiya. Agar v0 km/h mein tha, toh use m/s mein convert kiya taaki formula kaam kare. v1 calculate karne ke baad, use wapas original unit mein convert kiya aur round off kar diya. Square root ke liye math module use kiya hai.

instruction: Goal: Let there be a right triangle with sides a, b and c, where c is the hypotenuse. h is the height drawn from the right angle to c and splits the hypotenuse to ca (segment connected to the side a) and cb (segment connected to the side b). As Euclid stated, when given the hypotenuse length c and the length of one of the hypotenuse segments cb, it is possible to determine the length of all sides and of the height, by using this formula: h² = ca * cb By using this formula and/or any other formulas of your choice, calculate the length of the two remaining sides (a and b) and the height (h) of the triangle. In the event of wrong data found in the input, print the word INCORRECT. All the outputs will need to be truncated to 2 decimal places. Input: Space separated string containing 2 positive integers describing the lengths of the side c c and the segment cb cb , or strings whenever wrong data is present. Output: the lengths of side a a, side b b and height h h, separated by spaces, or INCORRECT if wrong data is present.
output: Hum Pythagorean theorem use karke a aur b nikal sakte hain: a² = c² - cb² aur b² = c² - ca². Phir height h ke liye h² = ca * cb use karenge. Ye raha Python code: ```python import math input_str = input() try: c, cb = map(int, input_str.split()) except ValueError: print("INCORRECT") else: if c <= 0 or cb <= 0 or cb >= c: print("INCORRECT") else: ca = c - cb a = math.sqrt(c ** 2 - cb ** 2) b = math.sqrt(c ** 2 - ca ** 2) h = math.sqrt(ca * cb) print("{:.2f} {:.2f} {:.2f}".format(a, b, h)) ``` Sabse pehle map or split se input string ko integers c aur cb mein convert kiya. Phir check kiya ki data valid hai ya nahi—yani c aur cb positive hone chahiye aur cb, c se chota hona chahiye. Agar sab sahi hai, toh ca, a, b, aur h calculate karke {:.2f} format mein print kar diya.

instruction: Is model architecture ko describe karo.
input: Model architecture consists of 4 convolution layers followed by a fully connected layer and a softmax layer.
output: Ye architecture basically ek neural network hai, specifically ek Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), jo usually image classification ke tasks ke liye use hota hai. Isme akk input layer hai jo data leti hai, phir wo 4 convolution layers se guzarta hai. Har convolution layer mein ek filter ya kernel input data pe move karta hai aur element-wise multiplication karta hai, jisse feature maps bante hain jo input data ki specific characteristics detect kar paate hain. In convolution layers ke baad typically ek non-linear activation function hota hai, jaise Rectified Linear Units (ReLU), aur ek downsampling operation hota ha like max pooling, jo dimensionality kam kar deta hai par important features ko preserve rakhta hai. Convolution layers ke baad, output flatten hota hai aur ek fully connected layer mein jata hai. Is layer mein, har neuron pichli layer ke har neuron se connected hota ah, jisse model previous layer ke features ka combination seekh paata he. Last mein, output ek softmax layer mein jata hai, jo akk activation function hai jo model ke output ko probabilities mein convert kar deta hai. Softmax ensure karta hai ki saari output probabilities ka sum one ho, taaki predictions interpret karna easy ho jaye. Summary ye he ki is architecture mein 4 convolution layers hain jo features detect karti hain, phir ek fully connected layer hai jo unka combination seekhti hai, or end mein ek softmax layer hai jo results ko probabilities mein badal deti hai.

instruction: Is statement ka ek mathematical proof banao. For all positive numbers a and b, a+b>a
output: Proof dekho: Maano a aur b do positive numbers hain. Matlab, a>0 aur b>0. Ab inequality a>0 ke dono sides pe b add karte hain, toh humein milta hai: a+b > b, aur kyunki b>0 hai, toh humein pata he ki b > b-1. Hence, a+b > b > b-1. Kyunki a >= b-1 hai, toh hum upar wali inequality mein b-1 ki jagah a substitute kar sakte hain. Isliye, a+b > a. Proof complete.

instruction: Do scenarios batao ki AI ko public health advance karne ke liye kaise use kiya ja sakta hai.
output: Scenario 1: Disease Surveillance ke liye Predictive Analytics AI ka use public health mein prediction algorithms banane ke liye ho sakta hai, jo bahut saare medical data ko analyze karke patterns pehchan sakein ki koi disease outbreak hone wala hai. Ye algorithms healthcare databases, social media posts aur news platforms se real-time data nikal sakte hain, jaise patients ke symptoms aur prescriptions. COVID-19, influenza aur HIV jaise infectious diseases par focus karke, AI potential outbreaks predict kar sakta hai or preventive measures suggest kar sakta hai, jo health officials ke liye ek early warning system ka kaam karega. Scenario 2: Intelligent Clinical Decision Support Ek ar scenario hai doctors ar healthcare professionals ke liye intelligent decision support systems banana. Ye AI systems patient ke Electronic Health Records, medical history aur test results ko analyze karke personalized treatment recommendations de sakte hain. Patient ke case ko hazaron similar cases se compare karke, AI evidence-based diagnoses aur risk assessments generate kar sakta hai, jisse doctors best care provide kar payein. Ye khaas kar rural aur low-income areas mein kaam aayega jahan doctors ki kami hai aur specialist clinics tak pahunchna mushkil hota hai.

instruction: Memory leak kya hota hai? Kisi aise bande ko samjhao jise computing ka koi idea nahi hai.
output: Dekh, memory leak basically 1 aisi problem hai jahan program dhire-dhire computer ki memory khaata rehta aahe. Isko ek kitchen sink ki tarah soch aur program ko ek cook. Cook jab kaam karta hai, toh sink gande bartano se bhar jaata hai (ye memory use karne jaisa hai). Kaam khatam hone ke baad, cook ko bartan dho kar rakhne chahiye taaki sink khali ho jaye. Par agar cook bartan dhona bhool jaye aur unhe sink mein hi chhod de, toh sink dhire-dhire bhar jayega aur naye bartano ke liye jagah nahi bachegi. Memory leak mein bhi yahi hota hai—program memory toh leta hai, par usko 'clean up' karna bhool jata hai. End mein sink full ho jata hai, aur waise hi computer slow ho jata hai, freeze hota hai ya crash kar jata hai.

instruction: Is theorem ka proof likho: Do odd numbers ka sum humesha even hota hai.
output: Statement: Two odd numbers ka sum even hota hai. Proof: Maan lo hamare paas do odd numbers hain, a aur b. Odd number ki definition ke hisaab se, hum inhe aise likh sakte hain: a = 2m + 1, b = 2n + 1, jahan m aur n integers hain. Ab inka sum lete hain, jise hum C bolenge: C = a + b, a aur b ki values put karte hain: C = (2m + 1) + (2n + 1), Isko simplify karenge toh aayega: C = 2m + 2n + 2, ya fir C = 2(m + n + 1) Ab dekho, (m + n + 1) khud ek integer hai, toh ise k maan lete hain. Toh C = 2k ho gaya. Ye exact definition hai ek even number ki. Toh humne prove kar diya ki do odd numbers ka sum even hota hai. Theorem proved.

instruction: Machine learning ke advantages aur disadvantages pe ek case study banao.
output: ## Case Study: Machine Learning ke Pros and Cons ML aaj kal bahut popular he kyunki ye data se patterns dhoond kar predictions kar leta ah. Ye AI ka ek part hai jisme systems experience se seekhte hain. ### Advantages 1. Efficiency aur Productivity: ML algorithms bahut saara complex data fast process kar lete hain. Businesses isse repetitive tasks automate kar sakte hain, jisse staff important kaam pe focus kar sake. 2. Better Decision Making: ML se bade data sets mein correlations mil jaate hain jo normally dikhte nhiii. Isse strategy banane mein help milti hai aur risk kam ho jata hai. 3. Enhanced Customer Experience: Customer data analyze karke personalized recommendations di ja sakti hain, jisse satisfaction aur loyalty badhti hai. ### Disadvantages 1. Data Quality: ML model utna hi achha hota hai jitna uska training data. Agar data ganda hai, toh results bhi galat aayenge. Accuracy maintain karna kaafi tedious kaam hai. 2. Limited Interpretability: ML aksar 1 'black box' ki tarah hota aahe, samajh nahi aata ki decision kaise liya gaya. Regulated industries mein ye transparency issue ban jata hai. 3. High Cost or Complexity: ML system setup karna mehnga aur complex hota ah. Iske liye expert log, hardware aur bahut saare data ki zaroorat hoti hai, jo small companies ke liye mushkil hai. ### Conclusion ML ke apne fayde aur nuksan hain. Efficiency toh badhti hai par data quality aur cost ka chakkar rehta aahe. Organizations ko in points ko dhyan mein rakhna chahiye.

instruction: Carol ke piggy bank mein $4.55 hain, jo quarters aur nickels se bane hain. Nickels, quarters se seven zyada hain. Carol ke bank mein kitne nickels hain?
output: Is problem ko solve karne ke liye n aur q use karte hain nickels aur quarters ki count represent karne ke liye. Humein pata hai ki nickels, quarters se seven zyada hain, toh equation banegi: q = n - 7 Total amount $4.55 hai, yaani 455 cents. Isse second equation mil jayegi: 5n + 25q = 455 Ab first equation ko second mein substitute kar do q hatane ke liye: 5n + 25(n-7) = 455 Isko simplify karne par 6n = 126 aayega. 6 se divide karo toh n = 21. Toh Carol ke piggy bank mein 21 nickels hain.

instruction: Kal mera physics test hai, kya tum mujhe ek quick cheat sheet de sakte ho?
output: Ye le ek brief physics cheat sheet, tere test mein kaam aayegi: **Motion and Forces** - Distance = speed x time - Acceleration = (final speed - initial speed) / time - Force = mass x acceleration - Weight = mass x gravity (9.8m/s^2 on Earth) - Newton's First Law: An object will remain at rest or in motion unless acted upon by force - Newton's Second Law: The net force on an object is equal to its mass times its acceleration - Newton's Third Law: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction **Energy and Work** - Work = force x distance - Kinetic Energy = 0.5 x mass x (velocity^2) - Potential Energy = mass x gravity x height - Conservation of energy: energy cannot be created or destroyed, only converted from one form to another **Waves** - Speed = wavelength x frequency - The frequency of a wave is the number of cycles that pass a given point in one second - The period of a wave is the time it takes for one cycle to pass **Heat and Thermodynamics** - Heat flows from hotter to colder objects. - Temperature is a measure of the average kinetic energy of particles in an object. - The First law of Thermodynamics: energy cannot be created or destroyed, only converted from one form to another. - The Second law of Thermodynamics: heat cannot flow from a colder to a hotter body. **Electricity and Magnetism** - Voltage = current x resistance - Electric force = k x (charge 1 x charge 2) / (distance between charges)^2, where k is Coulomb's constant. - A magnetic field is created by moving electric charges. - Electromagnetic Induction: a changing magnetic field induces an electric current in a wire. Note kar lena ki ye bas ek overview hai, apne syllabus ke specific topics zaroor check kar lena. All the best!

instruction: Goal: You have to figure out if the system of equations is a Cramer system. A Cramer system is a system of equations with as many equations as unknowns. Input: Line 1: n the number of equations Next n lines: the equations Output: Line 1: 'Cramer' or 'not Cramer' Line 2: list of unknowns sorted by alphabetic order Example: Input: ``` 2 2a + 3 = 0 3 + 4b = 0 ``` Output: ``` Cramer ab ```
output: Iska solution ye Python code hai: ``` n = int(input()) equations = [] variables = set() for i in range(n): equation = input().strip() equations.append(equation) for char in equation: if char.isalpha(): variables.add(char) if n == len(variables): print("Cramer") print("".join(sorted(variables))) else: print("not Cramer") print("".join(sorted(variables))) ``` Pehle number of equations `n` read karo aur equations store karne ke liye empty list aur variables ke liye empty set banao. Loop chalao `n` times, equations read karo aur set mein saare unique variables extract karo. End mein check karo ki `n` aur variables ki count match kar rahi hai ya nahi. Match hui toh "Cramer" or sorted variables print karo, warna "not Cramer" aur sorted variables.

instruction: Ek experiment design karo jo is concept ko test kare: heavy metals ka plant growth pe kya asar hota hai.

Soil prepare karo aur respective heavy metal concentrations add karo. Bas ye dhyan rakhna ki sirf heavy metal ki quantity alag ho; baaki light, temperature, aur pani sab same hona chahiye. 4. Time-to-time growth monitor karo. Height, leaves ka number, aur overall look check karte raho. Agar growth ruk rahi hai ya leaves discolored ho rahe hain, toh record karo. 5. Last mein data analyze karo aur dekho ki control group ke comparison mein heavy metals waale plants mein kitna difference aaya. instruction: Ek string aur do indices diye gaye hain, ek function likho jo first index se second index tak ke part ko reverse kar de. String = "This is a sentence." First Index = 1 Second Index = 5
output: Python mein iska ek possible solution ye raha: ```python def reverse_substring(string, first_index, second_index): # check if indices are within bounds if first_index >= len(string) or second_index >= len(string): return "Invalid indices" if first_index > second_index: first_index, second_index = second_index, first_index # get substrings before, within and after the specified indices before_substr = string[:first_index] within_substr = string[first_index:second_index+1] after_substr = string[second_index+1:] # reverse the substring within the specified indices reversed_within_substr = within_substr[::-1] # concatenate all substrings result = before_substr + reversed_within_substr + after_substr return result # Test our function string = "This is a sentence." first_index = 1 second_index = 5 print(reverse_substring(string, first_index, second_index)) ``` Ye function string or do indices ko as arguments leta hai. Pehle ye check karta hai ki indices valid bounds mein hain ya nahi, aur agar first index second se bada hai toh unhe swap kar deta hai. Phir ye specified indices ke before, within aur after waale substrings extract karta hai aur slicing use karke beech waale part ko reverse kar deta hai. Last mein saare substrings ko concatenate karke result return kar deta hai.

instruction: Do fair, six-sided dice roll hue hain. Kya probability hai ki dono numbers ka sum 11 se kam ho?
output: Agar humein probability nikalni hai ki sum 11 se kam ho, toh easy tareeka ye hai ki pehle check karo ki sum 11 ya usse zyada hone ki probability kya hai. Total 36 pairs possible hain, jinme se sirf teen pairs (5,6), (6,5), aur (6,6) aise hain jinka sum 11 ya usse zyada hai. Toh probability ho gayi 3/36, jo simplify karke 1/12 aayega. Ab complementary probability use karenge. Kisi event ke hone ki probability 1 minus uske na hone ki probability hoti hai. Toh sum 11 se kam hone ki probability hogi 1 - 1/12 = 11/12. Simple hai, samajh aaya?

instruction: Ek proposal hai ki double zero wale years leap year tabhi honge agar 900 se divide karne pe remainder 200 ya 600 aaye. Is proposal ke according 1996 aur 4096 ke beech kitne leap years honge?
output: Hamein bas wo years dhundne hain jo double zero pe end ho rahe hain ar 900 se divide karne par 200 ya 600 remainder dete hain. 1800 multiple hai 900 ka, toh 200 add karo ta pehla year mila: 2000. Phir 900 add karte raho: 2900, phir 3800. 3800 ke baad koi year 4096 se pehle fit nahi baithta. Ab 1800 mein 600 add karo toh 2400 aata hai. Phir 900 add kiya toh 3300. Agla wala 4096 ke paar chala jayega. Toh total years hue: 2000, 2900, 3800, 2400, or 3300. Sab double zero pe end ho rahe hain, toh total 5 leap years hain. Simple logic hai.

instruction: Equation 2z-3z̅=-2-30i ko solve karke complex number z find karo. Yaad rakhna z̅ ka matlab z ka conjugate hai.
output: Dekho, sabse pehle z = a + bi maan lete hain, jahan a real part aahe aur b imaginary part. Humein pata hai ki z̅ conjugate hota hai, toh z̅ = a − bi hoga. Ab in values ko 2z − 3z̅ = −2 − 30i mein put karte hain: 2(a + bi) − 3(a − bi) = −2 − 30i Is equation ko simplify karenge toh milega: (2a − 3a) + (2b + 3b)i = −2 − 30i Ab real aur imaginary parts ko alag-alag solve karte hain: 2a − 3a = −2 --> a = 2 2b + 3b = −30 --> b = −6 Toh final answer hai, complex number z = 2 − 6i.

instruction: Goal: Ek program likhna hai jo input string se most frequently occurring letter find kare (sirf letters). Program ko most frequent letter aur uska count print karna chahiye. String mein hamesha ek hi most frequent letter hoga. Case insensitive hona chahiye, matlab 'A' aur 'a' same hain. Input: str : String, jisme letters aur spaces honge (spaces ko ignore karna hai). Output: Most frequent letter (lowercase) aur uska count, space-separated.
output: Python mein solution ye raha: ``` def find_most_frequent_letter(s): # Dictionary banayi frequency count karne ke liye freq = {} for c in s.lower(): if c.isalpha(): freq[c] = freq.get(c, 0) + 1 # Max frequency wala letter find kiya max_letter, max_count = None, 0 for letter, count in freq.items(): if count > max_count: max_letter, max_count = letter, count # Result ko lowercase string mein return kiya return max_letter.lower() + " " + str(max_count) # Example usage: s = "Hello, World!" result = find_most_frequent_letter(s) print(result) # Output: "l 3" ``` `find_most_frequent_letter` function pehle `freq` dictionary banata hai. `isalpha()` aur `lower()` use kiya hai taaki spaces ignore ho jayein aur case ka chakkar na rahe. Phir loop chalakar `max_letter` or `max_count` nikal liye. Simple hai, last mein space-separated lowercase string return ho jati hai.

instruction: India mein abhi gender aur age ke hisab se kaunse labor laws hain, explain karo.
output: India mein workers ke rights protect karne aur equality laane ke liye kaafi labor laws hain. Kuch main laws ye rahe: 1. The Equal Remuneration Act, 1976: Isme gender base discrimination allowed nahi hai. Matlab agar male aur female worker same kaam kar rahe hain, toh wages, recruitment aur service conditions same honi chahiye. 2. The Maternity Benefits Act, 1961: Ye women ki employment protect karta hai maternity leave ke time. Isme childbirth se 6 hafte pehle aur 6 hafte baad fully paid leave milti hai. 3. The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986: 14 saal se kam age ke bachon ko hazardous jobs mein rakhna prohibited hai. Baaki jobs mein bhi working conditions regulate ki jati hain. 4. The Factories Act, 1948: Factories mein workers ki safety, health aur welfare ka dhyan rakha jata hai. Isme adults ke max working hours set hain, child labor ban hai, aur male-female ke liye separate toilets aur washing facilities mandatory hain. 5. The Minimum Wages Act, 1948: Alag-alag industries aur categories ke liye minimum wages set kiye gaye hain taaki workers ko fair payment mile. Overall, Indian laws sabko equal treatment dene ki koshish karte hain, but practically ye enforcement, awareness aur employers ke compliance pe depend karta hai.

instruction: Ek aisa algorithm likho jo text analyze karke saare nouns extract karle.
output: ```python 1. Import the necessary libraries, such as the natural language toolkit (nltk). import nltk 2. Tokenize the given text into sentences and words. sentences = nltk.sent_tokenize(text) words = nltk.word_tokenize(text) 3. Apply part-of-speech tagging to the tokenized words to identify the grammatical category of each word. pos_tagged = nltk.pos_tag(words) 4. Initialize a list to store the extracted nouns. nouns = [] 5. Loop through the tagged words and check if the part-of-speech tag is a noun tag ('NN', 'NNS', 'NNP', or 'NNPS'). for word, tag in pos_tagged: if tag in ('NN', 'NNS', 'NNP', 'NNPS'): # If it is a noun tag, append the word to the list of extracted nouns nouns.append(word) 6. Return the list of extracted nouns. return nouns ``` Ye algorithm text ko analyze karega, use sentences aur words mein tokenize karega, phir POS tagging apply karke nouns identify karega. End mein saare extracted nouns ek list mein return ho jayenge.

instruction: AlphaGo Zero algorithm mein kis tarah ka artificial neural network architecture use hua tha, describe karo.
output: AlphaGo Zero mein residual connections wala deep neural network use hua tha. Isme multiple convolutional layers hain jisme batch normalization aur ReLU activations lage hain, aur last layer mein policy ke liye linear output aur board position value ke liye tanh output he. Residual connections ki wajah se network deep layers pe train ho pata hai aur vanishing gradients ka scene nahi hota. Isko reinforcement learning se train kiya gaya hai, jahan current version aur previous version ke self-play games ke outcomes se parameters update hote hain. Original AlphaGo ke compared isme koi hand-engineered features ya game ki prior knowledge nahi chahiye thi, bas raw board position aur self-play training pe rely kiya gaya.

instruction: Ek program banao jo computer ka temperature log kare aur value ke basis pe usage limit kare.
output: Python mein ek basic program hai jo CPU temperature monitor karega ar limit cross hone pe usage restrict kar dega: ```python import os import psutil import time from datetime import datetime #set temperature limit value in Celsius tempLimit = 70 #function to get current CPU temperature def getTemperature(): temperature = psutil.sensors_temperatures() currentTemp = temperature['coretemp'][0].current return currentTemp #function to log temperature of CPU with timestamps def logTemperature(temp): logfile = open('temperatureLog.txt', 'a') timestamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') log = timestamp + ' - CPU Temperature: ' + str(temp) + '\n' logfile.write(log) logfile.close() #function to check if the temperature exceeds limit and take action accordingly def checkTemperature(): while True: currentTemp = getTemperature() logTemperature(currentTemp) if currentTemp > tempLimit: #limit computer usage os.system("shutdown -s -t 60") #shutdown computer in 60 seconds break time.sleep(60) #check temperature every 60 seconds checkTemperature() ``` Ye program har 60 seconds mein CPU temperature log karke file mein save karta hai. Agar temperature `tempLimit` (yahan 70 degrees Celsius) se upar jata hai, toh computer 60 seconds mein shutdown ho jayega taaki overheating na ho. Tum limit aur checking frequency apne hisab se change kar sakte ho. Note: CPU temp nikalne ka method OS aur hardware pe depend karta hai. Ye wala method Linux specific hai, shayad baaki OS pe na chale.

instruction: Diye gaye data set ka spectrum categorize karo. [2, 3, 4, 9, 15, 22, 25, 31, 33]
output: Is data set [2, 3, 4, 9, 15, 22, 25, 31, 33] mein 9 integer values hain, jisme minimum 2 he aur maximum 33. Data ko Quartiles mein categorize kar sakte hain: - 1st Quartile (Q1): 1/4(n+1)= 2.5th position pe hai, jo 2nd aur 3rd data point ke beech aata hai. 3 aur 4 ke beech interpolate karke, Q1 = 3.25 - 2nd Quartile (Q2): 1/2(n+1)= 5th position pe hai, toh median 15 hai. - 3rd Quartile (Q3): 3/4(n+1)= 7.5th position pe hai, jo 7th aur 8th data point ke beech hai. 25 aur 31 ke beech interpolate karke, Q3 = 28 IQR (Interquartile Range) = Q3 - Q1 = 28 - 3.25 = 24.75 Lower Range = Q1 - 1.5(IQR) = 3.25 - 1.5(24.75) = -34.875 Upper Range = Q3 + 1.5(IQR) = 28 + 1.5(24.75) = 65.125 Lower aur upper range ko dekhte hue, ye keh sakte hain ki data set mein koi outliers nahi hain. Tum is dataset ko domain-specific knowledge ya bin intervals ke basis pe bhi organize kar sakte ho. Batao, tumhe kis type ki categorization chahiye?

instruction: Is research paper ke main points 500 words mein summarize kar do. Topic: The effects of climate change on global agriculture
output: Climate change aajkal bada issue ban gaya hai aur global agriculture pe iska impact kaafi serious aahe. Paper mein bataya hai ki kaise temperature badhne, rain patterns change hone aur extreme weather se productivity, land use ar food security pe asar padta hai. Main point ye hai ki iska asar har jagah alag hai. Kahin fayda ho raha hai toh kahin bahut nuksan. Jaise jahan heat stress badhega wahan crop yield giregi aur failure ka risk badh jayega. But high latitudes waale regions mein shayad growing season lamba hone se fayda ho. Research mein pests aur diseases ki baat bhi hai, jo crops aur livestock dono ko affect karte hain. Temp aur rain change hone se pests badhte hain, jis se management ka kharcha aur risk dono badh jaate hain. Ek aur important cheez hai adaptation. Water management improve karke, irrigation badha kar aur storage capacity increase karke drought se hone waale loss ko kam kiya ja sakta hai. Plus, heat aur drought resistant crop varieties use karna bhi zaroori he. Paper mein ye bhi discuss kiya hai ki agriculture khud greenhouse gas emissions ke through climate change mein contribute karta hai. Isko limit karne ke liye fertilizers ka sahi use, better livestock management aur deforestation rokna zaroori hai. Last mein, global cooperation pe zor diya hai. Food security ke liye governments or private sector ko milkar climate-smart practices mein invest karna hoga. Basically, paper depth mein batata hai ki climate change agriculture aur food security ko kaise affect karega and adaptation aur mitigation kitne zaroori hain.

instruction: Ek elementary student ke tutor bano jise do fractions add karne mein help chahiye. 7/9 + 4/5
output: Dekh, tujhe pata hi hoga ki normal numbers add karne ke liye bas sum nikalna hota hai. But fractions mein tu direct numerators (uupar waale) aur denominators (neeche waale) ko add nahi kar sakta. Ye steps follow kar: 1. Pehle check kar ki dono fractions ka denominator same ah ya nahi. Isko common denominator nikalna kehte hain. Yahan 9 aur 5 same nahi hain, toh humein 9 aur 5 ka LCM nikalna hoga, jo ki 45 hai. Ye hamara naya common denominator hoga. 2. Ab dono fractions ko change kar taaki denominator same ho jaye. Iske liye common denominator (45) ko original denominator se divide kar, aur phir numerator aur denominator dono ko usi number se multiply kar de. (45 ÷ 9 = 5) Toh pehle fraction 7/9 ke liye, dono ko 5 se multiply karenge: (7 x 5)/(9 x 5) = 35/45 (45 ÷ 5 = 9) Doosre fraction 4/5 ke liye, dono ko 9 se multiply karenge: (4 x 9)/(5 x 9) = 36/45 3. Ab hum in dono fractions ko add kar sakte hain. Denominator same hai, toh bas numerators ko add kar aur neeche common denominator likh de: 35/45 + 36/45 = (35 + 36)/45 = 71/45 Bas ho gaya! Common denominator nikala, fractions change kiye aur numerators add kar diye. Toh 7/9 + 4/5 ka answer 71/45 hai. Sahi hai!

instruction: Constant t find karo taaki (5x^2 - 6x + 7)(4x^2 +tx + 10) = 20x^4 -54x^3 +114x^2 -102x +70.
output: Humein polynomial product (5x^2 - 6x + 7)(4x^2 + tx + 10) diya ha aur t ki value nikalni hai taaki ye 20x^4 -54x^3 +114x^2 -102x +70 ke equal ho jaye. t ki value nikalne ke liye, left side waale product mein x ke coefficient ko dekhte hain. Ye x term tab aayega jab (+7)(+tx) aur (-6x)(+10) multiply honge expansion mein. Toh left side pe x term hua 7tx - 60x. Humein ise right side waale x term (-102x) ke equal karna hai. 7tx - 60x = -102x solve karne pe, t = -6 aayega. Check karne ke liye t = -6 ko original product mein daal kar simplify kar lo: (5x^2 - 6x + 7)(4x^2 - 6x + 10) = 20x^4 -54x^3 +114x^2 -102x +70 Ye right-hand side se match kar raha hai, toh answer correct hai.

instruction: Problem ko effectively approach kaise karein, ispe thodi advice do. Meri team ek mahine se project mein struggle kar rahi hai. Deliverables pe koi progress nahi ho rahi.
output: Dekh, kisi bhi problem ko sahi se solve karne ke liye pehle issue ki clear understanding aur ek structured plan hona zaroori hai. Tu aur teri team ye steps try kar sakte ho: 1. Root cause pehchano: Thoda time nikaal kar analyze karo ki progress ruk kyun rahi hai. Resources ki kami he, expertise nahi hai, ya fir communication gap hai? Jab root cause pata chalega, tabhi sahi solution milega. 2. Problem ko chhote parts mein break karo: Pure project ko manage-able tasks mein divide kar do. Har task ke liye specific aur measurable goals set karo taaki team focused rahe. 3. Solutions brainstorm karo: Puri team ko saath bithao aur ideas discuss karo. Sabko bolna ki koi bhi idea dein, chahe wo kitna bhi ajeeb lage. Phir best options select kar lo. 4. Action plan banao: Ek detailed plan ready karo ki chosen solutions ko implement kaise karna hai. Sabko unki roles aur responsibilities assign karo, deadlines set karo aur progress track karne ke liye checkpoints rakho. 5. Effective communication rakho: Team ke beech baatchit open honi chahiye. Updates share karne aur concerns batane ke liye encourage karo. Regular communication se sab ek hi goal ki taraf kaam karenge. 6. Progress evaluate karo: Time-to-time check karte raho ki deliverables pe kaam ho raha hai ya nahi. Agar koi cheez kaam nahi kar rahi, toh strategy change karne se mat darna. Yaad rakh, har problem growth ka ek chance hoti hai. Positive attitude aur collaborative approach se tumhari team ye challenges overcome kar legi.

instruction: Goal achieve karne ke liye koi strategy suggest karo. Mera goal hai ki do saal mein main debt-free ho jaoon.
output: Do saal mein debt-free hone ke liye ye strategy follow kar sakta hai: 1. Saare debts ki list bana: Sabse pehle clear hona chahiye ki kitna dena he. Loans, credit card debts, aur baaki financial obligations ki list bana, unke interest rates aur minimum monthly payments ke saath. 2. Budget bana aur uspe tikka reh: Debts ka picture clear hone ke baad ek budget set kar jisme income, expenses, aur debt payments cover hon. Budget realistic hona chahiye aur koshish kar ki usse deviate na kare. 3. Debts ko prioritize kar: Interest rates ke hisaab se priority set kar. Jis debt ka interest sabse zyada hai, use pehle khatam karne pe focus kar kyunki wo bohot jaldi badhte hain. 4. Income badhane ke raste dhoond: Agar 2 saal mein finish karna hai, toh extra income chahiye hogi. Part-time job, freelancing, ya purana saman bechne ka soch. 5. Faltu kharche kam kar: Apne expenses check kar aur dekh kahan cut-down ho sakta hai. Bahar ka khana kam kar, unnecessary subscriptions cancel kar, ya carpooling try kar. 6. Extra payments kar: Jab bhi possible ho, debts ki extra payment kar. Isse loan jaldi khatam hoga aur interest ke paise bachenge. 7. Professional help le: Agar manage nahi ho raha, ta kisi financial advisor ya credit counselor se baat karne mein hichkichana mat. Do saal mein debt-free hona bada goal hai, par disciplined rahega toh definitely achieve ho jayega. All the best!

instruction: Do cheezon ko compare karo aur batao kaunsi behtar hai. Online learning aur traditional classroom learning ko compare karo.
output: Online learning aur traditional classroom learning, dono ke apne pros aur cons hain. Kaunsa behtar he, ye puri tarah student ke learning style aur needs pe depend karta hai. Online learning mein flexibility aur convenience bohot zyada ha. Students apne pace aur schedule ke hisaab se courses aur assignments complete kar sakte hain. Un logo ke liye ye best hai jinki life busy ah. Plus, online platforms pe courses ki variety bohot zyada milti hai, toh apne interests aur career goals ke hisaab se sahi course dhoondna easy ho jata hai. Doosri taraf, traditional classroom learning ek structured aur interactive environment deta hai. Peers aur instructors ke saath face-to-face discussion aur collaboration ka mauka milta ha. Isse learning experience zyada dynamic hota hai aur networking bhi achhi hoti hai jo career mein aage kaam aati hai. Online learning ka ek bada downside ye ha ki motivated rehna mushkil hota hai. Bina classroom structure ke, kuch students time manage nahi kar paate. Iske opposite, traditional learning ka social environment students ko engage rakhta hai aur motivate karta ah. Conclusion ye ha ki dono ke apne fayde hain. Final choice user ki preference aur requirement pe depend karegi.

instruction: Consider sequences of positive real numbers of the form x, 2000, y, … in which every term after the first is 1 less than the product of its two immediate neighbors. For how many different values of x does the term 2001 appear somewhere in the sequence?
output: Dekh, maan le a, b, c sequence ke three consecutive terms hain. Toh b = ac - 1, jiska matlab hai c = (b + 1)/a. Ab a_n ko nth term maan lete hain. Toh a_1 = x, a_2 = 2000, aur: a_3 = (a_2 + 1)/a_1 = 2001/x, a_4 = (a_3 + 1)/a_2 = (2001/x + 1)/2000 = (x + 2001)/2000x, a_5 = ((x + 2001)/(2000x) + 1)/(2001/x) = (x + 1)/2000, a_6 = ((x + 1)/2000 + 1)/((x + 2001)/(2000x)) = x, a_7 = (x + 1)/((x + 1)/2000) = 2000. Kyunki a_6 = a_1 aur a_7 = a_2 hai, aur har term pichle do terms pe depend karta he, toh sequence periodic ho gaya period 5 ke saath. Iska matlab pehle paanch terms mein hi saari possible values aa jayengi. Case 1: a_1 = x = 2001. Case 2: a_3 = 2001/x = 2001, to x = 1. Case 3: a_4 = (x + 2001)/2000x = 2001, toh x = 2001/4001999. Case 4: a_5 = (x + 1)/2000 = 2001, toh x = 4001999. Toh total 4 different values of x possible hain.

instruction: Ek issue ko solve karne ke liye product design karo. Issue ye hai ki elderly logo ke paas young logo jaisi technology ka access nahi hai.
output: Is issue ko solve karne ke liye hum ek aisa product design kar sakte hain jo seniors ke liye technology ko simple aur accessible bana de. Iska naam "ElderTech" rakh sakte hain. Ye ek all-in-one device hoga jo smartphone, tablet ar computer ki functionality combine karega, par iska interface itna user-friendly hoga ki seniors ise easily navigate kar sakein. ElderTech ke features kuch aise ho sakte hain: - Bada aur clear touch screen, jisme font size adjust ho sake aur high contrast display ho. - Voice-activated controls aur virtual assistant, taaki hands-free operation ho sake. - Simple or intuitive menus jo seniors ke liye easy hon. - Zaruri apps preloaded hon, jaise email, video calling, medicine reminders aur health tracking. - Built-in tutorials aur help guides jo unhe device use karna sikhayein. - Un logo ke liye physical buttons ya keyboard ka option jo touch screen prefer nahi karte. - Mazboot build aur long battery life daily use ke liye. Seniors ko unki needs ke hisaab se design kiya hua device dekar, ElderTech technology gap ko khatam kar sakta ah aur unhe duniya se connected aur informed rakhne mein help karega.

instruction: Is statement ke support mein ek argument build karo: Schools mein advertising allow honi chahiye.

First aid kit: Choti-moti injuries ya bimariyon ko treat karne ke liye basic kit hona chahiye. 6. Knife ya multi-purpose tool: Khana prepare karne se lekar shelter banane tak, knife bahut kaam aata hai. 7. Navigation tool: Compass, map ya GPS device rasta dhoondhne aur safety tak pahunchne mein help karega. instruction: C++ mein SQL database se connect kaise karte hain? Ek code example de.
output: Ye dekh, ODBC driver use karke C++ se SQL Server connect karne ka example hai: ``` #include <iostream> #include <windows.h> #include <sql.h> #include <sqlext.h> int main() { SQLHENV env; SQLHDBC dbc; SQLRETURN ret; // Allocate environment handle SQLAllocHandle(SQL_HANDLE_ENV, SQL_NULL_HANDLE, &env); SQLSetEnvAttr(env, SQL_ATTR_ODBC_VERSION, (void*)SQL_OV_ODBC3, 0); // Allocate connection handle SQLAllocHandle(SQL_HANDLE_DBC, env, &dbc); // Connect to the database ret = SQLConnect(dbc, (SQLCHAR*)"myServerName", SQL_NTS, (SQLCHAR*)"myUsername", SQL_NTS, (SQLCHAR*)"myPassword", SQL_NTS); if (ret != SQL_SUCCESS && ret != SQL_SUCCESS_WITH_INFO) { // Error handling... return -1; } // Do something with the connected database... // Disconnect from the database and free handles SQLDisconnect(dbc); SQLFreeHandle(SQL_HANDLE_DBC, dbc); SQLFreeHandle(SQL_HANDLE_ENV, env); return 0; } ``` Isme `SQLAllocHandle` se environment aur connection handles allocate kiye hain. `SQLSetEnvAttr` se ODBC version 3.0 set kiya hai. `SQLConnect` use karke server name, username ar password pass karke connect kiya hai. Connection hone ke baad tu queries chala sakta hai. Last mein `SQLDisconnect` aur `SQLFreeHandle` se sab clean up kar diya.

instruction: Ek function bana jo text string ko compress kar sake. String of text: "This is a random string. It has no purpose other than to test this function."
output: Ye le Python function, Run-length encoding (RLE) use karke compress kar deta hai: ```python def compress_string(text: str): compressed_string = "" begin = 0 end = 0 while end < len(text): while end + 1 < len(text) and text[begin] == text[end + 1]: end += 1 if end + 1 - begin > 1: compressed_string += f'{end + 1 - begin}{text[begin]}' else: compressed_string += text[begin] begin = end = end + 1 return compressed_string # Test the function on the given input text = "This is a random string. It has no purpose other than to test this function." compressed_text = compress_string(text) print(compressed_text) ``` Ye function basically input text ke characters iterate karta hai aur dekhta hai ki consecutive characters kitne baar aa rahe hain. Agar koi character ek se zyada baar aata hai, toh use count aur character se replace kar deta hai. Isse string short ho jati he agar lambe sequences hon. Example ke liye, agar "This is a random string..." input doge, toh output `T2his is a random s2tring. I2t has no purpos2e o2ther than to tes2t this func2tion.` aayega kyunki 't' kai jagah double hai. Par dhyan rakhna, ye tabhi kaam karta hai jab characters repeat ho rahe hon. Is example mein toh output original se chhota nahi hua.

instruction: Movie "Back to the Future" ko analyze karo aur batao ki kaunse elements ise successful banate hain.
output: "Back to the Future" ek 1985 ki American sci-fi adventure film hai jise Robert Zemeckis ne direct kiya tha. Ye movie commercially bahut hit thi, worldwide $389 million gross kiye aur 1985 ki highest-grossing film bani. Iske success ke peeche kuch main reasons hain. Sabse pehle, iska plot kaafi engaging hai. Story teenager Marty McFly ki hai, jo galti se ek eccentric scientist Doc Brown ki wajah se 1955 mein pahunch jata hai. Ab use ensure karna aahe ki uske parents milein aur pyaar mein padein, or saath hi wapas future mein jana hai. Time-travel ka twist aur race-against-time wala tension ise exciting banata hai. Second, characters kaafi likable hain. Michael J. Fox ne Marty ka role bahut charismatically play kiya hai—uska awkwardness aur bravery audiences ko relate karti aahe. Doc Brown bhi apne wild hair aur manic energy ki wajah se fan favorite he. Third, humor aur pop culture references ki wajah se ye movie sabke liye entertaining bani. 1950s ki nostalgia, fashion aur music ne isme extra charm add kar diya. Finally, us time ke hisaab se special effects aur action scenes top-notch the. DeLorean time machine aur lightning strike wala scene aaj bhi impressive lagta hai. Conclusion ye hai ki engaging plot, relatable characters, humor aur solid special effects ne milkar ise ek timeless classic bana diya.

instruction: Ek argument-style essay likho jisme ye prove karna hai ki robots ko workplace mein include karna chahiye.
output: Robots ka workplace mein aana kaafi debatable topic raha hai kyunki tech bahut fast grow kar rahi hai. Sabko lagta hai jobs chale jayengi aur humans pe iska bura asar padega, par sirf nuksan dekhne ke bajaye ye dekhna chahiye ki production process mein robots kya fayda la rahe hain. Workplace mein robots lane se efficiency, precision aur safety conditions kaafi improve hoti hain. Sabse pehle toh robotics se efficiency badhti hai. Wo repetitive, time-consuming aur boring kaam, jaise assembly line work, packaging aur labeling, robots handle kar lete hain. Isse production speed badhti hai aur product banane mein time kam lagta hai. Plus, robots 24/7 kaam kar sakte hain bina kisi break ke, jisse output hamesha high rehta hai. Isse businesses ka profit badhta aahe aur customers ko bhi time pe saman mil jata hai. Ek aur bada advantage hai inki precision. Humans ke opposite, robots wo accuracy de sakte hain jo physically impossible hai. Galtiyan bahut kam ho jati hain aur faulty goods banne ka risk almost khatam ho jata hai. Iska matlab hai waste kam hota hai aur kaam ko redo karne ka kharcha bach jata hai. Jab error margin kam hota hai, toh companies complex tasks bhi confidently kar sakti hain, jisse quality improve hoti hai. Iske alawa, robots workplace mein safety badhate hain. Jo kaam humans ke liye dangerous ho sakte hain, jaise heavy lifting ya hazardous materials ke saath kaam karna, wo robots kar sakte hain. Isse workplace pe injury aur bimariyon ka risk kam ho jata hai. Robots environment monitor karke air quality check kar sakte hain aur hazards ke baare mein workers ko alert kar sakte hain. Isse humans safe rehte hain aur wo zyada complex tasks pe focus kar paate hain. Conclusion ye hai ki workplace mein robots lane ke bahut benefits hain, jaise efficiency, precision aur safety. Robotics ko threat samajhne ke bajaye, ise ek opportunity ki tarah dekhna chahiye taaki production behtar ho aur workers ke liye safe aur desirable roles create hon. Humans ko robotics ke saath evolve hona padega taaki hum naye opportunities ka fayda utha sakein.

instruction: Di gayi equation ko simplify karke x ki value nikalo. 2x – 3 = 4
output: Step 1: Goal aahe x ko isolate karna. Step 2: Left side se constant (-3) hatao. Dono side 3 add karo: 2x - 3 + 3 = 4 + 3 2x = 7 Step 3: x ki value ke liye dono side 2 se divide karo: 2x/2 = 7/2 x = 7/2 Step 4: Final answer. x = 7/2. Simple.

instruction: Ek classification model banao jo bata sake ki koi email spam hai ya nahi.
output: Spam classification model banane ke liye ye steps follow karo: 1. Data collect aur analyze karo: Pehle ek bada dataset gather karo jisme emails pehle se classified hon (spam ya not spam). Is data se model train hoga. Keywords aur patterns analyze karo jo spam emails mein common hote hain. 2. Preprocess the data: Model banane se pehle data clean karna padega. Irrelevant info hatao, mistakes theek karo aur data ko aise format mein transform karo jo ML algorithm samajh sake. 3. ML algorithm select karo: Bahut options hain—jaise Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines (SVM), ya Decision Trees. Jo tumhare data pe best fit ho ar accurate results de, wo choose karo. 4. Train the model: Data preprocess hone ke baad aur algorithm select hone ke baad, training data feed karo. Model data se seekhega aur parameters adjust karega taaki spam emails accurately classify kar sake. 5. Evaluate the model: Training ke baad, ek separate test set pe performance check karo jo training mein use nahi hua tha. Accuracy, precision aur recall metrics use karo. 6. Fine-tune the model: Agar performance thik naahi hai, toh parameters tweak karo ya koi doosra algorithm try karo. 7. Deploy the model: Jab results accurate aane lagein, toh deploy kar do. Isko email client ya server mein integrate karo taaki spam emails automatically filter ho jayein.

instruction: Ek program likho jo ek integer N read kare aur N^2 integers ko niche diye gaye table format mein output kare: • Table mein N lines honi chahiye, yaani line 1 se line N tak. • Har line mein line number ke N multiples hone chahiye, jo line number ke square se start hon, e.g. ---- Line 1 start hogi 1 * 1 = 1 se, aur uske baad 1 ke multiples yaani 2, 3, ... N tak. ---- Line 2 start hogi 2 * 2 = 4 se, aur uske baad 2 ke multiples yaani 6, 8, ... jab tak us line mein N numbers na ho jayein. • Ek hi line ke saare numbers space-separated hone chahiye. Input: Input mein ek integer N hoga. Output: N lines print karein: Table jaisa Goal section mein specify kiya gaya hai.
output: Is task ko achieve karne ke liye ye raha program: ``` N = int(input()) # loop for every line for i in range(1, N+1): line = "" # loop for every multiple in the line for j in range(i, (N*i)+1, i): line += str(j) + " " print(line) ``` Yahan pehle humne `input()` use karke integer input liya. Phir, required table banane ke liye do nested `for` loops use kiye. Outer loop har line ke liye iterate karta hai, aur inner loop current line ke har multiple ke liye iterate karta hai. Humne `range()` function use kiya hai current line ke multiples generate karne ke liye, jo line number ke square se start hote hain. Phir, hum current line ke multiples ko space ke saath concatenate karte hain aur result ko `line` variable mein store karte hain. Jab har line poori ban jati hai, hum use `print()` function se print kar dete hain. Finally, humein table format mein N^2 integers mil jate hain.
