instruction: Is code ko rewrite kar aur comments add kar de. def next_generator(self): for item in self.data: self.save_prev_item() match_instruction = re.search(self.pattern_instruction, item['instruction']) match_input = re.search(self.pattern_input, item['input']) match_output = re.search(self.pattern_output, item['output']) if match_instruction or match_input or match_output: new_instruction = item['instruction'] new_input = item['input'] old_output = item['output'] modified_output = self.modify_output(match_output, item) self.fill_values(new_instruction, new_input, old_output, modified_output) self.prev_item = item yield self.instruction, self.input, self.old_output, self.modified_output self.save_prev_item() self.fill_values(instruction='End of matches reached.') while True: yield self.instruction, self.input, self.old_output, self.
output: # 'next_generator' function define kiya hai self parameter ke saath def next_generator(self): # for loop self.data ke items pe iterate kar raha hai aur prev item save kar raha hai for item in self.data: self.save_prev_item() # re.search() se instruction, input aur output fields mein match dhoond rahe hain match_instruction = re.search(self.pattern_instruction, item['instruction']) match_input = re.search(self.pattern_input, item['input']) match_output = re.search(self.pattern_output, item['output']) # Agar koi match milta hai, toh values modify aur fill ki jati hain if match_instruction or match_input or match_output: new_instruction = item['instruction'] new_input = item['input'] old_output = item['output'] modified_output = self.modify_output(match_output, item) self.fill_values(new_instruction, new_input, old_output, modified_output) self.prev_item = item # Modified instruction, input, old_output aur modified_output yield kar raha hai yield self.instruction, self.input, self.old_output, self.modified_output # End of matches pe, fill_values function call ho raha hai self.save_prev_item() self.fill_values(instruction='End of matches reached.') # Ek infinite loop hai yield statement ke saath while True: yield self.instruction, self.input, self.old_output, self.

instruction: Is code block ko optimize karne ke kuch tareeke batao. for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){ if(i%2==0){ System.out.println(i); } }
output: Dekh, is code ko optimize karne ke kaafi options hain. 1. i++ ki jagah i += 2 use karle. Since tujhe sirf even numbers print karne hain, toh if statement ki zaroorat hi nahi padegi aur code fast execute hoga: ``` for(int i = 0; i <= n; i += 2){ System.out.println(i); } ``` 2. Buffer ka size pehle se allocate karle. Agar tujhe integers ka max size pata hai, toh memory allocation ka time bachane ke liye buffer pre-allocate kar sakta hai. Saath hi, string manipulations ke liye System.out.println ki jagah StringBuilder use karna zyada efficient rahega. ``` StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(n); for(int i = 0; i <= n; i += 2) { sb.append(i); sb.append("\n"); } System.out.println(sb.toString()); ```

instruction: Ek python program likho jo text se saare emails extract kare. This is a text. sender@example.com
output: Ye lo sample Python code jisse tum kisi bhi text se emails extract kar sakte ho: ``` python import re def extract_emails(text): email_regex = r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b' emails = re.findall(email_regex, text) return emails text = 'This is a text. sender@example.com' emails = extract_emails(text) print(emails) ``` Is code mein `re` module use kiya gaya hai email addresses match karne ke liye regular expression define karne ko, ar phir `findall` method se input text se saare email occurrences ki list nikaali gayi hai. Example mein `text` variable ko 'This is a text. sender@example.com' set kiya gaya ha. Jab hum `extract_emails` function run karte hain, to ye result return karta hai: `['sender@example.com']`. Bas ye dhyan rakhna ki ye script common use cases ke liye perfect hai, par shayad saare possible email formats cover na kare.

instruction: Agar 1/x + 1/y = 3 aur 1/x - 1/y = -7 hai, toh x + y ki value kya hogi? Answer common fraction mein dena.
output: Pehle x aur y ki value nikaalne ke liye thodi algebraic manipulation karte hain. Dono equations ko add karne pe: 1/x + 1/y = 3 1/x - 1/y = -7 ------------- 2/x = -4 Dono sides ko 2 se divide karo toh: 1/x = -2 Waise hi, pehli equation mein se doosri subtract karne pe: 2/y = 10 Dono sides ko 2 se divide karo toh: 1/y = 5 Toh x = -1/2 aur y = 1/5 ho gaya. Ab sum compute karte hain: x + y = (-1/2) + (1/5) = (-5 + 2)/10 = -3/10 Toh x + y ki value -3/10 hai.

Iske alawa, ye sentiment ethical egoism jaisa lagta hai, jahan insaan sirf apne self-interest mein act karta he. Ye ek valid perspective ho sakta hai, par critics kehte hain ki ye society ke overall needs ko ignore karta hai aur negative outcomes la sakta hai. Conclusion ye ah ki individual freedom ek accha ideal hai, par use doosron ke rights aur moral correctness ke saath balance karna zaroori hai.

instruction: Agar 'a' 3 ka smallest positive two-digit multiple hai, aur 'b' 4 ka smallest positive three-digit multiple hai, toh a+b find karo.
output: Dekh, 10 ko 3 se divide karein toh quotient 3 aata hai aur remainder 1. Toh 3 * 3 toh one-digit hai, isliye 3 * 4 smallest two-digit multiple hoga. Toh a=12. instruction: Instructions dhyan se padho aur unhe complete karne ke liye ek algorithm banao. Ek integers ke array mein maximum value find karne ke liye function banao.
output: Max value find karne ka algorithm ye raha: 1. Sabse pehle ek function define karo jo input mein integers ka array le. 2. Ek `max` variable banao aur usko array ke pehle element se initialize karo. 3. Array mein second element se loop shuru karo. 4. Har element ko current `max` value se compare karo. 5. Agar current element `max` value se bada hai, toh `max` variable ko update karke current element set kar do. 6. Ye process tab tak chalao jab tak array ke saare elements compare na ho jayein. 7. Finally `max` value return kar do, jisme ab array ki maximum value hogi. Python mein iska code aisa dikhega: ```python def find_max(arr): max = arr[0] for i in range(1, len(arr)): if arr[i] > max: max = arr[i] return max ```

instruction: Determine karo ki niche diye gaye data set ke liye kaunsa sorting algorithm best rahega. Data set -> [67, 32, 53, 88, 88, 88, 24, 48]
output: Is particular data set mein sirf 8 elements hain, toh koi bhi sorting algorithm isko reasonable time mein sort kar dega. Par agar choose karna hi hai, ta do options hain: - **Insertion Sort**: Ye small data sets aur almost sorted data ke liye sahi rehta hai. Iski average aur worst-case time complexity O(n^2) hai, lekin best case mein ye O(n) ho jati hai. - **Quick Sort**: Agar data set bahut bada ya bahut chota nahi hai (is case mein 8 elements medium sized maane ja sakte hain), toh quick sort kaafi efficient ho sakta he kyunki iski average time complexity O(n log n) hai. Toh agar tumhe optimal average time complexity chahiye to Quick Sort use karo, ar agar data almost sorted hai toh Insertion Sort.

instruction: Agar sequence 2, 6, 10, ..., x, y, 26 ek arithmetic sequence hai, toh x + y ki value kya hogi?
output: Arithmetic sequence 2, 6, 10, ..., x, y, 26 mein x + y ki value nikaalne ke liye pehle common difference dhoondte hain. Kyunki 2 + 4 = 6 aur 6 + 4 = 10, ta common difference 4 hai. Is information se hum peeche se calculate kar sakte hain ki y, 26 (last term) se 4 kam hoga, to y = 22. Waise hi, x, 26 se 8 kam hoga kyunki beech mein do terms missing hain, toh x = 18. Finally, x aur y ko add karke total value mil jayegi: x + y = 18 + 22 = 40.

instruction: Paper mein kaunse sources use hue hain, unhe cite karo. Abstract: Fine-tuning continuous prompts for target tasks has recently emerged as a compact alternative to full model fine-tuning. Motivated by these promising results, we investigate the feasibility of extracting a discrete (textual) interpretation of continuous prompts that is faithful to the problem they solve. In practice, we observe a "wayward" behavior between the task solved by continuous prompts and their nearest neighbor discrete projections: We can find continuous prompts that solve a task while being projected to an arbitrary text (e.g., definition of a different or even a contradictory task), while being within a very small (2%) margin of the best continuous prompt of the same size for the task. We provide intuitions behind this odd and surprising behavior, as well as extensive empirical analyses quantifying the effect of various parameters. For instance, for larger model sizes we observe higher waywardness, i.e, we can find prompts that more closely map to any arbitrary text with a smaller drop in accuracy. These findings have important implications relating to the difficulty of faithfully interpreting continuous prompts and their generalization across models and tasks, providing guidance for future progress in prompting language models.

Phir Kennedy ne target diya ki decade ke end tak Moon pe jaana hai, jisse Apollo Program start hua aur 1969 mein Neil Armstrong aur Buzz Aldrin Moon pe pahunche. Uske baad 1981 mein Space Shuttle program shuru hua, jisse reusable transport aur ISS ki construction possible hui. NASA ne Voyager aur Pioneer jaise unmanned missions bhi kiye aur 2004 se Mars Exploration Rovers chal rahe hain. Abhi Artemis program pe kaam chal raha hai taaki 2024 tak humans wapas Moon pe ja sakein.

instruction: In do poems ko compare karo: Robert Frost ki "The Road Not Taken" aur Edgar Allan Poe ki "The Raven".
output: Robert Frost ki "The Road Not Taken" aur Edgar Allan Poe ki "The Raven" form aur subject matter, dono ke hisaab se ek dusre se kaafi alag hain. Form ki baat karein toh "The Road Not Taken" ek four-stanza poem hai jiska rhyme scheme ABAAB hai. Isme iambic tetrameter use hua hai, thode variations ke saath. Dusri taraf, "The Raven" ek narrative poem hai jisme 18 six-line stanzas hain. Iska rhyme scheme ABCBBB hai aur isme kuch trochaic octameter lines milti hain. Subject matter dekhein toh "The Road Not Taken" choice aur uske consequences par ek meditation hai. Frost ne ek speaker ko dikhaya hai jo road ke fork par khada hai aur use decide karna aahe ki kaunse raste pe jana hai. Poem ka title aur final lines is choice ki importance batate hain aur suggest karte hain ki speaker is moment ko apni life ka ek defining point maanta hai. In contrast, "The Raven" death, mourning aur loss ke themes explore karti hai. Poem ka speaker ek aadmi hai jisne haal hi mein apni love, Lenore, ko khoya he. Poem ke dauran speaker kaafi agitated ho jata hai jab wo ek mysterious raven se interact karta hai, jo sirf "Nevermore" bolta hai. Ye repeated refrain "Nevermore" speaker ki badhti hui despair ko dikhata hai aur use yakeen ho jata hai ki wo apni beloved ko phir kabhi nahi dekh payega. Overall, dono hi famous American poets ki celebrated works hain, par form aur content mein inka kaafi fark hai, ar ye human experience par do alag perspectives deti hain.

instruction: Identify karo ki courtroom mein inme se kaunsi type ki speech legal hai? Direct examination, cross-examination, evidence, opinion.
output: Courtroom mein direct examination, cross-examination, aur evidence—ye teeno legally accepted types of speech hain. Direct examination mein, wahi attorney witness se sawal puchta hai jisne use testify karne ke liye bulaya ho. Cross-examination mein, opposing attorney ko witness se sawal puchne ka mauka milta he. Evidence court mein case ko support ya undermine karne ke liye present kiya jata hai. Opinions ka scene thoda alag hai aur ye case ki circumstances par depend karta he. Expert witnesses, jinhe unki expertise ke liye bulaya gaya ho, wo apne field ke matters par opinion de sakte hain. Lay witnesses ya non-expert witnesses ko bhi apne personal observations base karke opinion dene ki permission mil sakti hai. Baaki saare cases mein, opinions generally allowed nahi hote kyunki unhe irrelevant mana jata hai aur wo facts par based nahi hote.

instruction: Maano tum ek bade city ke mayor ho aur tumhe budget plan banana hai. Describe karo ki tum ye kaise karoge.
output: Major city ka mayor hone ke naate, meri responsibility hai ki main ek thorough budget plan banau taaki city ke resources sahi se distribute ho sakein. Main ye steps follow karunga: 1. Current financial situation samajhna: Sabse pehle main city ki current financial state analyze karunga, pichle saalon ke kharche, income aur debts review karunga. Isse mze pata chalega ki kitne funds available hain or pehle kahan kitna spend hua ha. 2. Necessary data gather karna: Main saare departments aur agencies se wo data mangunga jo budget banane ke liye chahiye, jaise unke past expenses aur future plans jinme funding ki zaroorat ho. Expected revenues ka data bhi collect karunga. 3. Priorities aur goals define karna: Data collect hone ke baad, main apni staff ke saath milkar agle saal ki priorities decide karunga, jaise public safety, health, infrastructure ya education. 4. Resources allocate karna: Priorities aur available funds ke basis par, main decide karunga ki resources ko different departments aur projects mein kaise distribute karna ah. Ye allocation transparent hona chahiye aur city ki needs ko meet karna chahiye. 5. Publish karna aur public comment lena: Jab preliminary budget ready ho jayega, toh use public ko dikhaya jayega taaki wo apne suggestions de sakein. Iske liye public hearings rakhi jayengi aur community groups se discuss kiya jayega. 6. Budget finalize, approve aur implement karna: Public comments ke baad final revisions honge or phir budget city council ko approval ke liye bheja jayega. Approve hone ke baad, ye official plan ban jayega jiske basis par funds distribute honge. Poore saal main budget ko review karta rahunga aur zaroorat padne par adjustments karunga taaki funds efficiently use ho sakein.

instruction: Tumhe ek debate team join karni hai aur tumhe is topic par argument dena hai: "The school system should not track student's academic performance".
output: Students ki academic performance track karne ka chalan hamare education system mein saalon se chala aa raha he, par ye practice ab outdated ho chuki hai aur fayde se zyada nuksan karti ha. Mere arguments ye hain ki school system ko academic performance track nahi karni chahiye: 1. One-size-fits-all education: Performance track karne se students ko different groups mein baant diya jata hai. Abilities ke basis par grouping karne se education standardized ho jati hai, personalized nahi. Isse students ke unique learning styles aur interests ignore ho jate hain. Tracking ki jagah, schools ko flexible learning experiences par focus karna chahiye jo har student ki individual needs ko pura karein. 2. Pressure aur anxiety badhti hai: Constant tracking se students par bahut zyada pressure aa jata hai. Khaas kar chhote bachhe grades ko lekar anxious ho jate hain aur stress mein rehte hain. Is pressure se mental health issues ho sakte hain aur kuch toh dropout tak kar lete hain. 3. Creativity aur curiosity khatam hoti hai: Fail hone ya kam marks lane ka darr students ki natural creativity ko rok deta hai. Wo sirf grades par focus karte hain aur academic risks lene se darte hain, naye subjects explore nahi karte, aur class discussions mein participate nahi karte. Genuine learning se zyada unhe grades ki chinta rehti ha. 4. Self-fulfilling prophecy: Jin students ko "low performers" ka label mil jata hai, unhe aksar boring curriculum aur poor-quality instruction diya jata hai. Isse ek self-fulfilling prophecy ban jati hai—students poor perform karte hain kyunki unse yahi expect kiya jata aahe. Iske bajaye, schools ko sabhi students se high expectations rakhni chahiye ar engaging curriculum dena chahiye taaki wo apna full potential reach kar sakein. Conclusion ye hai ki academic performance track karna ek purani practice hai jo personal aur educational growth ko rokti hai. Schools ko personalized learning par focus karna chahiye, pressure kam karna chahiye, aur students ko inspire karna chahiye.

instruction: Identify karo: Is hypothesis ko explore karne ke liye kaunsa scientific method use hona chahiye: "The colder the climate, the shorter the lifespan of mosquitoes"?
output: Is hypothesis ko explore karne ke liye observational ya experimental study best rahegi. Observational study mein, scientists alag-alag climates wale regions se mosquito populations ka data collect kar sakte hain, specifically temperature par focus karte hue. Colder versus warmer climates mein mosquitoes ki average lifespan compare karke, researchers analyze kar sakte hain ki temperature aur lifespan ke beech koi correlation hai ya nahi. Alternatively, ek experimental study use ki ja sakti hai, jahan scientists controlled environments mein alag-alag temperatures par mosquitoes ko grow karenge aur baaki saare variables constant rakhenge. Different temperature groups ki average lifespan compare karke, researchers ye determine kar sakte hain ki temperature aur mosquito lifespan ke beech koi causal relationship hai ya nahi. Dono methods valuable insights denge, lekin experimental study zyada strong evidence degi cause-and-effect relationship prove karne ke liye.

instruction: Maano A, M, aur C non-negative integers hain aise ki A+M+C=12. Toh A* M* C+A* M+M* C+C* A ki maximum value kya hogi?
output: Dekho, A, M aur C non-negative integers hain aur humein diya gaya hai ki A + M + C = 12. Humein is expression ki maximum value find karni hai: q = AMC + AM + MC + CA. Isse solve karne ke liye, notice karo ki hum q ko aise rewrite kar sakte hain: q + (A + M + C) + 1 = (A + 1)(M + 1)(C + 1) AM-GM inequality use karke humein pata hai ki: (A + 1)(M + 1)(C + 1) ≤ [((A + 1) + (M + 1) + (C + 1))/3]^3 = [(A + M + C + 3)/3]^3 = 125 Toh iska matlab hai: q ≤ 125 - 12 - 1 = 112 So, q ki maximum value 112 aahe. Ye tab hota hai jab A = M = C = 4 ho.

instruction: In do artworks ke beech ke differences batao. "The Starry Night" (Vincent van Gogh) aur "The Night Before the Circus" (Vik Muniz)
output: Vincent van Gogh ki 'The Starry Night' aur Vik Muniz ki 'The Night Before the Circus' dono kaafi alag artworks hain aur inme kaafi differences hain. Sabse pehle, ye dono paintings alag-alag artists ne banayi hain jo different time periods aur art movements se belong karte hain. 'The Starry Night' 1889 mein Van Gogh ne paint ki thi, jo ek Post-Impressionist artist tha. Wahi 'The Night Before the Circus' 2007 mein Vik Muniz ne banayi, jo ek contemporary artist he aur unconventional materials use karne ke liye jaana jaata aahe. Doosra, dono ka subject matter ekdum different hai. 'The Starry Night' ek night landscape dikhata ah jisme swirling clouds, crescent moon aur chamakte sitare hain. Kehte hain ye Van Gogh ki turbulent mental state ko represent karta hai jab wo asylum mein tha. 'The Night Before the Circus' mein circus performers ko dikhaya gaya hai jo apni performance ki taiyari kar rahe hain. Is scene mein kaafi energy aur anticipation hai. Teesra, medium aur technique ka bhi farq hai. 'The Starry Night' canvas pe oil painting hai, jabki 'The Night Before the Circus' ek 3D image ki photograph hai. Muniz ne isse toys, strings, wires aur circuits jaise found objects ko arrange karke banaya tha. Overall, bhale hi dono night scenes hain, par artist, subject aur technique ke maamle mein dono ekdum opposite hain.

instruction: Is sonnet ko analyze karo aur iska overall style aur message samjhao. Shall I compare thee to a summer’s day? Thou art more lovely and more temperate: Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May, And summer’s lease hath all too short a date:
output: Ye William Shakespeare ke famous Sonnet 18 ka pehla quatrain hai. Ye iambic pentameter mein likha gaya hai, jo Shakespearean sonnets ka common style hai—jahan har line mein ten syllables hote hain aur ek unstressed syllable ke baad stressed syllable aata he. Iska rhyme scheme typical Shakespearean format ABAB CDCD EFEF GG follow karta hai. Is quatrain mein, speaker ek rhetorical question puchta hai aur saamne wale ki beauty ko summer's day se compare karta hai. Lekin fir wo kehta hai ki wo person summer's day se bhi zyada lovely aur temperate aahe. Wo reasons bhi deta hai, jaise ki May mein chalne wali tez hawayein aur ye baat ki summer bahut jaldi khatam ho jata hai (summer's lease is too short). Is comparison ke through ek clear message nikalta hai ki us person ki beauty (jo shayad speaker ka lover hai) summer ki temporary beauty se kahin zyada superior aur constant hai. Summer toh fleeting hai, par us person ki beauty hamesha rahegi.

instruction: Ek script likho jo do logon ke beech meeting set karne ka process automate kar de. X is trying to set up a meeting with Y.
output: X aur Y ki meeting automate karne ke liye ye script use kar lo: ```python # Required Modules from datetime import datetime, timedelta import pytz def schedule_meeting(meeting_request: str): """ This function automates the process of creating a meeting between two people. :param str meeting_request: a string containing details of the meeting request """ # Extract X and Y from the meeting request X, Y = meeting_request.split(' is trying to set up a meeting with ') # Finding mutual availability availability_X = input(f"Please enter the availability for {X} (in format DD/MM/YYYY - HH:MM): ") availability_Y = input(f"Please enter the availability for {Y} (in format DD/MM/YYYY - HH:MM): ") time_X = datetime.strptime(availability_X, '%d/%m/%Y - %H:%M') time_Y = datetime.strptime(availability_Y, '%d/%m/%Y - %H:%M') while time_X != time_Y: print(f"{X} and {Y} are not available at the same time. Please enter a different time.") availability_X = input(f"Please enter the availability for {X} (in format DD/MM/YYYY - HH:MM): ") availability_Y = input(f"Please enter the availability for {Y} (in format DD/MM/YYYY - HH:MM): ") time_X = datetime.strptime(availability_X, '%d/%m/%Y - %H:%M') time_Y = datetime.strptime(availability_Y, '%d/%m/%Y - %H:%M') # Getting Meeting Details meeting_timezone = input(f"Please enter the timezone for the meeting (in format Continent/City): ") meeting_duration = input(f"Please enter duration of the meeting in minutes: ") meeting_agenda = input(f"Please enter agenda for the meeting: ") # Create Calendar Event tz = pytz.timezone(meeting_timezone) start_time = tz.localize(time_X) end_time = start_time + timedelta(minutes=int(meeting_duration)) event = { 'summary': f'Meeting between {X} and {Y}', 'location': '', 'description': meeting_agenda, 'start': { 'dateTime': start_time.isoformat(), 'timeZone': meeting_timezone }, 'end': { 'dateTime': end_time.isoformat(), 'timeZone': meeting_timezone } } return event ```

instruction: a aur b positive real numbers hain aur a + b = 1 hai. 1/a + 1/b ki saari possible values find karo.
output: Hamare paas positive real numbers a aur b hain jahan a + b = 1 hai. 1/a + 1/b ki possible values nikalne ke liye AM-HM inequality use karte hain: (a + b)/2 ≥ 2/(1/a + 1/b) Isko simplify karein toh: 1/a + 1/b ≥ 4/(a + b) = 4 Toh minimum possible value 4 hogi, jo tab aayegi jab a = b = 1/2 ho. Lekin, jaise-jaise a zero ke close jayega aur b one ke, 1/a + 1/b ki value arbitrarily large ho jayegi. Isliye, possible values ka set [4, ∞) hoga.

output: Pair mein swelling or pain ke kai reasons ho sakte hain: - Injury: Kisi chot ki wajah se sprain ya fracture ho sakta hai. - Infection: Skin ya toenail mein infection se swelling aa sakti hai. - Gout: Jab blood mein uric acid badh jata hai toh joints mein crystals ban jaate hain, jisse inflammation aur intense pain hota hai. - Bursitis: Joint ko cushion karne wale fluid-filled sac (bursa) mein inflammation hone se pain ho sakta hai. - Blood clot: Leg mein blood clot hone se blood flow ruk sakta hai, jisse foot swell ho jata hai. - Heart ya kidney disease: In conditions mein fluid retain hota hai, jiski wajah se feet mein swelling aa sakti hai. instruction: Original question ye hai: Roll-to-Roll Printing kya hai? Ek answer diya gaya hai: Roll-to-Roll Printing ek system hai jisme aap full roll of media use karte ho. Neeche diye gaye context se is answer ko refine karo agar zaroorat hai toh. ------------ Roll-to-Roll printing is where you utilize a full roll of media (DTF film), rather than a single sheet of media, that feeds onto another empty roll at the end of the system. It is a really efficient system if you need to print constantly. It’s almost a set-and-forget type of printer that will print until you run out of media or ink, which is already faster than single feed sheets that cannot be stacked. ------------ Context use karke answer refine karo, warna original answer hi rehne do.
output: Roll-to-Roll Printing ek aisa system hai jisme tum single sheet ki jagah poora media roll (jaise DTF film) use karte ho, jo system ke end mein ek doosre empty roll pe feed hota he. Ye single sheet printing se kaafi alag hai. Agar continuous printing karni hai toh ye ekdum efficient system hai. Basically, ye 'set-and-forget' type ka printer hai jo tab tak chalta rahega jab tak media ya ink khatam na ho jaye. Single feed sheets ke mukable ye kaafi fast aur efficient ah kyunki wahan sheets stack nahi kar sakte.

instruction: Neeche diye gaye linear regression model ki coefficient of determination (r-squared value) find karo. y = 0.5x + 0.1 x = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] y = [0.1, 0.6, 1.1, 1.6, 2.1, 2.6]
output: Coefficient of determination, jise R-squared value bhi kehte hain, ye batata hai ki dependent variable (y) ka kitna variance independent variable (x) se predict kiya ja sakta hai. R-squared nikalne ke liye humein total sum of squares (TSS), regression sum of squares (RSS), or residual sum of squares (ESS) compute karna hoga. Pehle y ka mean nikalte hain: ```python n = len(y) y_mean = sum(y) / n ``` Isse y_mean 1.41666666666667 aata hai. Ab total sum of squares (TSS) calculate karte hain, jo dependent variable (y) ka total variance measure karta hai: ```python TSS = sum([(y[i] - y_mean) ** 2 for i in range(n)]) ``` TSS ki value 5.0666666667 aayi. Ab linear regression equation y = 0.5x + 0.1 use karke predicted y values nikalenge: ```python y_pred = [0.5 * x[i] + 0.1 for i in range(n)] ``` In predicted values se hum regression sum of squares (RSS) nikal sakte hain, jo batata he ki x ki wajah se y mein kitna variance explain ho raha hai: ```python RSS = sum([(y_pred[i]-y_mean) ** 2 for i in range(n)]) ``` RSS bhi 5.0666666667 aaya. Finally, residual sum of squares (ESS) nikalte hain, jo wo variance hai jo x explain nah kar paaya: ```python ESS = sum([(y[i] - y_pred[i]) ** 2 for i in range(n)]) ``` Kyunki data model ko perfectly follow kar raha hai, isliye ESS 0 aahe. Ab R-squared value nikalne ka formula use karte hain: R^2 = 1 - (ESS/TSS) ```python R_squared = 1 - (ESS/TSS) ``` Hamare case mein ESS zero he, toh R-squared value 1.0 aayi. Iska matlab y ka 100% variance x se explain ho raha ah aur model data pe perfectly fit baithta hai.

instruction: Insertion sort use karke is array ko sort karne ka ek algorithm likho. [3, 2, 4, 1, 5]
output: Insertion sort use karke array sort karne ka algorithm ye raha. Maan lo hamara input array arr[] hai: 1. Array ke second element, arr[i], se start karo aur last tak iterate karo. 2. "key" variable ko arr[i] set karo. 3. "j" variable ko i-1 set karo. 4. Jab tak j >= 0 hai aur arr[j] key se bada ah, arr[j] ko j+1 position pe move karo. 5. arr[j+1] ko key set kar do. 6. Steps 2-5 ko saari i values ke liye repeat karo jab tak end na aa jaye. 7. Jo final array milega, wo sorted hoga. Input array [3, 2, 4, 1, 5] ke saath implementation: 1. Iteration i = 1 se start hota hai (second element), toh key = arr[1] = 2. 2. j = 0 hai aur arr[j] = 3 hai, jo 2 se bada hai. Toh arr[j+1] ban gaya arr[1] = 3. 3. arr[j+1] = arr[0+1] = key, toh ab arr[0] = 2. Array ab [2, 3, 4, 1, 5] hai. 4. Jab i = 2 hoga, key = arr[2] = 4. Kyunki 4, 3 se bada he, toh koi change nahi hoga aur i increment hoke 3 ho jayega. 5. key = arr[3] = 1, j = 2. Kyunki arr[2] 1 se bada hai, arr[3] ho gaya 4. Array ab [2, 3, 4, 4, 5] hai. 6. Ab j ki value ghatayenge ar check karenge. Kyunki 0 tak saari arr[j] values 1 se badi hain, har iteration mein j+1 ko key set karenge. Iske baad final array [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] ban jayega. 7. Last value i = 4 aahe, toh key = arr[4] = 5. Ye sabse bada hai, toh koi change nahi hoga. Final Output: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

instruction: Ek text classification algorithm banao jo har sentence ko ek label assign kare. Labels hain "positive", "negative", aur "neutral". "I bought a new phone and it doesn't work."

instruction: (-1, 3) se pass hone wali aur line y = 4x + 9 ke perpendicular ray ki equation nikalo.
output: Jo line perpendicular hoti hai, uska slope original line ke slope ka negative reciprocal hota hai. Yahan slope 4 hai, toh perpendicular line ka slope -1/4 hoga. Point-slope form use karke, (-1, 3) point aur -1/4 slope ke liye equation hogi: y - y1 = m(x - x1) y - 3 = (-1/4)(x - (-1)) y - 3 = (-1/4)(x + 1) y - 3 = (-1/4)x - (1/4) y = (-1/4)x - (1/4) + 3 y = (-1/4)x + 11/4. Ye equation y = 4x + 9 ke perpendicular hai aur (-1, 3) se pass hoti hai. Ab ray ki baat karein toh direction pata honi chahiye. Kyunki second point nahi diya hai, toh assume kar lete hain ki ye positive x-axis ki direction mein extend ho rahi hai.

instruction: Ek integers ka array diya hai, usko aise rearrange karo ki even position wale elements apne piche aur aage wale elements se bade hon. [5, 3, 6, 1, 8]
output: Iska ek simple tareeka ye hai ki pehle array ko sort kar lo, jaise [1, 3, 5, 6, 8]. Phir index 1 se start karke adjacent elements ko iteratively swap karte jao. ```python def rearrange_array(arr): arr.sort() for i in range(1, len(arr)-1, 2): arr[i], arr[i+1] = arr[i+1], arr[i] return arr ``` Upar wale input ke liye swaps aise honge: [1,3,5,6,8] → [1,5,3,6,8] → [1,5,6,3,8]. Final rearranged array hoga: [1, 5, 3, 6, 8]. Yahan even position elements - 5 (index 1) aur 6 (index 3) - apne padosi elements se bade hain. Yaad rakhna ki array zero-indexed hai, toh first element odd position pe hai; sirf even index positions (2, 4, 6...) pe ye condition apply hoti hai.

instruction: Ek aisa code likho jisme kisi list ke particular number ki value store aur access ki ja sake, address ko parameter ki tarah pass karke.
output: Ye raha Python code ka example jo is instruction ko implement karta hai: ```python def main(): # initialize the list of numbers numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # get the address of the third element loc = id(numbers[2]) # store a value at the location store_value(loc, 10) # access the value at the location value = access_value(loc) print(value) def store_value(location, value): """Stores a value at a memory location.""" # get the object at the location obj = get_object(location) # store the value obj.value = value def access_value(location): """Accesses the value at a memory location""" # get the object at the location obj= get_object(location) # access the value value = obj.value return value def get_object(location): """Gets an object at a memory location.""" # get the ctypes library import ctypes # get the object at the memory location obj = ctypes.cast(location, ctypes.py_object).value return obj if __name__ == '__main__': main() ``` Jab tum is code ko run karoge, toh `store_value()` function list ke third element ki memory location pe 10 store karega (jahan pehle 3 tha). Phir `access_value()` function usi memory location se value uthayega, jo ki ab 10 hogi. Last mein, code console pe 10 print kar dega.

instruction: Is text se names extract karne ke liye ek regular expression banao. John Jones, Sarah Smith, and Mark Miller
output: Iske liye `\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z-]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)*\b` wala regex sahi rahega. Ye capitalized words ko match karta hai aur assume karta hai ki first aur last name dono exist karte hain. Names extract karne ke steps ye rahe: 1. Pehle 're' module import kar lo taaki Python mein regular expressions use kar sako. ```python import re ``` 2. Phir ek text variable define karo jisme input string ho. ```python text = "John Jones, Sarah Smith, and Mark Miller" ``` 3. Ab provide kiye gaye expression se ek regular expression pattern banao. ```python pattern = r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z-]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)*\b" ``` 4. Finally, 're' module ke `findall` method ka use karke input text se saare non-overlapping matches nikal lo. ```python names = re.findall(pattern, text) ``` 5. Ab extracted names ki list ko display ya return kar do. ``` print(names) # ['John Jones', 'Sarah Smith', 'Mark Miller'] ```

instruction: Is data se pie chart banane ka ek script likh do. Small Business (15%), Medium Business (25%), Large Business (60%)
output: Ye lo script, Python aur Matplotlib library use karke pie chart ban jayega: ```python import matplotlib.pyplot as plt # Data as a dictionary data = {"Small Business": 15, "Medium Business": 25, "Large Business": 60} # Create a figure and axis fig, ax = plt.subplots() # Create the pie chart ax.pie(data.values(), labels=data.keys(), startangle=90, autopct='%1.1f%%') # Set the title ax.set_title("Business Distribution") # Show the chart plt.show() ``` Is script mein Matplotlib ka `pie` function use hua aahe jo labels aur values leta hai. `autopct` parameter se chart pe percentage dikhega. Start angle 90 degrees set kiya hai aur title "Business Distribution" rakha hai. Last mein `show` function se chart display ho jayega.

instruction: Ek real-world scenario ke liye system design karo jo task ko automate kar sake. Restaurant food delivery system
output: Restaurant food delivery system design karne ke liye humein ek automated process banana hoga jisse customers order place kar sakein, delivery track kar sakein aur khana ghar baithe mil jaye. Step-by-step guide ye rahi: 1. Online platform banao: Ek website ya mobile app (ya dono) banao jahan customers menu dekh sakein, order place karein aur payment complete karein. 2. Payment gateway integrate karo: Payments process karne ke liye ek secure system chahiye. Aisa payment gateway lagao jo credit/debit cards, PayPal, aur mobile payments support kare. 3. Order processing automate karo: Jaise hi order aaye, system automatically receipt generate karke customer ko email ya text bhej de. Order details kitchen ko bhi forward honi chahiye. 4. Real-time tracking lao: Jab khana ready ho jaye, delivery person ko notification milna chahiye. Customers GPS use karke apni delivery real-time track kar sakein. 5. Feedback mechanism banao: Delivery ke baad, customers apna experience share kar sakein. Iske liye unhe feedback form bhejo ya app/website par feedback section rakho. Summary mein, ek efficient delivery system wahi hai jo customer ko smooth experience de. Automation se restaurants orders fast process kar payenge, jisse efficiency aur customer satisfaction dono badhenge.

instruction: Kisi ek side ko pick karo aur is statement ke liye argument build karo. There should be mandatory vaccinations for children in the United States.
output: United States mein bachon ki health aur wellbeing ke liye vaccinations bahut zaruri hain. Isliye, mandatory vaccinations honi chahiye taaki bachon ko khatarnak aur deadly diseases se bachaya ja sake. Ek bada reason ye ah ki vaccinations infectious diseases ko rokne ka ek proven aur effective tarika hain. Jab bachon ko vaccinate kiya jata hai, toh measles, polio, aur whooping cough jaisi bimariyon ka risk kam ho jata ha. Isse na sirf woh bacha bachta hai, balki community mein bimari failne ke chances bhi kam ho jate hain. Dusra point ye hai ki jab population ka ek bada hissa vaccinated hota hai, toh herd immunity create hoti hai. Iska matlab hai ki itne log immune ho jate hain ki bimari failna mushkil ho jata hai, unke liye bhi jo immunized naahi hain. Ye herd immunity un logon ke liye bahut zaruri hai jo vaccine nahi le sakte, jaise infants, elderly, ya jinki immune system weak he. Iske alawa, mandatory vaccinations public interest ka mamla hai. Jo bache vaccinated nahi hain, woh public health ke liye risk ban sakte hain kyunki woh bimari dusron tak faila sakte hain. Isse na sirf unki health, balki poori community ki health khatre mein padti hai. Government jab vaccination mandatory karti ha, to woh apne sabhi citizens ki safety ke liye action le rahi hoti aahe. Conclusion ye hai ki US mein bachon ke liye mandatory vaccinations ek zaruri step aahe. Ye infectious diseases ko rokta hai, herd immunity badhata hai aur public interest mein hai. Sabhi bachon ko vaccinate karke hum ek safer aur healthier future ensure kar rahe hain.

instruction: Is verse ko analyze karo aur iska significance samjhao. "Be patient and calm—for no one can catch fish in anger."
output: Ye verse ek metaphor ha, jahan machli pakadne (catching fish) ka matlab hai apne goals achieve karna ya life mein success pana. Iska main message ye hai ki mushkil waqt mein patience aur calmness rakhna bahut zaruri hai. Ye batata hai ki agar hum gusse mein ya frustrated rahenge, toh shayad hum woh naahi paa payenge jo hum chahte hain. Gussa ek aisa emotion hai jo hamari judgment ko cloud kar deta hai aur hum logically nahi soch paate. Jab hum gusse mein hote hain, toh bina consequences soche impulsive decisions le lete hain. Wahi dusri taraf, jab hum patient aur calm hote hain, toh hum better decisions le paate hain jo humein goals tak pahunchate hain. Machli pakadne wali analogy ye dikhati hai ki success ke liye patience aur perseverance chahiye hota hai. Jaise ek fisherman ko sahi waqt ka wait karna padta hai line cast karne ke liye, waise hi humein bhi opportunities ka wait karna chahiye aur sahi time aane par unhe grab karna chahiye. Overall, ye verse ek reminder hai ki patience aur calmness aisi virtues hain jo humein ek successful ar fulfilling life jeene mein help karti hain.

instruction: Text mein mention kiye gaye theme par ek blog post likho. The story is about a world without technology and the impact it had on the people.
output: The Impact of a World Without Technology Socho agar ek aisi duniya ho jahan technology na ho. No smartphones, no internet, no computers, no cars, aur no electricity. Aaj jo convenience aur speed humein milti hai, uske bina life kaisi hogi? Ye sunne mein kisi fictional story jaisa lagta hai, par reality ye hai ki technology itni aage nikal chuki hai ki ye hamari daily life ka integral part ban gayi hai. Technology ne hamari life bahut easy kar di hai, daily tasks ko simple banane se lekar instant information aur entertainment tak. Par, iska hamari life aur duniya par kya impact pad raha hai, ye sochna zaruri hai. Bina technology ke, humein slow down hona padega. Hum virtual world par depend karne ke bajaye physical world ke saath interact karenge. Isse lifestyle zyada active ho jayegi kyunki screens aur devices ke distractions nahi honge aur hum physical activities par zyada rely karenge. Technology na hone se humein face-to-face communication karni padegi, jisse logon ke beech connections strong honge aur hum apne aas-paas ke logon ki zyada appreciate karenge. Bina technology ke humein un conveniences ke bina jeena seekhna hoga. Cooking, kapde dhona, aur lambi distances travel karna zyada mehnat wala aur time-consuming kaam ban jayega. Par dusri taraf, ye living ka ek simpler aur sustainable tarika ho sakta hai, kyunki hum natural resources par rely karenge aur nature ke saath harmony mein rahenge. Technology-less world 1 daunting prospect lag sakta hai, par iske positive impacts bhi honge. Hum life ki simple pleasures ko appreciate karna seekhenge aur duniya se akk deeper level par connect karenge. That being said, technology to rehne wali hai, toh ye hum par depend karta hai ki hum ise responsibly use karein or benefits ar impact ke beech balance banayein.

instruction: Un logon ke liye tips ki list generate karo jo ek successful career change karna chahte hain.
output: 1. Apni strengths assess karo: Apne skills, values, interests aur personality traits ko analyze karo taaki pata chale ki kaunse careers tumhare liye best rahenge. 2. Research karo: Jin industries ar job titles mein interest hai unhe investigate karo. Job requirements, potential employers aur economic conditions ke baare mein info gather karo. 3. Apne skills update karo: Naye skills ya certifications lene ke liye courses, workshops, ya online training programs join karo taaki transition smooth ho. 4. Network banao: Apne desired field ke logon se connect karo, professional associations join karo, aur networking events mein jao taaki industry opportunities ka pata chale. 5. Strong resume aur cover letter banao: Apne resume aur cover letter ko aise tailor karo ki tumhare transferable skills or experience highlight hon, aur tumhara enthusiasm dikhe. 6. Entry-level positions ke liye open raho: Naye career mein bottom se start karne aur upar badhne ke liye taiyar raho. Isse experience, on-the-job training, aur industry exposure milega. 7. Positive raho: Career change challenging ho sakta hai aur time leta hai, par confident rehna aur goals par focus karna bahut zaruri hai. 8. Income drop ke liye prepared raho: Successful career change ka matlab ye bhi ho sakta hai ki shuruat mein salary kam ho. Is financial change ke liye prepared raho or planning kar lo. 9. Patient aur persistent raho: Career change mein time, effort aur hard work lagta ha, ta agar cheezein overnight nahi hoti toh discourage mat hona. Bas lage raho aur goals ko mat chhodo. 10. Support lo: Kisi career counselor, mentor ya coach ki help lo jo tumhe is transition ke dauran guidance aur advice de sakein.

instruction: Ek story generate karo ek ballerina ke baare mein jo apni family ko bachane ke liye ek mission pe nikalti hai.
output: Suno, ek story hai Isabella ki jo ek pro ballerina thi. Uska pura family dancers ka tha aur bachpan se hi usne ballet seekha tha. Wo bahut graceful thi aur apne kaam ko lekar ekdum passionate thi. Ek din Isabella ki life ekdum palat gayi jab ek evil sorcerer ne uski family ko kidnap kar liya. Sorcerer ne unhe chhodne ke badle ransom maanga, par Isabella ke paas itne paise nahi the. Usne khud ko prepare kiya aur sorcerer ka saamna kiya. Jab wo uske samne khadi hui, Isabella ne apne graceful ballet moves use kiye taaki wo sorcerer ke spells aur attacks se bach sake. Wo uske charon taraf twirl aur leap karti rahi, ek pal ke liye bhi nahi ruki. End mein, Isabella ne sorcerer ko hara diya aur apni family ko free kara liya. Sab sahi-salamat ghar wapas aa gaye aur Isabella ko uske doston ar padosiyon ne ek hero ki tarah treat kiya. instruction: Ek algorithm banao jo integers ki list ko sort kare. [10, 7, 4, 8, 13, 6]
output: Dekh, ek simple algorithm banate hain list sort karne ke liye. Algorithm: SORT(a[]): 1. List a[] ki length n nikal lo aur use variable n mein store karo. 2. Ek for loop chalao i = 0 se i < n tak, aur ye steps follow karo: 3. Ek variable 'smallest' ko i ke equal set karo. 4. Ek aur for loop chalao j = i+1 se j < n tak: i. a[j] ki value ko a[smallest] se compare karo. Agar a[smallest] bada hai a[j] se, toh smallest variable ko j ke equal kar do. 5. i ko same rakhte hue, a[i] aur a[smallest] ki values ko swap kar do. 6. Step 3 se 5 ko repeat karo jab tak list sort na ho jaye. ### Python implementation: ```python def SORT(a): n = len(a) for i in range(n): smallest = i for j in range(i+1,n): if a[smallest] > a[j]: smallest = j a[i], a[smallest] = a[smallest], a[i] return a ``` ### Example: Is function ko use karke hum list sort kar sakte hain: ```python a = [10, 7, 4, 8, 13, 6] SORT(a) ``` Output ek sorted list hogi: [4, 6, 7, 8, 10, 13]

instruction: Tokyo city ki history research karo aur key facts ki summary generate karo.

Shehar ka naam badal kar Tokyo rakha gaya aur modernization shuru hui—naye roads, railways, buildings bane aur western technology aur culture aaya. 20th century mein Tokyo aur grow hua, halanki World War II mein US bombing ki wajah se ise kaafi nuksaan hua. War ke baad Tokyo ko phir se rebuild kiya gaya or 1960s tak ye Japan ki economic success ka symbol ban gaya. 1964 mein Tokyo ne Summer Olympics host kiye, jisne Japan ki recovery ko duniya ko dikhaya. Aaj, Tokyo Japan ka political, economic aur cultural center hai aur duniya ke major global cities mein se ek hai, jahan 13 million se zyada log rehte hain. Tokyo apni modernity aur tradition ke blend ke liye jaana jaata ah, jahan bustling streets aur skyscrapers ke saath-saath historic temples aur shrines bhi hain.

instruction: Is sentence ki dependencies analyze karo: At the end of the week, I want to take a vacation
output: Is sentence mein kaafi syntactic dependencies hain. Detail mein dekh: 1. 'End' preposition 'of' aur noun 'week' par depend karta hai taaki 'end of the week' phrase bane, jo time batata hai. 2. 'At' pure 'the end of the week' phrase par depend karta hai, jo sentence ke liye ek adverbial phrase ka kaam karta hai. 3. 'want' main verb aahe aur root word hai, ye subject 'I' par depend karta hai. 4. 'to take' verb 'want' par depend karta hai jisse 'I want to take' ka meaning nikalta hai. 5. 'Vacation' verb 'take' par depend karta aahe ye batane ke liye ki kya lena hai. Overall structure hai: Adverbial Phrase + Subject + Verb + Direct Object. Basically, subject (I) ki ek desire ('want') he ki vo ek specific time ('at the end of the week') par ek action ('take') kare jiska object 'vacation' hai.

instruction: Ek function f : ℝ→ℝ hai jisme f(x) f(y) - f(xy) = x + y hai for all real numbers x and y. Agar n possible values hain f(2) ki, aur s unka sum hai, toh n × s find karo.
output: Hume diya hai f: ℝ → ℝ jisme f(x) f(y) - f(xy) = x + y hai. Sabse pehle x = y = 1 rakhte hain, toh f(1)^2 - f(1) = 2 milega. Isko factorize karenge ta (f(1) + 1)(f(1) - 2) = 0, matlab f(1) = -1 ya f(1) = 2. Ab y = 1 rakho, toh f(x) f(1) - f(x) = x + 1 aayega. Matlab f(x) (f(1) - 1) = x + 1. Since f(1) ≠ 1, f(x) = (x + 1)/(f(1) - 1) ho jayega. Agar f(1) = -1 hai, toh f(x) = (x + 1)/(-2), par ye function kaam nahi karta. Agar f(1) = 2 ah, toh f(x) = x + 1, aur ye perfectly work karta aahe. Toh n = 1 aur s = 3, isliye n × s = 3.

instruction: Maano x, y, z positive real numbers hain aur xyz = 8 hai. x + 2y + 4z ki minimum value nikalo.
output: Dekh, x, y, z positive real numbers hain aur xyz = 8 hai, hume x + 2y + 4z ki min value chahiye. AM-GM inequality use karenge toh: x + 2y + 4z ≥ 3 (x * 2y * 4z)^(1/3) = 3 (8xyz)^(1/3) = 3 (8 * 8)^(1/3) = 12. Equality tab hogi jab x = 2y = 4z aur xyz = 8 ho. Is system ko solve karenge toh x = 4, y = 2, aur z = 1 aayega. Toh minimum value 12 hi hogi.

instruction: Do Android operating systems ki characteristics compare aur contrast karo Android Pie (9.0) and Android Q (10.0)

Security ki baat karein toh Android Q ne privacy features introduce karke ek step aage badhaya, jisse users ko apne data pe zyada control mila. Example ke liye, ab users location, calendar aur sensitive info ka app access control kar sakte hain. Saath hi, Android Q mein "Scoped Storage" aaya, jo external storage ka app access restrict karta hai. Android Q mein foldable screens ke liye native support bhi aaya, jo kaafi bada change tha. Background activity handle karne ke tareeke mein bhi improvement hua, jisse background apps ka device resources pe access limited ho gaya aur battery life badh gayi. Basically, Android Pie ne kaafi improvements laye, par Android Q ne usi foundation pe build karke UI, security aur functionality ko aur better banaya. Naye gestures, privacy features aur foldable screen support hi Android Q ko standout banate hain.

instruction: Tim roz subah uthte hi neend mein apne sock drawer mein randomly do socks uthata hai. Agar drawer mein 10 gray-bottomed aur 8 white-bottomed socks hain, toh kya probability hai ki use ek matching pair mile?
output: Dekho, Tim roz randomly do socks nikalta hai—kuch gray-bottomed aur kuch white-bottomed. Total socks 18 hain, toh 2 socks choose karne ke total C(18,2) = 153 ways honge. Matching pair tab milega jab ya toh dono gray hon ya dono white. Gray ke liye C(10,2) = 45 ways hain, aur white ke liye C(8,2) = 28 ways. Toh total probability hui (45 + 28)/153 = 73/153.

instruction: Ek python program likho jo string mein vowels aur consonants count kare.
output: Lo, simple sa program hai: ```python def count_vowels_consonants(string): # Initialize a variable to count vowels vowel_count = 0 # Initialize a variable to count consonants consonant_count = 0 # Create a list of vowels vowels = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'] # Convert the string to lowercase if it has uppercase letters string = string.lower() # Iterate through each character in the string for char in string: # If the character is a vowel, increase the vowel count if char in vowels: vowel_count += 1 # If the character is not a vowel, increase the consonant count else: consonant_count += 1 # Return the vowel count and consonant count return vowel_count, consonant_count # Run the function with a sample string sample_string = "This is an example" vowel_count, consonant_count = count_vowels_consonants(sample_string) # Print the results print(f"Number of vowels in the string: {vowel_count}") print(f"Number of consonants in the string: {consonant_count}") ``` Basic logic ha, loop chalao aur check karo.

instruction: Diye gaye scenario pe scientific method apply karo. Goal: Ek one-of-a-kind burger banana hai
output: Scientific method basically ek experimentation process hai jisse hum observations explore karte hain aur questions ke answers dhoondte hain. Burger banane ke liye ise aise use kar sakte hain: 1. **Question pucho.** Yahan hamara sawal hoga: "Kaunse ingredients aur cooking methods se ek unique aur tasty burger banega?" 2. **Background research karo.** Alag-alag types ke burgers, unke ingredients, preparation methods aur food industry ke trends check karo. 3. **Hypothesis banao.** Research ke baad ek educated guess lagao. Jaise: "Agar beef or chorizo ka blend use karein, upar se spicy guacamole aur crispy fried onions daalein, aur use charcoal grill pe pakayein, toh burger unique aur delicious banega." 4. **Experiment se test karo.** Hypothesis ke hisaab se burger banao aur taste test karo ki flavor aur uniqueness waise hi hai ya nahi. 5. **Data analyze karke conclusion nikalo.** Taste test ke results dekho aur decide karo ki hypothesis sahi tha ya nahi, aur kya changes karne ki zaroorat aahe. 6. **Results share karo.** Final recipe doosron ke saath share karo, ya shayad kisi burger cook-off mein participate karo ya menu mein add karo.

instruction: Focus aur directrix diya gaya hai, parabola ki equation nikalo. Focus: (2, 4), Directrix: y = 0
output: Parabola basically un points ka set hota hai jo focus aur directrix se equal distance pe hote hain. Maano (x, y) parabola pe ek point hai. Focus (2,4) aur directrix y=0 hai. Distance formula use karte hain: sqrt[(x-2)^2 + (y-4)^2] = y-0 Donon side square karo: (x-2)^2 + (y-4)^2 = y^2 x^2 - 4x + 4 + (y-4)^2 = y^2 x^2 - 4x + 4 + y^2 - 8y + 16 = y^2 x^2 - 4x + 16 - 8y + 16 = 0 Simplify karne pe: x^2 - 4x - 8y + 36 = 0. Standard form ke liye x ka square complete karo: (x - 2)^2 - 4 - 8y + 36 = 0. Simplifying, humein milta hai: (x - 2)^2 = 8y - 32 Final standard form equation hogi: (x - 2)^2 = 8(y - 4).

instruction: Ek 500 words ka blog post likho jo coronavirus ka small businesses par impact dikhaye.
output: Coronavirus pandemic ne global economy ki halat kharab kar di hai, aur small businesses sabse zyada hit hue hain. Duniya bhar mein local stores, bars, restaurants or chhote businesses ko lockdowns aur social distancing ki wajah se ya toh kaam kam karna pada ya phir band hona pada. Is blog post mein hum baat karenge ki kaise corona ne small businesses ko affect kiya or owners is mushkil waqt mein kaise survive kar sakte hain. Sabse pehla aur bada impact raha revenue ka bhari loss. Log gharon se bahar nahi nikal rahe the, toh foot traffic gir gaya aur sales kam ho gayi. Kuch businesses ne jaldi adapt kiya aur online sales ya delivery start kar di, par sab itne lucky nahi the. Jo pivot naahi kar paaye, unhe government support ya loans par depend rehna pada. Iska asar jobs par bhi pada. Data ke hisaab se, US mein two-thirds new jobs small businesses se aati hain, aur pandemic ki wajah se bahut saari jobs chali gayin. Cost cut karne ke liye owners ko employees nikalne pade, jis se unemployment badh gayi. Supply chain bhi hit hui, jis se small businesses ko apna saaman lane mein dikkat aayi. Borders band hone ya trade restrictions ki wajah se imports late hone lage ya phir prices badh gaye. Ye extra cost small business owners ke liye handle karna mushkil ho gaya. Phir bhi, adapt karne ke tareeke hain. Bahut se businesses ne technology use karke customers ko remotely serve karna shuru kiya. Online ordering se lekar virtual events tak, naye innovative tareeke nikale gaye. Ek aur strategy hai expenses ko monitor karna aur jahan ho sake cost cut karna. Isme leases renegotiate karna, staff hours kam karna ya marketing budget ghatana shamil hai. Bottom line par nazar rakh kar hi survive kiya ja sakta hai. Conclusion mein yahi hai ki coronavirus ka impact bahut deep tha. Small business owners...

instruction: Global warming ka Arctic par kya asar hota hai, is par 900 words ki ek scientific report generate karo.
output: Arctic region global warming se kaafi zyada affect ho raha hai, jo basically Earth ke climate system ke average temperature mein long-term rise hai. Arctic par global warming ka impact ek bahut bada research topic hai kyunki ye region global climate change ke consequences samajhne ke liye central hai. Is report mein hum discuss karenge ki global warming Arctic aur uske ecosystem par kya specific effects daalti hai. Ek main effect hai sea ice ka pighalna. Arctic ocean sea ice ki ek layer se covered hota hai jo season ke hisaab se change hoti hai. Pichle kuch decades mein satellite data se pata chala hai ki Arctic sea ice ka extent kaafi kam ho gaya aahe, khaas kar summer months mein. Iska main reason global warming ki wajah se badhta temperature hai. National Snow and Ice Data Center ke mutabiq, ye decline accelerate hua hai aur Arctic Ocean har decade mein lagbhag 13.2% ice cover kho raha hai. Iska asar poore ecosystem, ocean currents or global climate par padta ha. Ek aur effect hai permafrost ka thaw hona. Permafrost frozen soil ki woh layer hoti hai jo Arctic landscape ke bade hisse ko cover karti hai. Temperature badhne se jab ye thaw hota hai, toh environment par kai impacts padte hain. Sabse pehla ha greenhouse gases jaise carbon dioxide aur methane ka release hona. Arctic permafrost mein hazaron saalon se accumulated carbon hota hai. Jab ye pighalta hai, toh organic matter decompose hota hai aur gases atmosphere mein release hoti hain, jis se greenhouse effect aur badh jata hai. Iske alawa, permafrost thawing se Arctic landscape badal raha hai. Frozen ground soil, vegetation aur human infrastructure ke liye support ka kaam karta ha. Jab ye thaw hota hai, toh zameen unstable ho jati hai, jis se landslides hote hain aur infrastructure collapse ho jata hai. Saath hi, ye water cycle ko bhi affect karta hai, drainage aur storage mein badlav aata hai, jis se wetland aur lake systems change ho jate hain. Global warming Arctic ke flora aur fauna ko bhi affect karti hai. Sea ice ka pighalna, permafrost thaw aur temperature patterns mein badlav ne...

instruction: Is statement ke against ek argument taiyaar karo: 'Everyone should get eight hours of sleep every night'
output: Dekho, sleep zaroori hai, par ye kehna ki 'sabko 8 ghante sona chahiye' thoda galat hai. Har kisi ki body alag hoti hai aur age ke saath sleep requirements change hoti hain. Ye points dekho: 1. Age ka farak: Bachhon ko 12-17 ghante chahiye, teens ko 8-10, aur adults ko 7-8. 2. Individual differences: Kuch log 6 ghante mein fresh feel karte hain, toh kuch ko 10 ghante lagte hain. 3. Quality vs Quantity: 6 ghante ki gehri neend 8 ghante ki disturbed neend se kahin behtar hai. 4. Lifestyle: Diet, exercise aur stress levels bhi matter karte hain. Jo bahut active aahe, use zyada neend chahiye hogi. Toh basically, ye 'one-size-fits-all' wala approach nahi chalega. Apni body ki suno, 8 ghante ka rule blindly follow mat karo.

instruction: Is dataset mein do variables ka covariance predict karo. Variable 1 | Variable 2 --- | --- 2 | 3 5 | 7 10 | 11
output: Covariance basically ye measure karta hai ki do variables saath mein kaise change hote hain. Isko calculate karne ke liye hum har variable ar uske mean ke difference ke product ka mean lete hain. Calculation aise hogi: Sabse pehle dono variables ke means nikalte hain: - Variable 1 ka mean: (2+5+10)/3 = 17/3 ≈ 5.67 - Variable 2 ka mean: (3+7+11)/3 = 21/3 = 7 Ab har value aur uske mean ka difference nikalte hain: - Variable 1: 2-5.67 = -3.67, 5-5.67 = -0.67, 10-5.67 = 4.33 - Variable 2: 3-7 = -4, 7-7 = 0, 11-7 = 4 Ab in differences ka product nikalte hain: - Obs 1: (-3.67) * (-4) = 14.68 - Obs 2: (-0.67) * 0 = 0 - Obs 3: 4.33 * 4 = 17.32 Finally, in products ka mean nikal kar covariance mil jayega: Covariance = (14.68 + 0 + 17.32)/3 = 32/3 ≈ 10.67 Toh is dataset mein Variable 1 aur Variable 2 ka covariance approx 10.67 ah.

instruction: Ek program banao jo detect kar sake ki text English mein likha hai ya nahi. Text: This text is written in English.
output: Ye le simple Python program: ```python from nltk.corpus import words from nltk.util import ngrams from nltk.tokenize import word_tokenize def check_language(text): text = text.lower() words_list = set(words.words()) tokens = word_tokenize(text) word_count = len(tokens) eng_word_count = 0 for word in tokens: if word in words_list: eng_word_count += 1 eng_percent = (eng_word_count / word_count) * 100 if eng_percent > 70: return "English" else: return "Not English" # Test text = "This text is written in English." result = check_language(text) print(result) ``` Output: ``` English ``` Is program mein text input lekar check kiya jata hai ki woh English hai ya nahi. NLTK English corpus use karke valid words ka percentage nikala jata hai. Agar 70% se zyada words English hain, toh output 'English' aayega, warna 'Not English'.

instruction: Ek script likho jo ek random password generate kare jo in criteria ko meet kare: Password length: 8 characters Uppercase letters hone chahiye Lowercase letters hone chahiye Kam se kam ek number hona chahiye
output: import random import string def random_password(length: int=8): characters = string.ascii_lowercase + string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits # Yeh ensure karo ki password mein kam se kam ek uppercase, lowercase, aur digit ho password = random.choice(string.ascii_uppercase) + random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) + random.choice(string.digits) # Baaki ke random characters generate karo for i in range(length-3): password += random.choice(characters) password = ''.join(random.sample(password, len(password))) # characters ko shuffle kar do return password print(random_password()) # Example output: lD7JbLk1

instruction: Agar mere computer se steady beeping sound aa rahi hai toh mujhe kya karna chahiye?
output: Steady beeping sound ka matlab hardware issue ya failure ho sakta he. Yeh steps try karo: 1. Beep code identify karo: Beeps ka pattern aur apne computer ya motherboard ka model dekh kar manufacturer ki documentation check karo ki iska matlab kya hai. 2. Loose connections check karo: Dekho ki saare internal cables aur components (power cable, RAM, hard drive, graphics card) sahi se lage hue hain ya nahi. 3. Components reseat karo: RAM aur graphics card ko nikal kar phir se properly fit karo taaki connection firm ho jaye. 4. Individual components test karo: Ek ek karke parts hatao aur dekho beeping band hoti hai kya. Diagnostic tools se memory aur hard drive ke errors check kar lo. 5. CMOS reset karo: Configuration issues clear karne ke liye CMOS reset try karo. Iska tareeka motherboard manual mein mil jayega. Agar isse bhi kaam nahi bana, toh kisi professional technician ko dikhao.

instruction: Is scenario mein kaunsi capital protection strategies use ki ja sakti hain? Investing in a highly volatile stock market
output: Highly volatile stock market mein invest karte waqt loss kam karne ke liye yeh capital protection strategies use kar sakte ho: 1. Stop-Loss Orders: Broker ke paas ek order set kar do ki jab security ek particular price pe pahunche toh woh sell ho jaye. Isse bada loss hone ka risk kam ho jata hai. 2. Diversification: Saara paisa ek hi jagah mat lagao. Alag-alag assets mein invest karo taaki risk distribute ho jaye. 3. Hedging: Related security mein position lo taaki risk offset ho sake. For example, put options lene se stock price girne pe potential loss limited rehta hai. 4. Asset Allocation: Apne risk tolerance ke hisaab se portfolio ko stocks, bonds aur cash mein divide karo. Portfolio ko regular review aur rebalance karte raho. 5. Dollar-Cost Averaging: Ek saath bada amount lagane ke bajaye regular intervals pe fixed amount invest karo. Isse wrong timing ka risk kam ho jata hai. Overall, koi ek fixed approach sabke liye sahi nahi hoti. Best strategy aapke personal goals or risk capacity pe depend karegi.

instruction: Design a hypothetical experiment to determine how long it takes to learn a new skill.
output: Title: Nayi skill seekhne mein kitna time lagta hai Objective: Is study ka maqsad ye pata karna hai ki average kitna time lagta ah kisi nayi skill mein expert banne ke liye. Participants: 60 log lenge, age 18 to 60, jinhe juggling nahi aati. Inko teen groups mein divide karenge: young adults (18-30), middle-aged (31-45), aur older adults (45-60). Procedure: 1. Pre-assessment: Experiment shuru karne se pehle hand-eye coordination ka ek standardized test hoga. 2. Training sessions: Har age group ko juggling training di jayegi. Roz 1-hour ka session hoga ek instructor ke under. 3. Progress tracking: Har hafte proficiency test hoga—ye dekhne ke liye ki bina drop kiye wo kitne catches kar pa rahe hain. 4. Data collection: Ye record karenge ki kitne sessions ke baad participant proficiency tak pahunche (yani kam se kam 50 catches lagatar). 5. Post-assessment: Training khatam hone ke baad phir se hand-eye coordination test hoga. Data analysis: Statistical methods use karke poore sample aur har age group ka average nikalenge. Expected outcome: Hypothesize kiya gaya hai ki har age group ke liye sessions ki sankhya alag hogi. Young adults sabse jaldi seekhenge aur older adults ko zyada time lagega. Saath hi, coordination scores mein bhi kaafi improvement dikhegi.

instruction: Fix the code so that it runs without producing an error public class Demo { public static void main(String[] args) { int a = 10 int b= 10 System.out.println("Sum of both numbers: " + a + b); } }
output: Ye le corrected code, ab bina kisi error ke chal jayega: ``` public class Demo { public static void main(String[] args) { int a = 10; int b = 10; System.out.println("Sum of both numbers: " + (a + b)); } } ``` Maine do issues fix kiye hain: 1. Variable declarations ke baad semicolons lagaye hain. Java mein statement end karne ke liye semicolon zaroori hai, nahi toh compile-time error aata hai. 2. Print statement mein `(a + b)` ko parentheses mein daal diya. Agar parentheses nhiii hote, toh Java pehle 'a' ko string ke saath jodta aur phir 'b' ko, jisse output "Sum of both numbers: 1010" aata. Parentheses lagane se pehle sum calculate hoga, phir wo string ke saath judega, toh correct output "Sum of both numbers: 20" aayega.

instruction: Find the surface areas of the following shapes. Shape: Cube, Rectangular Prism, Cylinder Length of edge for Cube : 4 cm Length, Width and Height for Rectangular Prism : 4 cm, 5 cm, 6 cm Radius and Height for Cylinder: 5 cm and 10 cm
output: Ye le surface area calculations: 1. Cube: Formula hai 6 × (edge length)^2. Edge = 4 cm Surface area = 6 × (4 cm)² = 96 cm² 2. Rectangular Prism: Formula hai 2 × (length × width + width × height + length × height). L = 4 cm, W = 5 cm, H = 6 cm Surface area = 2 × (4 cm × 5 cm + 5 cm × 6 cm + 4 cm × 6 cm) Surface area = 2 × (94 cm²) = 188 cm² 3. Cylinder: Formula he 2 × π × radius × (radius + height). Radius = 5 cm, Height = 10 cm Surface area = 2 × π × 5 cm × (5 cm + 10 cm) Surface area = 2π × 75 cm² = 150π cm² or approx 471.24 cm².

instruction: US aur China ke educational systems ki similarities aur differences compare karte hue ek essay likho.
output: Education human development ka ek bahut zaroori part aahe. Duniya bhar ke countries ne apne culture, resources aur goals ke hisaab se systems design kiye hain. Inme US aur China apni global influence aur economic power ki wajah se alag dikhte hain. Is essay mein hum in dono countries ke educational systems ki similarities aur differences discuss karenge. US aur China ke structures mein kaafi similarities hain, jaise school system ka layout. Dono jagah 12-year primary aur secondary education hoti hai, jisme elementary, middle, aur high schools hote hain. Dono countries mein bache 6 saal ki age mein primary school start karte hain aur phir high school aur university tak jaate hain. Saath hi, dono countries mein standardized testing pe bahut zor diya jata hai. US mein SAT college readiness check karta hai, wahi China mein National College Entrance Exam (Gao Kao) university admission ki key hai. Halanki dono systems standardized testing pe focus karte hain, lekin teaching ka structure alag hai. US ka curriculum general hota hai taaki well-rounded education mile jisme different subjects include hon. Students ke paas classes aur electives choose karne ki freedom hoti hai, jisse unhe personalized education milti hai. Iske opposite, Chinese system zyada rigid ah, jahan students mainly Math, Science, aur Chinese language pe focus karte hain. Unka curriculum bahut structured hota hai taaki woh Gao Kao exam mein excel kar sakein. Educational approach mein bhi bada difference hai. US student-centered approach follow karta hai, jahan students ko critical thinkers, creative aur participative banaya jata hai. Teachers group work, discussions aur experimentation jaise techniques use karte hain. Dusri taraf, Chinese system zyada conventional hai, jahan teacher hi authority hota hai aur students se expect kiya jata hai ki woh info absorb karein. Classes zyada lecture-based hoti hain, jahan teacher knowledge deta hai aur students notes lete hain. Conclusion mein, US aur China global superpowers hain aur unke educational systems unke cultural, political aur economic reasons se shape huye hain. Dono mein 12-year system aur standardized testing common ah, par curriculum, teaching methods aur approach alag hain. US flexible aur student-centered hai, jabki China ka system rigid aur conventional hai. In differences ke apne advantages hain, jo students ko alag-alag skills dete hain aur countries ki economic aur technological growth mein help karte hain.

instruction: Identify karo ki 100 se kam aise kitne positive integers hain jo 6 aur 7 dono ke multiples hain.
output: Sirf akk hi positive integer hai 100 se kam jo 6 aur 7 dono ka multiple hai, aur wo hai 42. Iska reason ye hai ki 6 aur 7 ka LCM 42 hai, matlab 42 sabse chhota number aahe jo dono se divide hota hai. Koi bhi dusra common multiple 2 x LCM(6,7) = 2 * 42 = 84 ya usse bada hoga, jo ki 100 se kam toh hai. But, next common multiple 3 x LCM(6,7) = 126 hota hai, jo 100 se zyada hai, isliye sirf ek hi number condition satisfy karta hai.

instruction: Ek naye product launch ke liye cost-benefit analysis design karo. Product ek revolutionary smartphone hai jo unbelievable high resolution photos aur videos le sakta hai.

Yahan hum ek revolutionary smartphone ki baat kar rahe hain jisme unbelievable high resolution photos aur videos aate hain. Is product ka cost-benefit analysis kuch aisa hoga: Costs: 1. Research and Development: High-resolution phone banane ke liye kaafi capital-intensive R&D chahiye taaki phone fully functional ho aur technical requirements meet kare. 2. Marketing and Advertising: Market mein naya product lane ke liye ek bada marketing campaign chahiye taaki log product aur uske unique features ke baare mein jaan sakein. 3. Manufacturing Costs: Unbelievable high resolution ke liye specific aur expensive components lagenge, jiski wajah se manufacturing cost badh jayegi. 4. Distribution and Logistics: Alag-alag regions mein product distribute karna costly hoga, khaas kar agar worldwide launch hai. Isme shipping, storage aur delivery ke kharche aayenge. Benefits: 1. Competitive Advantage: High-resolution smartphone se company ko rivals pe bada advantage milega, jisse market share badhega aur reputation improve hogi. 2. Increased Sales and Revenue: Ek unique aur revolutionary product hone ki wajah se, sales aur revenue badhne ki umeed hai kyunki log latest technology pe upgrade karna chahte hain. 3. Customer Retention: Phone ka high-resolution camera brand loyalty badhayega, jisse customers future purchases ke liye wapas aayenge. 4. Product Differentiation: Iska unbelievable camera un customers ko attract karega jo market mein kuch naya aur different dhoond rahe hain. Ye company ko competitors se alag khada karega. Conclusion mein, bhale hi cost kaafi zyada hai, lekin potential benefits ise ek wise investment banate hain. Agar launch well-planned ar executed raha, toh company ko financial, strategic aur reputational rewards mil sakte hain.

instruction: Ek bash script likho jo saari "segment*.txt" type ki text files ko ek single "segments.txt" file mein gather kar le
output: Ye le bash script "segment*.txt" files ko "segments.txt" mein merge karne ke liye: ``` #!/bin/bash # Create an empty "segments.txt" file > segments.txt # Loop through all "segment*.txt" files in the current directory, # read their contents and append to "segments.txt" for file in segment*.txt; do cat "$file" >> segments.txt done ``` Isko "gather_segments.sh" naam se save kar aur terminal mein `bash gather_segments.sh` run kar dena. instruction: Ek algorithm bana jo sentence se important keywords nikal sake. "The cat sat on the mat."
output: Keywords extract karne ka ek simple tareeka ye hai: 1. Pehle zaroori libraries import kar lo: ```python import nltk from nltk.corpus import stopwords ``` 2. Agar pehle nahi kiya, toh stopwords download karne padenge. ```python nltk.download('stopwords') ``` 3. Sentence ko words ki list mein tokenize karo: ```python sentence = "The cat sat on the mat." words = nltk.word_tokenize(sentence) ``` 4. Ab list se stopwords hata do. 'the', 'on', 'is' jaise words ka keyword extraction mein koi khaas matlab nahi hota. ```python stop_words = set(stopwords.words('english')) keywords = [word for word in words if not word.lower() in stop_words] ``` 5. Iske baad punctuation hatana ya lemmatization karna hota hai, par simple rakhne ke liye yahi kaafi hai. ```python print(keywords) ``` Final output aayega: `['cat', 'sat', 'mat']` Dekh, ye basic rule-based approach hai. Agar zyada advanced chahiye toh NLP techniques ya machine learning use kar sakte hain.

instruction: In facts ko use karke ek persuasive essay likho taaki kisi ko convince kar sako ki climate change real hai. Facts: Rapidly rising global temperatures, carbon dioxide levels higher than any time in the past 800,000 years, melting ice caps and glaciers
output: Climate change koi myth nah hai, balki ek fact hai jiske piche solid scientific evidence hai. Is baat ke kuch bade proofs hain: global temperatures ka tezi se badhna, carbon dioxide levels ka pichle 800,000 saalon mein sabse high hona, aur ice caps aur glaciers ka pighalna. Global temperatures itni alarming speed se badh rahe hain ki pichla decade record-breaking garam tha. Ye wahi trend hai jiski warning climate scientists ne pehle hi di thi—ki fossil fuels jalane aur human activities ki wajah se Earth ka atmosphere garam hoga. Iska asar hum ab dekh rahe hain: heatwaves, droughts ar extreme weather events badhte ja rahe hain. Sirf temperature hi nhi, atmosphere mein carbon dioxide ka level bhi drastically badh gaya hai. CO2 akk greenhouse gas hai jo heat ko trap karti hai aur planet ko garam karti hai. Abhi ke CO2 levels pichle 800,000 saalon mein sabse zyada hain, jo saaf dikhata hai ki human activity ka climate par kitna bada impact pad raha hai. Last mein, glaciers aur ice caps ka pighalna sabse bada sign hai. Iski wajah se sea levels badh rahe hain, jo coastal areas ke liye khatra hai, aur isse storms bhi zyada intense ho rahe hain. Ye rapid melting ek clear warning hai ki humein climate change ko rokne ke liye turant action lena hoga. Conclusion ye hai ki evidence ekdum clear hai, aur ye hamari responsibility hai ki hum is global crisis se ladein. Climate change koi theory nhi, ek reality he, aur agar humein apni planet aur future generations ko bachana hai, ta humein iska saamna karna hi hoga.

instruction: Kya tum koi creative example de sakte ho ki AI education system ko kaise disrupt kar sakta hai?

For instance, agar kisi student ko visual aids aur real-life examples se zyada samajh aata hai aur abstract concepts mein dikat hoti hai, toh system content aur delivery method ko tailor kar dega. instruction: Maan lo tumse pucha jaye ki healthcare field mein robotics ke kya-kya uses ho sakte hain.
output: Healthcare industry mein robotics ke kaafi saare applications hain, jo patient care ke tareeke ko revolutionize kar sakte hain. Ye dekho kuch main ways jahan robotics use ho rahi hai ya ho sakti hai: 1. Surgical Robots: Complex surgeries mein precision aur accuracy badhane ke liye inka use hota ha. Surgeons inhe control karte hain, jisse surgery kam invasive hoti hai aur patient jaldi recover karta hai. 2. Rehabilitation Robots: Injury ya stroke se recover ho rahe patients ki help ke liye ye robots physical therapy aur mobility exercises mein support dete hain. 3. Telepresence Robots: Inki madad se doctors remote areas mein patients ko examine, diagnose aur communicate kar sakte hain. Specialists tak information bhejna isse asaan ho jata hai. 4. Assistive Robots: Elderly ya disabled logon ki help ke liye ye robots useful hain taaki wo zyada independently reh sakein. Ye mobility aur daily activities mein support provide karte hain. 5. Pharmacy Robots: Medication dispense aur label karne ka kaam ye robots accurately karte hain, jisse errors ka risk kam ho jata hai. 6. Disinfection Robots: Hospitals mein surfaces or spaces ko sanitize karne ke liye inka use hota hai, jisse harmful bacteria aur viruses khatam ho jate hain. 7. Delivery Robots: Supplies, equipment aur medicines ko facility ke andar transport karne ke liye inka use hota hai, jisse efficiency badhti hai. In short, robotics healthcare ko efficient banayega aur patient outcomes improve karega. Jaise technology advance hogi, humein aur bhi innovative uses dekhne ko milenge.

instruction: Function f(x)=b/(2x-3) diya hai. Agar f(2)=f^-1(b+1) hai, toh b ki saari possible values ka product nikalo.
output: Dekho, humein function f(x) = b/(2x - 3) diya gaya hai aur humein b ki woh values find karni hain jiske liye f(2) = f^-1(b + 1) ho. Sabse pehle f(2) nikalte hain: f(2) = b/(2*2 - 3) = b/1 = b. Toh basically humein woh b chahiye jahan f(b) = b/(2b - 3) = b + 1 ho. Dono sides ko 2b - 3 se multiply karke simplify karenge toh equation aayegi: 2b^2 - 2b - 3 = 0. Vieta's formulas use karke, is quadratic equation ke roots ka product -3/2 hoga. Bas ek cheez note kar lo ki 3/2 valid solution nahi hai b ke liye. So, final product -3/2 hi hai.

instruction: Is instruction ke liye ek input banao: Find the sum of the first ten natural numbers
output: Pehle 10 natural numbers ka sum nikalne ke liye arithmetic series ka formula use kar sakte hain. Formula hai: S = n/2 * (first term + last term), jahan n terms ka number hai. Hamare case mein first term 1 hai, last term 10 hai, aur total terms bhi 10 hain. Formula mein values plug karo toh: S = 10/2 * (1 + 10) = 55. Toh answer 55 hai.

instruction: Agar product 1734 × 5389 × 80,607 ko 10 se divide karein, toh remainder kya aayega?
output: 1734 × 5389 × 80,607 ko 10 se divide karne par remainder nikalne ka simple tarika ye hai: - Humein sirf product ka units digit chahiye. - 1734 × 5389 ka units digit 6 hoga, kyunki 4 × 9 = 36. - Ab is 6 ko 80,607 ke units digit (jo ki 7 hai) se multiply karo: 6 × 7 = 42. - Toh final product ka units digit 2 hai, wahi hamara remainder hai.

instruction: Ek python script likho jo numbers ki list se standard deviation calculate kare. 1, 3, 5
output: Ye lo Python script standard deviation calculate karne ke liye: ```python import math def calculate_std_dev(lst): mean = sum(lst) / len(lst) variance = sum([(x - mean) ** 2 for x in lst]) / len(lst) std_dev = math.sqrt(variance) return std_dev lst = [1, 3, 5] std_dev = calculate_std_dev(lst) print(std_dev) ```

instruction: Product ki cost calculate karo agar original price $125 hai aur discount 15% hai.
output: 15% discount ke baad cost aise aayegi: Original price: $125 Discount: 15% Discount amount = 125 ka 15% = (15 / 100) * 125 = $18.75 Final price = Original price - Discount amount = 125 - 18.75 = $106.25 Toh final cost $106.25 hogi.

instruction: Ek algorithm banao self-driving car ke liye taaki woh road follow kare aur red lights par ruke.
output: Self-driving car ke liye ek basic algorithm aisa ho sakta hai: 1. Cameras, radar aur lidar sensors use karke road ke lane markings, traffic signals aur aas-paas ki vehicles ya obstacles detect karo. 2. Is data ko real-time mein computer vision ar machine learning algorithms se process karo taaki best action decide ho sake. 3. Agar red light dikhe, toh car slow karke stop line ya crosswalk ke peeche poori tarah rok do, aur aage wali cars se safe distance rakho. 4. Ruke hue waqt signal monitor karte raho. Jab light green ho jaye, toh check karo ki koi pedestrian ya vehicle toh cross nahi kar raha, phir smoothly accelerate karke road follow karo. 5. Lane markings ko continuously monitor karo aur steering, throttle aur brake use karke car ki trajectory adjust karte raho taaki car lane ke andar rahe. 6. Agar aage koi obstacle ya hazard dikhe, jaise koi ruki hui gaadi ya road cross karta hua insaan, toh collision avoid karne ke liye slow ho jao ya ruk jao. 7. Destination tak pahunchne tak road follow karo aur traffic signals aur conditions ke hisaab se respond karte raho.

instruction: Healthcare domain mein AI kaise use ho raha hai, uske kam se kam teen examples do.
output: Healthcare mein AI ka role kaafi badh gaya hai aur is field mein bahut saare naye innovations aa rahe hain. Kuch examples ye rahe: 1. Predictive Healthcare: AI-powered predictive analytics tools ab kaafi important ho gaye hain. Inse doctors fast aur accurate diagnosis kar paate hain, high-risk patients ko pehchan sakte hain aur early interventions le sakte hain. For example, algorithms patient data analyze karke bata sakte hain ki kisko diabetes ya heart disease ka risk hai, taaki symptoms aane se pehle hi preventative measures liye ja sakein. 2. Medical Imaging: Radiology scans, MRIs ar X-rays ke analysis ki accuracy aur speed badhane ke liye AI use ho raha hai. Computer vision algorithms tumors ya fractures jaisi abnormalities ko human radiologists se zyada accurately pehchan sakte hain, jisse diagnosis aur treatment jaldi start ho pata hai. 3. Virtual Health Assistants: Chatbots ya voice assistants jaise AI-powered virtual health assistants patients ki help kar rahe hain personalized health info dene mein, questions answer karne mein, aur appointments book karne ya medication reminders dene mein. Ye technology patients aur healthcare providers ke beech ka gap kam karti ha aur access improve karti ha.
