instruction: Python mein ek test suite banao ye check karne ke liye ki input string ek valid email address hai ya nahi.
output: Ye lo Python ka test suite email validation check karne ke liye. ```python import unittest def is_valid_email(email): if "@" in email: username, domain = email.split("@") if "." in domain: # Check if the domain has any special character(except ".") if any(char.isdigit() or char.isalpha() or char == '.' for char in domain): return True return False class TestEmailValidator(unittest.TestCase): def test_valid_emails(self): emails = ["test@example.com", "test.email@domain.uk", "test.email+alex@domain.co.jp"] for email in emails: self.assertTrue(is_valid_email(email)) def test_invalid_emails(self): emails = ["plainaddress", "@missingusername.com", "missingatsign.com"] for email in emails: self.assertFalse(is_valid_email(email)) def test_invalid_domains(self): emails = ["username@.com", "username@.a"] for email in emails: self.assertFalse(is_valid_email(email)) def test_invalid_chars_in_domain(self): emails = ["username@%*.com"] for email in emails: self.assertFalse(is_valid_email(email)) if __name__ == '__main__': unittest.main() ```

instruction: Java mein nested loops use karke ek code likho jo 1 se 10 tak numbers ascending order mein print kare.
output: Ye raha Java code nested loops ke sath 1 se 10 print karne ke liye: ```java for(int i = 1; i <= 10; i++) { for(int j = 1; j <= i; j++) { if(j == i) { System.out.println(i); } } } ``` Isme ek outer loop hai jo 1 se 10 tak chalta ha. Har iteration mein inner loop execute hota he jo `i` times chalta hai. Jab inner loop apni last iteration pe pahunchta hai, toh ye current `i` ki value print kar deta ha. Is tarah 1 se 10 tak numbers ascending order mein print ho jate hain.

instruction: In do lines ka intersecting point nikaalo: x + 3y = 6 2x - 4y = 3
output: Chalo, Substitution method use karke x aur y nikaalte hain: Pehle first equation se x ki value nikaalo: x + 3y = 6 x = 6 - 3y Ab is x ki value ko second equation mein put karo: 2x - 4y = 3 2(6-3y) - 4y = 3 12 - 6y - 4y = 3 12 - 10y = 3 10y = 9 y = 9/10 Ab y ki value ko first equation mein daalo taaki x mil jaye: x + 3y = 6 x + 3(9/10) = 6 x + 27/10 = 6 x = 6 - 27/10 x = 60/10 - 27/10 x = 33/10 Toh intersection point (x, y) = (33/10, 9/10) hai.

instruction: US ke do regions (e.g. Midwest aur Northeast) ke climate ko compare karo.
output: Midwest aur Northeast US ke do diverse areas hain aur dono ka climate alag hai. Midwest mein usually lambi aur thandi winters hoti hain aur summers hot aur humid hote hain. Spring ar fall moderate hote hain, temperatures 60 se 70 degrees Fahrenheit ke beech rehte hain. North areas jaise Minnesota aur Wisconsin mein winters bahut severe hoti hain, temperatures zero se niche chale jaate hain. Wahan snowfall kaafi heavy hoti hai, kuch areas mein yearly average 80 inches se zyada. Iske opposite, southern Midwest zyada temperate hai, jahan winters short aur mild hoti hain or summers lambe aur warm. Northeast ki baat karein toh wahan humid continental climate hai, jahan summers warm aur humid hote hain aur winters thande aur snowy. Coastal regions thode mild hote hain aur wahan precipitation kam hoti hai, par inland areas mein severe winters aur heavy snowfall hoti he. Winters mein temperature zero se niche gir sakta hai aur summers mein 80s aur 90s tak pahunch jata hai. Overall, Northeast mein annual temperature swings zyada hote hain. Summary ye hai ki dono jagah charo seasons hote hain, par geographic or topographic reasons ki wajah se severity aur duration alag hoti hai. Midwest hot humid summers aur long cold winters ke liye jaana jaata hai, jabki Northeast mein temperature differences aur precipitation levels zyada hote hain.

instruction: Ek query likho jisse un customers ko select kiya ja sake jinhone pichle saal total $1,000 se zyada spend kiye hon.
output: Ye SQL query use kar lo, isse last year $1,000 se zyada spend karne wale customers mil jayenge: ```SQL SELECT CustomerId, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSpent FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate BETWEEN DATEADD(year,-1,GETDATE()) AND GETDATE() GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(TotalAmount) > 1000 ``` Is query mein `Orders` table se `CustomerId` or `TotalAmount` ka sum liya gaya hai. `WHERE` clause se results ko filter karke sirf pichle saal ke orders rakhe gaye hain. `GROUP BY` clause results ko `CustomerId` ke basis par group karta ha, aur `HAVING` clause sirf un groups ko dikhata hai jahan total spend 1,000 se zyada hai. Final result mein un customers ki list mil jayegi jinhone pichle saal $1,000 se zyada kharch kiye hain.

instruction: Triangle ke interior angle nikaalo jab uski teen sides 8 cm, 3 cm, aur 7 cm ho.
output: Dekh, jab sides di hui ho toh cosine rule use karle. Kisi bhi triangle ABC ke liye, angle C ka cosine aise nikalta hai: ``` cos(C) = (a^2 + b^2 - c^2) / (2ab) ``` Maan le hume side c = 8 cm ke opposite wala angle C nikaalna hai. Formula mein values put kar: ``` cos(C) = ((3^2 + 7^2 - 8^2) / (2 * 3 * 7)) = (-11 / 42) ``` Ab C ki value nikaalne ke liye dono side inverse cosine lele: ``` C = acos(-11/42) ≈ 108.23 degrees ``` Toh 8 cm wali side ke opposite interior angle approx 108.23 degrees ha.

instruction: Simplify karne ke baad sqrt(3)× 3^1/2 + 12 ÷ 3 × 2 - 4^3/2 ki value kya hogi?
output: Isko hum aise simplify kar sakte hain: sqrt(3) × 3^1/2 + 12 ÷ 3 × 2 - 4^3/2 = 3^1/2 × 3^1/2 + 12 ÷ 3 × 2 - 4^3/2 [Note: sqrt(3) × 3^1/2 = 3^1 = 3] = 3 + 4 × 2 - 8 [Note: 4^3/2 = (2^2)^3/2 = 2^3 = 8] = 3 + 8 - 8 = 3. Toh final simplified value 3 hai.

instruction: x ki value find karo, given ki x nonzero hai aur {x}, ⌊ x ⌋, aur x ek arithmetic sequence form karte hain. (Yahan {x} = x - ⌊ x ⌋ hai.)
output: Humein ye milna chahiye: ⌊ x ⌋ - {x} = x - ⌊ x ⌋, ya phir right side simplify karein toh: ⌊ x ⌋ - {x} = {x}. Iska matlab: ⌊ x ⌋ = 2{x}. Kyunki left side ek integer hai, to 2{x} ko bhi integer hona padega. Humein pata hai ki 0 ≤ {x} < 1, toh ya toh {x} = 0 hoga ya {x} = 1/2. Agar {x} = 0 hai, toh ⌊ x ⌋ = 2 * 0 = 0, matlab x = 0, par question mein diya hai ki x nonzero hai, toh ye possible nahi ha. Isliye {x} = 1/2 hona chahiye, toh ⌊ x ⌋ = 2 * 1/2 = 1, aur x = 1 + 1/2 = 3/2.

instruction: Ek code likho jo diye gaye text ko string ke middle mein insert kare. Given string: "My name is" Text to be inserted: Bob
output: Simple python code hai middle mein text insert karne ke liye. ``` python def insert_text(given_string, text): # Calculate the middle index of the given string middle_index = int(len(given_string) / 2) # Insert the text at the middle index result = given_string[:middle_index] + text + given_string[middle_index:] # Return the result return result # Example usage given_string = "My name is" text = " Bob " print(insert_text(given_string, text)) ``` Output: "My na Bob me is"

instruction: Ek function likho jo do given lists ka intersection find kare. list1 = [1, 2, 3, 4] list2 = [3, 4, 5, 6]
output: Python mein do lists ka intersection nikalne ka ek simple tareeka ye raha: ```python def intersect_lists(list1, list2): # Create a set of the first list set1 = set(list1) # Find the intersection of the set and the second list intersection = set1.intersection(list2) # Return the intersection as a list return list(intersection) # Test the function with the given inputs list1 = [1, 2, 3, 4] list2 = [3, 4, 5, 6] result = intersect_lists(list1, list2) print(f"The intersection of {list1} and {list2} is: {result}") ``` Is function mein pehle humne first list ko set mein convert kiya aur phir `.intersection()` method use karke common elements nikal liye. Last mein result ko wapas list bana kar return kar diya. Diye huye inputs ke saath test karoge toh [3, 4] aayega.

instruction: Teen colors ki list sort karne ke liye ek algorithm generate karo. colors = ['white', 'red', 'blue']
output: Teen colors ki list sort karne ke liye hum bubble sort jaisa simple algorithm use kar sakte hain. Python mein example dekho: ```python colors = ['white', 'red', 'blue'] # Define a custom order for the colors color_order = {'red':0, 'white':1, 'blue':2} n = len(colors) for i in range(n): for j in range(0, n-i-1): if color_order[colors[j]] > color_order[colors[j+1]]: colors[j], colors[j+1] = colors[j+1], colors[j] print("sorted colors: ", colors) ``` Yahan humne pehle ek dictionary banayi taaki colors ka ek custom order set kar sakein. Maine red, white, aur blue ka order rakha hai, par tum isse change kar sakte ho. Phir bubble sort use karke adjacent elements ko compare kiya aur custom order ke hisaab se swap kar diya. Result mein sorted list mil jayegi. Output: `sorted colors: ['red', 'white', 'blue']`

instruction: Reader ko convince karo ki ye particular topic kyun important hai. Neend (sleep) ko prioritize karna kyun zaroori hai?
output: Dekho, sleep hamari life ka ek bahut bada part hai, par log isko aksar ignore kar dete hain. Sleep prioritize karna kyun zaroori aahe, uske kuch reasons ye rahe: 1. Agar neend poori nahi hui toh irritability, anxiety ar depression ho sakta hai. Zyada time tak sleep deprivation raha to thinking, concentration aur judgment sab kharab ho jayega. 3. Immune system: Sleep immune system ko strong banati hai taaki infections aur illnesses se lada ja sake. Neend nahi hogi toh body diseases se nhiii lad payegi aur hum jaldi beemar padenge. Conclusion ye hai ki physical, mental aur emotional well-being ke liye sleep bahut vital hai, jisse hum ek healthy aur happy life jee sakte hain. Acchi neend mein invest karna matlab apni overall quality of life behtar karna hai.

def next_generator(self):
		for item in self.data:

			match_instruction = re.search(self.pattern_instruction, item['instruction'])

output: # next_generator function, self parameter ke saath def next_generator(self): # data list pe iterate karo ar prev item save karo for item in self.data: self.save_prev_item() # instruction, input, output fields mein match search karo match_instruction = re.search(self.pattern_instruction, item['instruction']) match_input = re.search(self.pattern_input, item['input']) match_output = re.search(self.pattern_output, item['output']) # agar match mila to values modify karke fill karo if match_instruction or match_input or match_output: new_instruction = item['instruction'] new_input = item['input'] old_output = item['output'] modified_output = self.modify_output(match_output, item) self.fill_values(new_instruction, new_input, old_output, modified_output) self.prev_item = item # modified values yield karo yield self.instruction, self.input, self.old_output, self.modified_output # matches khatam hone par fill_values call karo self.save_prev_item() self.fill_values(instruction='End of matches reached.') # infinite loop with yield while True: yield self.instruction, self.input, self.old_output, self.

instruction: Samjhaao ki kuch data operations ke liye non-relational database relational se better kyun hota hai.
output: Dekho, relational database structured data pe chalta hai aur iska schema kafi rigid hota hai—fixed tables, rows aur columns. But non-relational database unstructured ya semi-structured data store kar sakta aahe, toh iska organization kafi flexible hota hai. Main reason ye he ki jab bahut saara unstructured data handle karna ho, jaise social media feeds, customer chats ya IoT devices ka data, toh relational database fail ho jata hai. Non-relational databases isse better handle karte hain kyunki inke paas document-based, key-value, column-family ya graph models hote hain. Dusra point hai horizontal scaling. Non-relational databases mein data ko easily multiple servers pe distribute kiya ja sakta ha, jis se access aur retrieval fast ho jata ah. Itna load relational database handle nah kar paate. Lastly, agar data access patterns unpredictable hain, toh non-relational zyada efficient hota hai. For example, agar kisi specific key-value pair pe bahut saare read/write operations ho rahe hain, toh non-relational database uske liye optimize ho sakta hai. Basically, agar unstructured data hai, distributed environment chahiye, ya fast-evolving patterns hain, toh non-relational hi best hai.

instruction: f(x) = { x-2 if x < 4, sqrt(x) if x ≥ 4 }. Iska inverse f^-1 hai. f^-1(-5) + f^-1(-4) + … + f^-1(4) + f^-1(5) ki value nikaalo.
output: Pehle f(x) ke dono parts ki range check karte hain. Maan lo g(x) = x-2 (x < 4 ke liye) aur h(x) = sqrt(x) (x ≥ 4 ke liye). x < 4 hai to x-2 < 2 hoga, matlab g ki range (-∞, -2) hai. x ≥ 4 hai ta sqrt(x) ≥ 2 hoga, toh h ki range [2, ∞) he. Ab g ka inverse g^-1(x) = x+2 hai, aur h ka inverse h^-1(x) = x^2 hai. Toh f^-1(x) nikaalne ke liye, agar x < 2 hai ta g^-1 use karo, aur agar x ≥ 2 hai toh h^-1: f^-1(-5) + f^-1(-4) + … + f^-1(4) + f^-1(5) = (g^-1(-5) + … + g^-1(1)) + (h^-1(2) + … + h^-1(5)) = ((-3) + (-2) + … + 3) + (4 + 9 + 16 + 25) = 0 + 54 = 54. Toh final answer 54 ha.

instruction: Ek triangle ki sides log_10(12), log_10(75), aur log_10(n) hain (n ek positive integer hai). n ki kitni possible values ho sakti hain?
output: Hume positive integer n ki possible values find karni hain, jahan sides log_10(12), log_10(75), aur log_10(n) hain. Triangle inequality rule ke hisaab se, triangle tabhi banega jab ye teen inequalities true honge: 1. log_10 75 + log_10 n > log_10 12 2. log_10 12 + log_10 75 > log_10 n 3. log_10 12 + log_10 n > log_10 75 Pehli wali toh hamesha true hogi kyunki log_10(75) already log_10(12) se bada hai aur log_10(n) positive hai. Second inequality se milta hai log_10(12 * 75) > log_10(n), yaani 900 > n. Third inequality se milta hai log_10(12n) > log_10(75), yaani 12n > 75, jiska matlab ah n > 75/12 = 6.25. Toh n ki possible values 7, 8, 9, …, 899 tak hain. Total values hongi 899 - 7 + 1 = 893.

instruction: LMS aur CMS ke beech ka difference compare karke batao.
output: LMS (Learning Management System) aur CMS (Course Management System) dono educational software platforms hain jo online courses manage karne ke liye use hote hain. Log aksar in terms ko ek hi samajhte hain, par inme kuch basic differences hain. LMS ek aisa software application hai jo educational courses, training programs ya learning and development programs ki administration, documentation, tracking aur delivery ke liye ek framework provide karta hai. Iska main goal learning process ko manage karna hota hai taaki students ko content, assessments aur resources akk organized tareeke se mil sakein. Doosri taraf, CMS ek LMS ka hi subset hai jo primarily course creation aur delivery process pe focus karta hai. CMS instructors ko tools deta ha jisse wo course materials, assignments aur assessments design aur develop kar sakein. Isme messaging boards, chat rooms aur forums jaise features hote hain jo instructors aur students ke beech communication asaan banate hain. Ek bada difference ye ha ki instructors ka control content aur presentation pe kitna ah. CMS mein instructors ko course design aur customize karne ki zyada flexibility milti he, jabki LMS generally ek standardized format follow karta hai. In short, dono hi online courses ke liye hain, par CMS ka focus content creation pe hota hai, jabki LMS overall learning process ki administration, tracking aur reporting ke liye wide range of functionality deta hai.

instruction: Ek example do security test scenario ka jo company ko system security ke liye karna chahiye.
output: Test Scenario: Password Strength and Encryption Description: Is test scenario ka goal system ki security check karna ah by verifying password strength requirements aur encryption methods jo user data secure karne ke liye use hote hain. Steps: 1. Check karo ki system mein password strength requirements hain ya naahi, jaise minimum length, complexity rules (uppercase, lowercase, numbers aur symbols ka mix), aur ye ki common passwords restricted hon. 2. Weak ya common passwords use karke account banane ki koshish karo taaki pata chale ki system unhe reject karta ah ya nhiii. 3. Check karo ki brute force attacks rokne ke liye system account lock karta hai ya login attempts limit karta hai jab kai baar login fail ho jaye. 4. Database mein passwords kaise store ho rahe hain wo inspect karo taaki confirm ho sake ki wo hashed aur salted hain. 5. Penetration testing karo taaki encryption method ki effectiveness verify ho sake aur koi overlooked vulnerability na reh jaye. Expected Result: System ko strict password requirements enforce karni chahiye, weak passwords reject karne chahiye, login attempts limit karne chahiye, ar hashing aur salting jaise encryption methods use karke passwords securely store karne chahiye.

instruction: Binary search algorithm implement karo. arr: [1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 15], x: 8
output: Python implementation ye raha. Isse check kar sakte ho ki element `x` list `arr` mein hai ya nahi: ```python def binary_search(arr, x): low = 0 high = len(arr) - 1 mid = 0 while low <= high: mid = (high + low) // 2 # Check if x is present at mid if arr[mid] < x: low = mid + 1 # If x is greater, ignore left half elif arr[mid] > x: high = mid - 1 # If x is smaller, ignore right half else: return mid # If we reach here, then the element was not present in the list return -1 arr = [1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 15] x = 8 result = binary_search(arr, x) if result != -1: print(f"Element is present at index {result}") else: print("Element is not present in the list") ``` Result: `Element is present at index 4` kyunki element `8` index `4` par aahe.

instruction: Is proposition ke liye arguments for aur against generate karo. Government ko sabko ek basic income provide karni chahiye.

Inflation badh sakta hai: Economy mein cash ka flow badhne se demand badhegi, jis se prices upar ja sakte hain. 4. Implementation mushkil hai: National level pe iske logistics complex honge aur kai stakeholders iska opposition kar sakte hain. 5. Taxpayers ke liye unfair hai: Kuch logo ka kehna hai ki hard-working taxpayers ke liye ye unfair hoga kyunki program fund karne ke liye unpe taxes badhane padenge.

instruction: Is text ko ek web article format mein convert karo. Biologists duniya bhar mein life ke different forms ke baare mein aur zyada discover kar rahe hain. Chote single-celled organisms se lekar whales jaise bade animals tak, sab web of life se connected hain.
output:
`

Discovering the Many Ways Life Exists

Biologists lagatar naye discoveries kar rahe hain ki hamari planet pe life kitni diverse hai. Sabse chote creatures, jaise single-celled organisms, se lekar sabse bade animals, jaise whales tak, ye web of life bahut bada aur interconnected hai.

instruction: Maan lo task finish karne ke liye sirf 10 minutes bache hain. Tum apne remaining tasks ko kaise prioritize karoge?

instruction: Agar 1/x + 1/y = 3 aur 1/x - 1/y = -7 hai, toh x + y ki value kya hogi? Answer ko common fraction mein batana.
output: Dekh, pehle algebraic manipulation se x aur y nikalte hain. Dono equations ko add karne par: 1/x + 1/y = 3 1/x - 1/y = -7 ------------- 2/x = -4 Ab dono sides ko 2 se divide kar do, toh milega: 1/x = -2 Waise hi, pehli equation se doosri subtract karne par: 2/y = 10 Isse divide karne par: 1/y = 5 Toh x = -1/2 aur y = 1/5 ho gaya. Ab final sum nikalte hain: x + y = (-1/2) + (1/5) = (-5 + 2)/10 = -3/10 Toh x + y ki value -3/10 hai.

instruction: Is statement ko ethics ke point of view se analyze karo: 'Everyone should be free to do whatever they want.'
output: Ye statement 'Everyone should be free to do whatever they want' basically individual freedom ke concept pe based hai, jo ki ek important ethical value hai. Par isme kaafi saare ethical sawal aur concerns bhi hain. Sabse pehle toh, individual freedom zaroori hai, par ise doosron ke rights aur freedom ke saath balance karna padta hai. Agar har koi bina kisi limit ke jo chahe wo karne laga, toh doosron ko nuksan pahunch sakta hai. For example, agar koi kisi ko harm karna chahe aur wo free ho aisa karne ke liye, toh ye saamne wale ke safety ke right ko khatam kar dega. Phir ye baat bhi hai ki kuch actions, bhale hi wo kisi ko direct nuksan na pahunchayein, phir bhi unethical ho sakte hain. Jaise fraud ya deception; shayad isse direct physical harm na ho, par morally ye galat hi mana jayega. Iske alawa, ye soch 'ethical egoism' jaisi lagti hai, jahan banda sirf apne self-interest ke liye act karta hai. Ye ek perspective ho sakta hai, par critics kehte hain ki ye society ki needs ko ignore karta hai aur results negative ho sakte hain. Conclusion ye hai ki individual freedom ka ideal toh sahi hai, par ise doosron ke rights aur moral correctness ke saath balance karna zaroori hai.

instruction: Is code block ko optimize karne ke tareeke batao. for(int i=0;i<=n;i++){ if(i%2==0){ System.out.println(i); } }
output: Is code ko optimize karne ke kuch tareeke hain: 1. i++ ki jagah i += 2 use kar. Kyunki tujhe sirf even values chahiye, toh if statement ki zaroorat hi nahi padegi aur code fast chalega: ``` for(int i = 0; i <= n; i += 2){ System.out.println(i); } ``` 2. Buffer size preallocate kar le. Agar integers ka max size pata hai, toh memory allocation ka time bachega. Saath hi, System.out.println ki jagah StringBuilder use kar, wo string manipulations ke liye zyada efficient hai: ``` StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(n); for(int i = 0; i <= n; i += 2) { sb.append(i); sb.append("\n"); } System.out.println(sb.toString()); ```

instruction: Ek python program likho jo text se saare emails extract kare. Text: This is a text. sender@example.com

Example text 'This is a text. sender@example.com' pe run karoge toh `['sender@example.com']` aayega. Bas dhyaan rakhna ki ye basic use cases ke liye sahi hai, par shayad har ek possible email format cover na kare.

instruction: Instructions padho aur unhe poora karne ke liye ek algorithm banao.
input: Given an array of integers, create a function to find the maximum value in the array.
output: Array mein max value nikaalne ka algorithm ye raha: 1. Ek function define karo jo input mein integers ka array le. 2. Ek `max` variable banao aur usme array ka pehla element daal do. 3. Second element se loop shuru karo. 4. Har element ko current `max` value se compare karo. 5. Agar current element `max` se bada ah, ta `max` ko update kar do. 6. Ye tab tak karo jab tak saare elements check na ho jayein. 7. Last mein `max` value return kar do. Python mein iska code aisa hoga: ```python def find_max(arr): max = arr[0] for i in range(1, len(arr)): if arr[i] > max: max = arr[i] return max ```

instruction: Batao in sorting algorithms mein se kaunsa is data set ke liye best rahega Data set -> [67, 32, 53, 88, 88, 88, 24, 48]
output: Is particular data set mein sirf 8 elements hain, toh koi bhi sorting algorithm easily sort kar dega. But agar choose karna hi hai, toh do options hain: - **Insertion Sort**: Small data sets aur mostly sorted data ke liye sahi hai. Average aur worst-case time complexity O(n^2) hai, par best case scenario mein iski time complexity O(n) ho jati he. - **Quick Sort**: Agar data set na zyada bada ho na zyada chota (yahan 8 elements hain, toh medium-sized maan lo), toh quick sort kafi efficient hai kyunki iski average time complexity O(n log n) hai. Toh, agar optimal average time complexity chahiye to Quick Sort use karo, aur agar data almost sorted hai to Insertion Sort.

instruction: Agar 2, 6, 10, ..., x, y, 26 ek arithmetic sequence hai, toh x + y ki value kya hogi?
output: Dekho, x + y nikalne ke liye pehle common difference dekhna padega. 2 + 4 = 6, 6 + 4 = 10... toh common difference 4 hai. Ab peeche se calculate karte hain: y, 26 se 4 kam hoga (kyunki wo last term hai), toh y = 22. Waise hi, x, 26 se 8 kam hoga kyunki do terms missing hain, toh x = 18. Last mein bas dono ko add kar do: x + y = 18 + 22 = 40.

instruction: As n ranges over positive integers, 11n+3 aur 6n+1 ke greatest common divisor ki maximum possible value kya hogi?
output: Max GCD tab aayega jab n-1, 7 ka multiple ho. Euclidean Algorithm use karke pata chalta hai ki GCD 7 hoga jab (11n+3, 6n+1) = (n-1, 7). Warna GCD 1 hi rahega. So, max value 7 hai.

instruction: JavaScript use karke ek function banao jo current time 'HH:MM' format mein print kare.
output: Ye le JavaScript function current time 'HH:MM' format mein print karne ke liye: ``` function printCurrentTime() { let currentTime = new Date(); let hours = currentTime.getHours(); let minutes = currentTime.getMinutes(); if(hours < 10) { hours = '0' + hours; // Padding the hours with zero, if less than 10 } if(minutes < 10) { minutes = '0' + minutes; // Padding the minutes with zero, if less than 10 } console.log(hours + ':' + minutes); } printCurrentTime(); // Example function Call ``` Is function mein pehle `Date` object banaya hai current time lene ke liye. Phir `getHours` aur `getMinutes` use karke hours aur minutes nikaale hain. Agar hours ya minutes 10 se kam hain, ta formatting ke liye aage ek zero add kar diya hai. Finally, formatted time console pe log kar diya.

instruction: Homepage pe product images ka size badhane ke liye ek A/B test plan banao.
output: Homepage pe images badi karne se user engagement ya conversion rates badhenge ya nahi, ye check karne ke liye A/B testing sahi rahegi. Ye raha ek basic plan: 1. **Objective:** Main goal ye dekhna hai ki images badi karne se click-through rate, time on site aur conversion rate pe kya asar padta hai. 2. **Hypothesis:** Hume lagta hai ki badi images zyada eye-catching hongi, toh users zyada click karenge aur engagement badhegi, jisse conversion rates upar jayenge. 3. **Test Groups:** Visitors ko do groups mein randomly divide karenge: - Group A (Control Group): Inhe purane size wali images dikhengi. - Group B (Test Group): Inhe badi images dikhengi. 4. **Duration:** Test kam se kam do hafte chalayenge taaki statistical significance ke liye kaafi sample size mil jaye. Is beech dono groups ki performance monitor karenge. 5. **Measurements:** Click-through rate, time on site, conversion rate, bounce rate aur average order value check karenge. Isse pata chalega ki image size badhane se fayda hua ya nahi. 6. **Data analysis:** Test khatam hone ke baad data analyze karenge. Agar Group B ki performance significantly better rahi, toh is change ko permanently implement kar denge. 7. **Conclusion:** Data dekh kar decide karenge ki change rakhna hai ya purana size hi rehne dena hai. Findings ko document karke stakeholders ke saath share karenge.

instruction: Naye breakfast cereal "Sunny Crunch" ko bechne ke liye marketing strategy banao.
output: Sunny Crunch bechne ke liye ye strategies try karo: 1. Target audience pehchano: Sabse pehle dekho ki ise kaun khareedega—bachon wali families, busy working adults, ya health-conscious log? Audience set ho gayi toh baaki marketing easy ho jayegi. 2. Social media use karo: FB, Insta aur Twitter pe engage karo. Packaging aur recipe ideas ki mast photos/videos dalo. Giveaways aur contests rakho taaki log user-generated content share karein. Influencers ko bhi pakdo. 3. Product placement: Grocery stores mein sahi jagah rakho. Eye-level shelves pe ya checkout ke paas high-traffic areas mein "Sunny Crunch" hona chahiye. Stores ke saath milke exclusive discounts bhi de sakte ho. 4. Packaging pe dhyan do: Aisi packaging banao jo shelf pe alag dikhe aur health benefits highlight kare. Bright colors aur bold text use karo. 5. Sampling: In-store sampling rakho taaki log khareedne se pehle taste kar sakein. Gyms, offices ya schools mein bhi samples baanto. 6. Advertising: Online aur offline dono pe kharch karo—targeted digital ads, billboards, print media aur TV commercials. Catchy slogans aur bright imagery use karo. 7. Partnerships: Un brands ya influencers ke saath collaborate karo jiniki audience match karti ho. Recipe bloggers ya nutritionists ko involve karo. 8. Feedback or loyalty: Customers se feedback lo aur product improve karo. Repeat customers ke liye loyalty program ya special promos rakho. Basically, targeted ads, social media, strategic placement aur collaborations ka mix use karke Sunny Crunch ko hit kar sakte ho.

instruction: Niche diye gaye input ko use karke military ki importance pe ek essay likho. Military forces hazaaron saalon se human societies ka hissa rahe hain. Ye citizens ko external threats se bachane se lekar internal unrest ke time pe order maintain karne tak kai kaam karte hain.
output: Kisi bhi desh ke liye military 1 bahut zaroori institution hai, iski importance ko ignore nahi kiya ja sakta. Saalon se military ne society ki safety aur stability maintain karne mein bada role play kiya hai. Inka impact sirf borders tak nahi hai, balki global peace mein bhi inka contribution clear dikhta hai. Military ka primary kaam citizens ko external threats se bachana hota hai. Deshon ko hamesha padosi countries ya door ke nations se khatra rehta aahe. Military ka kaam hi hota hai country ki territorial integrity ko protect karna. Iske liye wo diplomacy, peacekeeping missions ya direct combat ka sahara lete hain. Isme kai baar jaan ka risk hota hai, lekin military ye bojh uthati hai taaki hum sab safe rahein. Internal unrest ke time pe bhi military order maintain karne mein help karti hai. Civil strife jaisi situations mein law and order restore karne ke liye military ko bulaya jata hai taaki log aur unki property safe rahe. Terrorist organizations aur non-state actors wale regions mein military ne in threats ko khatam karne mein bahut crucial role nibhaya hai. Disaster response mein bhi military ka bada haath hota he. Hurricane ya earthquake jaise natural disasters ho, ya oil spills jaise man-made accidents, military sabse pehle pahunchti hai. Unki training, discipline aur heavy machinery access ki wajah se wo aisi situations ko jaldi aur effectively handle kar lete hain. Conclusion ye hai ki society ki safety aur stability ke liye military bahut zaroori hai. Chahe khatra bahar se ho ya andar se, wo humein protect karte hain. Unka discipline aur duty ke prati commitment unhe kisi bhi nation ka ek vital asset banata hai.

instruction: Ek aisa data structure describe karo jise user ki medical condition ki information store karne ke liye use kiya ja sake.
output: User ki medical condition store karne ke liye hum ek object ya dictionary use kar sakte hain, jo ek patient health record ki tarah kaam karega. Isme key-value pairs honge jo user ka name, age, gender aur medical conditions store karenge. Ek key "medical_conditions" hogi, jiski value ek list ya array hogi. Is list ke har element mein ek aur object ya dictionary ho sakti hai, jisme specific condition ki details hongi—jaise diagnosis date, symptoms, treatment plans, medications aur physician ke notes. Ek example dekho: { "name": "Jane Doe", "age": 45, "gender": "Female", "medical_conditions": [ { "condition": "Diabetes", "diagnosis_date": "05/03/2015", "symptoms": ["frequent urination", "increased thirst", "fatigue"], "treatment": { "medication": ["metformin"], "insulin": true, "diet": "low-carb diet", "exercise": "regular exercise" }, "physician_notes": "Patient has well-managed diabetes with regular checkups and medication." }, { "condition": "Hypertension", "diagnosis_date": "01/15/2018", "symptoms": ["high blood pressure", "headaches", "dizziness"], "treatment": { "medication":["lisinopril"], "lifestyle_changes":["low-sodium diet", "regular exercise"], }, "physician_notes": "Patient needs to monitor blood pressure regularly and continue with medication and lifestyle changes." } ] } Is tarah ke data structure se medical conditions ko add, delete ya update karna easy ho jata he aur patient ki health history ka 1 comprehensive view milta hai.

instruction: Niche diye gaye input ko use karke suspicious online activities detect karne ka ek algorithm develop karo. Online platforms ko aksar fraud, scams aur abusive behavior jaisi malicious activities face karni padti hain.
output: 1. Pehle define karo ki "suspicious activity" kyaa hai platform ki guidelines aur user history ke basis pe. Jaise ki ek hi IP se multiple accounts banana, baar-baar login fail hona, ya transactions ka ajeeb pattern. 2. User activity aur data monitor karo. Predefined rules aur machine learning algorithms run karke deviant behavior ya anomalies pehchano jo suspicious lag rahe hon. 3. Ek fraud detection system implement karo jo AI aur ML use karke real-time mein user behavior aur data analyze kare. 4. Data analytics use karo taaki different data points—jaise account creation time, login frequency aur transaction history—ke beech correlations aur patterns nikal sakein. 5. Naye users ko verify karne ka system banao. Personal ID ya koi aur verification method mango taaki account abuse na ho. 6. System ko regularly update karo aur ML algorithms ko train karte raho taaki accuracy badhe aur false positives kam hon. 7. Agar koi suspicious activity milti hai, toh system us account ya transaction ko flag kar de aur platform ki security team ko notify kare taaki investigation ho sake.

instruction: Python mein ek function banao jo do positive integers le aur unke cubes ka sum return kare.
output: Ye lo function: ```python def sum_of_cubes(a: int, b: int) -> int: return a ** 3 + b ** 3 ``` Bas `a` aur `b` input lo, `**` operator se cubes nikalo aur add kar do. Simple hai. Example: ```python print(sum_of_cubes(2, 3)) ``` Output `35` aayega, kyunki 2^3 + 3^3 = 8 + 27 = 35.

instruction: Batao ki is paper mein kaunse sources use hue hain: Abstract: Fine-tuning continuous prompts for target tasks has recently emerged as a compact alternative to full model fine-tuning. Motivated by these promising results, we investigate the feasibility of extracting a discrete (textual) interpretation of continuous prompts that is faithful to the problem they solve. In practice, we observe a "wayward" behavior between the task solved by continuous prompts and their nearest neighbor discrete projections: We can find continuous prompts that solve a task while being projected to an arbitrary text (e.g., definition of a different or even a contradictory task), while being within a very small (2%) margin of the best continuous prompt of the same size for the task. We provide intuitions behind this odd and surprising behavior, as well as extensive empirical analyses quantifying the effect of various parameters. For instance, for larger model sizes we observe higher waywardness, i.e, we can find prompts that more closely map to any arbitrary text with a smaller drop in accuracy. These findings have important implications relating to the difficulty of faithfully interpreting continuous prompts and their generalization across models and tasks, providing guidance for future progress in prompting language models.
output: Sorry, bina paper ke references dekhe main ye nahi bata sakta ki kaunse sources use hue hain. Kya tum mujhe full text ya sources wali list bhej sakte ho? Tabhi main properly cite kar paunga.

instruction: Maan lo $2^x$ 144 ka greatest power of 2 factor hai, aur $3^y$ 144 ka greatest power of 3 factor hai. Is expression ko solve karo: $(1/5)^y - x$
output: Kyunki 144 ko $2^4 \times 3^2$ likha ja sakta hai, toh hum keh sakte hain ki 144 ka greatest power of 2 factor $2^4$ hai, aur greatest power of 3 factor $3^2$ hai. Toh x = 4 aur y = 2 ho gaya. In values ko expression mein daalo toh: $(1/5)^y - x = (1/5)^2 - 4$ Simplify karenge toh: $(1/5)^2 - 4 = (1/25) \times (1 - 500)$ $= (1/25) \times (-499)$ $= -199/25$ Toh final answer -199/25 hai.

instruction: Har positive integer n ke liye, n! ka matlab 1* 2* 3* ⋯ * (n-1)* n hai. Batao ki jab 9! ko 11 se divide karenge toh remainder kya aayega?
output: 9! ko 11 se divide karne pe remainder nikalne ke liye ye steps follow karo: - Pehle 1 * 2 * 3 * 4 * 5 * 6 * 7 * 8 * 9 ka product compute karo - Factors ko aise pairs mein group karo jinka multiply 11 ke close ho (jaise 2 and 6, 3 and 4, etc.) - Har pair product ko residue mod 11 se replace karo (jaise 2 * 6 ≡ 1 mod 11, 3 * 4 ≡ 5 mod 11, etc.) - Saare residues ko multiply karke final residue mod 11 nikaal lo. Is case mein final residue 1 hai, toh 9! ko 11 se divide karne pe remainder 1 aayega.

instruction: Natural Language Processing mein use hone waale kam se kam paanch computer algorithms ki list banao.
output: 1. Hidden Markov Models (HMMs): Iska use part-of-speech tagging ke liye hota he, jahan algorithm predict karta hai ki context ke hisaab se kisi word ke specific part of speech hone ki probability kya ha. 2. Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA): Ye topic modeling ke liye use hota hai. Isme algorithm documents ke collection mein se latent topics pehchanta hai aur har word ko ek topic assign karta hai. 3. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM): Iska use language generation aur text classification mein hota hai, jahan algorithm pichle words ke context ke basis par next word predict karta hai. 4. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs): Ye language translation aur speech recognition ke liye use hote hain. Algorithm input sequence ko ek-ek karke process karta hai aur internal state memory use karke purana context yaad rakhta hai. 5. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs): Sentiment analysis or text classification ke liye use hote hain, jahan algorithm local features par filters apply karta hai aur elements ke beech spatial relationships capture karta hai.

output: Is data processing task ke liye ek possible system architecture ye ho sakta hai: 1. **Document Reception Module:** Is module ka kaam text documents ko receive, verify aur parse karna hai. Users interface ke through upload kar sakte hain ya kisi storage location se data liya ja sakta hai. Format aur size verify hone ke baad documents processing ke liye bhej diye jaate hain. 2. **Text Processing Module:** Yahan NLP techniques use karke text ko process kiya jaata hai, sentences mein split kiya jaata hai aur grammar or syntax analyze hota ah. Text-to-speech (TTS) process se pehle context samajhne ke liye ek language model ka use hoga. 3. **Text-to-Speech Module:** Ye module TTS engine use karke processed text ko audio mein convert karta hai. Deep learning techniques ki madad se realistic speech generate ki ja sakti hai. Isse input text ke hisaab se different voices ya languages configure ki ja sakti hain. 4. **Audio File Generation Module:** Ye module specified format (jaise MP3 ya WAV) mein audio file generate karta hai. File ka metadata, jaise document name or baaki details, yahan set ki jaati hain. 5. **Storage Module:** Generated audio files ko storage module mein move kiya jayega, jo local ya cloud-based ho sakta hai. Storage space itna hona chahiye ki saari files easily fit ho jayein. 6. **Delivery Module:** Ye module ensure karta ha ki audio files requesting user tak pahunche ya intended location par store ho jayein. Delivery download, email, ya automatic server upload ke form mein ho sakti ah. Saare modules ek central processing unit se connected hote hain jo data flow aur overall workflow ko manage karta hai. Agar documents ka volume zyada hai, toh processing power badha kar system ko scale kiya ja sakta hai. Saath hi, performance aur errors track karne ke liye monitoring aur logging system bhi lagaya ja sakta hai.

instruction: Taxi se 50 miles travel karne ke baad, Ann ko $120 fare charge kiya gaya. Agar taxi fare distance ke directly proportional hai, toh agar Ann 70 miles travel karti toh use kitna charge (in dollars) karna padta?

instruction: Is document mein space program ki history ke baare mein info nikaalo. NASA's History
output: NASA, yaani The National Aeronautics and Space Administration, 1958 mein US government ne banaya tha, jab Soviet Union ne pehla artificial satellite Sputnik launch kiya tha. NASA ka main kaam US space exploration, aeronautics ar space science activities ko coordinate aur oversee karna tha. NASA ki shuruati badi achievements mein se ek Project Mercury tha, jo 1959 mein launch hua tha. Iska goal ek astronaut ko Earth's orbit mein bhejna tha, aur ye 1962 mein pura hua jab astronaut John Glenn pehle American bane jisne Earth ka orbit kiya. 1961 mein, President John F. Kennedy ne announce kiya ki decade ke end tak ek insaan ko Moon par bhejkar safely wapas lana hai. Is wajah se Apollo Program develop hua, jisne 1969 mein ye goal achieve kiya jab astronauts Neil Armstrong aur Buzz Aldrin pehle insaan bane jo Moon par chale. Apollo program ke baad, NASA ne Space Shuttle program par focus kiya jo 1981 mein shuru hua. Space Shuttle ki wajah se crew ar cargo ko low Earth orbit tak reusable tareeke se le jaya ja sakta tha, aur isi se International Space Station (ISS) bhi banaya gaya. NASA kai unmanned space missions mein bhi involved raha hai, jaise Voyager aur Pioneer programs, jinhone outer planets aur uske aage explore kiya, aur Mars Exploration Rover missions, jo 2004 se Mars ki surface explore kar rahe hain. Filhaal, NASA future human missions to Mars aur Artemis program ki planning kar raha hai, jiska aim 2024 tak humans ko wapas Moon par bhejna hai.

instruction: Batao is activity mein success ki probability kya hogi. You toss a fair coin three times.
output: Dekho, agar success ka matlab ye hai ki kisi bhi coin toss mein head aaye, toh success ki probability wahi hogi jo teen tosses mein kam se kam 1 head aane ki hoti hai. Is problem ko solve karne ka sabse easy tareeka ye aahe ki pehle probability nikaalo ki ek bhi head na aaye, ar phir us value ko 1 se subtract kar do. Ek single toss mein head na aane ki probability 1/2 hoti hai (yaani tail aane ki probability), toh teenon tosses mein head na aane ki probability hogi (1/2) x (1/2) x (1/2) = 1/8. Iska matlab, teen coin tosses mein kam se kam ek head aane ki probability 1 - 1/8 = 7/8 ya 87.5% aahe.

instruction: Is statement par ek essay likho. The importance of music education in our lives.
output: Music undoubtedly human expression ka sabse bada zariya hai jo sadiyon se chala aa raha hai. Ye lagbhag har kisi ki life ka ek important part hai, aur iska reason bhi valid hai. Ye stress relief ke liye best hai, mood thik karta hai aur self-expression ka ek badhiya tareeka hai. Apni universal language ki wajah se, music alag-alag cultures aur backgrounds ke logo ko jod sakta hai, jiska overall well-being par positive impact padta hai. Iski importance bahut zyada hai, khaas karke education mein. Music education young minds ko shape karne aur unhe apni creativity unique tareeke se express karne mein help karti hai. Schools mein music education hona bahut zaroori hai taaki bacho ko ek well-rounded education mile. Jab bache bachpan se hi music ke contact mein rehte hain, toh unhe apne aas-paas ki duniya ki behtar samajh milti hai. Ye prove ho chuka hai ki jo bache early age mein music seekhte hain, unki cognitive skills—jaise memory, attention span aur language abilities—kafi improve hoti hain. Aisa isliye hota hai kyunki music brain ke different areas ko stimulate karta hai, jisse critical thinking, creativity aur problem-solving abilities develop hoti hain. Koi instrument bajana ya gaana seekhna bacho ke confidence ke liye bhi bahut accha hota hai. Music education unhe ek safe space deta hai jahan wo apne talent ko explore kar sakein ar creatively express kar sakein, jisse unki self-esteem aur self-worth badhti hai. Audience ke samne perform karna thoda scary ho sakta hai, par music education bacho ko risks lena aur apne darr par jeetna sikhati hai, jis se confidence badhta hai. Iske alawa, music education bacho ko discipline aur hard work ki importance bhi sikhati hai. Koi instrument seekhna koi aasaan kaam nahi hai aur isme dedication aur practice lagti hai. Jab bache instrument seekhte hain, toh wo life skills jaise perseverance, time management aur responsibility bhi seekh jate hain. Music education ka bacho ki social life par bhi positive asar padta hai. Jab bache music ensembles mein participate karte hain, toh wo seekhte hain ki ek common goal achieve karne ke liye dusron ke saath kaise kaam kiya jata hai, jisse teamwork aur cooperation badhta hai. Isse unki social skills improve hoti hain aur wo dusron ke saath healthy relationships banane mein capable bante hain. Conclusion mein yahi kahunga ki young minds ko shape karne aur future mein succeed hone ke liye zaroori life skills dene mein music education ka bahut bada role hai. instruction: Essays mein plagiarism detect karne ke liye ek machine learning program likho. Essay Text: An essay is a piece of writing that conveys the writer's opinion on a subject. It consists of a combination of facts and thoughts on the topic at hand.
output: Academic aur professional writing mein plagiarism ek bada issue ha. Isse detect karne ke liye hum ML techniques use kar sakte hain, jisme submitted essay ko ek bade database aur published sources se compare kiya jata he. Ek example program aisa ho sakta hai: 1. **Preprocessing**: Pehle text ko saaf karo, punctuation aur stop words hatao, aur sab lowercase kar do taaki features extract karna easy ho. 2. **Feature Extraction**: Phir relevant features nikalo. TF-IDF vectors use kar sakte hain jo batate hain ki words kitne important hain relative to a larger corpus. Ek aur feature hai cosine similarity, jo TF-IDF vectors ke angle se similarity check karta ha. 3. **Model Training**: Ab akk dataset lo jisme plagiarized aur non-plagiarized essays hon. Logistic regression, Naive Bayes ya Support Vector Machines (SVMs) jaise algorithms use karke model train karo taaki wo accurately classify kar sake. 4. **Prediction**: Last mein trained model se check karo ki input essay plagiarized hai ya nahi. Agar model predict karta he ki plagiarized hai, toh database mein search karke source dhundo ki text kahan se copy hua hai. Overall, ML se hum ek accurate plagiarism detector bana sakte hain jo academic integrity maintain karne mein help karega.

instruction: In dono art works ke beech ka difference batao: 'The Starry Night' (Vincent van Gogh) aur 'The Night Before the Circus' (Vik Muniz).
output: Van Gogh ki 'The Starry Night' aur Vik Muniz ki 'The Night Before the Circus' dono kaafi alag hain. Pehli baat toh ye ki dono artists different time periods aur movements se hain. 'The Starry Night' 1889 mein Van Gogh ne banayi thi, jo Post-Impressionist tha. Wahi 'The Night Before the Circus' 2007 mein Vik Muniz ne banayi, jo unconventional materials use karne ke liye jaana jata ah. Subject matter bhi totally different hai. 'The Starry Night' mein ek night landscape hai swirling clouds aur moon ke saath, jo shayad Van Gogh ki turbulent mental state dikhata hai. Dusri taraf, 'The Night Before the Circus' mein circus performers ko dikhaya gaya hai jo performance ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh wahan kaafi energy hai. Medium aur technique ka bhi bada difference hai. 'The Starry Night' canvas pe oil painting aahe, but 'The Night Before the Circus' ek photograph hai ek 3D image ki, jise Muniz ne toys, strings aur circuits jaise random objects se banaya tha. Basically, dono night scenes hain, par artist, subject ar technique bilkul alag hain.

Please enter a different time.") availability_X = input(f"Please enter the availability for {X} (in format DD/MM/YYYY - HH:MM): ") availability_Y = input(f"Please enter the availability for {Y} (in format DD/MM/YYYY - HH:MM): ") time_X = datetime.strptime(availability_X, '%d/%m/%Y - %H:%M') time_Y = datetime.strptime(availability_Y, '%d/%m/%Y - %H:%M') # Getting Meeting Details meeting_timezone = input(f"Please enter the timezone for the meeting (in format Continent/City): ") meeting_duration = input(f"Please enter duration of the meeting in minutes: ") meeting_agenda = input(f"Please enter agenda for the meeting: ") # Create Calendar Event tz = pytz.timezone(meeting_timezone) start_time = tz.localize(time_X) end_time = start_time + timedelta(minutes=int(meeting_duration)) event = { 'summary': f'Meeting between {X} and {Y}', 'location': '', 'description': meeting_agenda, 'start': { 'dateTime': start_time.isoformat(), 'timeZone': meeting_timezone } } return event ```

instruction: Maano a aur b positive real numbers hain aur a + b = 1 hai. 1/a + 1/b ki saari possible values find karo.
output: Hamare paas positive real numbers a aur b hain jinka sum a + b = 1 hai. 1/a + 1/b ki possible values nikalne ke liye hum AM-HM inequality use kar sakte hain: (a + b)/2 ≥ 2/(1/a + 1/b) Isko simplify karenge toh: 1/a + 1/b ≥ 4/(a + b) = 4 Minimum possible value 4 hogi, jo tab aati ha jab a = b = 1/2. Lekin, jaise-jaise a zero ki taraf jayega ar b 1 ki taraf, 1/a + 1/b ki value badhti jayegi. Isliye, 1/a + 1/b ki saari possible values ka set [4, ∞) hoga.

instruction: Original question: What is Roll-to-Roll Printing? Existing answer: Roll-to-Roll Printing is a system where you utilize a full roll of media. Refine the answer using this context: Roll-to-Roll printing is where you utilize a full roll of media (DTF film), rather than a single sheet of media, that feeds onto another empty roll at the end of the system. It is a really efficient system if you need to print constantly. It’s almost a set-and-forget type of printer that will print until you run out of media or ink, which is already faster than single feed sheets that cannot be stacked.
output: Roll-to-Roll Printing ek aisa system hai jahan aap single sheet ki jagah pura media roll (jaise DTF film) use karte ho, jo end mein ek aur empty roll pe feed hota he. Ye continuous printing ke liye bohot efficient hai. Basically, ye 'set-and-forget' wala printer hai jo tab tak chalta rahega jab tak media ya ink khatam na ho jaye. instruction: Is statement ko support karne ke liye evidence provide karo: Studies show that the use of technology has positive impacts on educational outcomes.

Ek study 2016 mein International Journal of Educational Research mein publish hui thi, jisme paya gaya ki technology access se students ke standardized test scores, khaas karke reading aur mathematics mein, improve huye (Savaşci, 2016). Ek aur study Journal of Educational Research and Review mein aayi thi, jisme bataya gaya ki laptops, interactive whiteboards aur tablets jaise multimedia tools use karne se students ki academic achievement par bada asar pada (Abuhmaid, 2011). Review of Educational Research journal mein 42 studies ke meta-analysis se ye conclude hua ki reading instruction ke liye computer-based technology use karne ka statistically significant positive impact raha (Cheung & Slavin, 2013). Toh overall, kaafi evidence hai ki technology educational outcomes ko behtar banati hai. References: Abuhmaid, A. (2011). ICT training courses for teacher professional development in Jordan. The Turkish Online Journal of Educational Technology, 10(4), 195–210. Cheung, A., & Slavin, R. E. (2013). The effectiveness of educational technology applications for enhancing reading achievement in K-12 classrooms: A meta-analysis. Educational Research Review, 9, 88-113. Savaşci, H. (2016). The Effects of Using Technology on Students’ Achievement in Mathematics. International Journal of Educational Research Review 3.3 (2016): 28-38.

instruction: Find the minimum value of (x^2)/(y - 1) + (y^2)/(x - 1) for real numbers x > 1 and y > 1.
output: Maano a = x - 1 aur b = y - 1. Toh x = a + 1 aur y = b + 1, so (x^2)/(y - 1) + (y^2)/(x - 1) = ((a + 1)^2)/b + ((b + 1)^2)/a = (a^2 + 2a + 1)/b + (b^2 + 2b + 1)/a = 2 ( a/b + b/a) + (a^2)/b + 1/b + (b^2)/a + 1/a. AM-GM se: a/b + b/a ≥ 2 sqrt(a/b*b/a) = 2 aur (a^2)/b + 1/b + (b^2)/a + 1/a ≥ 4 ((a^2)/b*1/b*(b^2)/a*1/a)^(1/4) = 4, toh 2 ( a/b + b/a) + (a^2)/b + 1/b + (b^2)/a + 1/a ≥ 2 * 2 + 4 = 8. Equality tab hogi jab a = b = 1, yaani x = y = 2. Toh minimum value 8 aahe.

instruction: Find the equation of the ray passing through (–1, 3) and perpendicular to the line y = 4x + 9.
output: Dekho, agar koi line doosri line ke perpendicular aahe, toh uska slope original line ke slope ka negative reciprocal hota hai. Yahan given line ka slope 4 hai, to hamari line ka slope -1/4 ho jayega. Point-slope form use karke hum nikaal sakte hain ki (-1, 3) se passing aur -1/4 slope wali line ki equation kya hogi: y - y1 = m(x - x1) y - 3 = (-1/4)(x - (-1)) y - 3 = (-1/4)(x + 1) y - 3 = (-1/4)x - (1/4) y = (-1/4)x - (1/4) + 3 y = (-1/4)x + 11/4. Ye equation y = 4x + 9 ke perpendicular hai aur point (-1, 3) se pass hoti hai. Par humein ray ki equation chahiye, toh direction set karni padegi. Ray ek direction mein infinitely extend hoti hai. Kyunki koi second point nahi diya gaya, ta assume kar lete hain ki ye ray positive x-axis ki direction mein ja rahi ah.

instruction: Create a word cloud using a given text. The United Nations (UN) is an intergovernmental organization, established 24 October 1945 to promote international peace and security, to develop friendly relations among nations, and to achieve international cooperation in solving international problems of an economic, social, cultural, or humanitarian character.
output: Word cloud banana hai? Simple hai. Pehle text preprocess karo, stop-words aur punctuation hatao, sab lowercase karo, phir `wordcloud` library use karke image generate karo. Ye raha Python implementation: ``` python import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from wordcloud import WordCloud import nltk from nltk.corpus import stopwords nltk.download('stopwords') import string def make_wordcloud(text): stop_words = set(stopwords.words('english')) # preprocess text text = text.translate(str.maketrans('', '', string.punctuation)) text = text.lower().split() filtered_text = [w for w in text if not w in stop_words] # generate word cloud wordcloud = WordCloud(background_color='white', width=800, height=400, max_words=50).generate(' '.join(filtered_text)) # plot plt.figure(figsize=(20,10)) plt.imshow(wordcloud) plt.axis("off") plt.tight_layout(pad=0) plt.show() make_wordcloud('The United Nations (UN) is an intergovernmental organization, established 24 October 1945 to promote international peace and security, to develop friendly relations among nations, and to achieve international cooperation in solving international problems of an economic, social, cultural, or humanitarian character.') ``` Is code se ek image banegi jisme common words bade dikhenge. 'nations', 'international', 'security', 'peace', aur 'problems' bade ayenge kyunki wo baar-baar use huye hain. Main AI hoon, image nahi dikha sakta, toh code khud run kar lo.

instruction: Ek plant-based dish ki recipe banao jo kisi badi vegan dinner party ke liye sahi rahe.
output: Ye le ek mast vegan shepherd's pie ki recipe, badi party ke liye perfect hai: Ingredients: - 6 bade potatoes, peeled aur chopped - ½ cup unsweetened almond milk - 2 tablespoons vegan butter - Salt aur pepper, taste ke hisaab se - 2 tablespoons olive oil - 1 bada onion, diced - 2 cloves garlic, minced - 2 carrots, peeled aur diced - 200g sliced mushrooms - 2 cups cooked lentils - 2 tablespoons tomato paste - 1 tablespoon soy sauce - 1 teaspoon dried thyme - ½ cup frozen peas - ½ cup vegetable broth Instructions: 1. Oven ko 200°C (400°F) pe preheat kar lo. 2. Potatoes ko bade pot mein boil karo jab tak wo soft na ho jayein (approx 20 mins). 3. Paani nikaal kar unhe almond milk, vegan butter, salt or pepper ke saath mash kar lo jab tak smooth na ho jayein. Side mein rakh do. 4. Ek bade frying pan mein olive oil garam karo. Onion, garlic, carrots aur mushrooms daal kar sauté karo jab tak vegetables tender na ho jayein (approx 10 mins). 5. Ab lentils, tomato paste, soy sauce, thyme, peas aur vegetable broth daalo, aur 5 mins aur pakaao. 6. Lentil mixture mein salt aur pepper daalo, phir usko ek bade baking dish mein transfer kar lo. 7. Mashed potato mixture ko lentil mixture ke upar evenly spread kar do. 8. Shepherd's pie ko 30-35 mins tak bake karo, jab tak potato topping golden brown na ho jaye. 9. Garam-garam serve karo, aur agar chahiye toh fresh thyme ya parsley se garnish kar lo. Ye kaafi flavorful dish ha, vegan guests ko zaroor pasand aayegi. Isse 6-8 log kha sakte hain, aur agar group bada hai to quantity double kar dena. Enjoy!

instruction: Ek Python script likho jo kisi string se saare unique characters ki list nikaal sake.
output: Ye raha Python script jo string se unique characters ki list banata hai: ```python def unique_chars(string): # Create an empty set to store unique characters unique_set = set() # Go through each character of the string for char in string: # If the character is not in the set, add it if char not in unique_set: unique_set.add(char) # Create a list from the set of unique characters unique_list = list(unique_set) # Return the list of unique characters return unique_list # Define a test string test_string = "I am loving python" # Get the list of unique characters result = unique_chars(test_string) # Print the resulting list print(result) ``` Is script mein `unique_chars` naam ka function hai jo string argument leta hai. Function ke andar ek empty set banaya hai unique characters store karne ke liye. Phir function string ke har character pe jaata hai aur check karta hai ki wo set mein hai ya nah. Agar nahi hai, ta usko add kar deta hai. Last mein, us set ko list mein convert karke return kar diya. Phir result ko print kar diya.

instruction: Is text se names extract karne ke liye ek regular expression banao: "John Jones, Sarah Smith, and Mark Miller"
output: Iske liye `\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z-]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)*\b` wala regex sahi rahega. Ye pehle capitalized word ko match karta ha aur phir assume karta hai ki first aur last name honge. Steps ye hain: 1. 're' module import karo Python mein. ```python import re ``` 2. Ek text variable define karo. ```python text = "John Jones, Sarah Smith, and Mark Miller" ``` 3. Regex pattern create karo. ```python pattern = r"\b[A-Z][a-zA-Z-]+(?:\s[A-Z][a-z]+)*\b" ``` 4. `re.findall` use karke saare matches nikaal lo. ```python names = re.findall(pattern, text) ``` 5. List ko print kar lo. ```python print(names) # ['John Jones', 'Sarah Smith', 'Mark Miller'] ```

instruction: Diye gaye data se pie chart banane ke liye ek script likho: Small Business (15%), Medium Business (25%), Large Business (60%)
output: Aap Python aur Matplotlib library use karke ye script likh sakte hain: ```python import matplotlib.pyplot as plt # Data as a dictionary data = {"Small Business": 15, "Medium Business": 25, "Large Business": 60} # Create a figure and axis fig, ax = plt.subplots() # Create the pie chart ax.pie(data.values(), labels=data.keys(), startangle=90, autopct='%1.1f%%') # Set the title ax.set_title("Business Distribution") # Show the chart plt.show() ``` Ye script Matplotlib ke `pie` function ko use karke pie chart banata hai, jisme values aur labels pass karne hote hain. Percentage dikhane ke liye `autopct` parameter use kiya gaya he. Start angle 90 degrees rakha hai aur title "Business Distribution" set kiya hai. Finally, `show` function se chart display ho jayega.

instruction: Wildlife pe climate change ka kya impact hua hai, ispe 500 words ka ek essay likho.
output: Climate change ek global phenomenon hai jisne duniya ke har region ko affect kiya ah, aur local environment aur ecological systems pe iska bada asar pada hai. Is changing climate ka ek critical outcome wildlife pe iska impact hai, jiske effects kaafi remarkable aur disturbing rahe hain. Wildlife pe climate change ka sabse noticeable impact habitats mein badlav hai. Climate change global weather patterns ko change kar raha hai, jiski wajah se temperature aur precipitation zones shift ho rahe hain. Is wajah se bahut saare animals ya toh behtar conditions ki talash mein apne habitats chhod rahe hain ya fir nayi climate ke hisaab se adapt kar rahe hain. For example, North pole mein temperatures badhne se polar bears ko khane ki talash mein aur door jaana pad raha aahe, aur malnutrition ki wajah se is species ki population gir gayi hai. Wahin doosri taraf, insects, fish aur birds jaise animals ne apne migratory patterns badal liye hain, taaki wo nayi magar kam desirable conditions mein survive kar sakein. Habitats ke alawa, climate change se ocean temperatures badhe hain aur acidification hua hai. Seawater temperature badhne se coral bleaching hui hai, jisne marine wildlife populations ko nuksan pahunchaya hai. Garam paani fish populations ko stress de raha hai, jis wajah se kai species ki ginti kam ho rahi hai ya wo cooler water ki talash mein migrate kar rahi hain. Sirf marine animals hi nahi, balki seabirds jo fish aur marine life pe depend karte hain, unhe bhi apna diet badalna pada hai warna starvation ka risk tha. Global weather patterns mein badlav se natural disasters jaise hurricanes, droughts or flooding ki frequency aur intensity badh gayi hai, jisne humans aur wildlife dono ko affect kiya he. Flooding aur tez hawayein habitats ko destroy kar sakti hain, khaaskar coastal regions mein jahan kai species ke breeding grounds hote hain. Droughts ki wajah se un regions mein paani ki kami ho jati hai jo pehle se arid hain, jisse species ke liye drinking water dhoondna mushkil ho jata hai. Droughts se vegetation ka loss hota hai, jo herbivores ko affect karta hai kyunki wo plants pe depend karte hain, jis se unki population ghat jati hai. Moreover, climate change ko biodiversity loss ka ek bada factor mana jata hai jo aaj kal hum dekh rahe hain. IUCN Red List, jo conservation status ki global inventory hai, batati hai ki presently, four mein se ek mammal, eight mein se ek bird, or one-third amphibians extinction ke risk pe hain. Climate change in sab groups ko affect kar raha hai aur extinction ka risk badha raha hai. Maana ki climate change ke impact ko deny nahi kiya ja sakta,

instruction: Ek Python program likho jo meal ki total cost calculate kare, ingredients aur unke price ke basis pe. Lettuce (3 oz): $1.50; Tomatoes (2 pcs): $0.50; Onion (1 pc): $0.20; Garlic (2 cloves): $0.05
output: Ye lo Python program, isse tumhari meal cost calculate ho jayegi: ```python # Input data in dictionary meal = { 'Lettuce (3 oz)': 1.5, 'Tomatoes (2 pcs)': 0.5, 'Onion (1 pc)': 0.2, 'Garlic (2 cloves)': 0.05 } # Calculate total cost total_cost = sum(meal.values()) # Print the result print(f'The total cost of this meal would be ${total_cost:.2f}') ``` Jab tum is script ko run karoge, toh output aayega: `The total cost of this meal would be $2.25`. Is program mein humne ek dictionary `meal` use ki hai jisme ingredients keys hain aur unki costs values. `total_cost` variable `sum` function use karke dictionary ki saari values ko add kar raha hai. Finally, `print` function formatted text aur `total_cost` variable display karta hai jo 2 decimal places tak dikhta hai.

instruction: Linear regression aur decision trees ke advantages aur disadvantages compare karke batao.
output: Linear Regression aur Decision Trees dono predictive models banane ke popular machine learning approaches hain. Dono ke apne advantages aur disadvantages hain, aur choice is baat pe depend karti aahe ki problem kya hai. Linear Regression ke Advantages: 1. Simplicity: Linear regression models ko samajhna aur interpret karna simple hai. 2. Speed: Ye models bade datasets pe bhi kaafi fast train ho jate hain. 3. Numeric Output: Numeric output ya continuous variables jaise weight ya price predict karne ke liye ye best hai. Linear Regression ke Disadvantages: 1. Linearity Assumption: Ye assume karta hai ki independent aur dependent variables ke beech linear relationship ha, jo real-world mein hamesha nahi hota. 2. Sensitivity to Outliers: Ye models outliers ke liye sensitive hote hain, jo results ko skew kar sakte hain aur accuracy kam kar dete hain. Decision Trees ke Advantages: 1. Easy to Understand: Inhe samajhna simple hai. Tree structure decision-making process ko visually aur intuitively represent karta hai. 2. Non-Parametric: Decision trees non-parametric hote hain, matlab ye data distribution ke baare mein koi assumptions nahi lete. 3. Categorical Variables: Ye bina kisi encoding ke categorical variables ko easily handle kar sakte hain. Decision Trees ke Disadvantages: 1. Prone to Overfitting: Inme overfitting ka risk zyada hota hai, khaaskar jab tree bahut deep ho jaye. Isse unseen data pe accuracy gir sakti hai. 2. Tendency to Bias: Decision trees un variables ki taraf bias ho sakte hain jinme zyada levels hote hain, jis se splitting sub-optimal ho sakti hai. Conclusion ye hai ki dono ke apne pros aur cons hain. Linear regression simple aur fast hai numeric output ke liye, jabki decision trees intuitive hain aur categorical variables handle kar lete hain. Linear regression linearity assume karta hai aur outliers se affect hota hai, jabki decision trees overfitting aur bias ka shikaar ho sakte hain. Final choice problem ki specifics pe depend karegi.

instruction: News mein jo padha uske baare mein batao: The discovery of an exoplanet orbiting two suns
output: Abhi haal hi mein scientists ne ek exciting discovery ki hai—ek exoplanet jo do suns ke orbit mein hai, jise circumbinary orbit kehte hain. Is planet ka naam TOI-1338 b hai, jo Earth se lagbhag 1,300 light-years door Pictor constellation mein ha. TOI-1338 b ek gas giant exoplanet hai, jo Earth se almost 7 times bada hai, aur do suns ka ek single orbit complete karne mein isse nearly 95 Earth days lagte hain. NASA ke Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) ne isse transit method use karke dhoonda hai. Ye discovery isliye khaas hai kyunki abhi tak sirf ek dozen aise planets mile hain jo do stars ke orbit mein hon, toh ye kaafi rare occurrence hai. TOI-1338 b ke do suns bhi kaafi alag hain—ek hamare sun se 10% bada hai, jabki doosra kaafi cooler, dim aur hamare sun ke size ka sirf one-third hai. Ye interesting discovery circumbinary systems mein exoplanets ke formation aur existence ki hamari understanding ko aur behtar banati hai.

instruction: (1,1) aur (4,7) points ke beech ka distance find karo. Answer simplest radical form mein hona chahiye.
output: (1,1) aur (4,7) ke beech ka horizontal separation 4-1=3 units hai. Vertical separation 7-1=6 units hai. Toh, (1,1) aur (4,7) endpoints wala segment ek right triangle ka hypotenuse hai jiske legs 3 units aur 6 units hain. Pythagorean theorem use karke, is segment ki length sqrt(3^2+6^2)=3sqrt(1^2+2^2)=3sqrt(5) hogi.

instruction: Product ka maximum price calculate karo agar total cost aur profit margin diya ho. Total cost: $20 Profit Margin: 40%
output: Max price nikalne ke liye simple hai, total cost mein wo profit add kar do jo tumhe chahiye. Profit margin 40% hai, toh total cost ka 40% nikalna hoga. Pehle $20 ka 40% calculate karo. Profit = (profit margin / 100) * total cost = (40/100) * 20 = 8 Toh product ka maximum price hoga total cost plus profit, yaani $20 + $8 = $28.

instruction: Ek situation ke liye equation formulate karo. Person A ke paas 3 copies hain ek book ki, aur Person B ke paas usse double.

instruction: Ek integers ka array diya hai, use aise rearrange karo ki even position wale elements apne preceding aur succeeding elements se bade hon. [5, 3, 6, 1, 8]
output: Iska ek possible solution ye hoga ki pehle array ko non-descending order mein sort kar lo, matlab [1, 3, 5, 6, 8]. Phir second element (index 1) se start karke, adjacent elements ko iteratively swap karte jao. ```python def rearrange_array(arr): arr.sort() for i in range(1, len(arr)-1, 2): arr[i], arr[i+1] = arr[i+1], arr[i] return arr ``` Upar wale input ke liye swaps aise honge: [1,3,5,6,8] → [1,5,3,6,8] → [1,5,6,3,8]. Final rearranged array aayega: [1, 5, 3, 6, 8]. Yahan saare even position elements - 5 (index 1) aur 6 (index 3) apne padosi elements se bade hain. Note kar lena ki array zero-indexed hai, toh pehla element odd position par hai; sirf even index positions - matlab 2, 4, 6 wagera - ye condition follow karte hain.

instruction: Ek code likho jisme kisi list ke particular number ki value store aur access ki ja sake, by passing the address of the location as a parameter.
output: Ye raha ek Python code ka example jo is instruction ko implement karta hai: ```python def main(): # initialize the list of numbers numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # get the address of the third element loc = id(numbers[2]) # store a value at the location store_value(loc, 10) # access the value at the location value = access_value(loc) print(value) def store_value(location, value): """Stores a value at a memory location.""" # get the object at the location obj = get_object(location) # store the value obj.value = value def access_value(location): """Accesses the value at a memory location""" # get the object at the location obj= get_object(location) # access the value value = obj.value return value def get_object(location): """Gets an object at a memory location.""" # get the ctypes library import ctypes # get the object at the memory location obj = ctypes.cast(location, ctypes.py_object).value return obj if __name__ == '__main__': main() ``` Jab tum ye code run karoge, toh ye `store_value()` function use karke list ke third element ki memory location par value 10 store karega (jiski initial value 3 thi). Phir `access_value()` function use karke usi location se value access karega, aur result 10 aayega. Finally, code console par 10 print kar dega.

Uske baad se, Isabella aur bhi zyada passion aur grace ke saath dance karne lagi, kyunki use pata tha ki uski strength aur determination ne use life ke sabse bade challenge se jeetaya hai. instruction: x, y, z positive real numbers hain aur xyz = 8 hai. x + 2y + 4z ki minimum value nikalo.
output: Dekho, x, y, z positive real numbers hain aur xyz = 8 ah. Hume x + 2y + 4z ki minimum value chahiye. AM-GM inequality use karenge toh: x + 2y + 4z ≥ 3 (x * 2y * 4z)^(1/3) = 3 (8xyz)^(1/3) = 3 (8 * 8)^(1/3) = 12. Equality tab hogi jab x = 2y = 4z aur xyz = 8. Solve karne pe x = 4, y = 2, aur z = 1 aayega. Toh minimum value 12 hi hai.

instruction: Is sentence ki dependencies analyze karo: "At the end of the week, I want to take a vacation"
output: Dekho, is sentence mein kaafi syntactic dependencies hain. Scene yeh hai: 1. 'End', 'of' aur 'week' milke 'end of the week' banate hain, jo time expression ka kaam karta hai. 2. 'At' pure phrase 'the end of the week' pe depend karta hai, jo sentence ka time setting batata hai. 3. 'want' main verb hai aur root word hai, jo subject 'I' pe depend karta hai. 4. 'to take', 'want' pe depend karta he taaki 'I want to take' ka meaning nikle. 5. 'Vacation' verb 'take' pe depend karta hai, kyunki wahi cheez leni hai. Overall structure: Adverbial Phrase + Subject + Verb + Direct Object hai. Basically, subject (I) ki desire ('want') aahe ki vo ek action ('take') kare jiska object 'vacation' hai, aur time 'at the end of the week' hai.

instruction: Maan lo f : ℝ→ℝ ek function hai jiske liye f(x) f(y) - f(xy) = x + y har real number x aur y ke liye true hai. Agar f(2) ki possible values ka number n hai, aur un sab values ka sum s hai, toh n × s find karo.
output: Dekho, f: ℝ → ℝ function diya hai jahan f(x) f(y) - f(xy) = x + y hai. Sabse pehle x = y = 1 rakhte hain, toh f(1)^2 - f(1) = 2 milta hai. Isko factor karenge ta (f(1) + 1)(f(1) - 2) = 0 aayega, matlab f(1) = -1 ya f(1) = 2. Ab y = 1 rakhte hain, toh f(x) f(1) - f(x) = x + 1 aayega. Isko simplify karke f(x) (f(1) - 1) = x + 1 likh sakte hain. Kyunki f(1) ≠ 1 hai, toh f(x) = (x + 1)/(f(1) - 1) ho jayega. Agar f(1) = -1 hai, toh f(x) = (x + 1)/(-2), par check karne pe pata chalta hai ki yeh function kaam nahi kar raha. Agar f(1) = 2 hai, toh f(x) = x + 1, aur yeh function perfectly kaam karta hai. Isliye, n = 1 aur s = 3, toh final answer n × s = 3 hai.

instruction: Tim roz subah apne sock drawer se randomly do socks uthata hai. Agar drawer mein 10 gray-bottomed aur 8 white-bottomed socks hain, toh probability kya hai ki use matching pair mile?
output: Tim randomly 2 socks utha raha hai. Total socks = 18. Total ways = C(18,2) = 153. Matching pair ke liye ya toh 2 gray ho ya 2 white. Gray ways = C(10,2) = 45. White ways = C(8,2) = 28. Probability = (45 + 28)/153 = 73/153.

instruction: Quadratic equation x^2 - 63x + k = 0 ke dono roots prime numbers hain. k ki kitni possible values ho sakti hain, find karo.
output: Maan lo roots p aur q hain. Vieta's formulas ke hisaab se, p + q = 63. Agar p aur q dono odd hote, toh p + q even hota, iska matlab p ya q mein se ek ko even hona hi padega. Prime numbers mein sirf 2 hi even hai, to ek root 2 hoga aur doosra 63 - 2 = 61. Isliye, k = 2 * 61 = 122. Toh k ki sirf 1 hi possible value hai.

output: Ye le ek simple python program jo string mein vowels aur consonants count kar lega: ```python def count_vowels_consonants(string): # Initialize a variable to count vowels vowel_count = 0 # Initialize a variable to count consonants consonant_count = 0 # Create a list of vowels vowels = ['a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u'] # Convert the string to lowercase if it has uppercase letters string = string.lower() # Iterate through each character in the string for char in string: # If the character is a vowel, increase the vowel count if char in vowels: vowel_count += 1 # If the character is not a vowel, increase the consonant count else: consonant_count += 1 # Return the vowel count and consonant count return vowel_count, consonant_count # Run the function with a sample string sample_string = "This is an example" vowel_count, consonant_count = count_vowels_consonants(sample_string) # Print the results print(f"Number of vowels in the string: {vowel_count}") print(f"Number of consonants in the string: {consonant_count}") ```

instruction: Boss ko manage karte hue team lead karna thoda mushkil ho sakta hai. Batao kaunsi techniques kaam aayengi jab aapko boss ko bhi handle karna ho aur team ko bhi lead karna ho.
output: Dekho, jab tum boss ko manage karte hue team lead kar rahe ho, toh dono roles mein effective hone ke liye kuch cheezein dhyan mein rakhni padti hain. 1. Sahi se communicate karo: Communication sabse important hai. Ye ensure karo ki tum aur tumhara boss goals, expectations aur deadlines ko lekar ek hi page par ho. Team ke saath bhi regular touch mein raho taaki sabko pata ho kya chal raha hai aur sab milkar objectives poore karein. 2. Clear expectations set karo: Sabki roles aur responsibilities clear honi chahiye—chahe wo tum ho, boss ho ya team members. Sabko pata hona chahiye ki unse kya expect kiya ja raha aahe aur quality standards kya hain. 3. Proactive bano: Problems aane ka wait mat karo, pehle hi solve karne ki koshish karo. Naye processes lao efficiency badhane ke liye ya team ke conflicts solve karo. Isse tumhari leadership quality aur challenging situations handle karne ki ability dikhegi. 4. Respectful raho: Boss ki respect karna zaroori hai, bhale hi tum unke decisions se agree na karo. Agar koi problem hai toh professional tareeke se baat karo aur solution pe focus karo, blame game mat khelo. 5. Team ko empower karo: Sirf boss ko manage karna kafi nahi hai, apni team ko bhi support karo. Unhe zaroori resources do aur naye challenges lene ke liye encourage karo. Basically, communication, clear expectations, proactivity, respect aur team empowerment hi key hai. Agar ye follow karoge toh successful leader ban jaoge ar team goals achieve kar legi.

instruction: Let r, s, and t be the roots of the equation x^3 - 20x^2 + 18x - 7 = 0. Find the value of (1+r)(1+s)(1+t).
output: Pehle (1+r)(1+s)(1+t) ko expand karte hain: (1+r)(1+s)(1+t) = 1 + (r+s+t) + (rs+st+tr) + rst Ab r, s, or t equation x^3 - 20x^2 + 18x - 7 = 0 ke roots hain, toh Vieta's formulas se humein pata hai: r+s+t = 20/1 = 20 rs+st+tr = 18/1 = 18 rst = 7/1 = 7 Toh bas values put karni hain: (1+r)(1+s)(1+t) = 1 + 20 + 18 + 7 = 46

Dhire-dhire unka movement grow karne laga aur pura town notice karne laga. Jab movement bada hua, toh government ne notice kiya aur soldiers bhej diye rebellion ko khatam karne. Par log piche naahi hate. Young, old, men, women—sab saath khade ho gaye. Wo doston ka group ab lead kar raha tha. Unhone peaceful protests, sit-ins aur petitions organize kiye. Dhire-dhire ye fight pure desh mein phail gayi. Government ne bahut koshish ki unhe rokne ki, par log naahi ruke kyunki unka cause sahi tha. Mahino ke protest ke baad, government ko jhukna pada. Unhone free elections announce kiye aur rights restore karne ka vaada kiya. Wo dost hairan the ki unka chhota sa group itna bada change le aaya. End mein, unki bravery ne desh ke liye 1 bright future banaya. Ab unhe government se darr nahi lagta tha, kyunki unhone prove kar diya tha ki jab log saath khade hote hain, toh kuch bhi possible hai.

instruction: Dimension reduction ka concept machine learning mein kya hota hai, ek suitable example ke saath samjhao.
output: Dimension reduction basically ek aisi technique hai jisme hum dataset ke input variables ya features ka number kam kar dete hain, par important information ko retain karte hain. Isme high dimensional data ko lower dimensional space mein transform kiya jata hai. Goal ye hai ki redundant ya irrelevant features ko hata diya jaye aur sirf kaam ke features rakhe jayein, taaki useful info ka loss minimum ho. Isse model ki performance aur accuracy badhti hai, training time kam ho jata hai, aur data visualize karna bhi easy ho jata hai. For example, maan lo ek store ke sales records ka dataset hai jisme customer demographics, behavior aur purchase history ki info hai. Agar goal customer purchases predict karne ka model banana hai, toh training fast karne ke liye variables kam karna sahi rahega. PCA (Principal Component Analysis) jaisi techniques use karke hum wo features identify kar sakte hain jo data mein variation laate hain aur baaki ko discard kar sakte hain. Is case mein customer ki income, age aur purchase history important features honge, jabki phone number ya address irrelevant hoke nikaal diye jayenge.

instruction: Ingredients ki list di gayi hai, isse ek vegan dinner recipe banao jo 30 minutes mein prepare ho sake. black beans, bell peppers, onions, red potatoes
output: Ye rahi ek vegan dinner recipe jisme bell peppers, onions, red potatoes aur black beans use hue hain. Simple hai aur 30 minutes mein ready ho jayegi. Vegan Black Bean and Potato Hash Ingredients: - 1 can black beans - 1 bell pepper, diced - 1 small onion, chopped - 5-6 small red potatoes, cubed - 2 tablespoons olive oil - 1 tsp paprika - namak aur pepper taste ke hisaab se - garnish ke liye fresh herbs (jaise parsley ya cilantro) Instructions: 1. Oven ko 425°F (218°C) pe preheat karo. 2. Cubed red potatoes ko baking sheet pe arrange karo. 3. 1 tablespoon olive oil, paprika, namak aur pepper se season karo. 4. Potatoes ko oven mein 20-25 minutes tak roast karo jab tak wo lightly browned aur crispy na ho jayein. 5. Stove top pe medium heat pe ek tablespoon olive oil garam karo. Onion dalo aur 4-5 minutes tak pakaao jab tak soften na ho jayein. 6. Diced bell pepper dalo aur 4-5 minutes aur pakaao jab tak pepper thode tender na ho jayein. 7. Black beans ko drain karke rinse karo, phir skillet mein daal do. 5 minutes aur pakaao jab tak heat through na ho jayein. 8. Serve karne ke liye, roasted potatoes ko plates mein nikalo aur upar se black bean aur pepper mixture daal do. 9. Fresh herbs se garnish karo aur hot serve karo. Enjoy!

instruction: Vehicle ki maximum speed nikaalo agar acceleration rate, initial speed aur time passed diya gaya ho. Acceleration rate = 4 m/s^2, initial speed = 10 m/s, time passed = 5 seconds
output: Vehicle ki maximum speed is equation se niklegi: v = u + at Yahan: - v = final maximum velocity (m/s) - u = initial velocity (m/s) - a = acceleration (m/s^2) - t = time (s) Given values: acceleration rate a = 4 m/s^2, initial speed u = 10 m/s, aur time t = 5 seconds. Calculation aise hogi: v = 10 m/s + (4 m/s^2)(5 s) v = 30 m/s Toh vehicle ki maximum speed 30 m/s hai.
